experiences.description: During this tour, you will learn about the rich history, culture, and architecture of the area from one of our highly trained guides throughout the way. Taste samples and enjoy specially created dishes at locally owned restaurants. The tour lasts 3 hours long.

experiences.title: Midtown Sacramento Arts and Food Tour
experiences.description:
Known for its art, each wall in Midtown tells a story.

Midtown Sacramento is a most vibrant part of the city! Among other things, tour guests will learn the intriguing history of murals in the city, while experiencing Sacramento’s current art scene. Guests will also try dishes from some of midtown’s finest menus, in an area of the city that has exploded with restaurants in recent years.

Along the way, we’ll pop into venues with farm-to-fork ingredients and farm-to-glass libations, all sure to tantalize your palate while filling your belly. Our culinary concierge will guide the group in and out of eateries while pointing out the sights and sounds of midtown in between.

Local Roots Food Tours limits the group size of each tour to no more than 14 individuals. Special dietary needs can be met with prior notice. Senior, military, and children discounts are available.

experiences.title: Downtown Food and Drink Tour: Libations on the East Side
experiences.description:
Discover San Diego’s most evolving foodie neighborhood the East Village. Previously a warehouse district, the East Village is now home to an array of eclectic eateries, award winning restaurants, breweries, and cocktail bars. Now bordered by the bay and unified by the famous Petco Park the East Village is becoming one of the best neighborhoods for worldwide local cuisine. Throughout this tour you will learn about the evolution of San Diego’s culinary underground and how an area loaded with warehouses and factories like Wonderbread became the “new downtown” in San Diego, while eating and drinking some of the best booze, food, and brews San Diego has to offer. 

-Walk into 4-5 local restaurants, cocktail bars, and breweries

-Eat an eclectic variety of cuisine from award winning michelin restaurants, cocktail bars and unique breweries

-Sip on multiple libations 

-Local Tour Guide 

-Learn how an area filled with warehouses and factories turned into the hot spot for local eateries

experiences.title: Taco Tour Santa Barbara | Food Tour
experiences.description:
Perfect for team building activities in Santa Barbara, date night, bachelorette party and food lovers !

Discover one of the best food tours in Santa Barbara with a fun and interactive Taco Tour through the Funk Zone and Downtown.

Best tacos, craft beers+wine+margaritas Santa Barbara has to offer on this unforgettable guided food tour. Explore the beauty of Santa Barbara—known as The American Riviera—on a relaxed 2.5-hour, 1.5-mile walking tour led by a knowledgeable and entertaining local guide.

Eat like a local as you visit 5 of Santa Barbara’s most beloved taco spots, from hidden gems to must-try favorites. Along the way, enjoy authentic flavors, learn about the history & culture, & soak in the vibrant downtown atmosphere.

Check out our reviews we are rated #1 Best Food Tour in Santa Barbara.
“Private group experiences and custom tours are available.”

experiences.title: Carlsbad Food Tour
experiences.description:
This Carlsbad village tour features 5 mouth-watering food samplings at unique eateries with insightful historical, architectural and cultural presentations! Enjoy Carlsbad's specialty foods, including Strawberry Shortcake from The Strawberry Shack & Gelato. The goal is to entice your taste buds and stimulate your mind with the sights, flavors and way of life in Carlsbad.

Come and experience Carlsbad Village of the past while listening to stories about some of its architectural jewels. Knowledgeable guides will share some of the interesting facts about the village in the early days. The Village is steeped with history, and this experience will be an insider's view of old and new Carlsbad. 

Alternate Tasting Locations may be added to tour:
Froglanders -French Crepes
The Goods - Donuts
Strawberry Shack - Strawberry Shortcake
Choice Juicery - Avocado toast
Blue Water Grill - Fish & Chips, Chowder

experiences.title: Little Italy Food and Drink Walking Tour: Pizza, Pasta & Piazzas
experiences.description: On this tour, guests will get a local expert to guide them around the Little Italy neighborhood giving insight to local restaurants, shops and vendors they might not otherwise discover as well as the unique history of this area. Guests will get the opportunity to meet new people while they taste food samples at four different locations, two of which include wine or beer samples and one includes dessert.

experiences.title: The ORIGINAL Downtown Santa Barbara Walking Food & Drink Tour
experiences.description:
Eat and drink your way through downtown Santa Barbara with a local—no planning required. We’ll take you to a mix of favorite spots, with generous tastings, a little day drinking, and just enough storytelling along the way.

Founded over 10 years ago from a local’s love of Santa Barbara, great food, and bringing people together—without the stress of planning it all yourself.

You’ll experience the city alongside a knowledgeable local host—not a scripted tour guide. Group sizes are kept smaller for a more personal, social experience.

We can accommodate most food allergies with advance notice. Private and corporate tours are available. Tastings and locations may vary slightly based on availability.

experiences.title: Healdsburg Wine and Food Pairing Guided Walking Tour
experiences.description:
This is Healdsburg's “original” Wine & Food Pairing Walking Tour. Our 4-hour guided taste adventure, hits all the gourmet highlights of charming Healdsburg, the hippest town in Wine Country! Join us to experience the art of Wine & Food Pairing in a fun, casual way. Discover why certain wines taste better with specific foods. We’ve partnered with local wineries & chefs, to offer you a wonderful arrangement of unique tastings. 

Meet your Guide in Gazebo in the Healdsburg Plaza. After a brief orientation of town, you’ll be on to your first winery visit where you’ll enjoy a private seated wine & food pairing. You'll continue your adventure to enjoy another tasting of boutique wines creatively balanced with simple foods. Each pairing will make you rethink the way you experience food and wine. Listen to the winemakers & their families as they share their stories, passion and unparalleled love of the fertile land they call home.

Come "Walking" with us and discover the best of Healdsburg!

experiences.title: Downtown SLO Brunch Food & Drink Walking Tour
experiences.description:
Taste of SLO - Downtown Walking Food Tour | 3 Hours | Food & Drink Included

Explore downtown San Luis Obispo on this small-group food and drink tour, sampling farm-to-table bites, handcrafted desserts, and local wine, beer, or cocktails. Visit five top-rated spots, meet passionate chefs, and discover the city's rich food culture.

Highlights:

✔️ Five delicious stops featuring SLO’s best flavors.✔️ All food & drinks included – no hidden fees!✔️ Exclusive tastings from BBQ to artisan desserts.✔️ Local expert guide sharing history & foodie insights.✔️ Small-group experience for a relaxed, personalized tour.

 Meeting Point: Downtown SLO‍♀️ Distance: 1.5 miles, easy pace Max group: 12 guests Dietary needs? Let us know in advance.

 Book now – spots fill fast!

experiences.title: Napa Valley Wine and Food Tasting Tour from San Francisco
experiences.description: Experience the best of Napa Valley on our exclusive small group tour Napa Valley wine tour departing from San Francisco. Cross the iconic Golden Gate Bridge and visit two of Napa's most famous wineries (Castello di Amorosa and Artesa Winery), where you'll learn about winemaking, and indulge in tastings of 4-5 premium wines complemented by a selection of charcuterie, and chocolates. Enjoy free time in charming downtown Napa and capture memorable photos at the Welcome to Napa Valley sign. This is the ultimate Napa wine tour experience!

experiences.title: Solvang Walking Food & Photo Tour
experiences.description:
Skip the tourist traps and head out with a local foodie for a fun-filled, behind-the-scenes cultural food tour in the unique Danish village nestled in the heart of the Santa Ynez Valley (30 miles north of downtown Santa Barbara). 

Our Solvang food tour starts along Mission Drive and will walk you through the the downtown neighborhood streets where you will taste traditional Danish and local artisan food and drink unique to Solvang and the Central Coast. Indulge in bites of traditional Danish comfort fare and freshly baked goods as well as craft beer, local wine, & bakery treats. Along the way, you’ll get immersed in the local culture and hear interesting stories about each place you’ll visit.

You’ll also learn easy-to-shoot food photo tips from your pro tour guide on this foodie photography tour and take your photo skills to the next level using your smartphone’s camera app. By the end of your 3 hour tour, you’ll be eating like a local and shooting like a pro!

experiences.title: Macaron making with a Master Chef - Carmel-by-the-Sea, CA
experiences.description: You will be baking macarons with a macaron master who has been featured on the Cooking Channel. You will receive hands-on training and all the techniques, tips and tricks to create these gourmet treats at home!

experiences.title: Chinatown Walking Tour: Food, History & Flavor
experiences.description:
There are two Chinatowns, one that you see from a van or bus, and the one that can only be experienced on foot in the back alleys, food markets, and local restaurants.

One Chinatown, the one from the bus, is interesting. Our Chinatown will surprise you with new adventures around every corner. In our Chinatown, artisans form Fortune Cookies by hand. In our Chinatown, artisans practice their craft in small alleys using techniques handed down for thousands of years. And in our Chinatown, the authentic cuisine will enliven your senses with new flavors, smells, and aromas.

We'll explore exotic and unique Asian produce, herbs, and teas from the very people who know them best. We'll uncover their hidden secrets only intrepid locals know. And you'll be astonished by the new finds in secret alcoves.

We'll spend about three hours eating everything from Dim Sum, fortune cookies, teas, and more.

experiences.title: Carmel Small Group Walking Food & Cultural Tour
experiences.description: Carmel-by-the-Sea's original and only locally owned food tour, rooted in this community since 2012. Discover the village's best-kept culinary secrets on this 3-hour guided walking tour featuring five tastings — including wine or a cocktail — at beloved local restaurants, tasting rooms, and specialty shops. Your local guide — someone who lives in this community — shares the history, architecture, and insider stories that make Carmel unlike anywhere else on the California coast, with stops built on relationships we've cultivated with local businesses over more than a decade. You may visit a Wine Spectator Grand Award-winning restaurant, a honey company started by a local fifth grader, a celebrated bistro known for its chilaquiles and champagne cocktail, a local producer of confections made from century-old recipes, and more. The tastings add up to a generous lunch. Over 850 five-star reviews. Limited to 16 guests for a more personal, intimate experience.

experiences.title: LA Venice Beach Hidden Gems Food Tour With 6 Food Tastings
experiences.description:
On our Secret Food Tour: Los Angeles, you’ll be taken into the heart of Venice Beach to discover a lively and vibrant neighborhood with a rich foundation and of course, mouth-watering dishes. You'll experience firsthand what happens when great food meets culinary creativity.

We'll enter a community that fosters stunning street art, both on the main roads and weaving through the city neighborhoods. Venice Beach is a community that embraces diversity through art, culture, cuisine, and hospitality.

At the end of your tour, you'll have sampled some of Los Angeles' most delicious dishes and gained a better understanding of our culture and history.

experiences.title: Chinatown, North Beach, Little Italy: 7 Tastings & History
experiences.description:
Spend an afternoon exploring two of San Francisco's vibrant areas for food and nightlife on a walking tour through Chinatown and North Beach. On their own, they will stir your senses. Together, they awaken you to new flavors, ancient cultures, and a diverse lifestyle.

On their own, Chinatown and North Beach stir your senses.
Together, they awaken you to new flavors, new cultures, and to parts of your heart. We'll start by exploring Chinatown by twilight, including tasting treats from one of the oldest bakeries in Chinatown.

We'll search out authentic Chinese and Italian sites. We'll uncover their hidden secrets only intrepid locals know. And you'll be astonished by the new finds in secret alcoves.

From wine to Dim Sum, Peking Duck, fortune cookies, in the very places where the Beat Generation started and Barbary Coast history that made San Francisco what it is, you'll feel like you've really experienced Chinatown and North Beach\Little Italy.

experiences.title: Catalina Food Tour
experiences.description:
Dine like a local. Experience Catalina's history, culture & foodie fun with our knowledgeable guides on this delicious 2.5-hour food tour. 
 • Enjoy an all-inclusive experience as you sip, sample & savor Avalon's best. 
 • Encounter the sights, sounds and stories behind our well-known historic landmarks. 
 • Relax by the ocean on Catalina Island's only food & beverage excursion. 
 • Experience 5+ unique tasting locations - meet the people responsible for Avalon's food scene. 
 • Tour is limited to 10 people to ensure a personalized experience.

experiences.title: San Francisco: Chinatown & Litte Italy Food Tour with 5 Dishes
experiences.description: On our Secret Food Tour: San Francisco - North Beach and Chinatown, you’ll experience the most iconic parts of “The City by the Bay.” Our experienced guides will take you on a delicious journey through the Gold Rush days of the Barbary Coast. While most tour companies only focus on one neighborhood over the other, we dive deep into both to offer you a taste of the best of both worlds. On your journey, you’ll bite into pizza with a surprise topping straight from the Pacific bay! You will explore West Coast coffee culture and find yourself wanting more of our secret bite! You’ll also discover the inner workings of our world famous cable cars, investigate the naughty red light district, uncover where the “The Godfather” was written and conceived, and wander through the alleys where the original miner 49’ers cashed in their sacks of new found gold. All in one afternoon!

experiences.title: Temecula Valley Afternoon Wine Tour with Tastings and Cheeseboard
experiences.description:
Sip, savor, and explore three top wineries on a fun 4-hour weekend tour departing from Old Town Temecula.
Kick off your afternoon at 2:15 PM with pickup from the free parking lot behind The Stampede in Old Town Temecula, and venture into the heart of Temecula Valley’s scenic Wine Country for an easygoing experience filled with great wine, good company, and beautiful views. You’ll visit three exceptional wineries, with wine tasting flights included at each stop. At one winery stop, you will enjoy artisan cheeses, charcuterie and other nibbles with your wine tasting. A friendly and knowledgeable Grapeline host will guide the day, ensuring a smooth, relaxing, and enjoyable experience. Return to Old Town around 6:15 PM, just in time to catch a sunset dinner or evening stroll through Temecula’s vibrant historic district.

Available: Every Friday and Saturday
Duration: Approx. 4 hours (2:15 PM to 6:15 PM)

Cheers to a flavorful afternoon in Temecula Wine Country!

experiences.title: North Beach Food Tasting and Cultural Walking Tour
experiences.description: On this three hour guided food tour of North Beach, we'll visit 5 uniquely different mom-and-pop shops, ethnic eateries and restaurants and experience the history, architecture and culture of North Beach and the Barbary Coast.

experiences.title: North Beach & Little Italy Walking Tour: Food, History & Flavor
experiences.description:
Definitely one for the food lovers, the Little Italy and North Beach Walking Tour is a glimpse into the blend of culture and cuisine of San Francisco. Stroll amongst the cafes and bakeries of North Beach, San Francisco's own Little Italy.

Named one of the 15 best foodie tours in the USA by U.S. News and World Report (March 2018)

From the cafés and restaurants, to the smell of fresh-baked pastries in the air. Just when you think you can't feel any more romantic, you discover quaint shops with incredible crafts and ceramics that fill you with a sense of awe. We explore the life of North Beach, as we join family artisans kneading love into every pastry or dish. And just when you think that you can't be in any more of food heaven, we visit real coffee shops. And if that was not enough, we uncover authentic Italian cathedrals where hundreds of couples have felt their heartstrings tug.

experiences.title: San Diego Gaslamp Food Tour with 6 Modern Californian Tastings
experiences.description:
On your Secret Food Tours: San Diego, you'll walk into Gaslamp while enjoying dishes with influences from Mexico to the Far East.

Your guide will take you on a mouth-watering food journey exploring diverse cuisine that has evolved over generations. Feast on the freshest fish Taco, the Melt Burger, sweets and of course your delicious Secret Dish!

At the end of your tour, you'll have sampled some of San Diego's most delicious dishes and gained a better understanding of your culture and history.

experiences.title: San Francisco: The Mission District Food Tour with 5 Local Dishes
experiences.description:
Discover the flavors and stories that make San Francisco’s Mission District a true culinary and cultural hotspot. Once home to Irish, German, and Italian immigrants, the Mission District is now the heart of Latino culture in San Francisco, known for its colorful murals and diverse food scene.
Led by a local guide, this experience goes beyond food. As you walk through the neighborhood, you’ll learn about the communities that shaped the Mission and the cultural meaning behind its art, architecture, and cuisine.
The tour begins with an artisan focaccia square from a beloved local bakery, followed by a Mission-style baby burrito from a neighborhood taqueria. You’ll then enjoy a Filipino-Mexican fusion taco (tocino) and traditional Mexican sweet bread from a long-standing bakery. The experience is completed with our Signature Secret Dish, revealed only during the tour.
Perfect for food lovers and curious travelers, this tour offers an authentic way to experience the Mission District.

experiences.title: Tijuana Walking Street Food Tour with Wild Foodie Tours
experiences.description: Join Wild Foodie Tours to eat at your way through Tijuana like a local on our walking street food tour designed for food lovers. You'll also visit Tijuana's largest open-air market, pass by the iconic arch of downtown Tijuana for a photo op, and cross the bustling Avenida Revolución, the heart of Tijuana. Experience all the unique fun, food, and adventure this sister city of San Diego has to offer.

experiences.title: Mission District Food Tour
experiences.description: On the three hour Mission District Food Walking Tour, you will taste delectable foods from 5 uniquely different restaurants, mom-and-pop shops, ethnic eateries and bakeries. In addition to all the delectable foods you will be savoring, your guide will discuss the history, culture and food scene of the neighborhood. Join us on an eating adventure of San Francisco's Mission District.

experiences.title: Icon Wine & Food Pairing at Williamson Wines in Healdsburg
experiences.description: Bring friends and loved ones along for an intimate wine-tasting experience at the Williamson Wines tasting room in Downtown Healdsburg. Your expert host will guide you through five fine wines that are perfectly paired with artisanal food prepared by the in-house chef. Try a variety of our French and Australian-inspired wines alongside gourmet tapas to see for yourself how food & wine are better together. This fun and informative session lets you enjoy some of the best wines in California wine country while learning about compatible dishes.

experiences.title: Downtown Los Angeles Food Tour
experiences.description:
Savor the sights, sounds and flavors of Los Angeles on a food tour of Los Angeles! Your expert tour guide will lead you on a walking adventure through this extraordinary city, sharing stories of early settlers, Hollywood’s heyday, and the transformation of Los Angeles’ culture and food scene. 

On this food tour you will enjoy tastes from unique Los Angeles eateries, including the best bakeries, authentic ethnic eateries and renowned establishments creating a buzz in the foodie universe. Along the way your tour guide will introduce you to the city’s unique history, evolving food culture and fascinating architecture. At the end of your tour, with your newfound knowledge of Los Angeles’ best hidden gems, you’ll feel like a true Angeleno!

experiences.title: Farmers Market Tour & Hands-On Cooking Class in Long Beach
experiences.description:
Enjoy a private and authentic market tour and cooking class in a local home with host BA, a public health professional. BA is a passionate home cook and baker, who loves trying new and healthy recipes. She is well travelled and has lived in a few cities, so she loves mixing international flavors with local, seasonal produce. Also, accommodating dietary needs is her specialty! As she is lactose-free, her son is vegetarian, and many of her friends are gluten free.

Buy fresh, seasonal produce at the market and then join BA in her home kitchen for a 2 hour hands-on cooking class. After you cook, join BA and her sons (if they are home) at the dining table to relish the meal you helped prepare. 

• Guided visit of a local Farmer’s Market in Long Beach, CA
• Hands-on cooking class in a local's home in Long Beach, CA
• Introduction to American culture and cuisine
• 100% private activity
• Experience a farm to table experience
• Lactose free, gluten free, vegetarian and vegan options available

experiences.title: Funk Zone Wine and Food Walking Tour
experiences.description:
Explore Santa Barbara's vibrant Funk Zone through an engaging walking tour that combines curated wine tastings and delightful small bites. With pre-arranged visits to two boutique tasting rooms, guests enjoy guided wine flights while learning about unique varietals and the winemaking process. This tour merges local flavors and art, ensuring a rich cultural experience in Santa Barbara's buzzing food and tasting district. Ideal for couples, friends, and locals, this afternoon adventure invites you to sip, stroll, and savor without the need for transportation. After the tour, unwind at nearby restaurants with insider recommendations from your knowledgeable guide.

- Curated wine tastings at two local Funk Zone tasting rooms
- Enjoy small bites featuring local culinary flavors
- Knowledgeable guide provides insider tips for dining and exploring
- Tour duration is 3 hours, from 2 PM to 5 PM, daily

experiences.title: Manitou Springs Morning Tasting Tour Flavors and Springs
experiences.description:
Discover the culinary gems of Manitou Springs on this delightful morning tasting tour. With five unique culinary tastings and the chance to sample three ancient mineral springs, this tour offers a perfect blend of local flavors and rich history. As you stroll through the charming streets, you'll experience the artistic culture that defines this unique town at the base of Pikes Peak. Ideal for those seeking a leisurely start to their day, you’ll also enjoy exclusive discounts on any tempting souvenirs along the way. Our knowledgeable guides, affectionately known as "Taste Buds," can recommend lunch spots to round out your experience.

- Enjoy five culinary tastings and three ancient mineral springs
- Stroll through the historic streets of Manitou Springs
- Perfect for a relaxed morning experience before lunch
- Exclusive discounts available on souvenirs during the tour

experiences.title: Spirits and Spirits Bar Crawl
experiences.description:
Unlock Denver's Spooky Side: Spirits & Spirits Bar Crawl

Dare to sip where specters linger? Smile High Tours invites thrill-seekers to descend into Denver’s haunted heart during your chilling Spirits and Spirits Bar Crawl. Over three unforgettable hours, you’ll tread cobblestones steeped in tragedy while clutching a cocktail… because courage tastes better with bourbon.

Why This Crawl Haunts Your Imagination: 
- Ghosts AND Drinks: Paranormal tales paired with stops at historic bars—each pour comes with a side of lingering souls. 
- LoDo’s Dark Landmarks: Explore Union Station’s phantom travelers, Oxford Hotel’s infamous Room 320, Market Street’s violent past, and Larimer Square’s restless shadows. 
- Chilling Storytelling: Your guides blend verified history with bone-deep lore—no cheesy jump scares, just visceral, unsettling truths. 
- Socially Supernatural: Bond with fellow skeptics and believers as you toast to Denver’s dead… *if* you dare lift your glass amid whispers.

experiences.title: Ultimate Chocolate Experience
experiences.description: Start with our proprietary blend of chocolate and signature confections then specialize them to your group's tastes, preferences and allergies to take home your own hand crafted delights.

experiences.title: Italian Pasta Cooking Class in Denver (Includes 3-Course Meal)
experiences.description:
Step into a welcoming Denver kitchen and explore the flavors of the Italian Riviera in this interactive cooking class hosted through Cozymeal. With a maximum of 8 guests, this intimate session highlights authentic Italian techniques and fresh ingredients.

The menu you will prepare includes:

- Starter: Cheesy stuffed mushrooms with fresh herbs
- Main course: Handmade fettuccine with Ligurian walnut sauce
- Dessert: Golden bombolini filled with Nutella or fruit jelly

Guided by your local pasta chef, you’ll learn to balance flavors, perfect textures and bring regional Italian recipes to life. Guests are welcome to bring wine or beer to enjoy with their freshly made dishes, making this both an educational and indulgent culinary evening.

experiences.title: Fun Pasta Making Class With Local Chef in Colorado Springs
experiences.description:
Bring Italy to your kitchen in this pasta-making class with Chef Juwanza, hosted through Classpop!. You’ll craft fresh pasta from scratch using semolina flour, eggs and olive oil, learning how to knead, roll and shape dough into ribbons of fettuccine and strands of spaghetti. As your pasta cooks, whip up two classic sauces: a silky Alfredo with cream, garlic and Parmesan, and a rich Bolognese with ground meat, tomatoes, onions and carrots. Chef Juwanza keeps the class fun, approachable and hands-on, so you’ll leave with new skills and recipes you can recreate anytime. End the night by enjoying your pasta two ways — creamy, hearty and 100% homemade.

What to Expect:
- Step-by-step guidance from a talented chef who makes it make sense.
- A fun, beginner-friendly class where no one judges your knife skills.
- Tasting, laughing and leveling up your kitchen game.
- Ideal for: a solo outing, date night, girls’ night or group fun.

experiences.title: Beginner Mixology Class
experiences.description:
Have you ever wanted to learn how to craft cocktails like an international Mixologist?

We offer a hands-on experience in muddling, shaking, stirring, and sipping!

Other skills learned - how to balance a cocktail, how to create sour mix, some with egg white, Simple syrups, infusions, muddling skills, speed and accuracy. 

We are now offering smoked cocktail classes! 

We offer a real bar, real bar equipment in a comfortable space in Downtown Denver! 

Examples of what we Teach -

Espresso Martini
Egg white cocktails
Smoked Old Fashioned
Spicy Mango Margarita
Rum Coconut Daiquiri

experiences.title: Private Vintner's Wine Tasting Experience in Colorado
experiences.description: Our Winery produces award-winning Colorado and California wines, putting us in a unique position to share our knowledge and experience with you on the difference between our local industry here in Colorado and the larger wine country in California. Taste through multiple different products to expand your wine horizons.

experiences.title: World Cuisine Classes in the Base of the Mountains
experiences.description: Come to the land of the mountains in Twin Lakes, Colorado. We will be cooking out of a casita in the foothills of Twin Lakes. We will be preparing food that is local and derived from this area and region. Come learn new techniques and enjoy some quaint atmosphere and lovely food.

experiences.title: Denver's Beer and Graffiti Walking Tour
experiences.description:
Come separate yourself from the buzz of downtown to mill around amongst the craft culture of the River North Art District (RiNo). During this tour we will guide you through brewing process, cider making, as well as discuss the amazing stories of the businesses and street art on our route. 

Join us as we taste the beers made here, explore the neighborhood, experience the local outdoor art and murals, and introduce you to the hottest and fastest growing neighborhood in Denver.

experiences.title: Stranahan's Distillery Tour and Tasting Experience
experiences.description:
Step inside Colorado’s first legal whiskey distillery since Prohibition and discover how Stranahan’s American single malt whiskey comes to life. Located in Denver, this immersive tour follows the handcrafted journey — from distillation to barrel aging to bottling. Along the way, enjoy exclusive tastings of award-winning whiskeys and receive $10 off a select bottle of your choice.

Tours are offered daily and include:

-Guided distillery walkthrough led by a Stranahan’s whiskey expert
-The story of Stranahan’s founding and its place in American whiskey history
-Tastings of four award-winning Stranahan's American single malt whiskeys

Perfect for curious newcomers and devoted whiskey fans alike.

experiences.title: Guided 3-Hour Fort Collins Old Town Food Tour
experiences.description:
Old Town Food Tour offers an experience like none other, as you enjoy opportunities provided by many local restaurants to sample their unique cuisines. You will also be connected with an experienced tour guide who will not only assist in showcasing each restaurant, but also will give you the opportunity to learn about what makes Fort Collins one of the fastest growing cities in America. Restaurant partners include:

- Slyce Pizza
- The Still Whiskey Steaks
- La Piadina
- Ginger & Baker
- Ace Gillett's
- La Boutique
- Hot Sauce Realm
- Sonny Lubicks
- Japango
- Nuance Chocolate

***Please be advised that during your tour, you will visit 4-5 of these partners***

experiences.title: 3 Hour Whiskey and History Tour
experiences.description:
Did you know Denver was founded over a barrel of whiskey? On this 3 hour Colorado Whiskey tour you will learn about Whiskies and their role in the founding of the city. On this walking tour you will visit Denver's oldest Irish Pub, a modern day saloon, and a local Denver distillery. Along the way you will sample different whiskies, learn how high altitude distilling is different than anywhere else and learn some light local history. VALID ID REQUIRED (Co. does not accept vertical ID's)

Stop 1: Nallen's Irish Pub - All tastings and samples are included in the ticket price if you choose that option. Distillery tastings are included

Stop 2: Seven Grand - 750 types of Whiskies, Bourbons and Scotches.

Stop 3: Mile High Spirits - Distillery tastings are included with all ticket options (a $40 value)

Tour needs 4 guests to operate, if there are not enough guests to run the tour you will be 100% refunded.

experiences.title: Denver Cocktails & History Tour
experiences.description:
Visit some of the best cocktail bars in Denver on this roving adventure through the heart of downtown.

From a light and crisp spritz to a smooth and serious Butter Pecan Old Fashioned, there's something for everyone on this boozy Denver cocktail tour.

Visit three of the best cocktail bars and restaurants in the city and sample four cocktails paired with small plates at two stops. 

You’ll start at the iconic Union Station, heading next to the city’s oldest hotel. You’ll end on the Dairy Block, one of Denver’s newest, coolest micro-districts. At each stop, you’ll sample a craft cocktail (or two!), learn about Denver’s growing food and cocktail scenes and mix and mingle with fellow foodies.

Your experienced local guide will share fun cocktail history and stories about Denver’s prohibition days as well as our recent culinary renaissance, putting Denver on the map for foodies and drink enthusiasts across the country.

experiences.title: Denver RiNo Arts District Food Tour
experiences.description:
On this three-hour walking food tour, taste some of the best dishes the RiNo Arts District has to offer while exploring a cool, industrial neighborhood.

You’ll meet your experienced local guide at Los Chingones, a fusion spot run by a prominent Denver chef. Over the next three hours, you’ll visit five award-winning local restaurants to taste delicious dishes with the option to add alcoholic drink pairings. 

You’ll taste house-made ricotta gnocchi, Mexican street tacos, specialty sourdough pizza, Bavarian pretzels made with local beer cheese and seasonal ice cream.* 

In between tour stops, your local foodie guide will share interesting stories about Denver’s growing culinary scene as well as the colorful murals that cover the streets and alleys of the RiNo Arts District.

*Tastings are subject to change

experiences.title: Downtown Denver Food Tour
experiences.description:
Discover Denver one bite at a time on this three-hour walking food tour through the heart of downtown.  You'll visit 5 award-winning local Denver restaurants for delicious tastings. 

You will taste authentic Neapolitan pizza certified by Italy's AVPN, award-winning from-scratch Colorado green chile, fluffy baked empanadas from a family-owned shop, Southwestern fusion cuisine on the brand new Dairy Block, and a sweet treat from a James Beard award-winning chef inside the historic Union Station.*

In between tastings, your experienced foodie guide will share stories about Denver's rich history and architecture. From secret tunnels to world-famous bordellos, learn just how wild the west was in the city's early days. You'll visit historic sites and landmarks like Coors Field, McGregor Square, the Dairy Block, the oldest hotel in Denver and the iconic Union Station.

*Tastings are subject to change

experiences.title: Classic Food Tour in Colorado Springs
experiences.description:
This classic and casual walking tour features food, drinks, local art and historical storytelling! You’ll visit four or five of the most loved restaurants, hole-in-the-walls, and artisan food shops in downtown Colorado Springs (enough for a full meal!). Get a behind-the-scenes look into downtown’s blossoming culinary scene and see downtown from a true local's perspective.

Enjoy historical storytelling of Pikes Peak, the gold rush, the railroad, and more from your expert local Tour Leader. Upgrade your ticket to include a drink package (Colorado craft beer, cocktails, wine or non-alcoholic options) for only $21.99. The itinerary provided is a sample and may be completely different than your actual tour. The tour covers 1-1.5 miles and does not make a complete circle.

experiences.title: Saturday Guided Distillery Tour and Whiskey Tasting
experiences.description: Go behind the barrels with your Signature Guided Tour and Tasting. This exclusive experience takes you into the heart of our distillery, where you’ll walk the working floors, explore your casks, and learn the art of whiskey-making from the experts. Discover the tradition and intention behind your process and see why we are America’s first dedicated Single Pot Still whiskey distillery. It is an immersive blend of education and flavor, designed to give you a deeper appreciation for every pour. Join us for a unique look at the craft behind the glass.

experiences.title: Cocktails & Tacos Tour in Colorado Springs
experiences.description:
Kick off your weekend with a lively stroll down Tejon Street in downtown Colorado Springs, where bold flavors and festive vibes collide. You’ll visit three local hotspots, enjoying taco and drink pairings at each stop—from classic tequila margaritas to creative craft cocktails. Along the way, dig into chips and salsa, creamy queso, and Spanish rice. 

Offered Friday and Saturday late afternoons, this high-energy tour is the perfect way to eat, sip, and celebrate.

experiences.title: Denver Food Tour with Food Tastings in Historic Lower Downtown
experiences.description:
We'll begin right in the middle of Denver's historic Ballpark District, home to Coors Field and the Colorado Rockies. 
First up, you'll dig into a gourmet smoked sausage made with locally-sourced elk, a favorite of the late Anthony Bourdain. 
Next, you'll learn what exactly green chili is and why we put it on pretty much everything! 
As we make our way into Lower Downtown (aka "LoDo"), you'll hear how wild the Wild West really was and see what remains of our classiest bordello. 
Did you know that Denver was recently named the top pizza city in America? At our next stop, you'll discover an innovative slice!
After which, you'll explore local architectural icons like the Ice House, Union Station, and the Oxford Hotel as you stroll through the oldest part of The Mile High City.
We'll treat you to a sweet finish with a traditional cannoli filled with creamy ricotta cheese and pistachios.
As with all our tours, there's also our secret dish, revealed only on the day of your tour.

experiences.title: Gluten Free Food & Brew Tours
experiences.description:
Denver’s best & only gluten free & brew tour with a local foodie, world traveler, & celiac! I was a gluten free travel blogger for years & built & sold the first dedicated gluten free app!

I lived abroad for 5 years, so I bring my world traveling experience, being gluten free in numerous countries, & my passion for food, bringing people together, & travel!

Denver is one of the best places to be gluten free & I’m going to show you all the gems that you will love! I promise those who eat gluten will love this tour too!

Ask is simple: come hungry, open-minded, & with comfortable shoes. You’ll leave with new friends, tasty new food & drinks in your belly.

You’ll not only have an insider’s knowledge to the city but you’ll also leave with a huge list of places to check out!

Must be 21 for this tour as we have 2 drink spots & 2 food spots.

experiences.title: Create Your Own Hydro Dipped Tumbler, Mug or Flask in Estes Park
experiences.description: The Hydro Dipping Art Experiences will be held outside in our Inspired Art Experiences tent. Hydro Dipping is so much fun, and every piece is completely unique! Your instructor will guide you through the process of choosing colors that compliment each other, and guide you through the process and techniques of dipping your tumbler or flask to create your design

experiences.title: Denver Downtown 16th Street Food Tour
experiences.description: What makes this tour unique is the way it combines Denver’s evolving downtown story with flavors from the local businesses shaping it today. Guests begin at the historic Brown Palace, then explore the newly redesigned 16th Street while seeing landmarks such as the Colorado State Capitol, Denver Pavilions, Paramount Theatre, Skyline Park, and the Daniels & Fisher Clock Tower. Along the way, the tour stops at four locally owned restaurants for a diverse lineup of tastings, including bison chili, empanadas, handmade pork potstickers, and green chile quiche. Rather than focusing on just one cuisine, the experience shows how immigrant-owned businesses, Colorado ingredients, and international food traditions all come together in downtown Denver. It is part walking tour, part history lesson, and part progressive meal, giving guests a deeper sense of the city through both its architecture and its food.

experiences.title: Denver Private Food Tour with 7 Tastings in Historic Downtown
experiences.description:
Taste the bold flavors of the Mile High City on our Denver food tour through the vibrant streets of Historic Downtown. Led by passionate local guides, this experience combines food, culture, and stories that showcase the city’s creative culinary spirit. Along the way, you’ll enjoy 6+ tastings that highlight Denver’s unique blend of Western tradition and global influence. Bite into smoky Colorado elk sausage, a golden fried chile relleno, and comforting pork green chili. Try a playful twist on a classic with Big Mac pizza, savor a Chinese five-spice donut, and cool off with creamy Vietnamese iced coffee ice cream. As always, the journey ends with our exclusive Secret Dish, a surprise that makes the experience even more memorable. This isn’t just a tasting—it’s your insider pass to the flavors and character of downtown Denver.

As a private tour, everything works around you! Our start times are much more easy going, dates can open up. It's a much more intimate and cozy experience.

experiences.title: Denver Craft Beer Tour in Lower Downtown
experiences.description:
Welcome to the ultimate craft beer experience in Denver, Colorado! 

Our Lodo Craft Beer Tour will take you to some of the best breweries in Denver’s downtown area, where you will get to taste 10+ perfectly crafted beers while exploring the city on foot.

While sipping beers along the way, you’ll see how a failed geologist started a brewery that defined Denver’s beer culture, explore Denver’s new Dairy Block and visit a small outpost of a Colorado mountain brewery, sip beers from the brewery that made canning craft beer cool. 

You’ll also get to know Denver’s best kept secrets. You’ll walk through Denver’s original red light district, hear about Denver’s outrageous grave robbers, & learn other seamy Denver history!

Throughout the tour, you will be accompanied by a knowledgeable guide who will:
- teach you how to taste beer like a beer snob
- explain the brewing process
- show the history of each of our brewing partners
- share some scandalous Denver history tidbits along the way

experiences.title: Denver Beer Spa: Colorado's Most Unique Spa Experience For Two
experiences.description:
The Only Beer Spa Experience of Its Kind in the U.S.

It is not your typical day spa; it’s a unique, award-winning experience that blends wellness, self-care, and craft beer and wine in a cozy, upscale setting. You’ll relax in a private spa suite featuring a beer-inspired soak (yes, you bathe in ingredients used to brew beer!), an infrared sauna, and a rain shower, all while sipping a curated selection of local craft brews or non alcoholic beverages. Whether you're traveling solo, as a couple, or with friends, Oakwell offers a playful yet rejuvenating escape that you won't find anywhere else in Denver, Colorado, and the U.S.

experiences.title: Vintner's Personalized Wine Tasting Experience
experiences.description: Our Winery produces award-winning Colorado and California wines, putting us in a unique position to share our knowledge and experience with you on the difference between our local industry here in Colorado and the larger wine country in California and other parts of the world.

experiences.title: California Vs. Colorado Wine Tasting
experiences.description:
This family-owned winery label is the creation of James & Mark Blanchard, two brothers with a shared passion for fine wines. Originated in Healdsburg, California, Blanchard Family Wines offers hand-crafted, artisan selections that truly showcase a sense of place, and exhibit boutique winemaking techniques. Their wines, from various appellations of California and Colorado, are extremely low-production and limited in availability. 

Blanchard Family Wines is dedicated to the creation of limited production, hand-crafted, artisan wines, sourced from the top vineyards in the Sonoma Valley and across the state of Colorado. We showcase the world-class appellations of Russian River, Chalk Hill, Dry Creek and Alexander Valley and most of our wines are either 100% varietal or single-vineyard products. Our family roots blend into our company philosophy, from our logo to our product names. We are proud to showcase wines from multiple Colorado producers around the state!

experiences.title: Denver Spirits & Spirits Haunted Pub Crawl
experiences.description: Although Denver is known as the Mile High City, it may also be well-known for its ghosts. The wealthiest and elite of the city used to reside on Millionaires Row, and it appears that many of them prefer to do so even after passing away. Come try some of Denver's best beverages with us while learning about the ghosts who inhabit sites like the Cottage House, Dunning Benedict House, and more.

experiences.title: Wine Tasting with Cheese, Charcuterie, and Dessert Experience
experiences.description: Keeping this activity short but sweet! Enjoy 4 wine tastings paired with desserts, a small charcuterie board, and select cheese. Your host will give you a brief explanation of the wines. A great date night experience and great value you should not miss!

experiences.title: Blackhat Distillery at the Historic Alexander Building
experiences.description: Experience the difference of an American Agave Spirit. And learn why American Agave is paving its own path and becoming its own genre in the world of spirits. You can choose either a tour+ commemorative rocks glass or a tour + commemorative shot glass.

experiences.title: Chinese Cooking Class in Denver (Includes 3-Course Meal)
experiences.description:
Three classic Chinese dishes, all made from scratch – this hands-on cooking class in Denver, hosted through Cozymeal, which connects you with top-rated local chefs, is held at your local chef's home venue and covers spring rolls, char siu bao and mango pudding in one satisfying experience.

Your hands-on cooking experience features:
- Authentic Spring Rolls with fresh vegetables
- Char Siu Bao with pork, honey, soy sauce and Chinese five spice
- Dairy Free Mango Pudding with fresh mango

You will leave with three classic Chinese recipes and the confidence to make them at home. Guests are welcome to bring wine or beer to enjoy throughout the experience.

experiences.title: Chocolate and Wine Pairing Class at The Chocolate Therapist
experiences.description:
The Chocolate Therapist makes handcrafted, all-natural chocolate on site. We are a clean-ingredient company. There are no dyes, preservatives, artificial ingredients, soy, or corn syrup in anything we make. Because of this, our chocolate pairs particularly well with wine and spirits, and our classes have been highly popular for many years. We also have a full-service coffee bar and a self-serve wine bar, so you can come in and order wine and a flight of chocolate and create your own pairing, even if you're not taking the class. The Chocolate Therapist is a completely unique experience, and it's nestled in the heart of a charming historic downtown area, filled with restaurants and one-of-a-kind local shops. We have customers who land at the airport and head straight to our shop for their first stop. We'd love to see you too!
We are new to Viator, please see reviews on Facebook, Google and Yelp.

experiences.title: DIY Watercolor Workshop and Tea Tasting in Pagosa Springs
experiences.description: Discover a unique blend of creativity and relaxation in an uplifting studio environment in downtown Pagosa Springs. This creative cafe and casual teahouse offers a DIY art menu where you can sip on carefully sourced loose-leaf teas, wine, local beers, or refreshing mocktails while creating something to take home. The space is designed to inspire both beginners, seasoned artists, lovers of tea, those new to the world of tea, or anyone looking for their next great afternoon! Your booking includes all materials, choice of DIY watercolor tutorial, and a tea tasting.

experiences.title: Fresh Pasta and Tiramisù Class in Denver (Includes 3-Course Meal)
experiences.description:
Discover the heart of Italian home cooking in this Denver pasta class hosted through Cozymeal. This 3-course experience combines rustic recipes with essential skills for making fresh pasta from scratch.

Your hands-on cooking experience features:

- First course: Tomato and basil bruschetta on crisp toasted bread.
- Second course: Handmade tagliatelle or gnocchi with fresh tomato-basil sauce.
- Dessert: Classic tiramisù with mascarpone, cacao and espresso-soaked ladyfingers.

Your local pasta chef will guide you through dough texture, kneading and shaping while sharing tips for a lively tomato sauce. Finish by assembling tiramisù with clean layers and balanced flavor. Bring wine or beer to enjoy as you cook and dine.

experiences.title: Fun Pasta Cooking Class With a Local Chef in Colorado Springs
experiences.description:
In this hands-on cooking class, Chef Juwanza brings authentic pasta-making techniques to a trendy local distillery where guests can relax, learn new skills and enjoy an elevated social night out in the heart of Colorado Springs.

Your experience begins with crafting fresh pasta dough from semolina flour, eggs and olive oil before learning how to knead, roll and shape pasta completely by hand. While the pasta cooks, Chef Juwanza will guide you through building two rich homemade sauces: a velvety Alfredo with garlic and Parmesan and a slow-inspired Bolognese layered with tomatoes, onions, carrots and savory ground meat. Finish by pairing your pasta with the sauce of your choice and enjoying the homemade Italian meal you created from scratch. This beginner-friendly class includes all fresh ingredients, professional cooking tools and approachable guidance designed to make every guest feel confident in the kitchen.

experiences.title: Gold Medal Food Tour and Museum Experience
experiences.description: Experience Olympic City USA in a whole new way with this immersive food and culture tour in downtown Colorado Springs. In partnership with the U.S. Olympic & Paralympic Museum, you’ll journey through iconic host cities with globally inspired tastings—from Italian pizza and Seoul-style dumplings to Mexican street tacos and London’s sticky toffee pudding. Enjoy your choice of margarita or refreshing agua fresca along the way.   After your guided food tour, return to the museum for self-paced exploration of its inspiring, interactive exhibits. This experience totals four hours and blends international flavors, history, and unforgettable storytelling.

experiences.title: Guided Wine Tasting Experience
experiences.description: Enjoy a personalized guided wine tasting featuring four wines selected with your wine educator based on your preferences. Learn about the winery’s history, tasting profiles, and simple tasting techniques in a relaxed, welcoming setting. Perfect for beginners and wine enthusiasts alike.

experiences.title: Homemade Manicotti Pasta Class in Denver (Includes 3-Course Meal)
experiences.description:
Celebrate regional Italian flavors in this Denver cooking class hosted through Cozymeal. Across three courses, you’ll explore the contrast between creamy filled pasta, vibrant produce and a light frozen dessert.

Your hands-on cooking experience features:

 - First course: Bruschetta with fresh toppings and balsamic glaze.
 - Second course: Homemade manicotti with a garlicky ricotta filling.
 - Dessert: Lemon raspberry granita with a refreshing crystalline texture.

Learn how to balance acidity and sweetness, assemble filled pasta and create a smooth ricotta mixture that holds its shape. Your local chef will also demonstrate the scraping technique that gives granita its signature texture. Bring wine or beer to pair with the menu.

experiences.title: Make Fresh Pasta With a Local Chef in Colorado Springs
experiences.description:
Fresh pasta has a way of making an ordinary day feel a little more Italian. Hosted at a Colorado Springs wine bar, this hands-on cooking experience puts you in front of the mixing bowl instead of the takeout menu. Under Chef Juwanza's guidance, you'll learn pasta-making from scratch, starting with a dough made from semolina flour, eggs and olive oil.

You'll practice kneading, shaping and preparing fresh pasta while learning techniques that build confidence in the kitchen. Then you'll transform your handmade pasta into two classic dishes. Simmer a hearty Spaghetti Bolognese with ground meat, tomatoes, onions and carrots, and prepare a creamy Fettuccine Alfredo with butter, garlic, heavy cream and Parmesan cheese.

Expect flour on your hands, incredible aromas in the air and plenty of hands-on fun. Chef Juwanza keeps every step approachable, whether you're new to pasta-making or looking to sharpen your skills. Leave knowing exactly how to recreate pasta night from scratch.

experiences.title: Pizza Cooking Class in Denver (Includes 3-Course Meal)
experiences.description:
Great pizza starts with great dough. This hands-on cooking class hosted through Cozymeal in Denver, teaches you how to make it from scratch – and how to top it, bake it and serve it alongside a fresh Caprese and a sweet Nutella finale.

Your hands-on cooking experience features:
- Caprese Salad – fresh mozzarella, tomato and basil
- Homemade Pizza – freshly made dough, tomato sauce, mozzarella and customizable toppings
- Nutella Pizza – freshly made dough and Nutella cream

You will leave knowing how to make great pizza from scratch – a well-developed dough, a balanced topping combination and a sweet finish. Guests are welcome to bring wine or beer to enjoy throughout the class.

experiences.title: Spirits of Mystic: Cocktail Pub Crawl
experiences.description: A Cocktail Pub Crawl with Seaside Shadows featuring locally cultivated cocktails -- some with spooky themes! - Join Seaside Shadows guides for a walk through some of Mystic's famous pubs featuring true ghostly tales and dark history of this bustling region of downtown Mystic and hear about the haunting tales of your favorite local pubs and taverns. This tour will feature stops at three local pubs/taverns allowing you to sample a different spirit at each stop along the way. The tour includes three drinks. (Tax and Gratuity included)

experiences.title: Paranormal Pub Crawl: Beer Tour
experiences.description: A Paranormal Pub Crawl with Seaside Shadows 3 local pubs/breweries -- Bank & Bridge Brew Pub with thematic local beers, Friar Tucks Tavern, with boards of beer choices and Captain Daniel Packer Inne -- a historic haunt with the DPIPA. Join Seaside Shadows guides for a walk through Mystic's Water Street featuring true ghostly tales and dark history of this bustling region of downtown Mystic and hear about the haunting tales of your favorite local pubs and taverns. This tour will feature stops at some of your favorite local pubs featuring Barley Head brews allowing you to sample a different flavor at each stop along the way. The tour includes a total of three beers! (Tax and Gratuity included)

experiences.title: Mystic Food Tour Taste the Best of Mystic CT
experiences.description:
Explore the vibrant culinary scene of Mystic, CT, on this guided food tour that takes you through downtown's top-rated restaurants and hidden gems. Sample six curated tastings that showcase the coastal flavors and creativity of local chefs while enjoying stories about Mystic’s maritime heritage and culinary evolution. This three-hour tour covers approximately 1.2 miles at a relaxed pace, making it perfect for food lovers and those looking to celebrate special occasions. Conclude your journey with a sweet treat overlooking the Mystic River, embracing the town's charming atmosphere.

- Duration: 3 hours with 6 tasting stops at renowned restaurants
- Suitable for ages 14 and up, with a maximum group size of 16
- Easy walking tour, approximately 1.2 miles through downtown
- Includes guided storytelling about Mystic’s food culture and history

experiences.title: Local Neighborhood Washington DC Food Tour by DrinkEatWalk Tours
experiences.description:
Drink•Eat•Walk small group evening food & drink neighborhood walking tours explore beyond tourist Washington in to the streets & places we DC locals hang out in, so you can experience the true flavor of the city. 

This local neighborhood Washington DC food tour dives into two of our city's most beloved areas — Dupont Circle's streets are filled with stately embassies, charming row homes, and fabulous people; Adams Morgan is DC's most eclectic neighborhood, bursting with sights, smells, and flavors from around the world.

We stop for eats & drinks in six different places, learning about the communities and culture that built and sustain DC in each one. In between, we'll walk the streets in a way that gives you a true feel for each neighborhood.

This tour is all about having a great group experience & solo travelers are definitely welcome. We'll get to know each other as we eat, drink, & learn our way into the night in this great city we locals call home.

Food tour DC like a local!

experiences.title: Private Loudoun County Wine Tour from DC with 3 Winery Stops
experiences.description:
Let us escort you on a wonderful and relaxing full-day tour through some of the finest wineries in Loudoun County, Virginia.
Complimentary hotel pick-up and drop-off is provided from all hotels within the Washington, DC metro area. Along the way, enjoy the natural beauty of the rural landscape on this scenic drive through Loudoun County.

The tour includes stops at three popular local wineries, such as Stone Tower Winery, Fabbioli Cellars, and Casanel Vineyards (locations may vary depending on availability), with approximately one hour to enjoy at each destination.

This is a private experience for groups of up to 14 passengers, with a total duration of six hours — time that will fly by as you ride in comfort and style in a luxury vehicle.

Please note: Wine tastings and tours inside the wineries are not included. Customers are responsible for making their own reservations directly with the wineries. We provide transportation only.

experiences.title: Gourmet Pasta Class in Washington D.C. (Includes 3-Course Meal)
experiences.description:
Discover gourmet pasta-making in Washington D.C. during this interactive class hosted through Cozymeal. Limited to 8 guests, the experience highlights both unfilled and filled pastas in a refined three-course menu.

The menu you will prepare includes:

- Starter: Seasonal vegetable salad with fresh herbs and vinaigrette
- First pasta: Garganelli with savory meat sauce or farfalle with vegetable ragù
- Second pasta: Tortellini or agnolotti stuffed with artisanal cheeses and herbs in cream sauce

Guided by your pasta chef, you’ll practice mixing dough, shaping varieties and pairing them with flavorful sauces while building confidence to recreate authentic recipes at home.

experiences.title: Northern Virginia Private Custom Wine Tour and Tasting from DC
experiences.description:
Please note:
This tour doesn't include admission for the Wineries. Price is for a 6 hour SUV transfer, additional fees will be charged if the tour exceeds 6 hours. 
This is a completely customizable private wine tour. The locations that are shown are just a sample. If you prefer to visit your desired wineries please let us know so we can customize your 6-hour tour accordingly. 

Some other sample itineraries include the following vineyards:
868 Estate Vineyards and Breaux Vineyards

experiences.title: Sushi Masterclass in Washington D.C. (Includes 4-Course Meal)
experiences.description:
Uncover the artistry of sushi-making in Washington D.C. during this immersive class hosted through Cozymeal. Limited to 8 guests, the workshop blends essential Japanese techniques with a diverse four-course menu.

The menu you will prepare includes:

- Starter: Tuna sesame salad with a light, tangy dressing
- Sushi maki: Spicy tuna roll, avocado cream cheese roll and spicy California roll
- Special maki: Spicy double tuna roll and caterpillar roll layered with avocado
- Temaki: Tuna, eel and California hand rolls

With step-by-step instruction from your sushi chef, you’ll learn precision rolling, knife skills and plating for sushi that balances flavor, texture and presentation.

experiences.title: Kurdish Grilling and Eating Experience in Washington DC
experiences.description: With a Kurdish chef and food expert, you'll learn the craft of grilling methods and take home simple techniques that will make you more successful with Mediterranean food.

experiences.title: Loudoun County 3-Winery Tour from DC Metro or Leesburg
experiences.description:
Leave the route planning and driving to us on a relaxed day in Loudoun County wine country. Vineyard Voyages visits three wineries on one of our rotating scheduled routes, with convenient meeting points at West Falls Church Metro or Market Station in Leesburg.

A Certified Tourism Ambassador guide hosts the experience while a professional driver handles the road, so you can focus on the scenery, wine, and time together. Each stop brings a different setting and personality, and the day is thoughtfully paced so you have time to taste, explore, and purchase lunch without organizing multiple cars or choosing a designated driver.

Choose Explorer for transportation, your guide, and three winery visits while purchasing tastings as you go. Choose Connoisseur for the same hosted experience plus one pre-selected tasting or flight at each of the three wineries. Lunch and additional purchases are separate with both ticket types.

experiences.title: Acquired Taste Food Tour in Georgetown
experiences.description: This is the one experience that makes a good trip into a great trip. This historical area is known by many but few get the chance to experience the great food in the area that the locals enjoy. This tour will embark on a few of DC's gems, while also sharing a few facts and history.

experiences.title: Cobblestones & Croissants: A Morning Food Tour in Georgetown, DC
experiences.description:
Our morning food tour is more than just delicious treats—it’s an immersive journey through Georgetown’s rich history and vibrant present. Passionate guides bring the cobblestone streets to life with captivating stories that reveal the true spirit of this remarkable neighbourhood. Along the way, you’ll sample authentic high quality baked goods, pastries, artisan chocolates, fresh coffee, gelato, and tea from 5 to 6 unique local establishments.

Experience Georgetown as it wakes up to a new day, and dive into the stories that have shaped this iconic district. Join us for “Cobblestones and Croissants”—a morning of tasty discoveries and unforgettable moments.

Note: Our selection of baked goods, pastries, chocolates, gelato, and beverages changes seasonally. We keep you moving to maximize the sites, but we utilize strategic, comfortable rest stops along the path. We recommend comfortable shoes and a readiness to soak in Georgetown’s lively atmosphere.

experiences.title: Small-Group History Tour Pub Crawl of Washington, D.C.
experiences.description:
This isn’t your 8th-grade field trip. On the Insider’s Pub Crawl, you’ll visit iconic D.C. bars and local pubs near the White House with an expert local guide. Uncover the unknown and hilarious history your teacher left out, from George Washington’s adventures as a master distiller to Prohibition bootleggers, scandalous spies, and parties at the White House. Laugh with fellow travelers from around the globe while the adults finally get their turn to learn history!

The tour lasts 2 hours and 15 minutes and begins outside Lafayette Square near the White House. Drinks are not included in the ticket price and are available for purchase separately at each bar, so you can choose exactly what you would like to enjoy. Buying a drink is never required. Walking is limited to just a few blocks, making the accessible for guests of all physical capabilities. 

 Ticket must be purchased in advance. Come laugh, learn, and experience the fun side of our nation’s capital. Cheers!

experiences.title: Washington DC's Best Donuts, Sweet Treats & Walking History Tour
experiences.description:
Recently voted one of TripAdvisor's top Food Experiences in the US.

Join us for a historic Donut adventure through our nation’s capital, Washington DC. Our tour begins in Western Market, which has a legacy dating back to 1802! There we will sample donuts made from a business that’s been in the same family for five generations. From there we’ll head downtown, where we’ll see a restaurant favored by a former President before passing by the White House itself for a perfect photo op. After soaking in some history at Lafayette Square, we’ll head deeper into DC to try some local fan favorite donuts from local celebrities. From there, we’ll head down Palmers Alley, the most instagrammable spot in DC, where we’ll end our adventure with delectable donuts with an international flavor. 

By the end, you’ll have made some great friends and enjoyed some incredible donuts and history. We hope you can join us today!

experiences.title: Georgetown Foodie Culinary Tour & Neighborhood Walk
experiences.description: Washington D.C.'s Georgetown neighborhood is home to some of the city’s most notable residents, local commerce, embassies, and of course, culinary gems. On this tour, you will eat your way through this well-known and prestigious neighborhood. You will learn about Georgetown's early iconic years as we stroll off-the-beaten path for a taste from various local eateries.

experiences.title: All Inclusive DC Signature Brewery Tour
experiences.description:
Discover DC’s craft beer scene the way it was meant to be experienced - all-inclusive, behind the scenes, with exclusive access you won’t get on your own.

This guided tour takes you to three of the District’s top breweries, where you’ll skip the lines, go beyond the taproom, and taste a curated lineup of local favorites. Whether you’re visiting DC or live here, this is the easiest (and most fun) way to explore the city’s best breweries in one trip.

Perfect for date nights, group outings, and anyone who wants a social, high-energy experience without the hassle of planning or driving. 

Itineraries vary as we tour a variety of local favorites but may include:

Aslin Beer Company
Atlas Brew Works
DC Brau
Henceforth
Lost Generation
Other Half
Right Proper
Red Bear Brewing
Port City Brewing
Urban Garden

experiences.title: DC's Original Food and History Walking Tour
experiences.description: U Street's Black Broadway era defined American culture — and its flavors still live on this corridor. Blue Fern Travel's DC's Original Food Tour explores the neighborhood bite by bite: from Ben's Chili Bowl to Ethiopian injera to flavors found nowhere else in America. Your guide reveals the murals, the jazz clubs, and the Civil Rights history woven into every block. Small group, max 12 guests. Every booking gives back to U Street and the community we walk through.

experiences.title: Little Ethiopia Food Tour
experiences.description: The Little Ethiopia Food Tour will take you through historic U Street to 9th street as we visit the heart of the world’s largest Ethiopian community outside of Ethiopia. Your gastronomic experience will chronicle the intricate flavors, textures, and colors in Ethiopian cuisine, while recounting the history of the Ethiopian people.

experiences.title: Washington's Hidden Gems Food Tour with 6+ Tasty Dishes
experiences.description: Wisconsin Avenue is Georgetown's beating heart, and that's where your local guide will start. Your first stop is a neighborhood favorite from a Michelin-recognized chef, known for fresh pita and creamy hummus, and for a line that stretches down the block. Next, a longtime local butcher shop serves up Washington's famous handmade half smoke, a true D.C. classic. Along the way, pass the former home of Julia Child and hear how she introduced generations of Americans to French cooking. At the Georgetown waterfront, sink your teeth into a farm-to-table taco loaded with seasonal flavor. Stroll past the historic C&O Canal, catch a glimpse of the legendary Blues Alley jazz club, and see the Old Stone House, the oldest unchanged building in D.C. Save room for one of the city's favorite cupcakes from a beloved local bakery, plus our Secret Dish, a surprise bite that captures the true character of Georgetown.

experiences.title: Tastes of Georgetown Food & History Small Group Walking Tour
experiences.description: Georgetown is DC's oldest neighborhood, and Blue Fern Travel brings its history to life through food. Walk the cobblestone streets on this small-group tour: six tastings, three centuries of stories, max 8 guests. Your guide connects every bite to the neighborhood's past. Every booking gives back to the community we walk through.

experiences.title: Gastronomic Georgetown Walking Food Tour
experiences.description: Our Gastronomic Georgetown Food Tour takes you to the historic yet chic charm of Georgetown, an area that predated Washington DC. You will be transported on this 3.5 hour food tour across 250+ years of history, and enjoy flavors closely connected to the Northwest DC neighborhood. Its roots are still very much alive and can be seen in the red brick town homes, and turn of the century factories that are found throughout the area. This tour includes a licensed and knowledgeable guide to show you through the town.

experiences.title: Private Washington DC Virginia Winery Wine Tasting Tour
experiences.description:
PRIVATE TOUR IS AVAILALBE FOR GROUPS OF 6 OR MORE GUESTS. 
We will pick you up from DC or alternate location of your choice for a day tour of Virginia's best wineries. We will visit two wineries during our tour and we'll provide history bits, snacks and water, and behind-the-scenes tours and tastings. Each tour is led by a certified wine expert. We will drop you off back around 4:30pm. Spirited Tours offers unforgettable experiences in Virginia and lets you both unwind and recharge in great company and with an excellent wine selection. 
Our team will always 'go the extra mile' to make your trip enjoyable!
What sets us apart:
1. Each winery tour is led by a certified wine expert
2. Guests travel in executive transportation
3. We have several different tour routes (visit our website for details or call us). 
4. We pick up from D.C. or alternate pick-up locations for private tours.
5. We provide light snacks and tastings at two different wineries

experiences.title: Tea Around Town A Tasting Tour of Washington D.C.
experiences.description: Relax in a climate-controlled, elegantly decorated interior. Whether it’s the heat of July or a brisk winter morning, you’ll be sipping in total comfort.

experiences.title: Virginia Wineries Guided Tour and Tastings from Washington DC
experiences.description:
We pick you up from DC for a day tour of Virginia's wine country where you'll enjoy wine tastings at two different wineries and have lunch (available for purchase at the estate or boxed lunch from us) while admiring the gorgeous views. We will provide history bits, snacks and water, and behind-the-scenes tours and tastings. We will drop you off back in DC before sunset. Join us on a public group tour and meet new friends.

What sets us apart:
1. Each winery tour is led by a certified wine expert
2. Guests travel in executive transportation
3. We work with some of the best NOVA wineries and have different routes. 
4. We provide light snacks and tastings at two different wineries

experiences.title: Dupont Circle Food Tour
experiences.description: Dupont Circle has been known as the district’s most cosmopolitan neighborhood for over thirty years.

experiences.title: City Cruises DC: Bottomless Mimosa Buffet Brunch Cruise
experiences.description:
Come aboard for a special two-hour bottomless mimosa brunch cruise. Enjoy our delicious menu of breakfast and lunch favorites while cruising the Potomac River. Take in the amazing views from our glass-enclosed deck or outdoor observation lounge.

Includes
2-hour cruise on the Potomac River
Delicious brunch buffet with freshly prepared breakfast, lunch and dessert dishes
Unlimited mimosas (must be 21 or older with valid ID)
The most breathtaking views of the nation's greatest landmarks
Onboard entertainment with DJ music
Unlimited coffee, hot tea, and iced tea

experiences.title: Capitol Hill Food and Walking Tour
experiences.description: Located within earshot of the US Capitol and the Mall, Capitol Hill is one of the earliest, historically diverse, and most beautiful areas in Washington DC. Enjoy a variety of food on this 3.5-hour, small-group walking tour that follows the culinary history of this diverse Washington DC neighborhood. All dishes served are included in the tour and there is a maximum of 12 participants.

experiences.title: Adams Morgan Food Tour
experiences.description: Adams Morgan has been known for its diversity and ethnicity for most of the 20th century. The turn-of-the-century neighborhood has retained its historic charm while becoming the district's destination for both eclectic cuisine and nightlife. Take a journey through the historic and culturally diverse neighborhood to enjoy a variety of foods along the way. This 3.5 hour neighborhood Food Tour features some of the best this area has to offer while telling the story of how a community lead by example and came together to embrace their diversity.

experiences.title: Fresh Handmade Pasta Alla Vodka DC
experiences.description: In this hands-on class, you’ll learn how to make the perfect pasta dough from scratch, mastering the techniques of kneading and rolling it out to the ideal thickness using a pasta machine. Then, you'll cut it into delicate strands of spaghetti. To complete the dish, you'll craft a velvety, flavorful Alla Vodka sauce to toss with your freshly made pasta. At the end of class, everyone will sit down together to enjoy their delicious homemade creation. Whether you're a pasta enthusiast or a beginner, this class is a great way to elevate your cooking skills and enjoy an unforgettable meal!

experiences.title: DC Ghosts Boos and Booze Haunted Pub Crawl By US Ghost Adventures
experiences.description:
Come on our thrilling, top-rated Haunted Pub Crawl tour presented by US Ghost Adventures!

Join us and visit some of the most notable watering holes in the city of Washington DC, where politicians came to relax after a busy day of lawmaking. The only catch is that most of these politicians have long since departed this life. On select nights, come have a few sips of local spirits while hearing about the city's local haunted Spirits and while exploring the beautiful streets of DC. Join us on the new Spirits of DC Haunted Pub Crawl and visit the city’s historic haunts and ghostly pubs and enjoy booze and Boo's at some of its most infamous paranormal and tipsy hotspots.

experiences.title: City Cruises DC: Scenic Buffet Lunch Cruise
experiences.description:
With the sunshine reflecting off the Potomac River, there’s no better place to enjoy an afternoon in Washington, D.C. than aboard a City Cruises lunch cruise. Treat yourself to an onboard historical tour of some of the most iconic landmarks in the country like Old Town Alexandria, the National Harbor, and the Washington Monument, as you sample creative dishes from our lunch buffet menu. 

2-hour cruise on the Potomac River
Delicious lunch buffet with freshly prepared entrees, salads, and desserts
The best views of the Washington Monument and other iconic Washington, D.C. sights
Onboard entertainment with DJ music
Unlimited coffee, hot tea, and iced tea

experiences.title: Leather Handbag Sip and Stitch Class
experiences.description: Where else can you make a modern leather handbag using a Chinese industrial hand crank sewing machine while enjoying piano jazz in an industrial chic setting?

experiences.title: Washington D.C Street Food Tour With A Local Guide
experiences.description: Discover Georgetown's rich history and vibrant food scene on this food walking tour with a local guide. You'll Start your journey at the historic Georgetown University, one of the country's most prestigious academic institutions. From there, explore the charming Federal-style townhouses and make your way to a renowned restaurant serving a classic dish that's deeply tied to D.C.'s history. Along the way, you'll stop at iconic landmarks such as the "Exorcist Steps" and the Francis Scott Key Bridge, taking in the captivating views and intriguing history. You'll also visit the bustling Georgetown Waterfront and Canal Park, home to a thriving food scene. As you savor a variety of delicious bites, including a beloved D.C. staple and a famous cupcake, you'll come to understand why Georgetown is a must-see destination for food lovers.

experiences.title: Washington DC Saturday Brunch Open Bar Yacht Cruise
experiences.description: Join us for an unforgettable cruise along the Potomac River on our double-decker party yacht. Step aboard and prepare to savor an all-inclusive ticket that covers a lively 2-hour cruise, enjoying both our indoor main cabin and our open-air top deck. Indulge in a delectable brunch buffet catered by Northside Social, featuring a variety of mouthwatering dishes to tantalize your taste buds. Quench your thirst with our premium open bar, where our lively bartenders craft a variety of fun cocktails and provide an array of liquor options, beer, wine, High Noon seltzers, mimosas, filtered water, sodas, and juices. Dance the day away to the beats of our fun DJ, while soaking in panoramic vistas of the stunning D.C. cityscape from the comfort of our yacht. It's the perfect blend of food, drinks, music, and breathtaking views—all aboard our party yacht for an experience you won't soon forget!

experiences.title: DIY Candle Making Class at a Local Brewery in Washington D.C.
experiences.description: Swap the usual “what should we do today?” debate for a fun, hands-on candle making class hosted at a trendy local brewery in Washington D.C.. In this hands-on experience, Instructor Rhonda will guide you step by step as you design and pour your own custom candle. You’ll explore different scents, learn how fragrance, wax and wicks work together and create a candle that feels completely personal. And the best news? No experience is needed. Get ready for an experience that is creative, relaxing and way more memorable than sitting through another average happy hour. This class is ideal for couples looking for a unique date night, friends planning a girls’ night out, solo guests who want a calming creative escape and travelers searching for a local activity beyond the typical sightseeing list. Come for the cozy atmosphere, stay for the joy of making something with your own hands and leave with a custom candle that feels totally you.
