To elevate the experience, pair your sushi with a craft beer from the brewery’s rotating tap list (available for purchase), making this an unforgettable foodie adventure. Perfect for friends, couples, or solo foodies looking for a hands-on, social cooking class.

experiences.title: Sushi Making Cooking Class at a Local Wine Bar in Atlanta
experiences.description:
This hands-on sushi-making class with Chef Jennifer offers a flavorful and fun culinary experience in a charming wine bar setting. Ideal for foodies, friends, or couples, this interactive class walks you through every step of making fresh sushi from scratch while enjoying a relaxed, social atmosphere.

Chef Jennifer will teach you how to prepare perfect sushi rice, slice fresh produce like avocado, cucumber, and mango, and roll two delicious sushi varieties. You’ll create a classic California roll featuring avocado, cucumber, and surimi, plus a colorful veggie roll packed with fresh, bright flavors.

Throughout the class, you’ll pick up expert tips for rolling and slicing, ensuring you can recreate your sushi-making skills at home. When the cooking’s done, dig into your creations and, if you’d like, pair them with a glass of wine from the bar’s selection (available for purchase) for the ultimate sushi and wine combo.

experiences.title: Big Island: Craft Chocolate Tasting and Farm Tour in Hilo
experiences.description:
This is Hawaii's most in-depth chocolate experience. Our 1.5-hour chocolate tasting and our 3.5-hour guided farm tour at Honolii Orchards are both led by experts in the craft chocolate industry and offer an immersive journey through the world of cacao. 

3.5 hour farm tour guests will walk the orchards, explore every stage of production—from harvest to post-harvest processing—and learn how chocolate is made. No question goes unanswered; the tour adapts to your curiosity, offering a collegiate-level, educational experience shaped by your interests. The 10+ bar tasting is also included.

1.5 hour chocolate tasting guests will experience a condensed tour entirely in the tasting room focused on the 10+ bar chocolate tasting and a brief overview of cacao horticulture with much less time for questions. 

These tours offer a deep dive into the art, science, and soul of chocolate. For those who want more than a taste—for those who want to understand—this is Hawaii’s premier experience.

experiences.title: Corner Store Kauai Cooking Class
experiences.description:
This hands-on cooking class showcases the historical and cultural significance of 4 much-loved dishes enjoyed by Hawaii's locals. You get hands-on training from a professional, local chef. 

Guests learn to cut fresh fish for poke, make perfect rice, and balance flavors for four local sauces. 

We discuss the important differences between local dishes and Hawaiian dishes.

experiences.title: Maui Vanilla Farm Tour Discover Organic Farming and Tasting
experiences.description:
Explore the lush landscape of Maui Vanilla Farm and immerse yourself in the art of organic farming. Learn about the unique vanilla cultivation process, from planting to harvesting, while enjoying tastings of your exquisite vanilla-infused products. This engaging tour is perfect for food lovers and those interested in sustainable agriculture. Experience the beauty of Maui and gain insider knowledge from your dedicated team.

- Guided tour through the picturesque Maui Vanilla Farm
- Discover the secrets of organic vanilla cultivation
- Enjoy tastings of your homemade vanilla products
- Ideal for food enthusiasts and eco-conscious travelers

experiences.title: Baumkuchen Campfire Baking Class
experiences.description:
Cooking a Baumstriezel on an open campfire within an environment almost like a Botanical Garden is the experience you get at Baumkuchenfarm. 
Eating the warm cake and dipping it into e.g. Chocolate cream is a romantic Hawaiian experience.

experiences.title: Hawai'i Coffee Experience on Oahu
experiences.description:
Learn from the Coffee Pros about the entire journey coffee makes before it gets to your cup. We show you hands on examples of coffee in it's various forms from farming to processing, and green bean before it's been roasted. Learn how to the pros taste and evaluate coffee and how things like origin, roast level, and environment play a key role in how coffee gets all it's unique flavors. Learn to how to describe what you like and find your favorite brew!

**Enjoy 10% off of your coffee purchases on the day of your tour!**

experiences.title: Maui Catamaran Sunset Cocktail Cruise From Ma'alaea Harbor
experiences.description: Join us aboard the Malolo for drinks and appetizers as we cruise gently along the Maui coastline. Sit back, relax, socialize with friends and family and take in the spectacular Maui sunset on this sunset cocktail catamaran cruise.

experiences.title: Hands-On Coffee Brewing and Goat Feeding Tour at Rising Kona
experiences.description: Morning tranquility awaits at Rising Kona Coffee Farm, where coffee lovers get hands-on with their brew. Start with a tasting of chocolate-covered Kona peaberries before exploring the lush coffee trees with an expert guide. Learn to grind, bloom, and pour your own perfect cup of 100% Kona coffee, comparing brewing methods side by side. The experience culminates with goat feeding, surrounded by the farm's playful dwarf goats, making for delightful photo ops. Relax on the back deck with ocean views and savor the beauty of Kona, all while gaining skills to brew the perfect cup at home.

experiences.title: Oahu in a Day: Small Group Waterfall, Food Trucks, and Lookouts
experiences.description:
Discover Oʻahu like never before on this immersive full-day circle island adventure, designed for travelers who want more than just a drive-by tour.

What sets us apart? We combine stunning photo opportunities with authentic local experiences — all in a relaxed, small-group setting.

Start your day with locally grown coffee at a Hawaiian farm, then take a refreshing swim at Waimea Valley’s waterfall, surrounded by tropical gardens. Capture iconic surf breaks on the North Shore before savoring lunch at the famous Kahuku food trucks.

We’ll explore cultural gems like tropical farms and scenic marvels including Chinaman’s Hat, the Pali Lookout, Makapuʻu cliffs, and the Halona Blowhole.

End the day on a sweet note with fresh malasadas from a local favorite.

From waterfalls to coastlines, temples to food trucks — this is the ultimate way to experience the real Oʻahu.

experiences.title: Hands-On Hawaiian Imu Cooking and Cultural Dining Experience
experiences.description: Join a truly immersive Hawaiian experience unlike any other lūʻau or tour. Our guests become active participants, helping to build an imu—the traditional Hawaiian underground oven—and preparing traditional dishes as part of a hands-on journey through Hawaii's cultural heritage. This is regenerative tourism in action: we share Hawaiian values of stewardship and respect for the land, inviting you to forge a reciprocal relationship with nature. Imu Mea 'Ai is owned and operated by Men of PA'A, a nonprofit that empowers Native Hawaiian men through meaningful community work. Your participation supports local development and cultural preservation, offering a unique, authentic experience led by native Hawaiians who are committed to keeping their traditions alive for future generations.

experiences.title: Coffee Brewing Workshop
experiences.description:
Happening at our farm you will learn how to brew your coffee at home like a pro. Our experience barista will provide all the basic knowledge necessary for brewing. Coffee brewing can be very simple with very little equipment and it can change the way you taste coffee.
During this workshop we will brew the same coffee three different ways, and you will experience the differences of taste.
All this is happening in our roasting room where you will also be able to see the roaster. And if you have time you can also add a free farm tour before or after the workshop.

experiences.title: Honolulu: Off The Beaten Path Food Tour
experiences.description:
Embark on an eating adventure with us, diving into the heart of Oahu's diverse culinary and cultural history. Our walking food tour spans less than half a mile, guiding you through 6-8 stops featuring a delightful array of 13-16 tastings. Venture beyond the typical tourist paths to uncover the authentic flavors that define Hawaii as the ultimate melting pot of cultures.

As you walk through the vibrant streets, our tour not only treats your taste buds but also unveils Oahu's architectural gems and historical landmarks. Immerse yourself in a rich sensory experience, where every step reveals the uniqueness of this island paradise. From bustling fresh fish and meat markets to enticing tropical fruit stalls, explore the mix of ethnic and exotic foods, culminating in modern fusion delights that make our historic Chinatown a one-of-a-kind culinary gem.

experiences.title: Maui Farm to Taco: A Farm to Table Cooking Class
experiences.description:
Our farm's sustainable, regenerative practices reflect in the taste of our crops, providing a genuinely educational cooking experience. 

You'll get hands-on training from our in-house chef and learn new techniques to take home.

Our diverse menu allows guest to experience local cultural ingredients fresh from the farm. Our class is gluten-free and vegetarian and can be made vegan by request.

experiences.title: Hala Tree Coffee Farm Tour
experiences.description:
Explore the lush Hala Tree Coffee farm in Hawaii and dive into the world of 100% Kona Coffee. This immersive tour offers a guided stroll through vibrant coffee orchards, where you can see ripe red cherries and learn about sustainable coffee production. Knowledgeable guides share the estate's rich history and the intricate processes involved in harvesting and roasting. The experience concludes with a delightful tasting session of Hala Tree's premium Kona Coffee, all set against the stunning backdrop of Hawaii's tropical beauty.

- Guided tour of Hala Tree Coffee farm with insights into coffee production
- Witness the vibrant coffee orchards and learn about sustainable practices
- Engage in the art of coffee roasting and enjoy the aromatic experience
- Participate in a tasting session to savor Hala Tree's premium Kona Coffee

experiences.title: Kauai Chocolate Farm Tasting Tour
experiences.description: Experience the award-winning flavors of Kauai on an immersive chocolate farm tasting tour at Lydgate Farms, the island’s original and most celebrated chocolate experience. Recognized globally for its exceptional Hawaiian-grown cacao, winner of multiple Cocoa of Excellence awards, you’ll taste the finest single-origin chocolates and discover how Pacific terroir shapes every bite. This guided adventure is more than a tour, it’s your invitation to savor authentic farm-to-bar chocolate, tropical fruit, honey, and island-grown vanilla in a picturesque botanical setting.

experiences.title: Oahu's Top Hawaiian Food & Scenic Tour
experiences.description:
This tour is all inclusive! Meaning all food is included!

Visiting Hawaiʻi is often a once-in-a-lifetime trip — and this tour is built to make the most of it. We’ve carefully curated the must-try local and Hawaiian foods that define the island’s flavors, from malasadas to garlic shrimp and traditional dishes.

But this isn’t just a food tour. Between tastings, you’ll visit some of Oʻahu’s most scenic and iconic locations — stunning coastlines, mountain lookouts, and quiet beach spots that make the island unforgettable.

It’s the best of both worlds: delicious, authentic food and incredible photo-worthy views. Perfect for first-timers who want to experience a true taste of Hawaiʻi — in every sense.

experiences.title: 2-Tank Dive Featuring the Molokini Crater
experiences.description:
Our world-class staff is friendly, knowledgeable, conscientious and excited to take clients diving. We take a maximum of twelve divers per cruise ensuring a more personalized and enjoyable experience. We offer full gear rentals, private guides, and private charter add-ons to make your experience even better. 

- You MUST have dove within 2 years of your planned dive date.

- You MUST provide dates of most recent dive. Without these you cannot board the boat.

- Dive Gear Information. Provide the Age, Height, Weight, and Shoe Size of every participant to provide you with correct pre-sized dive gear. 

- Diving experience: You MUST provide month and year of every participant's most recent Dive, (approximately) Number of lifetime dives, Certification level. This is required. Without these you cannot board the boat.

- Divers with dive dates GREATER than two years CANNOT DIVE unless they contact Pro-Diver at 808-875-4004 or 510-681-1078 to make special arrangements.

experiences.title: Oahu Catamaran Waikiki Sunset on 40 Foot Catamaran: Food and BYOB
experiences.description:
2025 VIATOR TOP 10 award for WATER EXPERIENCES in the UNITED STATES including the TOP SUNSET CRUISE in the US!

Join us for a beautiful Hawaiian sunset!! We have been sailing the Pacific waters off of the Island of Oahu since 1985 and are proud to boast a perfect safety record. Passengers are limited to 50% of Coast Guard rated capacity for the vessel to ensure your comfort and enjoyment. Complimentary pupus (appetizers) including charcuterie, freshly cut local fruits, chips, crackers, and nuts. Complimentary bottled water, soda and Juice. Guests are welcome to BYOB, but must be 21 years old. Yeti coolers and ice are available to all guests FREE OF CHARGE. Please call to reserve in order to guarantee availability of coolers.

experiences.title: Taste of Hawaii: A Maui Farm Tour
experiences.description:
Experience the vibrant heritage of Maui with our immersive Tasting Tour! Nestled in the heart of the island, our farm offers a unique opportunity to connect with nature, learn about sustainable practices, and savor the flavors of the land.

Whether you're a curious traveler, nature enthusiast, or food lover, our farm tour has something for everyone. Bring your family for an educational outing or explore the peaceful landscapes on your own. Capture memorable photos against some of the most beautiful landscapes Hawaii has to offer.

Join us for an unforgettable journey where you'll gain knowledge and appreciation for the land and the dedicated farmers. Reserve your spot now and immerse yourself in the beauty and flavors of Maui's agricultural paradise.

Don't forget to visit our farm website for more activities and ways to connect with the island. La Kahea Community Farm

experiences.title: Downtown Honolulu Food Tour with 5 Local Favorites Tastings
experiences.description:
Dive into the enchanting blend of cultures and flavors that define
Honolulu's iconic Waikiki neighborhood. Nestled against the backdrop
of the legendary Diamond Head, Waikiki has been a cultural crossroads for centuries, showcasing a unique culinary scene influenced by native Hawaiian traditions, Asian flavors, and global cuisines.

Your journey begins at the entrance to Waikiki at King David
Kalākaua's Statue, where you'll meet your knowledgeable local guide.
From this picturesque starting point, you'll explore the vibrant
streets of Waikiki while savoring its diverse culinary offerings.

Start your adventure with the sweet malasada, a local pastry with international roots. Explore Waikiki’s bustling streets, tasting a Japanese treat with a Hawaiian twist, poke bowls with fresh local fish, and tacos featuring comfort food staples. Cool down with artisanal shave ice and enjoy over five local tastings. Immerse yourself in the vibrant flavors and beauty of Waikiki.

experiences.title: Exotic Fruit Tasting Tour in Kona
experiences.description:
Embark on a flavorful journey through the lush landscapes of Aloha Adventure Farms with our Exotic Fruit Tasting Tour! This unique experience invites you to savor the vibrant and diverse flavors of Hawaii as you sample a variety of exotic fruits grown right here on the island.

Learn fascinating insights about Hawaii’s agricultural heritage, the fruits’ origins, and how they thrive in this paradise.

Perfect for foodies, nature enthusiasts, and anyone looking to connect with the natural bounty of Hawaii, this tour promises to be as educational as it is delicious!

experiences.title: Kō Hana Hawaiian Rum Distillery Tour and Tasting for One
experiences.description: Visit Oahu's first and only rum tasting room with an attached farm and distillery. Located in historic Kunia, the renovated general store of the retired Delmonte Pineapple Plantation welcomes you on this 45-60minute, fully guided tour. Enjoy a glass of fresh pressed cane juice, walk through a garden of native Hawaiian sugarcanes, walk through and enjoy the aroma of our barrel room and finish at the tasting bar, which includes four different rum tastings.

experiences.title: Kona Coffee Farm Tour from Tree to Tasting Room
experiences.description: Explore the journey of Kona coffee from tree to cup on this immersive farm tour. Start with an introduction to the various species of coffee trees, learn about their lifecycle, and discover the challenges faced by the 100% Kona coffee industry. Stroll through the farm to see not only coffee trees but also mango, avocado, and other fruit trees. Witness the wet processing method during harvest season and gain insights into the drying and grading processes. Conclude your visit with a tasting of fresh, locally sourced coffees in our tasting room.

experiences.title: Princeville Botanical Gardens Tour and Chocolate Tasting Ticket
experiences.description:
This 3-hour walking tour explores the nine acres of Princeville Botanical Gardens and includes a 50 minute gourmet chocolate tasting. You'll sample chocolate from around the world, north and south of the equator. You'll see our sacred cacao grove and learn about the history of cacao and how chocolate is processed as you sample our own delicious chocolate. 

Your expert guides will share stories of the gardens' development as well as a wealth of fascinating information about the plants, chocolate and the Hawaiian islands. You'll taste seasonal fruit samples, our garden tropical honey, and a variety of chocolate to keep your energy up as you explore our valleys. This is a chocolate and garden experience unlike any other on Kauai. 

PLEASE NOTE:
If you or any one in your party has been sick or tested positive for COVID in the past few days, please DO NOT visit the gardens until everyone is past stages of spreading infection. 
Mahalo nui loa for your understanding.

experiences.title: Kona Walking Food Tour
experiences.description: The only Walking Food Tour in Kona! Experience the best restaurants in Kona, some of which were featured on the show Diners, Drive-ins and Dives. Kona is a foodie paradise, immerse yourself in the Kona food scene, with at least 7 stops at establishments on beautiful Ali'i Drive. Each place will be serving delicious treats that will delight your senses. The focus is on local, fresh ingredients, with an emphasis on the fresh fish that Kona is known for. Each restaurant will be serving their best and most popular items. Enjoy drink pairings with your food, featuring Hawaiian cocktails, wine and beer. This is a local experience that will give you great ideas for restaurants to visit during your time in Kona. In addition to tasting fabulous food and drinks, you will also hear stories about the restaurants you visit, and the Kona restaurant scene. Your knowledgable guides will inform and entertain you with stories about Kona's fascinating history and our famous Kings and Queens of the past.

experiences.title: Diamond Head Hiking and Oahu Circle Island Tour feat. North Shore
experiences.description:
Experience the Best of Oahu in One Day

Discover the best of Oahu from Waikiki to the North Shore on a small-group adventure designed to give you a true “Taste of Hawaii.” Start your day with a hike up the famous Diamond Head Crater, where you’ll be rewarded with breathtaking views of Waikiki and the Pacific Ocean.

After your hike, relax as your local driver-guide takes you along Oahu’s beautiful East Coast toward the North Shore. Enjoy stunning coastal scenery and popular sightseeing stops while learning about Hawaii’s history, culture, local traditions, and hidden gems.

Small-group experience – Maximum of 10 guests for a more personalized tour.

Local Food Truck Experience – Enjoy a variety of options at Kahuku Sugar Mill Food Trucks, including Giovanni’s garlic shrimp, burgers, local food, vegan, and gluten-free options. Lunch not included.

Convenient hotel pickup from in Waikiki and Honolulu.

Come explore Oahu with a local and experience more than the typical tourist stops.

experiences.title: Tropical Fruit Tasting Experience
experiences.description:
Discover the vibrant world of dragonfruit and other tropical delights on a guided walking tour at our farm. Learn about the cultivation of various exotic fruits while enjoying breathtaking views of the Pacific Ocean and the majestic West Maui mountains. Complete the tour with a fruit tasting session featuring a locally-grown selection of seasonal fruit like pineapple, dragonfruit, longan, papaya, and/or soursop amongst others. This tour is suitable for all ages and offers an enriching experience into Hawaii’s agricultural heritage. Your tour can also be adjusted to accommodate both strollers and those with mobility challenges. Please feel welcome to add a note or call ahead to secure a golf cart. 

- Guided walking tour through the Farm
- Enjoy a variety of freshly-picked tropical fruits during the tasting
- Breathtaking views of the Pacific Ocean and West Maui mountains
- All ages welcome with complimentary dragon fruit lemonade included

experiences.title: Walking Food Tour Exploring Hanalei
experiences.description:
Enjoy culinary delight's while we sample the best of the north shore restaurants. Join us on Kauai as we explore Hanalei, known for it's cascading waterfall's, breath taking beaches, and rich culinary history. The last commercial town before the legendary Napali coast, Hanalei a beautifully small and prosperous community. Our group will meet up at a local spot, where we'll get to know each other and begin sampling delicious food. We will be walking to select local favorites to try signature dishes. No better way to learn about the local foods than trying for yourself. Each of our vendors has selected and prepared special sevings for you. Come Hungry and leave full! We feature an original selection of Hanalei restaurants. Avoid the waiting, or second guessing whats best on the menu! Book today for a fun afternoon of delicious Hawaiian foods and laughter. 

Hele Mai (Come join us) while we share food, absorb scenic Kauai, and learn some of the history of Hanalei!

experiences.title: Oahu Island Experience feat the North Shore (Small Group Tour)
experiences.description:
From Waikiki all the way to the North Shore of Oahu - this all day tour provides you with the best "Taste of Hawaii" all in one day.
Take advantage of the small group setting and sit back and relax as we drive up from the East Side of Oahu all the way up to the Famous North Shore of Oahu. We will share of story of Oahu while viewing all the top sightseeing spots and eating some great local food along the way.

Benefits of this tour: 
・Learn about culture, people, history of Oahu from our local driver.
・Small Group Tour with a more personalized experience
・We limit the capacity around 10 people for your comfort
・Choose from a vast selection of lunch options at the Kahuku Sugar Mill Food Trucks (Giovanni's Shrimp Truck, Da Bald Guy, Seven Brothers, Ry's Poke Shack, Raised by the Waves Vegan Cafe, Kolohe Cafe and a bunch of other food trucks as well) *cost of lunch is not included
・Hassle-free pickup from your accommodations in included from the Waikiki and Ala Moana areas

experiences.title: Koʻolau Distillery Whiskey Tour in Kailua, Hawai'i
experiences.description:
WE ARE OAHUʻS FIRST AND ONLY WHISKEY DISTILLERY. 
The tour is an exploration of an artisan craft distillery that utilizes Hawaii’s superior water to produce exceptionally smooth whiskey.

experiences.title: Waikiki Catamaran Snorkel with Lunch Option: Turtles Guaranteed
experiences.description:
Welcome aboard Hawaii Nautical, you're invited to observe, learn, and experience Hawaiian Green Sea Turtles firsthand!

Guests will learn about the life cycle, behaviors, and threats to the Hawaiian Sea Turtles "Honu" (Learning preserving, respectfully observing).

Set sail for Turtle Canyon on a 65 foot Gold Coast power catamaran from Waikiki, enjoying a scenic cruise along the shores of Oahu. Your goal: snorkeling in warm waters frequented by Hawaii’s green sea turtles! 

Back on board, enjoy complimentary local beer, signature cocktails or wine, and with the afternoon option, refuel with lunch. Keep an eye out for dolphins, migrating whales and other marine life as you soak up the sights, including Diamond Head. 

See Hawaiian Green Sea Turtles or cruise again for free. Reride on trip of same or lesser value on the Oahu, Big Island or Maui.

Largest and newest Waikiki catamaran offering a full bar with two local microbrews and two full sized bathrooms.

experiences.title: Oahu Island Sightseeing and Food Combo Tour
experiences.description:
Whether you are a new or frequent traveler to Hawaii, this is one of a kind tour that will elevate your travel alongside our professional tour guide. Join us on this all-inclusive and comprehensive full-day guided tour that includes both spectacular sightseeing and various foods. Our tour includes many top tourist stops of Oahu, including 8 top attractions (Halona Blowhole, Sandy beach, Byodo in Temple, Kualoa Regional Park, Kahuku, North Shore, Pupukea, and Dole Plantation) and 6 must-try food item places(Leonard Malasada, Tropical Macadamia Nut, Shrimp plate, Kona coffee, Shave Ice or Dole Whip). 

You will see some major travel points in Oahu and taste local snacks, drinks, fruit, dessert, and lunch. We will pick you up at your hotel in Waikiki and pass/stop by various beaches and attractions on the East Coast and North Shore.

Don’t pass up on the most Instagrammable memories you will have in Hawaii.

experiences.title: Big Island: Farm to Table Cooking Class at Kulaniapia Falls
experiences.description:
Experience farm to table in an incredibly personal and authentic way, led be a member of our community who is passionate about growing food, and sharing it with others.

We grow over 30 types of food, and will harvest fresh produce together. We will use whatever is in season to make a delicious meal together!

After harvesting, we will prepare our meal in our barns beautifully finished loft, with views of Hilo Bay and Mauna Kea.

experiences.title: Honolulu: Pacific Star Sunset Dinner Cruise and Show
experiences.description:
Indulge in the original Pacific Rim cuisine, where each dish serves as a gateway to the rich flavors of the region. Enjoy the ALL-NEW show “Moku Ola – Voyage of Life,” Hoku’s voyage of self-discovery through Polynesia from Hawaii to Tahiti, Samoa and Aotearoa. You’ll be mesmerized by authentically choreographed, powerful performances by our Na Hoku dancers, the largest cast on island waters! Elaborate costumes by a renowned local designer,
state-of-the-art audio and lighting systems on the STAR are truly dazzling! Enjoy STAR’s Pier Side Welcome Hula, “Bon Voyage Hula”, live Hawaiian music, and fun Dance Pa’ina until you disembark!

Whether you're seeking a serene sunset or a lively evening under the stars, this ship offers the finest in oceanic adventure with both style and grace. 

For an extended adventure, book your voyage on a Friday and enjoy an extra hour of sailing, making your experience even more memorable.

experiences.title: Winery Oeno Island Style Wine Tasting
experiences.description: Enjoy a 90 Minute Wine Tasting.Our New World Wine Style is Natural, Low in Preservatives and our Winery is relaxed and comfortable. VISIT OAHU'S ONLY WINERY- Marshall, Owner

experiences.title: Food Tour of Kaua'i
experiences.description:
Tasting Kauai Food Tours include tastings with some serious fun in Kauai’s most delicious and beautiful neighborhoods:
- Monday/Tuesday: Kilauea Walking Food Tour
- Wednesday: South Shore Food Tour
- Thursday: Royal Coconut Coast Food Tour
- Friday: Hanapepe Walking Food Tour
- Saturday: Downtown Lihue Walking Food Tour
- Sunday: Hanalei Walking Food Tour

You’ll enjoy delectable foods from one-of-a-kind specialty food stores, local restaurants and food trucks while receiving an insider’s view into the culture and history that defines the Garden Island. Walk away with new culinary perspectives, big smiles, satisfied taste buds and the confidence to explore new flavors. Details of each tour will be revealed to you when you choose the best day and location for your tour.
 • Tastings and stops vary with seasons and availability 
 • Transportation is caravan style - you drive/bike/walk and learn the island with us! 
 • Most dietary requests can be accommodated with advance notice

experiences.title: Maui Catamaran Sunset Cocktail Cruise from Ma'alaea Harbor
experiences.description: Join us aboard the Malolo for drinks as we cruise gently along the Maui coastline. Sit back, relax, socialize with friends and family and take in the spectacular Maui sunset.

experiences.title: Oahu: Dole Plantation and Ko Hana Distillery with Rum Tasting
experiences.description:
Savor Oʻahu beyond the beaches on a journey through the island’s scenic countryside. Begin at the legendary Dole Plantation, where you can stroll tropical gardens, snap photos, and indulge in iconic pineapple treats like fresh fruit and Dole Whip. 

Continue to Kō Hana Distillers for an inside look at Hawaii’s only cane-to-glass rum, crafted from heirloom sugarcane grown onsite. Guests 21 and over can sample premium rum or enjoy a handcrafted cocktail, while younger guests and non-drinkers can treat themselves to Kō Hana’s house-made gelato.

The day concludes at Coral Crater Adventure Park, where you can unwind, browse the shop, and take in the atmosphere of one of Oʻahu’s premier outdoor adventure destinations. Blending local flavors, island history, and scenic countryside views, this activity offers a refreshing look at a different side of Oʻahu.

experiences.title: Alpaca and Fruit Tasting Combo Tour at the Maui Dragonfruit Farm
experiences.description:
Learn all about alpacas at the Maui Dragon Fruit Farm during this engaging 1.5-hour tour. We begin walking around the grounds, where you’ll learn about tropical plants and the history of the farm and surrounding islands. Next, make your way down to the alpacas where you get to feed them, snap photos, and discover what makes them so unique. This tour concludes with a delightful fruit tasting on our scenic patio overlooking the ocean, making this experience perfect for all ages. 

- 1.5-hour tour suitable for all ages, perfect for families
- Interact with alpacas, including feeding and taking pictures
- Enjoy a tasting of fresh tropical fruits with a panoramic ocean view
- Tours available daily at 9 am, 10:30 am, and 12 pm

experiences.title: Create and Sip Fun and Refreshing Cocktails on Oahu’s North Shore
experiences.description: You will learn how to make three different cocktails with Aloha paired with plenty of pupus and bites to snack on. We will go over some of the secrets and the science behind these delicious beverages by showing you how to do all your own muddling/mixing for your drinks. You will get to show off your skills to your family and friends when you return home from your trip to the islands!

experiences.title: Coffee Roasting Experience at Rising Kona Coffee Farm
experiences.description: Discover the art of coffee roasting at Rising Kona Coffee Farm, where you’ll dive into the rich traditions of world-famous Kona coffee. This engaging 60-minute tour allows you to select premium green beans and roast them to your preference using our Roastronix roaster. Personalize your creation with a unique name, and take home a 100g bag of your own roast as a special Hawaiian souvenir. With a maximum of eight participants, enjoy an intimate experience led by knowledgeable guides who will share their passion for coffee and the farm’s history.

experiences.title: Craft Cocktail and Dinner Experience
experiences.description: This workshop is a one hour craft cocktail experience with foraged items and locally made cocktails. Your experience includes multiple craft cocktails followed by a four-course dinner experience.

experiences.title: Hands-On Coffee Cupping Workshop at Hala Tree
experiences.description: Explore the world of coffee flavors in an interactive cupping workshop at Hala Tree. This engaging session invites you to smell, taste, and compare a variety of freshly brewed coffees, guided by our knowledgeable team. Discover how factors like roast level and origin influence unique flavor profiles, allowing you to identify the tasting notes that resonate with your preferences. By the end of the workshop, you'll have the skills to select beans that transform every cup into a delightful experience.

experiences.title: Guided Half-Day Tour Scenic Adventure & Wine Tasting Tour
experiences.description:
This tour is great for the traveler looking for a diversity of experiences all in a half-day trip. 

Malad State Park is one of the most interesting and unique parks in the State of Idaho offering stunning geologic features. Span the gorge on the pedestrian bridge, walk down a short trail to the edge of the gorge and view its 60 foot cataract. 

Take in the spectacular waterfalls on 1000 Springs Scenic Byway as you wind through the majestic Hagerman Valley along the Snake River.

Arriving at Holesinsky Vineyard & Winery, one of Southern Idaho's premier family-owned and Certified Organic Wineries known for their French wine-making techniques and versatile flavors, you will be charmed by the inviting ambiance as you begin tasting a variety of their own creations. Enjoy a relaxing stroll around the beautiful vineyard in between sips.

experiences.title: Yellowstone Lower Loop VIP Full-Day Private Tour with Lunch
experiences.description:
All Stops are subject to change based on conditions and guides discretion. 
Leave the hassle of planning to us and allow us to provide you a tour filled with rich history of the first National Park in the world. Our Adventure Guides are experts that, not only, will take you to the popular sites in the park but give you the best viewpoint and opportunity to see these marvels in a different way than the typical tourist. 

We pick up and drop off at your hotel. 

Lunch is provided. 

Hassle-free planning on our end

*Single travelers may join groups*

experiences.title: Spuds and Spokes A Boise Bicycle Foodie Journey
experiences.description:
No other tour in Boise combines the thrill of cycling with a deep dive into Idaho’s potato culture quite like this. We’ve hand-selected the city’s most iconic spots—think stunning riverfront parks, historic neighborhoods, and the lively Basque Block—while curating a tater-themed feast that’ll leave you craving more. Along the way, our passionate local guide dishes out fascinating stories and insider tips, helping you see Boise through the eyes of a true Idahoan.

From the moment you pedal off, you’ll be treated to scrumptious spud-based snacks, more than enough for a hearty lunch, creative cocktail/mocktail pairings, and an indulgent dessert finale—all included in one immersive ride. Add in top-notch bicycles and helmets plus seamless admission everywhere we go, and all you need to do is show up ready to explore. Book now and discover why “Spuds & Spokes” isn’t just another food tour—it’s an unforgettable Idaho experience that celebrates the best of Boise’s culinary and cultural gems.

experiences.title: Boise River Urban Wine Walk: Sip & Stroll Through Urban Wineries
experiences.description:
No other tour in the Greater Boise area blends the beauty of the Boise River with the boldness of the city’s urban wine scene quite like this. We’ve hand-picked a walkable or bikable trail of riverside gems—featuring boutique wineries, vibrant eateries, and hidden local hangouts—all infused with Garden City charm. At each stop, guests savor perfectly paired wine tastings (or zero-proof alternatives) and flavor-packed bites that showcase Boise’s growing culinary culture.

Along the way, your passionate local guide shares insider stories, tasting tips, and the kind of Boise knowledge only a true wine-loving local would know. With every sip and stroll, you’ll uncover new favorites and enjoy a relaxed, elevated experience that feels indulgent—but never rushed. All tastings, snacks, and curated pairings are included—just bring your love for great wine. Book now and discover why this isn't just a wine tour—it’s a flavorful journey through the heart of Boise’s riverside wine country.

experiences.title: Culinary and Cultural Tour of Boise
experiences.description: Discover the heart of Boise through its flavors, stories, and hidden gems on the Capital City Culinary & Cultural Tour. This guided walking tour is the only experience in Boise that blends curated tastings with rich local history and vibrant culture. Stroll through iconic sites like the Idaho State Capitol, Freak Alley Gallery, and the Basque Block, while enjoying delicious bites from top local spots like Boise Fry Company, Ansots Basque Chorizos, Acero, and The Chocolat Bar. Led by passionate local guides, you’ll get insider stories, meet local makers, and taste the best of the city in one unforgettable afternoon. Book now to see—and savor—Boise like never before!

experiences.title: Downtown Boise's Best Brunch Experience
experiences.description: More than just brunch—this is your insider pass to Boise’s vibrant food, art, and culture scene. During this brunch & arts experience, you’ll savor inventive bites from Boise’s best breakfast spots, explore bold street art and historic architecture, and uncover hidden gems only locals know. Led by passionate guides, this experience blends delicious tastings with fascinating stories and colorful visuals, making it the ultimate way to see, taste, and truly experience the heart of downtown Boise.

experiences.title: BoDo Savor & Sip Foodie Walk Along the Boise Greenbelt
experiences.description: Experience Boise’s vibrant culinary scene with a guided evening of delicious small plates, local wine and beer pairings, and indulgent desserts—all served with a side of rich storytelling and neighborhood charm. Led by a local expert, this progressive dinner tour takes you through one of the city’s most creative and historic districts, offering insider access to top dining spots and hidden gems. Along the way, you’ll enjoy engaging conversation, meet passionate chefs and makers, and discover the unique culture and community that make Boise such a dynamic (and delicious) place to explore.

experiences.title: Tastes and Tales of Historic Downtown Caldwell Food Tour
experiences.description:
Discover the culinary delights of Caldwell on a 2.5-hour walking tour that brings you to 4 local eateries. Taste signature dishes and learn about the rich history behind each location from passionate local guides. Enjoy exclusive access to behind-the-scenes experiences, including special tastings and meet-and-greets with chefs. With a maximum group size of 12, this tour is perfect for food lovers and history buffs alike, ensuring a personalized experience through Caldwell's vibrant culinary scene.

- Sample delicious dishes from acclaimed local restaurants and hidden gems
- Engage with knowledgeable guides sharing insider culinary secrets
- Tour suitable for most ages and fitness levels, wheelchair accessible
- All tastings, gratuities, and tax included for a hassle-free experience

experiences.title: Private Chicago Foodie Tour
experiences.description:
Taste your way through Chicago on this private half-day walking food tour! Savor local favorites like Portillo’s hot dogs, Al’s Italian Beef, deep dish pizza, Garrett’s Popcorn, and Do-Rite Donuts while exploring top city landmarks such as the Tribune Tower, Wrigley Building, and Buckingham Fountain.

Led by a friendly local guide, this experience blends Chicago’s most famous eats, rich culture, and great photo ops — the perfect way to enjoy the best of the Windy City in one delicious day.

Tour Ticket Includes:
• 1 Portillo’s hot dog
• 1 small Garrett’s Popcorn
• 6" Al’s Italian Beef Sandwich
• 1 slice of authentic Chicago deep dish pizza

experiences.title: Private Indian-Mexican Fusion Cooking Class in a Chicago Home
experiences.description:
Enjoy a private and authentic cooking class in a local home with host Ruby who comes from a family that is all about communal eating and hosting large family gatherings, where good food and great conversations are the backbone of any meal. This is a perfect experience for anyone looking to connect with local culture over food. Your cooking class will take place in a local home kitchen where Ruby will teach you how to make 2-3 Indian-Mexcian dishes from their family recipes. After cooking, you will enjoy your meal together in your host's home.

• Private cooking lesson in a local home
• Introduction to India's culture and cuisine
• Learn to cook either traditional Indian meal or Indian-Mexican fusion
• 100% private activity
• Experience Indian hospitality in a residential Chicago neighborhood
• Vegetarian and gluten free options available

experiences.title: Chicago Local Brewery Expedition with Homemade Guacamole
experiences.description:
We'll explore five (5) of our favorite, Handcrafted Local Micro Breweries in two special locations of the historic, Chicago landmark district, Fulton Market; which used to be the meatpacking district, now becoming the Chicago Brewery District.

Here you'll experience the fabulous, intricate world of the art of beer creation. We will all meet at the first one, introduce ourselves and try some delicious appetizers; where Carla will make a special Homemade Guacamole and Homemade Tortilla chips, and here, the first 3 handcrafted beers (3-5oz beers) are on us.

Then we'll walk to the other breweries where you'll have a chance to order other beers and serve your own. Here you can stay as long as you want after the tour. During our expedition, we can all share our opinion about the flavors, the creation, etc...
All the breweries are within walking distance.

experiences.title: Exclusive Sushi-Making Class in Chicago (Includes 3-Course Meal)
experiences.description:
Discover the fundamentals of sushi-making in Chicago during this immersive class hosted through Cozymeal. Limited to 8 guests, the workshop showcases the precision and artistry of Japanese cuisine.

The menu you will prepare includes:
- Sushi: Spicy ahi-tuna roll with avocado, cucumber and aioli
- Sushi: Shrimp tempura roll with jalapeño, cucumber and miso aioli
- Dessert: Tropical fruit with tōgarashi and honey

With step-by-step guidance from your local sushi chef, you’ll gain confidence in rolling techniques and flavor pairing. Guests are welcome to bring wine or beer to complement the meal, making the evening both educational and enjoyable.

experiences.title: Learn To Make Mole The Real Mexican Way Before Lunch
experiences.description: With a deep knowledge of Mexican cuisine and a passion for cooking with authentic ingredients, Carla brings the art of Mole-making to your table. Each dish is crafted with care and expertise, resulting in a dining experience that is both flavorful and memorable. Whether you're a fan of Mexican cuisine or simply seeking a new and exciting culinary adventure, Carla's Mole experience is not to be missed. Book your seat at the table today and get ready to savor the authentic taste of Mexico!

experiences.title: Traveling Spoon Chicago-Style Deep Dish Pizza Private Online Cooking Class
experiences.description:
Enjoy a private and authentic online cooking class and learn to make Nancy's recipe for Chicago-style Deep Dish Pizza, a style of pizza that originated in pizza, filled tall with cheese, toppings and a chunky tomato sauce. This is a perfect experience for anyone looking to connect with local culture over food. A fun and cultural virtual cooking experience with a United States native!

• Learn to make traditional Chicago-style Deep Dish Pizza and an American dessert
• Private, one-on-one online instruction with a Chicago native
• Introduction to United States' culture and cuisine
• Scheduled mutually at your convenience (host lives in Chicago, Illinois (GMT-5) 
• Recipes and ingredients list will be emailed in advance of class
• Customization available for dietary restrictions or preferences
• Travel from your own home and learn culinary traditions of United States!

Please note you will be sent instructions to make the dough ahead of time as it takes a while to rise.

experiences.title: Breakfast, Lunch or Dinner: Exclusive Egyptian Countryside Exp
experiences.description:
Discover the charm of the Egyptian countryside on this private tour, where vibrant farmland meets rich cultural experiences. Enjoy a meal at sunrise, midday, or sunset, savoring the flavors of traditional Egyptian cuisine. Engage in horse riding, hop on traditional carts, and stroll through picturesque farmlands. Delight in tasting authentic Egyptian tea, baking bread with local families, and exploring buzzing beehives for an immersive rural adventure.

- Private tour offering a unique exploration of the Egyptian countryside
- Enjoy breakfast, lunch, or dinner at your preferred time of day
- Participate in horse riding, traditional cart rides, and local bread baking
- Experience tasting Egyptian tea and learning about beekeeping with locals

experiences.title: Chicago Full-Day Walking Food Tour with Free Bike or Kayak Rental
experiences.description: Get ready for the most complete adventure the city has to offer—an immersive Full Day Chicago Food Tour and Walking Tour that blends Chicago’s legendary flavors with its most iconic landmarks. Savor Chicago Pizza, Hot Dogs, Italian Beef, Garrett’s Chicago Mix Popcorn, and the original Palmer House Brownie, or elevate your day with our VIP craft beer upgrade. This unforgettable Chicago in a Day Tour explores Millennium Park, the Chicago Riverwalk, Michigan Avenue, Cloud Gate, Chicago Theater, and more, guided by true local experts. Enjoy a 5-hour journey through culture and cuisine, plus a FREE 2-hour bike or kayak rental to continue the adventure along Lake Michigan. Recently honored among the “Top 10 Food Tours in America” (USA Today) and “Top 20 Food Tours in the World” (TripAdvisor), this award-winning Culinary Tour is one of the top Things to do in Chicago. Don’t miss the most delicious, scenic Full Day Food Tour in Chicago—all in one extraordinary day.

experiences.title: Taste of Chicago's Chinatown Food Tours
experiences.description:
Best Chinatown Food and Walking Tour in town! The Chicago’s Chinatown Food and Walking Tour is a 3-hour immersive culinary and cultural experience designed to highlight the unique tastes, rich history, and vibrant culture of Chicago’s Chinatown. This comprehensive tour combines a curated food-tasting journey with an exploration of iconic landmarks, making it the most enriching and flavorful Chinatown experience available in such a short duration. 
All of the restaurants and shops we pick for you are our member businesses of Chicago Chinatown Chamber of Commerce with guaranteed food quality and hospitality! You get the most of your money and time!

A minimum of 4 participants is required for this experience. If the minimum is not met, the tour may be canceled, and you will receive a full refund.

experiences.title: Explore Chicago Black Culinary Heritage
experiences.description:
The Experience is more than a food tour. It is an immersive cultural experience that combines food, history, architecture, and storytelling in one of Chicago’s most influential neighborhoods.

Guests will enjoy curated tastings from locally owned Black restaurants while learning about the people, businesses, and historical moments that helped shape Chicago’s Black cultural landscape. Along the route, we visit significant landmarks, including the site where Barack and Michelle Obama’s love story began, historic community gathering spaces, public art, and locations connected to the neighborhood’s rich legacy of entrepreneurship, music, education, and civil rights.

Unlike traditional food tours that focus primarily on dining, this experience connects each tasting to the larger story of the community, providing travelers with insider knowledge and meaningful cultural context.

experiences.title: Private Tour Giza pyramids, the Sphinx, Camel Ride and Lunch.
experiences.description: Meet your tour-guide in your hotel lobby and depart in a private, air-conditioned vehicle to the Giza Plateau. The tour begins by exploring the oldest of the Seven Wonders of the Ancient World. You will visit the Pyramid of Cheops (The Great Pyramid of Giza), the largest pyramid in the world. Continue your tour with visits to the Pyramids of Chephren and Mykerinos. Learn the architectural significance and fascinating history of these magnificent structures. You will take some unforgettable photos in the panoramic view area where you will ride a camel for 30 minutes to the six pyramids panorama. While on the Giza Plateau, you will see The Great Sphinx of Giza and learn about the mystery of one of the oldest and largest sculptures in the world.

experiences.title: DIY Cocktail Candle and Wine Bottle Cutting Class in Chicago
experiences.description: Get ready to unleash your creativity at the BYOB Candle-Making Class at Chicago Candle Co. This hands-on workshop invites you to craft stunning, personalized candles from upcycled wine bottles, all while enjoying your favorite drinks. Under the guidance of friendly instructors, you’ll learn the art of glass cutting and soy wax pouring, choosing from a variety of cocktail-inspired scents. Bond with friends or make new ones in a welcoming atmosphere as you create unique pieces that reflect your individual style and eco-friendly values. Perfect for a fun night out or a memorable group activity in the heart of Chicago.

experiences.title: Pasta Making Cooking Class at a Local Distillery in Chicago
experiences.description: Experience the perfect pairing of fresh pasta and craft spirits in this hands-on cooking class with a talented chef, hosted at a local distillery in Chicago! Learn the time-honored techniques of pasta-making as you mix, knead, roll, and cut your own pasta from scratch using just eggs, flour, and olive oil. Then, prepare a rich marinara sauce with onions, garlic and tomatoes, with the option to add beef for a meaty variation. Enjoy the lively atmosphere of the distillery, where you can sip on expertly crafted spirits while perfecting your culinary skills. Whether you’re a pasta lover, a food enthusiast, or just looking for a fun and interactive night out, this class is the perfect way to learn, sip, and savor. Book your spot today for an unforgettable pasta-making experience in the heart of Chicago!

experiences.title: Spanish Paella Cooking Class in Chicago (Includes 3-Course Meal)
experiences.description:
Tapas, paella and flan – this hands-on Spanish cooking class in Chicago, hosted through Cozymeal, which connects you with top-rated local chefs, takes you through three pillars of coastal Spanish cuisine in one vibrant, skill-building experience.

Your hands-on cooking experience features:
- Gambas al Ajillo with shrimp, garlic, lemon, chile flakes and sourdough
- Seafood Paella with mussels, shrimp, saffron, bomba rice and chistorra
- Mango Flan with eggs, milk, condensed milk, evaporated milk and mango purée

You will leave with the skills to make authentic Spanish paella and tapas at home. Guests are welcome to bring wine or beer to enjoy throughout the experience.

experiences.title: Sushi Making Cooking Class at a Local Distillery in Chicago
experiences.description: Enjoy a unique sushi-making experience at a local distillery in Chicago with Chef Janet! In this hands-on class, you’ll learn how to craft fresh, restaurant-quality sushi while sipping on expertly distilled spirits available for purchase. Start by steaming and seasoning the perfect sushi rice, then prep fresh ingredients for two signature rolls. You’ll assemble a vibrant veggie roll with sweet mango, creamy avocado, and crisp cucumber, followed by a classic California roll featuring surimi, avocado, and cucumber. With Chef Janet’s expert guidance, you’ll master the techniques of rolling sushi and slicing it into picture-perfect pieces. Whether you're looking for a fun night out, a unique date idea, or a new culinary skill to impress friends and family, this class offers the perfect blend of great food, hands-on learning, and a relaxed distillery setting. Book your spot today for a sushi and spirits experience like no other in Chicago!

experiences.title: Downtown Chicago Walking Pizza Tour
experiences.description: This tour is just a short walk through great Chicago neighborhoods starting near Navy Pier and the Magnificent Mile, and then heading into the Gold Coast & River North. Compare two American pizzas vs. two Italian pizzas to understand how pizza evolved as an immigrant food. Explore Deep Dish, Roman, Neapolitan, and Artisanal pizza in just a couple of hours. Discuss how each of these styles is crafted and the differences in their ingredients, baking techniques, and ovens. Plenty of pizza to eat, come hungry!

experiences.title: Fortune Reading with Cheese in Chicago
experiences.description: I am the only person in the US, and possibly the world, that offers this experience. It is both a demonstration and an interactive opportunity where you'll have tons of fun learning about the history of cheese magic and getting to try it yourself. And then you get to eat your fortune!

experiences.title: Chicago's West Side Foodie Ride Bike Tour
experiences.description: Take a detour off the beaten path, and explore the flavors of Chicago’s delicious West Side with Bobbys's Bike Hike & Food Tours, America's longest running city bike tour company, who recently ranked as Top 20 Food Tours in the World by TripAdvisor and Top 10 Food Tours in America by USA Today! This 4-hour guided food and bike tour is the perfect way to learn more about Chicago's immigrant neighboroods and taste authentic Chicago culinary dishes along the way. You’ll explore the cultural cuisines of historic Fulton Market district, Ukrainian Village, Wicker Park, and Lincoln Park. The Chicago Bike and Food tour finishes with a chocolate tasting in Old Town. You’ll learn the history of these beautiful neighborhoods and the tradition behind each of the dishes we sample. Ride through Chicago's gorgeous and unique neighborhoods, plus our legendary Lakefront Trail! There is no better way to explore Chicago than by bike! All equipment is included on this food and bicycle tour of Chicago.

experiences.title: Chicago Bike & Classic Food Tour: Bikes, Bites & Views - Adults
experiences.description: Taste all of Chicago’s classic eats on this 4 1/2 hr Adults-only guided food & bicycle tour! Join the expert guides of Bobby’s Bike Hike, America’s first city bike tour company, on this exciting & informative adventure which recently ranked Top 20 Food Tours in the World by TripAdvisor. The journey is a leisurely paced 13mi & includes deep dish pizza, Chicago-style hot dog, Italian Beef, & dessert. Upgrade to sample local craft beer! On the DAY version of bike tour, you’ll drink in the sights of Chicago’s beautiful northside neighborhoods, including the Lakefront and Wrigleyville, home to our Chicago Cubs baseball team. On the NIGHT bike tour, you'll ride through the major downtown attractions & see the lights of Buckingham Fountain, Millennium Park and the glorious skyline. Cruise the Lakefront Trail, one of the most popular waterfront bike paths in the country. Don’t miss out on this fun tour! You’ll leave with a profound understanding of Chicago, even if you only came for the food.

experiences.title: Chicago's Delicious Downtown Donut Tour with 8 Amazing Tastings
experiences.description:
Recently voted one of TripAdvisor's top food tours in the US. 

Discover the sweet side of the Windy City on the Underground Donut Tour, Chicago’s Delicious Donut Adventure. We’ll kick things off at the legendary Doughnut Vault, tucked beside the historic Merchandise Mart, where you’ll enjoy one of Chicago’s most beloved treats. From there, we’ll stroll across the Chicago River, taking in picture-perfect skyline views before heading to a local artisan donut shop crafting fresh, handmade creations daily. As we wind our way through downtown, we’ll make our way toward Michigan Avenue, home to two iconic stops. First, indulge in a California-style donut shop bursting with flavors and flair, followed by a visit to Do-Rite Donuts, famous for their creative combinations, seasonal specials, and perfectly glazed classics. Equal parts tasty and scenic, this walking tour is the ultimate way to explore Chicago’s flavors, views, and charm. We hope you can join us!

experiences.title: Downtown Galena Food and Drink Tour
experiences.description: Welcome to our one-of-a-kind food tour in historic Galena! Our mission is to let visitors discover Galena's vibrant Main Street while immersing themselves in its dynamic food scene. This isn’t just a tour; it's an adventure for your taste buds. We focus solely on the culinary delights, offering an exclusive exploration of international items, beer, wine, desserts, and more. As the only tour in Galena dedicated entirely to food, we connect you with the passionate owners and unique flavors that make downtown Galena a must-visit destination. Join us and savor the best that Galena has to offer! This is a walking tour. We start at one end of Main Street and work our way down to their other end.

experiences.title: Chicago's Chinatown Food and Walking Tour
experiences.description: Chicago's Chinatown: Few neighborhoods in America combine such delicious cuisine with fascinating history. Join Bobby’s Bike Hike & Food Tours, whose food tours have ranked Top 10 in America by USA Today & Top 20 in the world by Tripadvisor, for a day of interesting stories and scrumptious eats on this delicious Food Tour in Chinatown. This 3-hour Walking and Chintown Food Tour, you’ll see the bustling Chinatown Square, then get to sampling some of the richest cuisine around; including Cantonese dim sum, Portuguese-Chinese bakery treats, Szechuan style, and even Xi'an cuisine, all while learning about the history of how these foods & culture arrived in Chicago. This is a totally unique culinary tour experience, and not to be missed! Upon arrival to the tour, you can add a VIP Drink option for alcoholic and ethnic drink pairings! Chinatown can be challenging to navigate on your own, so let our expert local guides show you the way & discover 5 of our all-time favorite dishes.

experiences.title: Chicago in a Day Walking Tour: Food, History & Architecture
experiences.description: Immerse yourself in Chicago's rich history and vibrant culinary scene on this captivating walking tour. Discover the city's iconic architecture and Prohibition-era charm while indulging in delectable local cuisine. From deep-dish pizza to hidden gems, savor the flavors of Chicago as a knowledgeable guide unveils the city's culinary secrets and fascinating history.

experiences.title: Chicago-Style Holiday Hike: Festive Food and Walking Tour
experiences.description:
There’s nothing more magical than downtown Chicago during the holidays. Bobby’s Bike Hike & Food Tours—internationally recognized for quality—presents the Holiday Hike, a 3-hour guided walking and food tour of the city’s top seasonal attractions.

You’ll sample Chicago favorites like deep-dish pizza, a Chicago-style hot dog, Italian beef, a chocolate brownie, and hot apple cider. Alcoholic beverages aren’t included, but holiday drink pairings can be added on-site.

Our local guides will fill the tour with festive stories—like how Rudolph the Red-Nosed Reindeer originated in Chicago. You’ll see the classic holiday windows at the original Marshall Field’s, the Chicago Christmas tree, the Millennium Park ice rink, and enjoy VIP entry to the Christkindlmarket.

No other tour offers such a complete Chicago holiday experience!

experiences.title: Vito's Vault Chicago Speakeasy Dinner Theatre
experiences.description: One of the most unique experiences in Chicago. Immerse yourself in the Roaring Twenties. Step back in time to Prohibition Chicago with da gangsters and da flappers, and your host, Vito Valentino. Great music, great food, great comedy, and a great time, not to mention Vito's bootleg hooch. Give da password at the door, but when you're in, you're in.

experiences.title: Chicago Food Tour: 6 Dishes with Deep Dish Pizza & Beef Sandwich
experiences.description:
On our Secret Food Tour: Chicago, you'll enjoy a variety of foods with culinary influences from the people who built this city.

You'll experience all the city's biggest food hits, many dishes with roots dating back over 150 years. This moving feast incorporates a walk through some of the city's world renowned architecture and public art in the famed Chicago Loop District. Experience our famous deep dish pizza, taste the amazing Italian beef sandwich, enjoy gourmet popcorn, and lots of other treats. Plus, there is our mouth-watering secret dish that you can only find out about on the day of the tour!

experiences.title: Chicago Pizza Tour
experiences.description: Enjoy Chicago’s only bus guided neighborhood pizza tour.  Eat like a local as you travel off the beaten path into Chicago neighborhoods to savor the best pizza.  Your local guide will teach you the science behind ingredient selection and baking as you sample slices from historic pizzerias.  In just a few hours, you’ll leave stuffed, and with an understanding of why pizza is such an important part of Chicago’s culture.

experiences.title: Chicago Favorites Ultimate Food and Walking Tour
experiences.description: The perfect Food Tour of Chicago for first timers or anyone eager to explore Chicago's famous foods & top attractions—all in one tour. Stroll the beautiful streets of downtown & taste the Windy City’s favorite eats on this iconic Chicago Food Tour! Bobby’s Bike Hike & Food Tours, whose food tours rank Top 20 worldwide on Tripadvisor, offers this ultimate walking & food experience featuring the hard-working, salt-of-the-earth classics Chicago made famous: a slice of deep dish pizza, a Chicago-style hot dog, Italian beef, popcorn & dessert. Expert guides lead you through downtown’s most iconic landmarks on our Day tours—Millennium Park, Chicago Theatre, Riverwalk, Michigan Ave—Night tours go a different route, please check itinerary for details-we share Chicago’s rich, food-loving history. It’s one of the tastiest Things to Do in Chicago! Enjoy your tour & get a BONUS 2-hour FREE bike or kayak rental gift per ticket. Cruise the Lakefront Bike Trail or paddle Lake Michigan for extra fun!

experiences.title: Artisan Italian Pasta Class in Chicago (Includes 3-Course Meal)
experiences.description:
Discover authentic Italian cooking in Chicago during this pasta-making class hosted through Cozymeal. Limited to just 8 guests, this immersive workshop showcases the art of crafting fresh pasta dough and creating a full three-course menu.

The menu you will prepare includes:

- Starter: Bruschetta with ripe tomatoes and basil on crisp bread
- Main course: Handcrafted gnocchi with tomato-basil sauce
- Dessert: Classic tiramisù with mascarpone and espresso-soaked ladyfingers

With personalized instruction from your pasta chef, this small-group class combines hands-on practice with flavorful dining. Guests are welcome to bring wine or beer to enjoy with their freshly made meal.

experiences.title: Private Deep Dish Pizza or Pasta Making Class Near Chicago
experiences.description: Enjoy a private and authentic cooking class and meal in a local Naperville home with your host Nancy. Nancy is one of those warm and wonderful people who make you feel at home as soon as you meet her! This is a perfect experience for anyone looking to connect with local culture over food. Your cooking class takes place in Nancy's open kitchen and lasts about 1.5 hours. Choose between Chicago-style deep dish pizza or fresh, handmade pasta for your main. Learn the tips and techniques of Italian American cooking before enjoying the meal you helped prepare with your warm and hospitable host. Come prepared for a morning or evening of food, laughter and, hopefully, new friendship.

experiences.title: Chicago Loop Food Tour: Taste the Most Iconic Local Eats
experiences.description: Join a local guide for the ultimate foodie adventure in Chicago’s historic Loop, tasting classics like deep‑dish pizza and Chicago‑style hot dogs while discovering insider stories behind the city’s rich food culture.

experiences.title: Chicago: Gangsters and Food Tasting Walking Tour
experiences.description:
Taste some of Chicago's most iconic foods while walking through one of the Prohibition Era’s most fashionable and notorious neighborhoods. Learn about Chicago's world-famous cuisine and the gangsters who ate it all in one special unique tour!

Sample two types of pizza - Chicago’s deep dish and historic tavern-style – as well as prime steak and the world famous “Chicago hot dog" all while treading the streets of Capone’s closest friends and dreaded enemies.

Highlights include a visit to an old tunnel used by prohibition gangsters in the basement of one of the establishments; a mansion once used a a brothel for gangsters; the Cathedral where gangsters were gunned down by Capone’s men; and a restaurant owned by the man who brought down what was left of the Chicago mafia in the early 2000’s.

Gluten-Free: Available at all 3 food stops (shared oven/prep spaces used).

Vegetarian / Vegan: Available at 1 of 3 stops (Pizza stop only).

Please notify us in advance of any dietary needs!

experiences.title: Chicago Foods Tour with The Loop, Skyline, Millennium Park
experiences.description:
Delve into Chicago’s one-of-a-kind cuisine and learn something that you would never expect on this small-group Secret Food Tour. Eat your way through the most prominent neighborhoods of the city and immerse yourself in its tastes and flavors. 

Stroll through the Loop and Millenium Park, wander down the Riverwalk and discover iconic sights and hidden gems from another perspective. 

Get inside Chicago’s life through food and connect your heart and soul to the Windy City vibe while tasting classic deep-dish pizza, dipped Italian beef, and Chicago-style hot-dogs.

• Benefit from small-group experience and undivided attention from your local guide
• Savor the classic Chicago eats and get to know the history of their creation
• Witness fascinating art objects, architecture landmarks, and beautiful cityscapes
• Get useful recommendation of where to eat and drink from your guide

experiences.title: River North Food Walking Tour
experiences.description:
On our 3 hour food walking tour of Chicago, you will taste delectable foods from 5 different delicious places. Tease your tastebuds as you savor foods from Chicago's best deep dish pizza restaurant, Rick Bayless' amazing Mexican fare and more.  

In addition to all the delicious food, your guide will discuss the history, culture and food scene of the neighborhood. We have vegetarian options at all the food stops and can accommodate other dietary restrictions with advance notice.  

Join us on a culinary adventure of Chicago's River North neighborhood. We've done all the delicious research to showcase the best eats in Chicago. Wear your comfy shoes, bring your appetite and we'll take care of the rest...

experiences.title: Tamales and Tacos with Margarita Cooking Class at Su Casa
experiences.description: Immerse yourself in the vibrant flavors of Mexico with a hands-on cooking class at Su Casa Mexican Restaurant. Guided by experienced chefs, participants will learn the art of crafting authentic tamales and tacos from scratch. This class is tailored for all skill levels, making it an ideal setting for food enthusiasts eager to enhance their culinary repertoire. As you knead, roll, and fill your creations, anticipate the rewarding moment of tasting your delicious handiwork, complemented by chips, salsa, and a refreshing drink.

experiences.title: Chicago to Milwaukee Day Trip with Brewery Tour & City Highlights
experiences.description: Escape Chicago for a day and experience Milwaukee’s culture, food, and legendary beer scene. This curated day trip includes highlights such as the Harley-Davidson Museum, free time at the Milwaukee Public Market, and an optional Miller Brewery tour and tasting. Enjoy scenic views along the lakefront and an outside visit to the Milwaukee Art Museum before returning to Chicago. Ideal for travelers looking for a relaxed, well-rounded introduction to Milwaukee.

experiences.title: City Cruises Chicago: River Architectural Lunch Cruise
experiences.description: Fine dining and unrivaled skyline views await from the moment you step aboard our Premier Plus Chicago Lunch Cruise. A selection of delectable plated lunch specials and craft cocktails will delight your palate while captivating panoramas of Chicago’s iconic architecture are marveled at from our glass-enclosed vessel. Breathtaking views of landmarks such as the Willis Tower, Navy Pier, and the Old Chicago Post Office can be enjoyed from the comfortable interior or the open-air spaces. This upscale experience on the Chicago River is complete with light architectural narration, masterful DJ entertainment, and top-notch service. Set sail for an awe-inspiring lunch cruise experience!

experiences.title: Deep Dish Cooking Class at Pizzeria Uno in Chicago
experiences.description:
You will learn how to make (and get to eat) an authentic Deep Dish pizza, all at the Birthplace of Deep Dish pizza - Pizzeria Uno. Be a part of American food history by cooking with Pizzeria Uno. Not only do you get to enjoy your masterpiece, but you can then make Deep Dish pizza at home with the knowledge that you have acquired! 
Enjoy your pizza with a salad and a drink (soda, beer or wine).

experiences.title: 2-Hour Chicago Wine and Cheese Cruise
experiences.description: This Wine & Cheese Cruise is a world class Chicago experience for locals and visitors. Board our famous tour boats at Michigan Avenue, and enjoy the Chicago River and Lake Michigan while tasting wine and cheese pairings. There is also a full service bar and climate controlled cabin on the vessel's lower deck. This activity does not have a narrated tour but features light music during the cruise.

experiences.title: City Cruises Chicago: Signature Lunch Cruise on Lake Michigan
experiences.description: Join us for an unforgettable afternoon on Lake Michigan with a Signature Chicago Lunch Cruise. Whether it’s a family outing or a meal with friends, upgrade your lunch with a chef-prepared buffet and sweeping views of Chicago’s iconic landmarks, such as Adler Planetarium and Navy Pier. This fun and relaxed lunch cruise experience is complete with live DJ entertainment, a fully stocked cash bar, dancing, and games on the open-air decks and indoor spaces. Set sail for a one-of-a-kind afternoon that is as scenic as it is delicious!

experiences.title: Artisan Italian Pasta Class in Chicago (Includes 4-Course Meal)
experiences.description:
Step into a welcoming kitchen in Chicago for an immersive Italian cooking class hosted through Cozymeal. Limited to 8 guests, this interactive workshop introduces you to authentic techniques behind pasta-making and classic Italian dishes.

The menu you will prepare includes:

- Starter: Caesar salad with homemade dressing and Parmesan
- Side: Italian garlic bread brushed with olive oil and herbs
- Main course: Fresh fettuccine pasta with savory Bolognese sauce
- Dessert: Vanilla bean panna cotta with seasonal fruit compote

With step-by-step guidance from your local pasta chef, you’ll enjoy a hands-on approach to mastering Italian cooking. Guests are welcome to bring wine or beer to complement the meal and celebrate the flavors of Italy.

experiences.title: Cooking Class with Celebrity Chef Tony Hu
experiences.description:
Join our exclusive cooking workshop series in collaboration with celebrity chef Tony Hu. In the first session, you'll learn to prepare two of his signature dishes—Chef’s Special Dry Chili Chicken and Crispy Lemon Shrimp.
Featured on numerous TV shows and interviews, including NBC, ABC, FOX, and WGN, Chef Tony Hu is the founder of the iconic Lao Sze Chuan Restaurants with 14 locations across the country. This hands-on cooking workshop is more than just a culinary lesson—it’s a cultural experience. We invite you to connect with Chinese heritage in a warm, interactive setting where every dish tells a story, and every bite is a celebration of tradition.

A minimum of 4 participants is required for this experience. If the minimum is not met, the tour may be canceled, and you will receive a full refund.

experiences.title: Fun Chocolate Making Class With a Local Chef in Chicago
experiences.description: This beginner-friendly chocolate class turns a classic confection into an approachable, rewarding skill. Led by Chef Janet, the experience focuses on teaching essential techniques while keeping the atmosphere relaxed and fun. You’ll learn how to temper chocolate correctly, experiment with popular fillings and use molds to create beautifully shaped treats. Chef Janet breaks everything down step by step, making the process easy to follow even if you’ve never worked with chocolate before. With plenty of tasting, hands-on practice and a supportive environment, this Chicago class is ideal for dessert lovers, curious home cooks or anyone looking for a creative night out that ends on a sweet note.

experiences.title: Fun Pasta Making Class With a Local Chef in Chicago
experiences.description: Forget complicated pasta projects — this is your excuse to make ridiculously cozy gnocchi from scratch. At a relaxed Chicago whiskey distillery, you’ll mix ricotta, flour and egg into a tender dough, then roll and cut it before shaping each piece by hand. You’ll pick up practical techniques for working with soft dough without overthinking every little move. Once your gnocchi is ready, you’ll cook it and make a rich sage butter sauce with Parmesan, fresh herbs and seasonal garnishes. You’ll learn how to combine the ingredients into a balanced, savory finish, then sit down to enjoy your freshly prepared meal. The atmosphere stays casual and social, making it easy to chat, laugh and enjoy the process. Your potatoes can take the night off — ricotta is handling gnocchi duty.

experiences.title: Immersive Potsticker Cooking Class in Chicago
experiences.description:
Chef Janet, a seasoned head chef, personal chef and culinary instructor, has served and educated countless food enthusiasts throughout her career. Let Chef Janet's expertise and charisma guide you in mastering the art of dumpling-making. This class takes place at a beautiful local venue known for its warm atmosphere and excellent craft beers. In this session, you'll start by preparing meat dumplings (vegetarian option available) using ingredients like carrots, cabbage, scallions, garlic, ginger and soy. You'll then create a tasty dipping sauce with soy and citrus. The class concludes with steaming or pan-frying your dumplings and enjoying your flavorful creations.

What to Expect:
- Step-by-step guidance from a talented chef who makes it make sense.
- A fun, beginner-friendly class where no one judges your knife skills.
- Tasting, laughing and leveling up your kitchen game.
- Ideal for: a solo outing, date night, girls’ night or group fun.

experiences.title: Italian Ravioli Cooking Class in Chicago (Includes 4-Course Meal)
experiences.description:
Get to grips with Italian pasta in this Florentine-inspired hands-on class in Chicago, hosted through Cozymeal, which connects you with top-rated local chefs. Carpaccio, hand-filled ravioli, a fresh vodka sauce and citrus cookies – four courses, four distinct techniques, one deeply satisfying Italian meal.

Your hands-on cooking experience features:
 - Marinated Vegetable Carpaccio – assorted vegetables, homemade herb dressing and fresh herbs
- Beef Ravioli – flour, eggs and seasoned beef
- Vodka Sauce – olive oil, tomatoes and vodka
- Italian Lemon Drop Cookies – flour, butter and eggs

You will leave with real pasta-making skills and a fresh perspective on Italian cuisine, from antipasto to dessert. Guests are welcome to bring wine or beer to enjoy throughout the experience.

experiences.title: Make Fresh Pasta With a Local Chef in Chicago
experiences.description: Put on your apron and get ready to turn simple ingredients into seriously satisfying pasta. You’ll begin by preparing fresh pasta dough from scratch, then learn the hands-on techniques for kneading, rolling and shaping it into pasta. Next comes the good stuff: a creamy pumpkin-sage sauce made with pumpkin purée, cream, Parmesan, sage, butter, garlic, nutmeg and black pepper. You’ll learn how to build the sauce, season it and bring it together with your freshly made pasta for a warm, comforting final dish. No fancy pasta skills are required, just a willingness to get your hands a little floury. It’s relaxed, social and deliciously practical, with plenty of satisfaction when you finally sit down to enjoy what you made.

experiences.title: Mediterranean Cooking Class in Chicago (Includes 3-Course Meal)
experiences.description:
Fresh, vibrant and built on ingredients you can find anywhere – this Mediterranean cooking class in Chicago, hosted through Cozymeal, which connects you with top-rated local chefs, teaches three crowd-pleasing dishes that bring the coast straight to your kitchen.

Your hands-on cooking experience features:
- Hummus with chickpeas, lemon, cumin and olive oil
- Greek Chicken With Lemon and Feta with chicken breast, Feta, thyme, lemon and white wine
- Balsamic Berries With Greek Yogurt with Greek yogurt, honey, balsamic vinegar and mixed berries

You will leave ready to recreate a full Mediterranean spread at home – from hummus to dessert. Guests are welcome to bring wine or beer to enjoy throughout the experience.

experiences.title: Private Chicago Cooking Class with Le Cordon Bleu Chef
experiences.description: In the heart of Chicago, near Wrigley Field, a culinary adventure awaits. Led by Rakhi, a professionally trained chef and Le Cordon Bleu graduate with experience working with Bobby Flay, this private cooking class immerses you in the rich flavors of Italian-American cuisine. Over 2.5 hours, you'll learn to prepare iconic dishes such as Chicken Vesuvio, hot fried chicken, and homemade desserts, all while enjoying a relaxed and interactive atmosphere. With the chance to tailor your menu, every class becomes a unique experience that celebrates Chicago's vibrant food culture. Gather your friends or family for a memorable evening of cooking and dining together.

experiences.title: Top Shelf 14-Passenger Brewery Tour
