experiences.description: We have excellent reviews! We know to treat people like we'd like to be treated. We are also very flexible.

experiences.title: Japanese Street Food Class in Beech Grove
experiences.description: Learn to make these Japanese Homestyle meals. Full of 'Umami" flavor and not too hard to make. You will receive recipes and know where to get your products to replicate a home.

experiences.title: Fountain Square Food Tour
experiences.description:
Fountain Square served as the southside's primary commercial corridor since the 1860's. Its laid back atmosphere, beautifully designed buildings and accessibility made it a popular neighborhood for decades. In the early 20th century, the neighborhood had more theaters than any part of Indianapolis, and became an important cultural destination. 

Fountain Square has recently seen a rapid transformation to a neighborhood with unique restaurants, and trendy art galleries located in renovated buildings. The Fountain Square Food Tour will give you an in-depth look at the area and its surroundings; from humble beginnings to grandeur, rapid decline to resurgence. We will enjoy food from long standing institutions, and hip new destinations.

experiences.title: Massachusetts Avenue Food Tour
experiences.description:
This Indianapolis food tour explores the commercial corridor bordering two of the earliest and most historic neighborhoods, Lockerbie and Chatham Arch.

Massachusetts Avenue is a prominent commercial boulevard crossing a grid of residential, commercial and industrial buildings that developed mainly throughout the 19th century. The area is also home to an expanding food scene, hosting nearly two dozen locally owned restaurants. The restaurants throughout the area are a combination of long standing local favorites dating back to the 1800's and new hot spots embracing the culinary traditions of the area.

The Massachusetts Avenue Food Tour will explore the advancement of Indianapolis cuisine over the past 150 years; from the traditions brought over by the city's original immigrants, to locally sourced progressive cuisine, all within a beautifully restored neighborhood.

experiences.title: Agafay Camel Ride, Pool & Lunch with Hotel Transfers
experiences.description: Escape the busy city and enjoy a relaxing day in the Agafay Desert. This experience combines a scenic 15-minute camel ride, access to a beautiful swimming pool, and a delicious traditional Moroccan lunch in a peaceful desert setting. You'll also visit a local women's argan oil cooperative to discover authentic Moroccan traditions. With round-trip transportation from Marrakech included, this is the perfect mix of relaxation, culture, and desert adventure in one unforgettable experience.

experiences.title: Books, Bites& Brews - Noblesville Shopping & Foodie Walking Tours
experiences.description:
Hidden corridors. Overlooked spaces. Unexpected flavors.

Starting in North Alley, this story-forward route explores the lesser-seen paths that helped shape downtown Noblesville.

Guests will wind through side streets and historic corridors while hearing stories of early commerce, civic life, and the evolution of downtown neighborhoods.

You’ll visit a mix of off-main-path retailers and heritage shops, paired with a relaxed bite stop at a local eatery along the way.

Depending on the day’s route, the experience may conclude with a final retail visit or a casual beverage stop at a partner wine bar, taproom, or café.

What to Expect on Every Tour

• Comfortable pacing with built-in rest opportunities
• One seated stop per tour
• Less than one mile of total walking distance
• Small group size capped at 15 guests

Each experience is designed to highlight downtown walkability and support local merchants, especially during the Embrace Downtown construction season.

experiences.title: The Dinner Detective True Crime Murder Mystery Show - Wichita, KS
experiences.description:
Now playing in Wichita, KS! The Dinner Detective is America's largest interactive murder mystery comedy dinner show! Solve a hilarious and engaging mystery while you feast on a fantastic dinner. Just beware! The killer is hiding somewhere in the room, and you may find yourself as a Prime Suspect!

Our show is very different from traditional murder mystery dinner shows. We will hide non-costumed actors in the audience that are pretending to be part of the crowd. This results in a much more social and interactive evening than with other shows. Our shows are set during the present day and take place in real time. Over the course of the night, our costumed Detectives will uncover clues, interrogate audience members that may or may not be part of the show, and help everyone get closer to solving the mystery.

experiences.title: James B. Beam, Heaven Hill and Lux Row Bourbon Tour
experiences.description:
Come discover why Mint Julep Experiences is the leading expert on the Kentucky Bourbon Trail - with nearly 20 years of experience, over 1 million guests served, and more than 5,000 5-star reviews!

Join Mint Julep Experiences for this Friday bourbon tour, which includes guided transportation, 3 distillery stops for tours and tastings, and a local lunch. Guests will enjoy lunch at a local favorite, a tour and tasting at Lux Row, a Connoisseur tasting at Heaven Hill, and a tour with tastings at James B. Beam Distilling Co.

experiences.title: Louisville Bourbon Walking Tours
experiences.description:
Come discover why Mint Julep Experiences is the leading expert on the Kentucky Bourbon Trail - with nearly 20 years of experience, over 1 million guests served, and more than 5,000 5-star reviews!

This immersive walking tour visits three iconic distilleries in NuLu, blending rich history, behind-the-scenes access, and curated tastings at every stop. Led by a knowledgeable local guide, you’ll sample signature pours and unique expressions while learning how mash bills and barrel aging influence flavor. Between stops, the guide shares Prohibition-era lore, architectural highlights, and modern bourbon culture that shaped Louisville. Suitable for both bourbon enthusiasts and curious newcomers, the relaxed, walkable route finishes with local partner perks and insider recommendations.

experiences.title: Buffalo Trace Distillery Tour, Tasting, and Transportation
experiences.description:
Explore the iconic Buffalo Trace Distillery on this half-day tour from downtown Louisville. This convenient half-day tour includes round-trip transportation from downtown Louisville, the Distilled Tour & Tasting, time to explore allocated bourbons in the gift shop, and a return to the city by 2:00 p.m. It is an easy, exciting, and affordable way to visit one of Kentucky’s most iconic bourbon destinations—all for just $89.

- Convenient round-trip transportation from downtown Louisville
- Enjoy the Distilled Tour & Tasting at Buffalo Trace Distillery
- Free time to explore the gift shop after your tour
- Half-day tour, departing at 9am and returning by 2pm

Come discover why Mint Julep Experiences is the leading expert on the Kentucky Bourbon Trail - with nearly 20 years of experience, over 1 million guests served, and more than 5,000 5-star reviews!

experiences.title: Distillery Tour at Second Sight Spirits with Spirits Tasting
experiences.description:
Experience the most future-favoring tour on the Kentucky Bourbon Trail Craft Tour®! Unravel
the mysteries of distillation, hear tales of circus life, and get the tall tale story of how two
childhood friends came together to build a distillery through luck, bartering, and Craigslist finds.
Tours always include a tasting of our Oak Eye Kentucky Bourbon, the ever-popular hazelnut
liqueur, our fine rums, and maybe even a couple of moonshines.

experiences.title: Germantown Sites & Bites: Louisville Food & History Walking Tour
experiences.description:
Get beyond downtown and experience Louisville through Germantown and Schnitzelburg, two neighborhoods that have been feeding, brewing and reinventing themselves for generations.

Historic shotgun houses and former factories sit alongside corner taverns, colorful murals, independent cafés, breweries and favorite local restaurants. Along the way, your guide connects what you’re tasting to the people and traditions that shaped these streets, from German immigrants and factory workers to today’s chefs and entrepreneurs.

Explore a side of Louisville many visitors miss
- Visit locally loved restaurants, bars and cafés
- Discover German heritage, working-class history and colorful local characters
- See shotgun houses, historic factories, murals and corner taverns
- Experience Louisville food, history and neighborhood culture together

experiences.title: Seasonal Cooking and Entertaining with The Mischief Maker
experiences.description: This is an intimate, host-led dining experience centered on seasonal cooking, thoughtful presentation, and the art of gathering. The experience can take place in the host’s private home or at the guest’s own home or Airbnb. Guests enjoy a beautifully prepared brunch or dinner while learning how menus are shaped by season and place, with an emphasis on relaxed, elegant entertaining rather than a formal cooking class.

experiences.title: Tour and Bourbon Tasting at KMAC Contemporary Art Museum
experiences.description: Visitors can expect to be immersed in a unique art environment while they are led through the flavors of our of featured bourbon, RD1.

experiences.title: Bites of the Bluegrass Cocktails & Bites Tour
experiences.description:
Embark on a spirited journey through the vibrant echoes of Lexington's East End, where each step reveals layers of history, culture, and intrigue. You'll indulge in expertly mixed cocktails and plates prepared by local chefs while your knowledgeable guide weaves a tapestry of captivating tales, transporting you through time.

Discover a fascinating connection between Kentucky and Japan, forged by visionary entrepreneurs. Hear the thundering hooves of black horsemen who once dominated the sport of kings on the sprawling track that once graced Downtown's East End. Unravel the mystery behind a vault laden with tear gas nestled within a local showroom, a relic of bygone days with stories waiting to be told.

With each revelation, you'll find yourself drawn deeper into the captivating narrative of Lexington's East End, a place where history and mystery intertwine to create an unforgettable experience.

All guests must be 21+ with proper ID.

experiences.title: Louisville Legends: 3Hr Whiskey Row Food & History Tour
experiences.description:
Eat your way through Louisville’s foodie "bucket list" with locally-owned Louisville Food Tours! Stroll down Whiskey Row and Museum Row tasting the dishes that define Derby City, including the famous Hot Brown sandwich, the original Derby Pie, chocolate bourbon truffles and modjeskas. You can also choose to add a 3-drink pairing of iconic Bourbon City drinks.

Along the way, your guide will bring Louisville’s history to life with stories of the legends who shaped the city. As you walk past cast-iron facades and historic buildings, you’ll trace the city’s evolution from a small river town to a bourbon powerhouse.

Stop for a photo with the world’s largest baseball bat at the Louisville Slugger Museum, stand beneath the gleaming gold statue of David in front of a quirky hotel/art museum, and discover Louisville's thriving culinary scene.

This tour is the ultimate way to discover the flavors and history of Derby City—just come hungry and ready to explore!

experiences.title: Haunted by History: True Crime Walking Dinner Tour
experiences.description:
We’ll begin the night with an Old Fashioned and beer cheese as we dive into Lexington’s limestone foundation — and the long-held belief that limestone can act as a portal between worlds. 

From there, we’ll walk through downtown Lexington hearing the stories that never made the brochures: serial killers who passed through town, the horses buried beneath our streets, unsolved murders, cholera graves, and the spirits that many believe still linger in our oldest buildings.

Along the way, we’ll stop for dinner courses at several downtown favorites — including burgers, tacos, pizza, and cocktails — paired with storytelling that ranges from scandal and crime to folklore and ghost lore.

This tour is not a ghost tour. This is a storytelling tour — and these stories are dangerously true.

Come hungry. Come curious. And maybe… don’t walk too far behind the group.

experiences.title: Private Louisville Food Tour with Food Tastings, Drinks & History
experiences.description:
Enjoy a carefully curated adventure through Louisville! Your exclusive private walking tour will lead you on an unforgettable journey filled with mouthwatering flavors, local stories, and a taste of Louisville’s soul. 

Choose from 3 meticulously crafted itineraries: vibrant NuLu, the Historic Highlands, or Phantoms of the Prohibition on Whiskey Row. As you stroll through each historic neighborhood, you’ll savor an array of mouthwatering dishes, from traditional Appalachian classics to culinary creations you’ll only find right here in Louisville. You'll sip bourbon, craft beer, and enjoy delicious cocktails as you learn the stories of Louisville's past.

Led by a knowledgeable local guide, you'll explore Louisville's most beautiful neighborhoods while diving into the city’s history and culinary heritage. Let the tastes and tales of this vibrant city unfold before you as you explore its culinary heritage on your private guided food tour of Louisville.

experiences.title: Distillery District Food & History Tour in Lexington
experiences.description:
Join us in Lexington’s lively Distillery District for a journey you won’t forget. This historic area was once home to one of the most important bourbon distilleries in Kentucky, founded in 1880 by legendary third-generation distiller James E. Pepper. Today, the district has been revitalized into one of Lexington’s most exciting gathering places — but the stories of bourbon, business, and big personalities still live here.

On this tour, we’ll explore the beginnings of bourbon, the drama and rivalries of early distillers, and the often-overlooked stories — including the women who helped build the bourbon industry. Along the way, you’ll enjoy great food, cocktails, and a bourbon tasting while experiencing one of Lexington’s most unique neighborhoods through storytelling.

Learn the stories you haven’t heard — and taste the district that helped build Kentucky’s most famous industry.

experiences.title: Bardstown Bourbon & Food Tour
experiences.description:
This is NOT a small bites food tour! Be sure to come hungry. Here's what awaits you:

Discover the flavor, history, and bourbon spirit of Bardstown, KY, on this guided downtown walking tour.

✔️ Stop at 4 local favorite spots

✔️ Enjoy samples of regional dishes and handcrafted treats

✔️ Sip local bourbon or bourbon-inspired beverages

✔️ Stroll through historic streets and landmarks

✔️ Hear insider stories of Bardstown’s bourbon and food culture from a knowledgeable local guide

A delicious way to explore the Bourbon Capital—one bite, one sip, and one story at a time!

Start Location:
Taste of Bardstown Market
212 N. 3rd St.
Bardstown, KY 40004

Parking:
There is a free municipal city parking lot at 112 W. Flaget St., Bardstown, KY 40004, across from Scout & Scholar Brewery. There is also free street parking on 3rd Street.

The Taste of Bardstown Tour is about one mile long and lasts about three hours.

Must be 21+ to participate.

experiences.title: Walking Food Tour Downtown Lexington
experiences.description: Learn about downtown Lexington's captivating history as we take a culinary cruise to five delicious stops all in one afternoon! Discover award-winning eateries, unique foodie items like the buzz button, freshly baked breads from family-owned shops, fresh Kentucky-farmed vegetables, and more! In between bites, learn about colorful characters from Lexington's history and pass through landmarks like Skuller's Clock, The Square, and Phoenix Park.

experiences.title: Woodford Reserve, Castle & Key, and Stitzel Weller Bourbon Tour
experiences.description:
Come discover why Mint Julep Experiences is the leading expert on the Kentucky Bourbon Trail - with nearly 20 years of experience, over 1 million guests served, and more than 5,000 5-star reviews!

This Friday bourbon tour includes guided transportation, three distillery stops for tours and tastings, and a local lunch. Guests will experience Kentucky distillery tours with a tour and tasting at Woodford Reserve, a tour and tasting at Castle & Key, and a premium tasting at Stitzel Weller. Explore the heart of the Kentucky Bourbon Trail on this expertly crafted adventure.

experiences.title: Phantoms of Prohibition: Ghosts, Cocktails, & Bites Walking Tour
experiences.description:
Discover Louisville's Prohibition history on this haunted walking food & cocktail tour in downtown Louisville!

Travel back in time to Whiskey Row during the era of hidden speakeasies to savor handcrafted Prohibition-era cocktails paired with delicious small bites. Along the way, you'll unravel salacious true stories of Prohibition: ruthless bootleggers, Whiskey distillers, mobsters, the Louisville origins of the Great Gatsby, and even an axe-wielding temperance supporter. You'll also hear chilling ghost stories that have left their mark on the city's checkered past.

 Our expert guides will transport you to the days of secret bars and underground revelry in Prohibition-era downtown Louisville. One part ghost tour, one part Jazz-Age cocktail tour, this 3-hour immersive experience combines dinner and cocktails with spine-tingling ghost stories and a host of colorful characters from Louisville's bootlegging past. You'll leave with a taste of history- and perhaps a shiver down your spine.

experiences.title: Louisville 3-Hour Bourbon Trolley Tour with Distillery & Tastings
experiences.description:
Explore the heart of bourbon country on a 3-hour guided trolley tour through Louisville visiting the city's top bourbon destinations. Enjoy exclusive access to tasting rooms and tour a bourbon distillery. This small group tour, capped at 12 guests, is Louisville's most unique bourbon tour. As you roll through Louisville's vibrant neighborhoods in a climate-controlled historic trolley, you'll enjoy bourbon pours, craft cocktails, and delicious bourbon-infused samples. Stops vary each day, and every tour is a little different! This tour is perfect for both bourbon newcomers and seasoned enthusiasts looking to discover their next favorite bottle.

- Duration: 3 hours
- 4-6 stops including a distillery tour and bourbon tasting rooms
- Bourbon pours, bourbon cocktails, and bourbon-infused spice, sauce, and sweet samples
- Exclusive access and custom crafted experiences not bookable through anyone but us
- Discover under-the-radar bourbon brands
- Take-Home Gift: Louisville Icons Tote bag

experiences.title: Historic Walking Tour of Victorian Louisville with Food & Bourbon
experiences.description:
Escape the crowds in Old Louisville and experience a side of the city most visitors miss. Just five minutes from downtown and NuLu, the Highlands area is a local’s favorite, home to Louisville’s iconic Victorian architecture, the inventor of the Disco ball, and vibrant “Restaurant Row”. Brimming with with tree-lined avenues, opulent Victorian mansions, and quirky charm, this hidden gem is over 50 years older than Old Louisville — and far more delicious!

In the Original Highlands and Cherokee Park neighborhoods, you'll stroll tree-lined streets lined with colorful murals, blooming flowers, and grand historic homes; hear fascinating stories of immigrants, icons, and innovators; p ass the final resting places of Muhammed Ali and Colonel Sanders at Cave Hill Cemeter; and taste signature Louisville flavors at beloved local eateries you’d never find on your own.

This small-group experience includes everything you came to Louisville for: bites, bourbon, history, and charm!

experiences.title: Tasting Experience
experiences.description: Fresh Bourbon is the offering the newest, most unique Bourbon Tasting currently in Kentucky. We guide our guests through a full sensory tasting with food & aroma pairing, to help them explore and understand the complexities of Bourbon. You'll get hands on training from a professional local mixologists and build your own custom Old-Fashioned. Plus, historical tips, tricks and stories from the Bourbon world and an opportunity to explore more flavors through our seasonal craft cocktail menu. All of which are included in a dynamic tasting experience, in fact, the first Bourbon Tasting Experience in downtown Lexington, Kentucky!

experiences.title: Secrets of Louisville: 3hr NuLu Food & History Walking Tour
experiences.description:
Explore vibrant NuLu & historic Butchertown with locally-owned Louisville Food Tours on the original Nulu food tour to taste the flavors of Louisville! Over the course of 3 immersive hours, you'll visit local eateries and enjoy delicious bites that showcase Louisville's culinary heritage. Dishes include biscuits & gravy with roots in the foothills of Appalachia, Kentucky-style fried chicken, a Louisville BBQ dish, bourbon balls, a Prohibition-era Hot Brown gravy, and barrel-aged craft beer.

As you wander through the historic streets of two of Louisville's oldest neighborhoods, you’ll uncover the stories behind the city’s rich history, visit a historic home once occupied by Thomas Edison, sample a unique confection inspired by a Victorian actress, and trace the paths of the immigrants who shaped Louisville. 

This tour typically sells out. Reserve your spot early and come hungry!

experiences.title: B&C Bourbon Experience Tour
experiences.description:
Our Bourbon Tour offers a personalized and authentic experience in the heart of bourbon country. Guests can choose three of the finest distilleries, selected based on availability and personal preferences, where they will enjoy guided tours, tastings, and a deep dive into the rich history and craftsmanship of bourbon.

The tour can be arranged with private luxury transportation for a more exclusive experience, or with public transportation for groups of up to 11 people, always ensuring a smooth, comfortable, and well-organized journey.

Every detail is thoughtfully designed to deliver a memorable experience, combining flexibility, comfort, and exceptional service from start to finish. ✨

experiences.title: Beyond the Barrel: NuLu Walking Bourbon & Food Pairing Experience
experiences.description:
Uncover the secrets of Kentucky bourbon! Go beyond the barrel to dive into bourbon's storied history - and learn all the stories they won't tell you on a Kentucky Bourbon Trail distillery tour. 

Visit award-winning restaurants and intimate tasting rooms in NuLu, a neighborhood recognized as one of “The Best Food Neighborhoods in the USA”. 

Trace the origins of bourbon whiskey from its roots in the Appalachian foothills to today's thriving bourbon scene, and leave with a profound understanding of bourbon's cultural importance in Louisville, Kentucky and beyond. 

Unlock bourbon's surprising versatility and depth of flavor through paired bites, pours, and cocktails, and land a few coveted tables at some of the most hard-to-book restaurants in town.

Perfect for both bourbon newcomers and seasoned enthusiasts, this guided walking tour offers an experience that you won't find at any bourbon distillery. Reserve your spot early to experience the world's only walking food & bourbon tour!

experiences.title: Angel's Envy, Stitzel-Weller and Kentucky Artisan Bourbon Tour
experiences.description:
Come discover why Mint Julep Experiences is the leading expert on the Kentucky Bourbon Trail - with nearly 20 years of experience, over 1 million guests served, and more than 5,000 5-star reviews!

Join Mint Julep Experiences for this Saturday bourbon tour, which includes guided transportation, 3 distillery stops for tours and tastings, and a local lunch. Guests will start the day with a tasting at Stitzel-Weller, enjoy a tour and tasting at Angel's Envy after lunch at a local favorite, and a tour and tasting at Kentucky Artisan (home of Jefferson's Reserve).

experiences.title: Experience Rebecca Ruth Chocolate Tour & Museum!
experiences.description:
We are a 100+ year old company with a small family owned atmosphere. 
Our Tour Guides provide traditional Southern Hospitality and energy to our tours. We are located in the heart of beautiful Historic Downtown Frankfort.

experiences.title: Louisville Food Tour with 5 Local Authentic Tastings
experiences.description:
Downtown Louisville has a rhythm all its own, where river air carries the sweet, oaky scent of aging barrels and cast-iron facades on historic Whiskey Row tell the story of bourbon pioneers. This tour ditches the tourist haunts and gets straight to what makes Louisville tick: its food.
As we wander Museum Row and the riverside, you'll indulge in spirit-infused chocolates revealing deep notes of Kentucky's finest bourbon, bite into a Short Rib Grilled Cheese with braised short ribs, gruyère, provolone and caramelized onions on toasted homemade brioche, and dip warm pretzels into zesty beer cheese, a regional staple with deep Kentucky roots.
Because we keep groups to a maximum of 12 guests, it feels like exploring with a friend who knows all the best spots. We'll also stop at a family-run dairy churning premium ice cream since the 1800s, and pause for our Secret Dish, a savory, melted tribute to this city's legendary comfort food tradition!

experiences.title: Experience Rebecca Ruth Chocolate Tour & Museum
experiences.description:
We are a 100+ year old company with a small family owned atmosphere. 
Our Tour Guides provide traditional Southern Hospitality and energy to our tours. We are located in the heart of beautiful Historic Downtown Frankfort.

experiences.title: Kentucky Bourbon Experience: 3 Iconic Distilleries & Tastings
experiences.description:
The Kentucky Bourbon Experience You’ve Been Looking For

Discover the authentic spirit of Kentucky on a carefully curated bourbon experience designed to maximize your day—not your time on the road.

✔ Visit 3 Kentucky bourbon distilleries 
✔ Experience a unique mix of iconic, family-owned, and innovative craft distilleries (subject to availability)
✔ Tours, tastings, or both, depending on each distillery’s schedule
✔ Door-to-door pickup & drop-off from Lousiville 
✔ itinerary with smart routing :More time exploring distilleries and less time driving
✔ Knowledgeable local bourbon guide
✔ Personalized customer support before and during your tour

Whether you visit legendary names like Buffalo Trace, Maker’s Mark, Woodford Reserve, Four Roses, Wild Turkey, Heaven Hill, or discover hidden gems, every itinerary is carefully planned to deliver an authentic Kentucky bourbon experience.

Perfect for first-time visitors and bourbon enthusiasts looking for more than a standard sightseeing tour.

experiences.title: Bourbon Tour (03) : Buffalo Trace, Woodford, Four Roses, Wild Turkey, Other
experiences.description:
Experience a unique sightseeing tour and/or tasting at 3 traditional Kentucky bourbon distilleries (KY has more than 60 distilleries). Avoid the stress of planning on your own and enjoy a seamless, well-organized tour.

Visit 03 iconic distilleries where you will learn about the bourbon production process and enjoy tastings of premium bourbons (21+ only). We provide a list of 18 distilleries for you to choose from. Please select 3, as we build your itinerary based on availability.

Your booking includes visits to 3 distilleries (tour and/or tasting).

Optional: You may add other distillery to your tour. Please contact us after booking.

Please note:
Min of 2 guests per tour
We schedule tours based on distillery and vehicle availability
Start times may vary depending on the selected distilleries
Please send your 3 preferred distilleries after booking
Distillery hours and availability vary by day
Please contact the operator by email or call Viator directly for any questions or requests

experiences.title: Spirits Distillery Guided Tours and Tastings in Louisville
experiences.description:
Discover the art of crafting spirits near Nulu in downtown Louisville. This intimate 1000 square foot nano distillery invites you to explore unique Italian-inspired spirits and liqueurs through guided tours and tastings. Taste small-batch products that highlight the rich history and science behind distilling. Perfect for spirits enthusiasts seeking to expand their palate and learn about the distillation process in a cozy setting. 

- Enjoy guided tours at Kentucky's smallest distillery
- Sample exclusive small-batch spirits and liqueurs
- Located conveniently near Nulu and Falls City Brewery

experiences.title: 2 Hours Guided Culinary Adventures in Radcliff
experiences.description: Cleangoodeats cooking classes offer a unique farm-to-table experience, blending vibrant, fresh ingredients with creative, nutrient-packed recipes. Our classes are designed to inspire travelers to explore bold flavors, master culinary techniques, and create meals that nourish both body and soul. Each session is hands-on and interactive, giving you the opportunity to prepare delicious, healthy dishes while learning tips on how to source local, organic produce and grass-fed meats. The emphasis on flavor, health, and fun creates a one-of-a-kind culinary adventure you won’t find anywhere else.

experiences.title: Podcast Tour How Bourbon Resurrected Louisville
experiences.description:
Discover the intoxicating story of how a single spirit brought a city back from the brink. This immersive walking tour takes you through the heart of downtown Louisville, revealing how the booming bourbon industry didn't just fill glasses, but literally saved the city's architectural soul. From 19th-century cast-iron facades rescued from the wrecking ball to abandoned factories transformed into cultural beacons, you will explore the sensory, historical, and economic forces of the Bourbon Renaissance.

A 2.2 km self-guided tour with 6 stops over 87 min
Ideal for travelers interested in Foodways & Culinary Identity and History & Memory
Immersively told in a podcast style by experts and locals
Matching audio content, AI guide and navigation through the app

experiences.title: Craft Cider and Mead Tasting in New Orleans
experiences.description: Join us as we explore how our location in New Orleans has shaped our techniques used and products offered, and learn how our approach compares to most cider production. This is an approximately forty-five minute long, guided tasting that offers four different samplings of cider, all of which are produced on site by Jon & Diana.

experiences.title: Seven Three Distilling Tour and Tasting
experiences.description: Our North Claiborne Avenue distillery reflects our love of New Orleans and commitment to making spirits with a sense of place. We have a lot of fun here and we’d love to welcome you for a tour and spirits tasting. The distillery is also available to host one-of-a-kind private events.

experiences.title: Hands-on Cajun Roux Cooking Class in New Orleans
experiences.description:
The Mardi Gras School of Cooking does small, intimate hands-on classes in the French Quarter. Classes are more like a dinner party with friends. Feel welcomed into our kitchens by the Chefs themselves. From the moment you arrive until you roll out the door our Chefs are friendly, personable and entertaining. Not to mention their culinary skills are impeccable. 

Our minimum class size is 2 people. A solo traveler may join an already scheduled class. Call us to hear about the available classes. 

For parties of 8 or more, you will have to contact us directly to book. We have questions.

experiences.title: New Orleans Hands-on Brunch Class
experiences.description: Join us for a True New Orleans style brunch! The South is known for Brunch, so let us show you how it’s done in New Orleans. Bottomless champagne, mimosas, wine, beer, sodas, and water are included. In this hands-on class, we will be making some of our favorite recipes. You will work alongside of the Chef learning the best ways to cut and prep the Holy Trinity. We are the only Cooking School that does small, intimate hands-on classes in the French Quarter. Our class size ranges from 2 people to 10. Classes are more like a dinner party with friends!

experiences.title: Hands-on Cajun Traditions Cooking Class
experiences.description:
The Mardi Gras School of Cooking does small, intimate hands-on classes in the French Quarter. Classes are more like a dinner party with friends. Feel welcomed into our kitchens by the Chefs themselves. From the moment you arrive until you roll out the door our Chefs are friendly, personable and entertaining. Not to mention their culinary skills are impecable. 

Our minimum class size is 2 people. A solo traveler may join an already scheduled class. Call us to hear about the available classes.

experiences.title: Food Tour of New Orleans Garden District: Group of Nine or Less
experiences.description:
SEMI-PRIVATE - Just 9 People or Less!

Indulge in an unforgettable adventure that goes beyond the ordinary! Get out of the French Quarter and join us in Uptown to experience where -- and what -- locals eat in New Orleans. 

Every stop on this culinary journey is designed to surprise and delight your taste buds. You'll learn the difference between Creole and Cajun, and witness firsthand how our food is a radiant expression of our people and culture. 

This is more than a tour; it's a FULL MEAL with the opportunity to eat like a local and truly understand why New Orleans is a haven for food lovers around the world. Be sure to come hungry!

experiences.title: New Orleans Hands-On Cooking Class with Meal
experiences.description: Learn how to cook an authentic Louisiana meal in this 3-Hour New Orleans cooking class. An expert chef will guide you and a group of, at most, 10 people through various recipes. Wine and beer are included in the price, and you can take your recipe and apron home with you after the class. Choose from multiple times and meals upon booking.

experiences.title: Pub Crawl: New Orleans Cocktail and Ghost Tour
experiences.description: I've served more pub crawls, by far, than any guide in New Orleans. This provides me preferential, or exclusive, access to select venues that will help aid the tour's narrative and propel our exploration of New Orleans' cocktail/ghost history. This tour pays for itself, once you know the places I sip. Between bars, we walk to haunted/historical locations unveiling the culture, history, architecture, and the city's terrifying past.

experiences.title: New Orleans Cocktail History Walking Tour in the French Quarter
experiences.description: Savor tasty cocktails in the French Quarter of New Orleans on a walking tour with an expert local guide. Visit hidden gems enjoyed by locals for centuries, learning from your fun and knowledgeable guide about the historic venues you see and legendary cocktails you sip. Discover the origins of the Daiquiri, learn the truth about absinthe, and sample a Sazerac concocted from a 19th-century recipe. Each stop features a classic cocktail, mixed by renowned bartenders who add a signature twist. It's a perfect tour for cocktail and culture enthusiasts!

experiences.title: New Orleans Sweet Treats Food Tour: Beignets, Donuts, & Much More
experiences.description:
Recently voted one of TripAdvisor's top food tours in the US. 

Most people are familiar with Bourbon Street and the French Quarter, but many people don’t know Magazine Street, where our tour takes place and has a rich history around food, art, culture and nightlife. We’ll visit 4 different shops - trying donuts and beignets all along the way. Starting with traditional beignets with powdered sugar and a coffee in hand, we’ll learn about the neighborhoods rich history as it relates to New Orleans. At our second stop, we’ll follow that up with artisanal donuts at one of the best donut shops in New Orleans. After a short walk, we’ll have some super interesting beignets with various toppings and sauces, unlike anything you’ve tried before. And finally, we’ll end up at our last stop and we’ll have our last surprise on the tour. It’s sure to be a delicious and casual adventure you’re sure to enjoy. 

Hope to see you soon!

experiences.title: New Orleans Cocktail and Food History Tour
experiences.description:
Combining the history of Louisiana cuisine and New Orleans-style cocktails, this event is a feast for the senses! 

Along with your guide you will visit up 6 locations: award-winning seafood restaurants, James Beard-nominated craft cocktail lounges, Creole restaurants, artisanal candy stores and more.

Once inside you’ll sample up to 6 or more different dishes that represent the modern expressions of our culinary heritage: classic dishes like gumbo, and muffulettas, but also new interpretations like sweet fried plantains! (Vegetarian options available too!)

We'll also enjoy 4 full-sized cocktails like the refreshing Pimm's Cup, the rum-heavy Hurricane, the classic Daiquiri and more!

This 4 hour gastronomic odyssey is our way of showing you where we like to go now, and what we like to eat and drink once we're there.

With so many dining and drinking options in New Orleans, why not try up to 6 different places in one fell swoop?!

*All venues subject to change based on availability.

experiences.title: New Orleans Food and History Walking Tour
experiences.description:
This New Orleans food tour has every culinary taste covered. With a history-savvy guide leading the way, you’ll walk from classic Creole restaurants and neighborhood sandwich shops to hot sauce bars and artisanal candy stores. Visit up to five locations to sample diverse foods representing the breadth of Louisiana’s culinary heritage, including dishes like seafood gumbo, po-boys, muffulettas and pralines. Vegetarian options available too! Learn about the historical origins of each cuisine and, when possible, hear the chefs discuss their influences. Enjoy plenty of food on this afternoon tour.

Please note: all venues are subject to change based on availability. This tour features a set menu (plus Vegetarian option), but does not have a gluten-free, dairy-free or Vegan option. However, please notify us of any food allergies (not aversions) during check-out.

experiences.title: New Orleans Small-Group Food Walking Tour and Cooking Class
experiences.description:
Take a 3-hour walking food tour with Destination Kitchen, enjoying some of the most famous and most visited eateries in the quarter while learning about the history and culture of New Orleans! Then, watch a cooking demonstration at New Orleans Cooking school. Learn to make Louisiana favorites with recipes, locally brewed beer, refreshments, and enough food for lunch. This is the perfect way to experience the food and culture of New Orleans in one day!

Sample menu ( may vary by day):
Gumbo, Jambalaya, Bread Pudding, Pralines, and a Biscuit with Molasses

Served with: Water, Iced tea, Lemonade, Coffee (morning class),
Abita beer (a local brew)

experiences.title: French Quarter Food Tour
experiences.description:
On our 3 hour walking food tour of New Orleans French Quarter, you will savor delicious foods from 5 restaurants, mom-and-pop shops and bakeries. In addition to all the delectable food, your guide will discuss the history, culture and food scene of the neighborhood. 

Our tours are storytelling through food. We call our French Quarter Food Tour "The Classic Five" because you will be tasting the quintessential New Orleans food staples. Join us on a 3 hour food extravaganza, as we eat our way though The Quarter...

experiences.title: French Quarter Food Tour: 5 Classic Bites and NOLA Stories
experiences.description: Dig into the rich and varied flavors that make New Orleans one of the USA’s top foodie destinations. From the most famous local haunts to some delectable hidden gems, you’ll leave with not only a full stomach and a smile, but a greater understanding of how New Orleans food, culture and history all go hand-in-hand.

experiences.title: French Quarter Walking Food Tour: Famous Flavors of New Orleans
experiences.description:
Best in the French Quarter! Celebrating 15 Years! Most economical, Family and Veteran Owned. The oldest Food Tour in New Orleans, 5000 plus 5 star reviews ! Simply the Best Food Tour in New Orleans! We have your table reserved. Unlike other companies that serve you standing up on the side walk.

Unlike other Food Tours, Tastebud Food Tours never cancels a Tour because of low bookings. We value your vacation and time. You will get the best with Tastebud Tours. Compare and SAVE! Likely to sell out!

Tastebud Food Tours is proud that our tours have earned earning Trip Advisors prestigious Hall of Fame Award and Travelers Choice for 15 years! #1 

Eat your way through the French Quarter on this 3-hour New Orleans food tour. Taste classic dishes like Gumbo, Jambalaya , pralines and other Creole specialties. Learn about the city's culinary history, which is strongly influenced by Louisiana’s French heritage and the vibrant Creole population. Rain or Shine, Book now!

experiences.title: New Orleans Garden District Food and History Tour
experiences.description: Visit three food stops that highlight New Orleans culture & history through flavors on this guided walking tour of the Garden District. After a brief tour of the neighborhood's architecture & history, enjoy a full meal of unique Cajun and Creole specialties, spread out over 3 local eateries. Start at the Lafayette Cemetery, then explore the architecture of the Garden District, home to historic mansions, colorful shotgun houses, and beautiful oak trees. There's also GREAT small business and antique/vintage shopping, boutiques and galleries on Magazine St.! Your food stops includes indulgent dishes of Creole fusion and the multicultural influences that shaped the 300-year-old city. Drinks (alcoholic or non-alcoholic) are included. Finish with a full stomach and plenty of recommendations for local fun and flavors for the rest of your visit!

experiences.title: New Orleans Demonstration Cooking Class with Meal
experiences.description: Take an entertaining and informative cooking class at the New Orleans School of Cooking! Located in a renovated molasses warehouse built in the early 1800s, this cooking class brings you to the heart of New Orleans’ French Quarter. Learn the basics of Louisiana cooking from professional chefs and learn how to make classic New Orleans specialties such as gumbo, jambalaya and pralines. Enjoy the finished delectable dishes accompanied by complimentary beer, iced tea and coffee, and take the recipes home with you!

experiences.title: French Quarter Small-Group Cocktail and Foodie Crawl
experiences.description:
New Orleans doesn't just serve food and cocktails—it serves legend. Come taste the difference.
Join Destination Kitchen Tours, New Orleans' top-rated food & cocktail walking tour, for 3 unforgettable hours through the French Quarter. This small-group, bespoke experience pairs signature cocktails with authentic local tastings, led by a passionate guide who knows the neighborhood's best kitchens, hidden bars, and legendary stories.
Skip the crowded walk-and-point tours. This is an intimate, walking dinner-party atmosphere where history, culture, and flavor collide—an authentic taste of New Orleans in a casual, high-end setting.
Women-owned and family-run for over a decade, Destination Kitchen Tours has earned 1,200+ five-star reviews and back-to-back travel industry awards, including TripAdvisor's Best of the Best.
Come hungry. Leave with new favorite bars, restaurants, and a deeper love for New Orleans.
Book now-space is limited on this top-rated French Quarter food and cocktail tour.

experiences.title: New Orleans Food Walking Tour of the French Quarter with Small-Group Option
experiences.description:
Fall head over heels for the French Quarter, one delicious bite at a time! What pops your cork more than gumbo, oysters, and 300 years of history? This half day food tour -where flavor meets legacy and how we roll in New Orleans!
Your passionate, knowledgeable guide leads you into the heart of the Quarter for tastings that read like a love letter to Creole and Cajun cooking. Including:
-Rich traditional Gumbo - at a beloved Creole restaurant
-Shrimp Po-Boy
-Boudin or Alligator Sausage for the adventurous
-Classic Muffuletta, stacked w/olive salad
-Rustic, savory Jambalaya
-Char-Grilled or BBQ Oysters, sizzling
-Crab Boudin Ball that packs a punch
-Calas, Beignets & buttery Pralines made right!
Stroll past the iconic Café du Monde. No Quarter adventure is complete without it!
Soak up the rich culinary legacy of this legendary area. Walk away w/ your own hotspot list. Option to upgrade to a small-group tour for an even closer connection to the food and stories.
See you in the Quarter!

experiences.title: New Orleans Original Seafood Tour of the French Quarter
experiences.description:
New Orleans is the #1 food destination in the USA. The question is, are you hungry for it’s delicious seafood?! If your answer is yes then it’s time to book Tastebud Tour’s Original New Orleans Seafood and History Food Tour. Take an unforgettable stroll through the streets of the Cresent City immersing your taste buds to some of the best seafood NOLA has to offer while your professional guide shares stories behind it’s iconic cuisine. 
Celebrating 16 years in New Orleans, Tastebud Food Tours is proud that our tours have earned 2600 5 Star reviews on TripAdvisor, earning Trip Advisors prestigious Hall of Fame Award and Travelers Choice for 2024! #1 in Nola! This Tour Operates Rain or Shine, unless we cancel due to dangerous weather

experiences.title: Pub Crawl: Haunted New Orleans Booze and Boos Ghost Walking Tour
experiences.description:
Join your costumed tour guide in the historic French Quarter for a journey through one of the most famous locations in history. This combination ghost tour and pub crawl will take you past some of the oldest buildings in the south. Each one with its own dark tale lurking behind the shutters. You’ll hear tales of war, murder, and voodoo; of legend and lore; of the bloody nightmares that are buried beneath the incredible French and Spanish architecture. With liquid courage in hand, we will spend two hours exploring the French Quarter and learning the intimate details of the city’s eternal residents. 

*Tour route and drink stops are subject to availability. 
*All guests must be 21+ with Valid ID. Alcohol is not included.

experiences.title: Lower Garden District Food Tour
experiences.description: On our 3-hour Lower Garden District Walking Food Tour, you will savor foods from 5 uniquely different restaurants, mom-and-pop shops, and bakeries. We will tease your taste buds as you nosh on foods from award-winning food establishments. The Lower Garden District food tour gets you out of The Quarter and into a neighborhood the locals live and eat in. We savor foods like Korean BBQ, the best Jewish Deli Sandwich in NOLA, authentic Mexican tacos, a bologna sandwich from a restaurant named by Bon Appetit as the "Best New Restaurant in America," and artisanal doughnuts. In addition to all the delectable foods, your guide will tell fun and interesting stories about the history, culture and food scene of the neighborhood. Join us on an eating adventure!

experiences.title: Crawl New Orleans: Haunted Pub Crawl and Ghost Tour
experiences.description:
Uncover the Ghostly Secrets of the French Quarter on the New Orleans Haunted Crawl

Step into the eerie history of New Orleans with this Haunted Crawl, where the past comes alive through spine-tingling tales of ghosts, hauntings, and dark legends. As you explore the haunted corners of the French Quarter, your expert guide will share stories of the city’s most infamous residents and the ghosts that still linger. Along the way, you’ll enjoy VIP entry to haunted bars, sipping on drinks as you dive deep into the haunted history of New Orleans.

- Discover the haunted history of New Orleans on a guided ghost tour
- Visit historic pubs and haunted locations in the French Quarter
- Enjoy VIP access to haunted bars with exclusive drink specials
- Perfect for ghost enthusiasts and leisurely tourists looking to experience the darker side of New Orleans with a drink in hand.

experiences.title: Shrimp Boil Cabaret: Seafood Tasting Menu & Live Music
experiences.description:
Experience the real French Quarter at Shrimp Boil Cabaret
Step away from the tourist crowds and join us for a private dinner party celebrating the flavors and sounds of the Quarter. The Shrimp is sourced from local shrimping families at their boat docks a few hours before your shrimp boil to choose the largest, freshest, wild-caught local shrimp available. Mister Gregory, "The Shrimp Boil King of New Orleans" grew up in the Gulf South shrimping and boiling and advocating for wild-caught Gulf Shrimp and the "eat it to save it" culinary approach. Please join us for live local music and a lovely dinner party, make some new friends and eat the very best shrimp in the world.

experiences.title: Pub Crawl: New Orleans Lewd Spirits Haunted Tour with Bar Stops
experiences.description: Discover debauchery during this 2-hour small-group haunted tour, which will cover topics such as adultery, prostitutes, and twisted doctors. Your guide will entertain you with treacherous and spooky stories as you walk from a variety of locations such as The Creole Cookery and May Baily's. Calm your nerves with some liquid courage as this tour combines spirits with spirits at 3 different bars. This 21-and-over tour is great for groups who want to experience the twisted side of NOLA.

experiences.title: French Quarter Walking Food Tour: Signature Tastes of New Orleans
experiences.description:
Experience the oldest food tour in New Orleans with over 5000 5-star reviews! We are a family and veteran owned business. We have your table reserved, unlike other companies that serve you standing up on the side walk. We never cancel a tour because of low bookings - we value your vacation and time. 

Eat your way through the French Quarter on this 3-hour New Orleans food tour. Taste classic dishes like pralines, jambalaya, gumbo, and other Creole specialties. Learn about the city's culinary history, which is strongly influenced by Louisiana’s French heritage and the vibrant Creole population. Have fun! This tour operates rain or shine.

experiences.title: New Orleans Seafood Bar Crawl
experiences.description:
New Orleans is most known for its unique culture, art, and seafood, and I’m excited to take you on a tour of the most popular seafood spots in the city, capturing the true essence of NOLA’s art and history. Behind every great food establishment here lies a story of tradition and innovation. On this food tour, you’ll not only taste the incredible flavors but also discover the rich histories that make these places so beloved by locals.

My goal is to create quality moments, capturing the best pictures and selfies in the heart of NOLA as we enjoy seafood from local gems. This experience is a LOVE LETTER to New Orleans! Bring your smile, positive energy, drinks, a fashionable outfit, and LET THE GOOD TIMES ROLL!

The tour lasts about an hour, with stops at local bars and seafood spots along the way.

Follow us on social media @tremeluxuryexperience to join the fun online!

experiences.title: New Orleans Original Craft Cocktail Walking Tour
experiences.description: Enjoy French Quarter courtyards, classic cocktails, and entertaining history! Did you know that the word “cocktail” originated in New Orleans? In a city that fosters creativity and breathes inspiration, it’s no wonder the history is so closely entwined with a culinary culture. On this small group tour you’ll drink in the rich history of the city as you explore the French Quarter, where the hour is always happy. If you don’t finish your drink, ask for a “to go cup.” This is not a bar crawl. It's history… with a twist!

experiences.title: French Quarter Food Walking Tour with Tastings
experiences.description:
Explore with us why New Orleans' Cajun and Creole cuisine is one of the most desired in the country. Sample the French Quarter's famously delicious dishes as you learn about the architecture of the buildings and its' 300 year old history. Meet the people behind the scenes that sprinkle local culture with flavors. Learn the historical facts about the city's oldest restaurants and discover the secrets behind New Orleans creole cooking. Include Samples

PLEASE NOTE we will NOT be able to accommodate food allergies/special diets. It is the guest’s responsibility to let us know if they have any food allergies or restrictions when they book a tour.

experiences.title: New Orleans Courtyard Cocktails: Happy Hour Mixology Class
experiences.description:
Timed perfectly for happy hour—a cocktail class with the fun, relaxed energy of an evening wind-down.
Local bartenders sharing both recipes and New Orleans’ legendary barroom stories.
Three handcrafted cocktails, plus history, technique, and plenty of laughs.
Light bites included, so you can sip, snack, and savor the moment.
Limited seating for a cozy, convivial atmosphere.

experiences.title: New Orleans Cooking Class and Cocktail Walking Tour
experiences.description:
Explore the rich culinary history of New Orleans on a tour that combines a cooking class with a French Quarter cocktail tour. First, learn about the basics of Louisiana cuisine from a professional chef during an entertaining demonstration, then sample classics such as jambalaya, gumbo, and pralines. 

When your cooking class ends you will have a few minutes to shop in the General Store before your tour guide arrives at the School to pick you up for the second part of your tour. Admire the architecture of the French Quarter as you stroll through the neighborhood, stopping in historic bars to sip the Big Easy’s most celebrated cocktails. You'll discover the flavors and culture of New Orleans during this fun and informative tour! Your cocktail tour guide will meet you outside of the cooking school by 4:15pm. Two drinks are included in the price.

experiences.title: New Orleans Food Walking Tour
experiences.description:
• 2-hour food tour in the French Quarter
 • Learn the difference between Cajun and Creole cooking 
 • Visit some of the most historic restaurants in the French Quarter
 • Enjoy tasting authentic New Orleans cuisine

experiences.title: Court of Two Sisters Live Jazz Brunch Buffet with Mimosa
experiences.description:
The Court of Two Sisters' Live Jazz Brunch buffet showcases the best of New Orleans from the music to the atmosphere to the food and drinks. The buffet boasts is a sumptuous display of hot and cold dishes incorporating local ingredients when possible.

A typical selection of hot dishes include made-to-order omelets, eggs benedict, ham or ribeye, sausage and bacon, grits and grillades, gumbo, jambalaya, turtle soup, red beans and rice, fried catfish, duck a l'Orange, creamed spinach, and shrimp etouffee among many others. The cold buffet includes a variety of salads, boiled gulf shrimp, fruits and cheeses, and assorted desserts.

Additionally, one complimentary glass of house wine, champagne or mimosa is included.

experiences.title: Paddlewheeler Creole Queen Jazz Dinner Cruise in New Orleans
experiences.description: Cruise into a brilliant and romantic sunset aboard the Paddlewheeler Creole Queen! Underneath enchanting skyline views enjoy the lively sounds from Sullivan Dabney, Jr. and the Muzik Jazz band while delighting your taste buds with a deliciously prepared Creole-styled meal (if option is chosen). Grab one or two classic New Orleans cocktails inside at the bar, then take a stroll outside along elegantly designed wrought iron trimmed railings for a night full of stars and warm banter. Become part of the city's unique energy and let the sweet Mississippi River breeze sweep you off your senses onto the dance floor atop our promenade deck for a night full of pure New Orleans magic.

experiences.title: New Orleans Steamboat Natchez Jazz Cruise with Dinner Option
experiences.description:
Welcome aboard the Steamboat NATCHEZ or Riverboat CITY of NEW ORLEANS! PLEASE make sure you choose your vessel carefully at check out.

Ready for the ultimate New Orleans night out? Step aboard a classic riverboat for a dinner jazz cruise on the mighty Mississippi River — one of the most iconic things to do in New Orleans!

Hear stories of the Big Easy's rich history, sit back, relax and enjoy the New Orleans atmosphere as the smooth jazz of the world-acclaimed Dukes of Dixieland fills your ears. This 2-hour cruise from the heart of the French Quarter will take you along the graceful Mississippi River.

Savor a Creole-inspired buffet, sip handcrafted cocktails, and sway to live New Orleans jazz as the skyline sparkles around you. Whether it’s date night, a group outing, or your first trip to the Crescent City, this two-hour cruise brings all the NOLA magic — food, music, and views included. Book together to sit together! Don’t just visit New Orleans — cruise through it in style.

experiences.title: Private New Orleans Food Tour: Tastes of the Bend Neighborhood
experiences.description: Secret and eclectic fare from New Orleans that a casual traveler may miss mixed with essential local daily cuisine. We will enrich your knowledge of the history of the Big Easy as well as your tongue. I hope you are ready for a big bite and plenty of laughs on this exciting culinary journey.

experiences.title: Bananas Foster Cooking Demonstration in the French Quarter
experiences.description:
Step into the sweet side of New Orleans at the historic Court of Two Sisters and discover the story behind one of the city’s most iconic desserts, Bananas Foster. Watch a step-by-step demonstration from caramelizing the bananas to the dramatic flambé that gives this classic dessert its signature finish.

Along the way, discover the fascinating history behind Bananas Foster and how this beloved New Orleans creation became a culinary tradition. You’ll also hear stories and little-known tidbits about the historic Court of Two Sisters and the colorful history of Royal Street.

After the demonstration, indulge in the delicious dessert served over homemade vanilla ice cream and take home a recipe card to try it yourself.

NOTE: This is a demonstration activity and does not include a hands-on experience.

experiences.title: Bom Creole Dining Experience w/ Pool and Louisiana Native Chef
experiences.description: Bonjour! Growing up in Cajun Country (Lafayette, LA) my family has utilized the resources from the along the Vermilion and Atchafalaya Rivers' for over two centuries. The first recipe I ever learned was from my grandfather Autoine Leon which resulted in " Big Popoa" homemade buttermilk biscuits! Specializing in Creole cuisine I use the freshest Louisiana seafood and ingredients to create my spectacular dishes and never forget to throw in the "Holy Trinity". With mealtime being the focal point of my upbringing I have fond memories with family and friends of community, togetherness, and celebration. Hospitality and cooking are in my roots and I can't wait to share my family's southern dishes with you! All ingredients are locally sourced and you'll be served the freshest Louisiana seafood! Now come on down and Let's Eat!

experiences.title: New Orleans Old Alker Distillery Tour and Expert Guided Tasting
experiences.description: Unlike mass-production facilities, Old Alker Distillery offers an authentic, hands-on look into New Orleans craft vodka, rum, and gin distilling. You’ll step directly onto our active production floor for an up-close look at our traditional handmade copper pot stills, learning how slow, small-batch distillation creates unmatched depth of flavor and a smooth mouthfeel. Our experience combines grain-to-glass education, a professionally guided flight of locally inspired spirits, and a freshly handcrafted parting cocktail—giving you an insider's taste of New Orleans craftsmanship.

experiences.title: Pork Butt Cabaret: Cajun Pork Tasting Menu & Live Music
experiences.description:
Throughout the evening, your host serves up the stories behind the food: Cajun boucheries, cochon de lait parties, the history of cracklin’, Louisiana sugar cane, and the generations of cooks who figured out that almost every part of a pig could become something delicious.

But this isn't a cooking class, and it isn't just dinner.

It's Pork Butt Cabaret.

A slightly outrageous, thoroughly New Orleans supper club filled with Louisiana food, live local music, storytelling, and good company—where the portions are generous, the music is lively, the stories get better as the evening goes on, and the pig is always the star of the show.

experiences.title: Spooky Ramen Tours
experiences.description: Allie Del Franco is a local with experience living in NYC and Hollywood. She brings both history with humor on the tour - a perfect combination for your Salem trip. All ages enjoy this tour (families, couples, single travelers) and she provides a custom experience to all including walking to other locations after the tour. and KIDS FREE!

experiences.title: Spooky Ramen Comedy Walking Tour
experiences.description: All tour guides are entertaining local comedians that will bring you laughter AND history on your Spooky Ramen Tours experience. They are all Salem certified tour guides and brings both history with humor on the tour - a perfect combination for your Salem trip. All ages enjoy this tour (families, couples, single travelers) and they provide a custom experience to all including walking to other locations after the tour. and KIDS FREE!

experiences.title: Fun Chinese Noodle Making Class With a Local Chef in Boston
experiences.description:
Turn simple ingredients into something truly unforgettable in this Boston noodle-making experience. In this interactive class, Chef Rita breaks down the art of hand-pulled noodles into approachable steps. Start by preparing noodle dough from flour, oil and salt, learning how proper kneading creates strength and flexibility.

Next, stretch and pull the dough into Biang Biang noodles, practicing the technique that gives them their signature shape and chew. Chef Rita will share tips to help you control thickness and achieve consistent results.

Alongside your noodles, create two flavorful sauces: a fragrant garlic sauce with peppercorn and ginger, and a creamy peanut sauce with soy and vinegar. Enjoy your dish at the end of class and leave with skills rooted in both technique and tradition.

experiences.title: Fun Ramen Making Class With a Local Chef in Boston
experiences.description: If your idea of comfort food starts with ramen, this is where things get interesting. You'll roll up your sleeves and learn how to build a deeply flavorful spicy miso broth using pork bones, chicken wing tips, pork fat, white miso paste, go chu jang, honda shi, konbu, ginger, garlic and white pepper. Next, you'll prepare roasted pork, cook a jammy soft-boiled egg and assemble a restaurant-worthy bowl with springy ramen noodles and carefully layered toppings. Along the way, you'll pick up practical techniques for developing rich flavor, balancing seasoning and reducing food waste by making smart use of ingredients that often get overlooked. The atmosphere stays relaxed and approachable, making it easy to learn whether it's your first cooking class or your fiftieth. Then comes the best part: sitting down to enjoy every rich, savory and slurp-worthy bite.

experiences.title: A Taste of the Freedom Trail: Iconic Boston Food & History Tour
experiences.description:
Experience Boston's iconic Freedom Trail through its most legendary dishes.

Savor generous tastings of New England classics, including creamy clam chowder, a classic lobster roll, slow-cooked Boston baked beans, and the city's famous Boston Cream Pie at the very hotel where it was first created in the 1850s.

Follow your local guide through Boston's historic streets, uncovering the fascinating stories behind each dish—from Native American influences and colonial traditions to the flavors that continue to define Boston's culinary heritage.

Unlike many food tours, most of our tastings are enjoyed while comfortably seated inside the restaurants with individually plated portions, giving you time to relax, savor each stop, and soak in the atmosphere.

With small groups, leisurely walking, and insider recommendations, you'll experience Boston like a local and discover its most famous landmarks tell a richer story when experienced through the food that has defined the city for generations.

experiences.title: Boston Food & Cocktail Tour: Stroll, Sip & Savor the South End
experiences.description:
Local Foods, Libations & Lots of Fun! 
Visit the local eateries Boston's South End residents call home. Walk to 4 different locations, where each visit includes an alcoholic beverage paired with your food tasting.

Food Tastings are representative of the diverse food scene in Boston's South End neighborhood and may include visits to a Creole / Asian Fusian hotspot, French-Cambodian restaurant, a beloved Wine and Cheese shop, and a Mexican lounge. When it comes to food - and cocktails - Boston's South End is not to be missed!

Available exclusively on Wednesdays and Fridays at 4:30pm.

experiences.title: Japanese Sushi Making Class in Boston (Includes 4-Course Meal)
experiences.description:
Discover the art of Japanese comfort cuisine in this hands-on sushi-making class in Boston, hosted through Cozymeal. This interactive 4-course lesson blends culinary instruction with authentic flavors.
Your hands-on cooking experience features:

- Starter: Edamame and seaweed snacks, combining crisp texture with savory flavor.
- Second course: Miso soup and crisp tempura, balancing a warming broth with a light, crunchy bite.
- Third course: Crispy rice, pan-seared until golden on the outside and fluffy inside.
- Main course: Hand-rolled sushi, crafted with perfectly seasoned rice and fresh fillings.

This workshop is designed for both beginners and enthusiasts, giving you practical skills to recreate Japanese favorites at home. With its welcoming atmosphere and five-star guidance, it’s perfect for intimate gatherings or larger groups. Non-alcoholic beverages are included to pair with your creations.

experiences.title: Romantic Italian Date Night Cooking Class in Boston
experiences.description: This romantic cooking class is more than just a lesson; it's an unforgettable date night experience. You'll gain the skills to recreate elegant Italian dishes at home, perfect for impressing your special someone with your culinary talents.

experiences.title: Best Boston Street Food Tour with 4+ Tastings
experiences.description: Step into the heart of Boston's North End and embark on a delectable journey through its vibrant street food culture. With a knowledgeable local guide leading the way, you’ll wander through bustling streets rich in authentic Italian cuisine. From iconic dishes like fresh seafood and savory pastas to hidden gems known only to locals, each stop promises to tantalize your taste buds. Your guide will share captivating historical anecdotes, offering insider knowledge on the traditions and flavors that define this historic neighborhood. Perfect for food enthusiasts and curious explorers alike, this tour promises an immersive and unforgettable culinary experience.

experiences.title: Morning Walks with Salem Food Tours
experiences.description:
Discover delicious, historic Salem, MA with our top-rated Morning Walks! Like a personal concierge, our Morning Walk gives a great overview of Salem's history, including our illustrious spice trade history, as well as information on Salem's thriving cultural and culinary scene. When we are done you'll have great tips for dining, shopping and exploring while in Salem. Highly recommend taking our Walk as early in your Salem trip as possible! 
Our Morning Walks begin in the downtown area. We start with a fresh baked locally made breakfast treat. You'll also be provided in advance a 10% off code for coffee or tea prior to tour. We'll then walk and learn about key points of interest in our downtown and waterfront areas. We end in the waterfront area with a spice tasting. If you have any questions or dietary issues, or if you have a large private group - please email us prior to tour date. More info on all our tours or for group tours please visit our website.

experiences.title: Chatham Bites and Sights Walking Guided Food Tasting Tour
experiences.description:
Taste your way through the heart of Cape Cod on a relaxed, flavor-packed food tour through Chatham’s most iconic streets and hidden gems. Led by a local expert, this 3-hour walking tour features multiple tasting stops with hand-picked seasonal bites from beloved local spots. It’s a delicious way to explore the area, whether it’s your first visit or your summer tradition.

Along the way, hear the stories behind the food—tales of tradition, local legends, and the people who make Chatham so special.

experiences.title: North End Boston Food Tour: Pizza, Pasta, and Pastries
experiences.description:
As a lifelong resident of the North End of Boston this isn’t just about what you eat—it’s about where you are and who you’re with.

As someone who grew up in Boston’s North End, I’ll take you through the neighborhood the way locals experience it. You’ll visit a mix of historic institutions and under-the-radar spots, meeting the people and traditions behind the food.

Along the way, you’ll hear personal stories of growing up Italian in Boston—stories that bring the neighborhood to life in a way no guidebook can.

Expect a variety of tastings such as pizza, pasta, arancini, meats, cheeses, and pastries from some of the North End’s most beloved spots.

experiences.title: Boston's Revolutionary and Drunken Past with Beer Included
experiences.description:
When visiting Boston, the Freedom Trail is a must-do activity, but why not see historic sites while drinking beer? Join Ye Olde Tavern Tours to see 10 sites on the Freedom Trail-including the site of the Boston Massacre and the Old State House-and grab a drink at 3 historic taverns. Beer and/or hard cider is included in the ticket price, so all you need to do is show up ready for fun.

Our guests want a unique and memorable way to learn about Boston's revolutionary (and drunken) history and for the past ten years, we have delivered. Our guides are expertly-trained historians who are also incredibly personable. Our founder, owner, and frequent tour guide has a PhD in American history and is a two-time author. We know our stuff and are passionate about sharing the most interesting stories.

We cap each tour at 12 people to provide an intimate experience. Ye Olde Tavern Tours is the most fun and social way to experience Boston!

We are a small, local business and appreciate your support!

experiences.title: Boston North End Bakery and Cafe Tour
experiences.description:
Welcome to the North End Bakery & Cafe Tour! Join the group and skip the lines as we have tastings from three bakeries and one cafe and venture through one of Boston's oldest and most important neighborhoods. Home to roughly 95 restaurants and 3 stops on Boston's Freedom Trail, you'll never run out of things to learn and places to try here.

During this tour, we'll taste the following:

-Sfogliatella from an underground bakery in a tucked-away alley
-Tiramisu from the oldest Italian café in Boston
-Florentine cannoli from a 24/7 bakery that's been a North End institution since 1926
-Chocolate ganache from a family-owned bakery that's been on Hanover St since 1930

And as a parting gift for joining the tour, you will be sent a post-tour email covering more of my favorite places to go, things to do, and food & drink to enjoy while you're in the Boston area!

Tastings are subject to change. Please alert us of any dietary restrictions or allergies before booking.

experiences.title: North End Food Tour: Taste Boston's Italian Heritage
experiences.description:
Welcome to the North End Food Tour! One of Boston's oldest and most important neighborhoods, the North End is most known for its multi-generation Italian-American culture, as well as its abundance of seafood, markets, and cafes. The group will have tastings at 5 different locations while learning about the North End's rich history and its contribution to the growth of Boston.

During this tour, we'll taste the following:

-Clams casino from an over 50-year-old family-run waterfront restaurant
-An Italian sub from one of Boston's most acclaimed sandwich shops
-Meatballs from a salumeria in a tucked-away alley off of Hanover St
-Florentine cannoli from a 24/7 bakery that's been a North End institution since 1926
-Tiramisu from the oldest Italian cafe in Boston

As a parting gift for joining the tour, you will receive a post-tour email highlighting my favorite places to visit, activities to enjoy, and hundreds of local food & drink options while you're in the Boston area.

experiences.title: Boston North End Food Tour with Wine and Limoncello Tasting
experiences.description: We never leave the neighborhood – we only walk three blocks. But we metaphorically travel the whole peninsula of Italy, tasting the regional foods so proudly represented in Boston’s historic North. Journey from Sicily for arancini and pizza to Naples for authentic Neapolitan pizza and Sorrento for gnocchi. Visit a neighborhood wine shop to master Italian wine pairing, then uncover secrets of the Mediterranean diet with an extra virgin olive oil tasting. Sample 12-year aged balsamic vinegar, Parma prosciutto, and Sardinian sheep’s milk cheese in a bustling market. Conclude at an artisan bakery with 160-year-old sourdough yeast, ending at a local caffe for espresso, cannoli, and gelato. The most comprehensive telling of how the North End became Italian. Built on 20 years of relationships with the neighborhood’s small businesses... personal enough that every tour is led by myself to ensure the best quality experience possible.

experiences.title: Boston Chinatown Food Tour: From Dumplings to Dim Sum
experiences.description:
Join us for a walking culinary and cultural adventure in Boston’s Chinatown! Never been to Chinatown? Curious about how to navigate this neighborhood and find the best of both traditional and modern day eats? Join us and we’ll show you!

During this tasty stroll, you can expect to:
 • Stroll the neighborhood streets, visit sites and learn about Chinatown’s past and present
 • Visit beloved local restaurants and enjoy both traditional Chinese and Chinese-American tastings
 • Discover how Chinese-American cuisine evolved and led to Boston-specific dishes

experiences.title: Boston Private Food Tour with 6+ Authentic Tastings
experiences.description:
Discover Boston’s famous North End, where Italian tradition meets New England seafood, on our Secret Food Tour. Over 3 delicious hours, our local guide will lead you through cobblestone streets as you explore the city’s rich 400-year history while tasting its most iconic dishes.

Enjoy a comforting cup of New England Clam Chowder, a buttery Lobster Roll, authentic Italian Brick Oven Pizza, a sweet Mini Cannoli, a refreshing Lemon Slush, and more. In total, you’ll experience 6+ tastings, including Our Delicious Secret Dish, revealed only on the tour.

Along the way, we’ll share stories of Boston’s past, from Puritan settlers to the modern-day city, making each stop both flavorful and unforgettable. 

As a private tour, everything works around you! Our start times are much more easy going, dates can open up. It's a much more intimate and cozy experience. No need to shout over other tourists, you will have every question answered, and leave feeling like a native yourself!

experiences.title: Boston's Food and History: North End, Freedom Trail, Beacon Hill
experiences.description: Uncover Boston’s best-kept secrets on a walking tour that blends history, culture, and flavor. Wander through the iconic North End, tasting fresh bread, pastries, pizza, and a classic Italian deli sandwich. Visit a legendary church, stroll the Freedom Trail, and soak in stunning views from Boston Harbor to charming Beacon Hill. With a local guide leading the way, experience the Boston you’ve always dreamed of—authentic, delicious, and unforgettable.

experiences.title: Boston Freedom Trail History Pub Crawl Small-Group Tour
experiences.description:
The Independence Pub Crawl combines Boston’s revolutionary history with four iconic and unique pubs along the Freedom Trail. An expert local guide will share the little-known and hilarious stories of colonial Boston and the American Revolution that the left out of 8th grade history class, all while you enjoy the company of fellow travelers from around the world

The tour lasts 2 hours and 15 minutes and begins at the Sam Adams statue outside Faneuil Hall. Walking is limited to a couple of blocks, allowing guests of all physical capabilities to enjoy the tour. Drinks are not included in the ticket price and are available for purchase separately at each pub, so you can choose exactly what you would like to enjoy.

Come laugh, learn, and raise a glass to Boston’s rebellious past. Cheers!

experiences.title: Boston Sweet Treats Food Tour: Fresh Donuts, Cider & Much More
experiences.description:
Recently voted as one of TripAdvisor's top food tours in the US. 

Explore Boston’s sweetest side on the Underground Donut Tour, a delicious journey through the city’s most iconic neighborhoods and bakeries. We’ll kick things off downtown at Kane’s Donuts in the Financial District, sampling some of their classic creations before strolling along the harbor and through historic Quincy Market. From there, we’ll head to the Boston Public Market for warm, fresh cider donuts that capture the flavors of New England. Next, we’ll taste a selection of artisanal donuts made fresh daily by local bakers before making our way to the North End, Boston’s beloved Italian district. Our final stop is the legendary Bova’s Bakery, where we’ll finish with a specialty Boston donut that’s worth every bite. Come hungry, this walking tour is a perfect blend of history, culture, and irresistible flavor.

experiences.title: Boston’s North End Food Tour: Italian Flavors and Heritage Walk
experiences.description: This Boston food tour goes beyond the tourist trail—discover hidden gems, learn fascinating stories, and experience why the North End is the heart of Boston’s culinary scene. Perfect for food lovers, history buffs, and anyone looking for an authentic taste of Boston!

experiences.title: Boston Seafood Tour: Behind the Scenes at the Historic Fish Pier
experiences.description: Explore Boston’s seafood scene on a small-group, behind-the-scenes tour of the historic Fish Pier, tasting sustainably sourced local favorites while discovering the stories behind America’s seafood capital.

experiences.title: 2-Hour Boston North End Food Tour with Authentic Italian Flavors
experiences.description:
