Dive into the historic grit and gourmet soul of the "Cradle of Liberty". We’ll bypass the typical tourist traps to explore the city’s oldest corridors, shifting from the maritime majesty of the waterfront to the legendary cobblestone streets of the North End.

The journey begins at the iconic Quincy Market, the crown jewel of the city’s 19th-century urban renewal. Standing beneath its massive copper dome, you’ll discover the market's transformation from a wholesale meat center to a world-class gathering spot. 

As we cross into the North End, the aroma of roasted garlic and fresh bread signals your arrival in Boston’s oldest residential neighborhood. 

We conclude your adventure at the Boston Public Market, a vibrant indoor hub that celebrates the rugged spirit of New England’s farmers. Surrounded by stalls of fresh Atlantic seafood and artisan crafts, we’ll gather for your Secret Dish, a savory specialty that captures the essence of Massachusetts heritage.

experiences.title: Boston South End Food Tour: Local Flavors & Neighborhood History
experiences.description:
Savor the South End’s Creative Spirit Through Its Flavors, Stories, and Local Makers

Discover Boston’s South End through its vibrant food scene and creative energy on this immersive walking tour. Enjoy multiple generous tastings from beloved, locally owned eateries featuring everything from globally inspired dishes to iconic neighborhood sweets.

Unlike many food tours, this experience offers primarily seated tastings with individual portions, giving you time to relax, savor, and truly enjoy each stop. Between tastings, you’ll explore the South End’s beautiful brownstones, rich history, and dynamic cultural scene with an expert local guide.

Every stop highlights passionate small business owners and the stories behind their signature dishes. 

Created by a proudly woman-owned local company, this tour offers an authentic, thoughtfully curated experience that goes beyond the typical tasting tour.

experiences.title: Boston Seafood Lovers Food and History Walking Tour
experiences.description: A true "SeaFoodie" never settles for just samples. Enjoy a FULL SIZE Lobster Roll at one of four Sit-Down stops on this unique culinary adventure! Follow your Guide (we have the VERY BEST Tour Guides in Boston - check our reviews!) along Boston's Freedom Trail, to the best Local eateries. Savor award-winning Clam "Chowdah", Raw Bar items like Shrimp & Oysters, plus that FULL-SIZE Lobster Roll! Finish this delicious experience with home-made Cannoli from a famous North End pastry shop. See three Freedom Trail sites along the way, plus a scenic stroll along Boston's Harbor Walk. Learn the history behind the Paul Revere house, Long Wharf, Old State House, and Faneuil Hall & Quincy Market. Look for our popular North End Pizza Lovers Tour, Historic Pub Lovers Tour, and our new Pre-Game Tours, too!

experiences.title: Boston Historic Pubs Tour with Drinks and Tastings Included
experiences.description: Raise a pint to the spirits of Samuel Adams, Paul Revere and George Washington as you relive almost 400 years of Tavern History in Boston. This fun & informative 3.5-hour Walking Tour (approx 2.5 miles) also includes a Ferry Ride across scenic Boston Harbor! See and Learn the history of 5 Freedom Trail sites. Includes 2 Historic Tavern visits, enjoying one Drink (beer/wine/soda) and an Appetizer at both Tavern stops. Along the way you’ll explore Boston’s oldest neighborhoods like Charlestown Navy Yard, Blackstone Block, Faneuil Hall / Quincy Market and the North End (Boston's Little Italy). Visit some of New England’s most historic landmarks as well as two of Boston's oldest Pubs & Taverns. Also look for our popular Pizza Lovers Tour and our Seafood Lovers Tour, too. Walk, Learn, Eat.... and repeat!

experiences.title: Boston’s Politically Incorrect North End Food Tour
experiences.description:
As the title suggests, Boston’s “Politically Incorrect “ Food Tour isn’t going to be your typical food tour. With his no BS style, your tour guide Anthony will give you an inside look into this Italian neighborhood. Born and raised in the North End he will share some great stories that only a true local can share. You will laugh while enjoying the folklore and history of this unique neighborhood. Anthony knows everyone which makes you feel like a local. 
On this 3-hour guided walking tour you’ll see historic sights such as the Old North Church and Paul Revere House, visit unique Mom and Pop shops including a 94 year old coffee shop, a pizza shop that only locals go to, other landmarks such as former mafia headquarters, Italian bakeries and hidden alleyways. Oh by the way as we explore we will be eating a ton of Italian specialties like pizza and/or arancini, Italian subs, ravioli, pastries and much more. COME HUNGRY!!

experiences.title: Sushi Making Class at a Local Distillery in Boston
experiences.description:
Upgrade your regular dinner dates or make fun new memories with friends as you join Chef Harold for an exciting sushi-making class at a lively Boston distillery. With over two decades of sushi-making expertise, Chef Harold will guide you through the art of crafting restaurant-worthy sushi rolls in a laid-back, hands-on setting—all while you sip on craft spirits from the distillery.

You’ll learn how to select the freshest ingredients, perfect your sushi-rolling technique, and even customize your own unique creations. Get creative with fillings and master the secrets behind your favorite takeout classics, all while enjoying the upbeat energy of the distillery.

After the class, sit back, sip on your favorite craft cocktail, and enjoy the sushi you made with your favorite people. Whether it’s a date night or a hangout with friends, this sushi-making class is the perfect blend of food, fun, and flavor.

experiences.title: Wine and Wine Jelly-Sauce Tasting on Plymouth Bay
experiences.description: Enjoy award winning wines, wine jellies, and wine sauces in a tasting on historic Plymouth Bay. "Experience Delicious" a stone's throw away from Plymouth Rock.

experiences.title: Boston North End Food Tour with Authentic Local Flavors & Dishes
experiences.description:
Discover Boston’s famous North End, where Italian tradition meets New England seafood, on our Secret Food Tour. Over 3 delicious hours, our local guide will lead you through cobblestone streets as you explore the city’s rich 400-year history while tasting its most iconic dishes.

Enjoy a comforting cup of New England Clam Chowder, a pastrami sandwich, authentic Italian Brick Oven Pizza, a sweet Mini Cannoli, a refreshing Lemon Slush, and more. In total, you’ll experience 6+ tastings, including Our Delicious Secret Dish, revealed only on the tour.

Along the way, we’ll share stories of Boston’s past, from Puritan settlers to the modern-day city, making each stop both flavorful and unforgettable. Whether you’re a foodie, history lover, or simply craving the best bites in Boston, this tour blends culture, flavor, and local charm into one memorable experience.

experiences.title: Sushi Making Class at a Local Brewery in Boston
experiences.description: Dive into the world of sushi-making with a talented chef, a seasoned expert with over 20 years of experience from California to Boston. In this hands-on sushi fundamentals class, you’ll learn how to craft gluten-free, nut-free, and dairy-free sushi while enjoying the relaxed atmosphere of your favorite local brewery. The class kicks off with a comforting bowl of Miso Soup, made with miso paste, dashi, and wakame seaweed, before you roll up your sleeves and dive into the art of sushi-making. A talented chef will guide you through creating two essential sushi styles: hand rolls (temaki) and inside-out rolls (uramaki). You’ll start by rolling a savory Shrimp Tempura Hand Roll, followed by a vegetarian-friendly Sweet Potato Hand Roll, and finish by mastering the bold and flavorful Spicy Tuna Roll. Sip on craft beer, enjoy the laid-back vibes and make tasty memories.

experiences.title: Boston Pizza Lovers Food and History Walking Tour
experiences.description: Feed BIG appetites, at small prices! A true Pizza Lover never settles for just samples. Enjoy three different FULL SIZE slices during this fun and educational pizza walk! Follow your Guide (we have the VERY BEST Tour Guides in Boston - check our reviews!) along Boston's Freedom Trail, to some of the very best pizzerias on the planet. Pizza on tour may include a slice named in the “Top 25 Best in America" by a famous food critic, a slice from Boston’s oldest Pizzeria with a brick oven from 1883, or taste Neapolitan-style from the Winner of Boston's 1st Pizza Festival! Some slices may be enjoyed "al fresco" in beautiful North End parks. Bonus stop at Modern Pastry to finish with a FREE home-made Cannoli! See and learn about top Boston historical sites including the Paul Revere House, Old North Church, the Skinny House, Bunker Hill Monument, and USS Constitution. Also look for our popular Historic Pub Tour, Boston SeaFoodie Tour, and our new Pre-Game Tours, too!.

experiences.title: Salem Booze and Brews Haunted Pub Crawl by US Ghost Adventures
experiences.description:
Take a detour to some of Salem’s best local watering holes to enjoy brew and booze while listening to sordid stories of ghostly ghouls and witches brews. 

It might’ve been a dry town when the Salem Witch Trials went down, but now, you can wet your appetite with some tasty, tipsy fun and drink a glass or three as you listen to the best tales of Salem’s dark and tortured past. 

The Spirits of Salem Haunted Pub Crawl will quench your thirst for haunted history and ghostly drinks, so join us and have your fill of spirits and spirits on this unique and unforgettable Salem drinking experience.

experiences.title: Italian Dinner with Tiramisu Finale in Boston
experiences.description:
Everyone loves to eat Italian food, but learning how to cook it from scratch is just as much fun!

Your event includes a reception with light snacks, a hands-on cooking class, and a sit-down dinner.

Please let us know if you have any dietary restrictions.

experiences.title: Boston Freedom Trail History Tour with Optional Food Tastings
experiences.description:
Walk Boston’s Freedom Trail with a local guide who brings the city’s history — and its food scene — to life. This tour pairs landmark sites with optional tastings of classic bites like clam chowder, baked beans, and cannoli.

You’ll visit highlights like the Boston Public Market, Faneuil Hall, the Paul Revere House, and Old North Church. On Fridays and Saturdays, you’ll even see the 300-year-old Haymarket tradition in action. 

Along the way, stroll historic streets, hear lesser-known local stories, and take in views of the Rose Kennedy Greenway and the Holocaust Memorial park.

Your guide will suggest delicious dishes at each stop. Try what you like — or just enjoy the atmosphere. Sampling everything will run about $30.

experiences.title: Boston Harbor Brunch Cruise
experiences.description:
Enjoy a delicious 2-hour brunch cruise and take in historic sights along the water including Castle and Deer Island, Spectacle Island, Long Island, Lovells Island, Georges Island, Independence Fort, Bunker Hill Monument, USS Cassin Young, USS Constitution, Old North Church, Boston’s Seaport District, and Boston’s incredible skyline. 

Brunch features a diverse buffet menu to suit all palettes including bakery, fruit, yogurt, eggs, bacon, seasonal salad and more!

Please contact us in advance to inform us of any food allergies. Please note we cannot accommodate all food allergies, but we will do our best if given advance notice.

experiences.title: Martha's Vineyard Day Trip with Optional Island Tour from Boston
experiences.description:
We are a veteran owned coach service to Martha's Vineyard. Our ease of booking, convenient pickup and drop-off locations and comfortable, air-conditioned coach will provide you with a memorable experience. Enjoy a short ride from Boston to Woods Hole where you will board the Steamship Authority with no lines or waiting in a holding area. With us, you will have time to enjoy breakfast and coffee from a local cafe before boarding. As always, round-trip ferry tickets, snacks, water, island maps, discount food cards and commentary are all included.
Island tour option; Unlike other tours, THIS IS NOT A SCHOOL BUS TOUR. A wonderful 3 hour, full island tour in one of our 14 passenger, air-conditioned, high-top vans is the best way to see the island. Tour goes through all 6 towns with stops along the way for pictures and restrooms. Our guides are the best in the business!

experiences.title: Homemade Dumplings 101 in Boston
experiences.description:
Everyone loves dumplings, but learning how to cook it from scratch is just as much fun!

 Who better to teach you and your friends the ins and outs of dumplings than Chef Gary, who has over 15 years of restaurant experience in Boston!

Your event includes a reception with light snacks, a hands-on cooking class, and a sit-down lunch.

experiences.title: Boston's Original Dumpling Party // Cambridge
experiences.description:
Get all the tips and tricks you need to learn to make mouthwatering dumplings while hearing stories about Chinese and Taiwanese cultural food traditions.

Why we love this experience
 • Learn how to roll, stuff, and fold 4-5 styles of dumplings, and sample Taiwanese street food bites
 • Guest can BYOB and tea bar included
 • Public classes are held at the historical Windsor Inn, which is the oldest free-standing residence in the central square
 • Team building, birthday/bachelorette, couples night
 • Limited free parking on site

experiences.title: Brunch in a Crunch in Boston
experiences.description: This cooking class is not just a meal; but a culinary adventure that enchants your mornings. Join us to transform your brunch into a celebration of flavors that will impress your friends and family for years to come.

experiences.title: Bully Boy Distillery: Distillery Tour and Tasting
experiences.description:
Discover the art of distilling at Bully Boy Distillers with an engaging tour of our facility in Boston, MA. Learn about our unique bourbon philosophy and processes, and explore our diverse range of handcrafted spirits including bourbon, gin, rum and amaro. This tour offers a behind-the-scenes look at how we create our award-winning products, along with tastings of our signature spirits. Perfect for spirit enthusiasts and those looking to deepen their understanding of craft distilling.

- Behind-the-scenes tour of Bully Boy Distillers in Boston
- Learn about the distillation process and bourbon philosophy
- Sample a variety of our handcrafted spirits during the tour including bourbon straight from the barrel
- An engraved Glencairn for you to take home
- Hang out at our craft cocktail bar before or after the tour
- Ideal for spirit lovers and those interested in craft cocktails

experiences.title: French Steakhouse Dinner in Boston
experiences.description: Step into the world of French culinary excellence and learn how to craft an exquisite steakhouse meal. Led by a seasoned chef with a passion for French cuisine, you'll explore the secrets of preparing classic French dishes, from perfectly seared steaks to sumptuous sauces and elegant side dishes.

experiences.title: Fun Dumpling Making Class With a Local Chef in Boston
experiences.description: This beginner-friendly dumpling class makes Asian-inspired cooking approachable, social and genuinely fun. Led by Chef Rita, the class walks you step by step through building flavorful dumplings with fillings tailored to your taste. You’ll practice shaping wrappers, experiment with multiple folding patterns and learn how technique affects texture and appearance. The atmosphere is relaxed and welcoming, making it easy to ask questions, laugh through the learning process and enjoy cooking alongside fellow food lovers. With hands-on instruction, flexible filling options and a complete meal included, this Boston class is perfect for friends, couples or anyone ready to level up their kitchen skills in a delicious way.

experiences.title: Fun Macaron Baking Class at a Local Craft Distillery near Boston
experiences.description: This macaron class is designed to help you build confidence while tackling one of baking’s most iconic pastries. Led by Chef Rita, the experience focuses on hands-on learning in a relaxed, encouraging environment. You’ll prepare and bake your own macarons, exploring rich dark chocolate and bright fruit flavors while learning how to achieve that signature crisp exterior and soft interior. Along the way, Chef Rita shares practical tips you can reuse for future baking projects, from proper mixing to baking precision. Ideal for friends, couples or solo bakers looking for something fun and skill-driven, this Boston class delivers both technique and creativity, with results you’ll be proud to share.

experiences.title: Private Authentic Vietnamese Cooking Class in Boston
experiences.description:
More than a cooking class, this is an opportunity to experience Vietnamese culture through food, storytelling, and personal connection. Join Liem in his Boston home as he shares family traditions, culinary techniques, and the fascinating history behind beloved Vietnamese dishes such as phở, crispy eggrolls, and banana blossom salad. As you cook together, you'll learn not only how to recreate authentic recipes but also the cultural significance of the ingredients and flavors that define Vietnamese cuisine. Enjoy the meal you've prepared in a welcoming home setting, creating memories and connections that extend far beyond the kitchen.

Choose the optional market trip and discover Vietnamese ingredients and pantry staples at a local supermarket while learning about Vietnamese food culture.

experiences.title: Private Hands On Roman Cooking Class in Quincy with Andrew
experiences.description:
This immersive cooking class offers a rare opportunity to explore history through food. Hosted by Andrew, a food writer and educator whose work has appeared in Gastro Obscura and Eaten, the experience blends hands-on cooking with storytelling, archaeology, and cultural insight. Drawing from historical sources, Andrew recreates authentic Ancient Roman recipes and explains the origins of the spices, ingredients, and techniques used thousands of years ago.

Set in Quincy, just outside Boston, you’ll begin with a traditional Roman drink or snack before cooking 2–3 dishes inspired by ancient texts. As you prepare and share the meal together, you’ll discover how food connects us across centuries, making this class both a culinary experience and a living history lesson.

experiences.title: Asian Noodle Cooking Class in Baltimore (Includes 4-Course Meal)
experiences.description:
Dive deep into Asian noodle craft in this hands-on class in Baltimore, hosted through Cozymeal, which connects you with top-rated local chefs. Every course is a new technique – pulling noodles, building a rich miso broth, folding gyozas and finishing with a delicate tofu dessert.

Your hands-on cooking experience features:
- Chilled Noodles With Butter Poached Shrimp – yuzu ponzu, garlic butter and poached shrimp
- Spicy Miso Pit Beef Noodle Soup – spicy miso broth, smoked pit beef, miso eggs and homemade chili oil
- Vegetable Potstickers – cabbage and shiitake gyozas with citrus-soy sauce
- Almond Tofu With Fresh Berries – almond milk tofu, matcha apple salad and blueberry compote

Leave ready to pull noodles, fold dumplings and build bold Asian broths at home. Please note that no liquor is allowed on the premises.

experiences.title: Tipsy History Tour: 300+ Years of Annapolis Drinking History
experiences.description:
Explore Annapolis' vibrant past on this unique historical pub crawl. Over two hours, discover how drinking influenced the city and the nation while enjoying recommended drinks at each stop. From rebels to rum-runners, each location reveals fascinating stories paired with a drink that defines the era. Perfect for whiskey enthusiasts and history buffs alike, this tour offers a relaxed atmosphere to toast the past and enjoy the present. Dress comfortably as you stroll through downtown, rain or shine, and prepare for a fun evening immersed in tipsy history.

- 2-hour historical pub crawl through downtown Annapolis
- Discover how drinking shaped Annapolis' history
- Enjoy recommended drinks at each stop, not included in the price
- Limited walking involved; dress for comfort and the weather

experiences.title: Midtown Dining District Foodie Tour
experiences.description: A leisurely stroll through OC's famous local restaurant and bar scene, combined with history, local lore and fun fascinating facts about this coastal gem of a town and the family's who started here. Includes tastings at 6 local eateries. Come hungry and leave full. Walk, Eat, Drink, Learn... Repeat

experiences.title: Berlin Tasting Tour: A Delicious Walk Through History
experiences.description: Find out why the Smithsonian named Berlin one of the 20 best small towns to visit. Enjoy tasty treats from several restaurants and specialty shops while learning about the families who started here and the dishes that inspire them. See for yourself why Berlin was crowned the "Coolest Small Town in America".

experiences.title: Downtown/Boardwalk Foodie Tour
experiences.description: Learn about Ocean City and the family's who started here. You will learn how the inlet was formed creating Assateague island and how OC became the White Marlin Capital of the world. Taste your way through some of the top places while your local guide shares fun facts about this coastal gem of a town.

experiences.title: Heart of Savory Salisbury Foodie Tour
experiences.description: With its newly revitalized historic Main Street and Riverwalk, Salisbury is quickly becoming on of the most vibrant hubs in Maryland for art, culture, and dining experiences. Now is the perfect time to explore our small-town foodie scene on foot with this immersive culinary journey that will take you to taste food and drink at local restaurants, cafes, breweries, bakeries and more.

experiences.title: French Cooking Class in Baltimore (Includes 3-Course Meal)
experiences.description:
Discover the art of French cuisine in this immersive cooking class, hosted through Cozymeal. This 3-course experience showcases refined flavors and beloved traditions of classic French dining.
Your hands-on cooking experience features:

- First course: French onion soup layered with caramelized onions, Gruyère cheese and crisp croûtons
- Second course: Coq au vin or beef Bourguignon, both simmered in red wine with mushrooms and herbs
- Dessert: Apple tarte Tatin baked to golden perfection or delicate coconut macaroons

This intimate workshop blends instruction with interactive cooking, leaving you confident to recreate French classics at home. Guests may bring their favorite wine or beer to enjoy alongside the meal.

experiences.title: Fun Taco Cooking Class With a Local Chef in Baltimore
experiences.description: Discover how simple ingredients become unforgettable tacos in this interactive Baltimore cooking class. In this experience, Chef Jesse introduces you to the fresh, vibrant flavors of Southern California street tacos. Begin by marinating beef and chicken with ingredients that enhance tenderness and bring bold flavor to the taco filling. Next, warm soft corn tortillas and build your tacos with the freshly cooked meats. Add sliced avocado, cilantro and bright lime juice to create the perfect balance of richness and freshness. Chef Jesse explains how each element contributes to the final dish while sharing practical tips you can easily recreate at home. Enjoy the tacos you prepared in a lively Baltimore setting and leave with new skills to elevate taco night anytime.

experiences.title: Baltimore Haunted Pub Crawl Fells Point Ghosts Bars and Poe
experiences.description:
Drink your way through the haunted side of historic Fells Point on Spirits of Fells Point, Baltimore’s adults-only haunted pub crawl.

Along the route, guests will visit atmospheric bars and historic streets while hearing stories of Edgar Allan Poe, vanished sailors, smugglers, gamblers, haunted taverns, waterfront crime, and the bad decisions that helped give Fells Point its notorious reputation.

This is more than a night out at the bars. It is a haunted walk through the places where sailors once spent their wages, privateers and merchants chased fortunes, and legends of restless spirits still linger near the harbor. Guests will have time to purchase drinks at select stops while enjoying spooky storytelling, local lore, and a fun social atmosphere.

Perfect for adults who want ghosts, history, drinks, and a little chaos, Spirits of Fells Point offers a memorable way to experience Baltimore after dark.

Guests must be 21+ with valid photo ID.

experiences.title: Hoi An Farming , Cooking Class, Foot Massage & Hoi An Walking Tour
experiences.description:
Tour Program :

8:00a.m : Pick up at Hotel in Hoi An or Da Nang city

- Visiting the Temple Kwan, Phuc Kien Temple, Tan Ky Ancient House, Phung Hung house, Japanese Bridge in Hoi An. After your walking tour If you have free time ,you can do shopping at the old town. Guide will escort you for the whole tour. 

- Visiting TRA QUE Vegetables village –a famous village about Organic Vegetable

 Here,You have a chance to take the photos of different kind of Mints, Basil, Lemon Grass, Coriender

 - Joining cooking activities at local family and learn how to make Vietnamese Traditional Dishes : Rice Pancakes, Spring Rolls, Barbecue Fish with Banana leaf ,Morning glory Cooked with Garlic.

- Lunch /Dinner with what you have cooked

- Enjoy 30 minute foot massage with herbs from vegetable garden.

Finish The Tour and send back hotel in Hoi An or Da Nang city

experiences.title: OC Bay Hopper - Foodie Tour By Boat
experiences.description:
This is the perfect trip for foodies looking for something other than the typical day at the beach.  You’ll be joined by OC and restaurant aficionado Sandy Gillis.  Sandy will be your guide.  You’ll then head out for a 3-hour tour of 3 waterfront restaurants.
 
On your tour you will sample delicious foods and tasty cocktails.  Depending on your departure point you’ll stop at 3 of the following:  Tailchasers, Fager’s Island, The Green Turtle, Hoopers Crab House, Sneaky Petes, Frog Bar.  Sandy will fill you in on all the fascinating facts about OC and the restaurants you visit.
 
When this trip is over you’ll have more than just a full belly – you will have also learned a few things.

experiences.title: Pasta Making Cooking Class at a Local Brewery in Baltimore
experiences.description: Join Chef Jesse at a local brewery in Baltimore for a pasta-making experience like no other! This hands-on class will teach you how to craft fresh pappardelle pasta from scratch using simple, wholesome ingredients. Learn the essential techniques of mixing, kneading, rolling, and cutting pasta dough, followed by preparing a flavorful roasted garlic tomato sauce with crushed tomatoes, garlic, olive oil, and classic Italian seasonings. As you refine your skills, enjoy the laid-back brewery atmosphere and sip on locally brewed craft beer available for purchase. Whether you're looking for a unique date night, a social outing with friends, or a fun way to expand your cooking repertoire, this class offers a perfect mix of culinary creativity, delicious flavors, and craft beer. Book your spot today for a memorable evening of fresh pasta and brews in Baltimore!

experiences.title: Baltimore Walking Foodie Tour in Fells Point
experiences.description:
We do 3 things: Food, facts and fun! 

Welcome to Fells Point, the true heart of Baltimore. 

Picture this: cobblestone streets lined with charming eateries, bustling markets, and hidden gems just waiting to be discovered. Join us as we guide you through Fells Point, where you’ll savor iconic dishes like mouthwatering Maryland crab cakes, fresh multi-ethnic exclusive offerings, and no fillers! Each stop is a celebration of Baltimore’s culinary heritage, and our passionate guide will share captivating stories about the area’s rich history and cultural influences.

Whether you’re a seasoned traveler or new to food tours, this experience is perfect for everyone! Connect with fellow food lovers as you explore the lively atmosphere, sample delicious flavors, and soak in the stunning waterfront views. 

Don’t miss your chance to taste the magic of Fells Point! Book your culinary adventure today and uncover why this neighborhood is a must-visit destination for food enthusiasts!

experiences.title: Fells Point Food Tour in Baltimore
experiences.description: This 3.5 hour tour explores parts of Baltimore's best preserved historic district, Fell's Point  is a spirited waterfront community founded nearly 280 years ago.  Enjoy Fell's point amazing atmosphere and historic roots while tasting a little of what makes Fells point the place to be in Baltimore.

experiences.title: Federal Hill Food Tour
experiences.description: Explore the Federal Hill food scene in south Baltimore’s most historic neighborhood.  This 3.5 hour food tour will allow you to experience all of this historic neighborhood has to offer. The Cross Street area has become the Federal Hill "Place to Be on the weekends. Fresh seafood turns the west end of the Cross Street Market into a part of Baltimore's amazing food scenes. Folks from all over gravitate to this area to have a test of the federal hill scene.

experiences.title: Historic Annapolis Food Tour
experiences.description: During The Historic Annapolis Food Tour, you will enjoy a series of dishes from restaurants in downtown Annapolis while weaving through historic sites. The tour lasts approximately 3.5 hours.

experiences.title: Baltimore Boos & Booze Haunted Pub Crawl
experiences.description:
Join us for a Baltimore Haunted Pub Crawl and add some fun to your work week or vacation! Explore several local watering holes and haunted hotspots on this unique, exciting tour.

This tour will take you to several pubs in Baltimore, which may be a combination of craft producers and local bars. There will be a variety of haunted stops in between these already notorious bars and pubs, so by the end of the tour, you'll be a ghost expert!

Grab your first drink at Max's Taphouse as your guide begins your haunting and historic journey through downtown Baltimore. From there, you'll have the chance to enjoy drinks at 3 other popular pubs and explore some other haunted locations in between. Hear stories of the Fell Family Cemetery while standing on haunted ground. Step back in time and hear the dark history behind the Waterfront Hotel. Enjoy your last drink at the Cat's Eye Pub before going home to tell your friends all about what you learned, saw, drank, and maybe even felt!

experiences.title: Annapolis Ghost Tours Boos & Booze Haunted Pub Crawl
experiences.description:
Come on to our Haunted Pub Crawl Tour in Annapolis!

Enjoy some liquid courage while hearing ghostly tales of Annapolis' most historic haunts and drinking hotspots. Take a Boo's and Booze Haunted Pub Crawl for genuine stories, scares, and delicious drinks in the historic district, with up to 2 hours of ghostly fun with the city's spirits and Spirits. Price does not include drinks or tastings.

experiences.title: Baltimore: Fells Point & Little Italy Food Tour with 7 Tastings
experiences.description:
Explore the rich culinary heritage of Baltimore on this guided food tour through Fells Point and Little Italy. Stroll along cobblestone streets while savoring authentic Maryland crab cakes, pierogies from a beloved Polish deli, a classic potato knish, and a delightful mini cannoli. Your local guide shares insider stories and historical insights, immersing you in the vibrant culture of this historic area. Experience a surprise stop that leaves guests amazed, ensuring a memorable journey through the heart of Baltimore's food scene.

- Guided walking food tour through Baltimore’s historic neighborhoods
- Taste iconic local dishes including crab cakes and cannoli
- Meet your knowledgeable guide for personal storytelling and insights
- Enjoy a surprise culinary stop along the route

experiences.title: Enchanted Full Day Napa & Sonoma Wine Tour from Oakland
experiences.description:
Explore and relish the enchanted day trip to California's famous wine country on this full-day tour of Napa and Sonoma County.

Tour and taste wine at a Napa Valley landmark—Castello di Amorosa. You’ll stop for photos of the iconic Golden Gate Bridge, enjoy wine tastings in both Napa and Sonoma, where you'll take in the delightful notes of each region, and have free time to explore historic Sonoma Square.

Many of the wineries that will be visited are some of the oldest wine making families wine in the Napa and Sonoma Valley. You’ll learn of their family histories and first beginnings in California’s most famous Wine Country.

experiences.title: Asian Fusion Sushi Class in Baltimore (4-Course Menu)
experiences.description:
Discover bold flavors and hands-on techniques in this Asian fusion cooking class in Baltimore. This workshop explores both sushi traditions and modern fusion favorites.

Your hands-on cooking experience features:

- Starter: Sweet and spicy edamame glazed with honey, soy and chili
- Sushi: Classic California roll with sushi rice, crab, avocado and sesame
- Main course: Chicken fried rice packed with vegetables, egg and savory soy-based sauce
- Dessert: Silky coconut mango mousse topped with whipped cream and lime zest

With step-by-step instruction from a local sushi chef, you’ll sharpen knife skills, learn the secrets of sushi rice and discover techniques for balancing Asian-inspired flavors. Set in a relaxed Baltimore kitchen, this class combines gourmet learning with vibrant dining. Guests may bring their favorite wine or beer to enjoy alongside the meal.

experiences.title: Baltimore Mozzarella Cheese Making Class with Local Chef
experiences.description:
This hands-on class with Chef Jesse teaches the art of fresh mozzarella from scratch. You’ll start with simple ingredients — whole milk, salt and water — and learn how to transform them into tender, stretchy mozzarella using traditional cheese-making techniques. Chef Jesse walks you through heating, curd formation and the satisfying process of pulling and shaping fresh cheese.

Once your mozzarella is ready, turn it into a classic Italian dish. Slice ripe heirloom tomatoes, layer them with fresh basil and your handmade cheese, then finish the Caprese salad with extra virgin olive oil and balsamic glaze.

Hosted at a trendy Baltimore venue, this beginner-friendly experience includes expert instruction, all ingredients and a fresh Caprese meal you’ll enjoy at the end of class. It’s simple, authentic and incredibly delicious.

experiences.title: Bay Hopper - Pizza Cruise
experiences.description:
What happens when you take pizza and you add that to a boat on the water? Mama mia - I'll tell you what happens - you get a great time!!! 

If you're tired of getting pizza delivered and eating it on your couch or gobbling a hot slice while sitting in a car - then we have a solution. It's called our Pizza Cruise.

We'll leave the dock at the Bay Hopper Kiosk on 118th street and head out to pick up some delicious pizza for your cruise! Pizza and cold drinks (and water) are included in the trip price- your kids will not leave the boat hungry!

We'll take your pizza order when you arrive at our 118th street Kiosk to board our boat. This is a great family trip!!!

experiences.title: Cooking or Baking Lesson with a Maryland Local Karen in her Home
experiences.description:
Join professional chef Kelila in her kitchen for a hands-on experience, where you will get to cook right along with her. Kelila has been a professional culinary instructor for many years and will walk you through every step of creating a great meal. The cooking portion of the experience will last for 1-2 hours, during which you will learn to make a starter, a main dish, and a dessert. You will be cooking a seasonal meal that showcases local ingredients and flavors from around the world - Pacific Rim and Kiwi cuisine. A few dishes that you may try are Hawks Bay plum and manuka honey glazed lamb ribs, plov (rice and carrots cooked in a seasoned broth), grilled peach and avocado salad, or stone fruit pavlova. Kelila has a very charismatic and bubbly personality, and is keen to share her knowledge of food and different cuisines, so make sure you ask her heaps of questions!  

Don't miss out on this wonderful culinary experience with a welcoming local!

experiences.title: DIY Candle Making Class at a Trendy Local Restaurant in Baltimore
experiences.description: Swap the usual “what should we do today?” debate for a fun, hands-on candle making class hosted at a trendy local restaurant in Baltimore. In this hands-on experience, Instructor Erica will guide you step by step as you design and pour your own custom candle. You’ll explore different scents, learn how fragrance, wax and wicks work together and create a candle that feels completely personal. And the best news? No experience is needed. Get ready for an experience that is creative, relaxing and way more memorable than sitting through another average happy hour. This class is ideal for couples looking for a unique date night, friends planning a girls’ night out, solo guests who want a calming creative escape and travelers searching for a local activity beyond the typical sightseeing list. Come for the cozy atmosphere, stay for the joy of making something with your own hands and leave with a custom candle that feels totally you.

experiences.title: Food and Shopping Tour in Bethesda Row
experiences.description: Discover the charm of Bethesda on this engaging two-hour tour that blends shopping and food at one of the area's most upscale shopping and dining districts, Bethesda Row! We’ll explore this lively, walkable district, popping into key shops you love while also sampling some of the area’s foodie highlights. Along the way, I’ll introduce you to some of my favorite local shops —think artisan gelato makers, talented bakers, specialty coffee roasters, and neighborhood chefs. Enjoy curated samples and warm welcomes from the people behind these beloved businesses, offering a more personal and insider experience than you’d typically find on your own. This experience is ideal for travelers looking to experience the local lifestyle and venture beyond the typical tourist attractions, this immersive tour offers a fun and flavorful introduction to Bethesda Row’s vibrant shopping, dining, and culinary scene.

experiences.title: Fun Dumpling Making Class at a Local Brewery in Baltimore
experiences.description: Skip the frozen aisle and discover just how fun dumpling making can be. In a relaxed culinary studio, this beginner-friendly cooking class breaks the process into simple, hands-on steps that make every fold feel achievable. You'll prepare a savory dumpling filling, learn how to fill and seal wrappers with confidence, and practice shaping dumplings using techniques you can recreate at home. Along the way, you'll pick up practical skills for portioning, folding and creating tightly sealed dumplings that cook beautifully. Finish by serving your handmade dumplings with a flavorful dipping sauce and enjoy every warm, satisfying bite. It's equal parts comfort food, creativity and a skill you'll be happy to show off.

experiences.title: Fun Dumpling Making Class With a Local Chef in Baltimore
experiences.description:
Learn the satisfying art of dumpling folding in a lively Baltimore setting.

In this interactive cooking class, Chef Jesse guides you step by step through crafting delicious dumplings from scratch. You’ll start by mixing a savory filling of ground chicken or shrimp with napa cabbage, garlic and ginger, learning how aromatic ingredients build depth of flavor.

Then move on to the delicate technique of wrapping and pleating dumplings, transforming simple wrappers into beautifully shaped bites. Chef Jesse demonstrates the folding patterns that give dumplings their signature look while ensuring they cook evenly.

As your dumplings finish cooking, whisk together a sweet-tangy dipping sauce made from soy sauce, brown sugar, rice wine vinegar and lemon juice. Enjoy your handmade dumplings at the end of class and leave with skills you can recreate anytime at home.

experiences.title: Fun Sushi Making Class With a Local Chef in Baltimore
experiences.description: Discover the surprisingly satisfying art of homemade sushi in this lively cooking class with Chef Brandi in Baltimore. Hosted at a stylish local venue near some of the city’s buzzing dining and nightlife districts, this hands-on experience combines creativity, connection and practical culinary skills in a relaxed social atmosphere. Chef Brandi guides you step-by-step through the foundations of sushi making, from preparing fluffy seasoned sushi rice to mastering rolling techniques with nori and fresh fillings. You’ll build a classic California roll with surimi, avocado and cucumber before creating a vibrant veggie roll layered with mango, avocado and crisp cucumber. Throughout the experience, Chef Brandi shares approachable techniques that help even total beginners feel confident rolling sushi by the end of class. All fresh ingredients and cooking tools are included, and you’ll sit down afterward to enjoy the sushi feast you created yourself.

experiences.title: Fun Tortilla Salsa and Guacamole Cooking Class in Baltimore
experiences.description: Tortillas taste a whole lot better when you make them yourself. At a Baltimore brewery, you’ll start with flour, water and salt, then mix, roll and shape your dough into fresh tortillas ready for the griddle. Once those are cooking, you’ll make creamy guacamole by mashing ripe avocado with garlic, salt, pepper and bright lime. Then you’ll chop tomato, onion, cilantro, garlic and jalapeño to create a fresh salsa with just the right kick. You’ll pick up practical skills for handling dough, chopping ingredients and balancing flavors as you go, with Chef Brandi keeping every step approachable for beginners. The relaxed brewery setting makes it easy to settle in, get hands-on and enjoy the process. By the end, you’ll have a homemade spread worth repeating at home.

experiences.title: Harpers Ferry Breweries and Distilleries 4 Hour Tour
experiences.description: Experience West Virginia Like You've Never Imagined! Book a tour that guides you and your guests through the beautiful, and historic landscapes of WV to some of the best breweries and distilleries on the East Coast. Get to know the distillers and learn about their personal journeys into the world of crafting distilled spirits, the history of distilling, learn about their techniques and vision, and best of all... taste the fruits of their labors! This tour will make 3 stops that we have pre-arranged with the staff so they can welcome you with the

experiences.title: Harpers Ferry to VA Wine Country 4 Hour Tour for 4 Guests
experiences.description:
Short on time but ready to sip your way through Virginia Wine Country? The 4 Hour "Ride to The Vines"** is the perfect escape to explore the *Passion of the Grape* without the rush and crowds on the weekends. Perfect for visitors and area residents!
Join us to experience a customized, door-to-door wine tour designed around your group. Book a romantic afternoon with a glass in hand, a birthday celebration, or a just-because getaway. Visit boutique wineries, scenic estate vineyards, and select breweries or distilleries, all safely guided by fun, knowledgeable local drivers. We handle the reservations so you can relax and soak in the views while stopping at award-winning venues along the way. Savor tastings, discover unique spots, and make lasting memories with friends or loved ones. 
Ideal for solo travelers, couples and larger groups, with convenient Sunday through Friday pickup available. from your location. 
Cheers to a perfectly paced wine country adventure!

experiences.title: Italian Pasta Making Class for Beginners in Baltimore
experiences.description:
Join a talented chef for a hands-on cooking class where you'll master the art of authentic Italian pasta from scratch. Using fresh, high-quality ingredients and time-honored techniques, you'll learn how to craft silky, homemade pasta with semolina and eggs. A talented chef will guide you step by step through the pasta-making process before teaching you how to prepare a rich, creamy Alfredo sauce from scratch. Made with fresh cream, garlic, Parmesan cheese, and unsalted butter, this decadent sauce pairs perfectly with your handcrafted pasta. Finally, bring everything together with a beautiful presentation, garnished with freshly shaved Parmesan and a touch of fresh herbs.

What to Expect:
- Step-by-step guidance from a talented chef who makes it make sense.
- A fun, beginner-friendly class where no one judges your knife skills.
- Tasting, laughing and leveling up your kitchen game.
- Ideal for: a solo outing, date night, girls’ night or group fun.

experiences.title: Pad Thai Cooking Class with a Local Chef
experiences.description:
Experience the bold flavors of Thai street food without leaving Baltimore. This interactive class with Chef Jesse focuses on crafting authentic shrimp Pad Thai from the ground up. Begin by preparing the essential ingredients — rice noodles, shrimp and fresh aromatics — before learning how to build a rich sauce using tamarind paste, fish sauce and peanuts. Chef Jesse demonstrates the proper stir-fry technique that gives Pad Thai its signature flavor and texture, showing you how to combine noodles and sauce quickly over high heat. You’ll also learn how Thai cuisine balances sweet, savory and tangy elements in every bite.

When your dish is finished, enjoy a plate of homemade shrimp Pad Thai and leave with the confidence to recreate this iconic recipe at home.

experiences.title: Private Enchanted Napa & Sonoma Wine Tour from Oakland
experiences.description:
Explore and relish the enchanted day trip to California's famous wine country on this full-day tour of Napa and Sonoma County.

Tour and taste wine at a Napa Valley landmark—Castello di Amorosa. You’ll stop for photos of the iconic Golden Gate Bridge, enjoy wine tastings in both Napa and Sonoma, where you'll take in the delightful notes of each region, and have free time to explore historic Sonoma Square.

Many of the wineries that will be visited are some of the oldest wine making families wine in the Napa and Sonoma Valley. You’ll learn of their family histories and first beginnings in California’s most famous Wine Country.

experiences.title: Ravioli Making Cooking Class at a Local Brewery in Baltimore
experiences.description: Join Chef Jesse at a local brewery in Baltimore for a pasta-making experience that combines Italian flavors with craft beer! This hands-on class will teach you how to make fresh ravioli from scratch, from kneading the perfect pasta dough to rolling it to the ideal thickness. Then, create a creamy ricotta filling enhanced with bright lemon zest and Parmesan before shaping and sealing your ravioli with expert precision. Once cooked to perfection, you’ll savor your handmade masterpiece while enjoying the relaxed atmosphere of the brewery. Pair your pasta with locally brewed beer available for purchase and enjoy a fun, social evening of culinary creativity. Whether you're looking for a unique date night, a social outing with friends, or a way to sharpen your cooking skills, this class is the perfect mix of hands-on learning and great flavors. Book your spot today for a memorable ravioli-making and craft beer experience in Baltimore!

experiences.title: Sushi Making Class for Beginners in Baltimore
experiences.description:
With a degree in culinary arts from Le Cordon Bleu, this talented chef has honed his skills in some of the most renowned restaurants in the greater Washington D.C. area and built a stellar reputation as a personal chef. 

This sushi-making class in Baltimore offers a fun, hands-on experience, perfect for beginners to master sushi techniques in a vibrant, wine-centric venue. 

You'll start by learning the fundamentals of sushi rolling. Under the talented chef's guidance, you'll create two types of sushi: California rolls with rice, cucumber, surimi, avocado, and nori, and Vegetable Rolls with rice, cream cheese, avocado, cucumber, and nori. 

What to Expect:
- Step-by-step guidance from a talented chef who makes it make sense.
- A fun, beginner-friendly class where no one judges your knife skills.
- Tasting, laughing and leveling up your kitchen game.
- Ideal for: a solo outing, date night, girls’ night or group fun.

experiences.title: Sushi Making Class With a Local Chef in Baltimore
experiences.description:
In this hands-on class with Chef Jesse, you’ll learn how to make fresh, colorful sushi rolls from scratch in a fun and approachable setting.

The class begins with perfectly seasoned sushi rice made with rice vinegar, sugar and salt. Then you’ll layer, roll and slice two signature creations. First, make a spicy tuna roll filled with sushi-grade tuna, avocado and spicy mayo wrapped in nori. Next, create a veggie rainbow roll with cucumber, carrot and avocado for a fresh, crunchy finish.

Chef Jesse guides you through practical techniques for preparing sushi rice, rolling sushi, handling ingredients and improving knife skills. The atmosphere stays relaxed and beginner-friendly, making it easy to follow along.

You’ll leave with practical sushi-making skills and a plate of handmade rolls ready to enjoy.

experiences.title: Maine Iconic Foods Tasting And Class in Wiscasset
experiences.description:
Blueberries, seaweed, potatoes, craft beer and so much more! Take your tastebuds on a trip around the state and explore the ingredients and flavors that make Maine so special. Participants will be introduced to some of Maine's most iconic food and drink industries and hear the stories of local farmers, fishermen and other producers - while sampling delicious products that represent them! 

This guided, 30-minute experience is a fantastic introduction to Maine's food and beverage landscape, history and culture. We recommend scheduling this class at the beginning of your time in Maine so you can take advantage of all you've learned during the rest of your trip. Stick around afterwards for personalized recommendations from your MTC host about wineries, breweries, markets, farms and other agritourism experiences to seek out while in Maine - customized to your interests and the regions you plan to visit while in Maine.

experiences.title: Guided Chocolate Tasting Session in Rockland
experiences.description: Learn about chocolate making process and how to taste chocolate at Maine's First Bean to Bar Chocolate Factory.

experiences.title: Portland ME: Casco Bay Boat Tour w/ Island Yoga + Mimosas or Wine
experiences.description:
This experience combines three things you rarely get in one outing: a small-group boat tour, yoga on a Casco Bay island, and a celebratory drink on the water. Choose a morning experience with mimosas and bakery favorites or an afternoon flow followed by a guided four-wine tasting and savory bites.

With only a handful of guests, the experience feels personal, relaxed, and completely different from a traditional boat tour or yoga class.

experiences.title: Maine Beer and Cider Tasting in Wiscasset
experiences.description:
Explore the brewed flavors of Maine! Take your tastebuds on a trip around the state and explore the wide variety of beers and ciders being produced right here in our state. Participants will be introduced to six Maine-made ciders and beers from six different producers - and hear the stories behind the brewers that brought them to your glass. 

This guided, 30-minute experience is a fantastic introduction to Maine's beer/cider landscape and history. We recommend scheduling this class at the beginning of your time in Maine so you can take advantage of all you've learned during the rest of your trip. Stick around afterwards for personalized recommendations from your MTC host about wineries, breweries, markets, farms and other agritourism experiences to seek out while in Maine - customized to your interests and the regions you plan to visit while in Maine.

experiences.title: Private Sightseeing Charter on a Vintage Lobster Boat with Drinks
experiences.description:
100% PRIVATE TOUR! Step aboard a vintage Maine Lobster Boat for a private, 2-hour lighthouse viewing & sightseeing charter. Leave the crowds behind as we cruise through the islands of Casco Bay, passing four iconic lighthouses, historic 19th-century forts, and the stunning Maine coastline.

Charters depart from Portland’s Old Port and are perfect for families and small groups. Each charter is completely private for up to 6 guests, and all ages are welcome!

First round of drinks included – Enjoy a local Portland, Maine beer or a glass of wine as you take in the breathtaking views!

experiences.title: Boos and Brews Walking Ghost Tour of Boothbay Harbor
experiences.description:
The Boos and Brews Walking Ghost Tour uncovers Boothbay Harbor’s unexplained past with eerie events told from a local’s perspective. We combine spine-tingling tales told in picturesque locations with a visit to the Footbridge Brewery for craft beer and barbeque! A local paranormal researcher tells ghostly tales about the harbor’s most haunted old sea captain’s homes, Boothbay Harbor’s very own sea serpent, and the spooky legends that surround many of the harbor’s islands. We’ll wrap up our walk on the weird side at the Footbridge Brewery where you can enjoy beautiful harbor views along with a craft beer flight, brewed with all locally sourced Maine ingredients, and Bridge House barbeque. 

Unlike national corporate chains, Mysterious Harbor Tours is locally owned and operated. No mega-groups of 30+ people. Enjoy an intimate, creepy atmosphere where you can actually hear your entertaining guide.

experiences.title: Savor Bar Harbor Culinary Walking Tour in Maine
experiences.description:
- An amazing array of tastes will be accompanied by a generous serving of local history, fun facts and lore – making your visit to Bar Harbor a unique and exciting adventure!
- As you sample the fare at the various stops, our tour guides and proprietors will reveal the history behind their industry and what goes into making their specialties. This is a fairly short walk around the Village Green and the beautiful harbor with plenty of food for lunch.

experiences.title: Portland Walking Food Tour – Warm Donuts, History & Hidden Gems
experiences.description: Portland, Maine is known for its culinary scene, including amazing donuts. With this tour, you'll get to sample from the city's best donut shops, while also learning of Maine's connection to the invention of the donut and the city's history. Your tour guide will take you not only to the most famous of them all, The Holy Donut, to skip the line, but also to local favorites, that are equally delicious.

experiences.title: Old Port Culinary Walking Tour from Portland
experiences.description:
- Portland's culinary culture is made up of many kinds of artisan food and beverage entrepreneurs from bakers, brewers and chefs to confectioners and more - wherever taste and creativity meet!
- We combine a unique combination of social history, culinary education, the stories of talented entrepreneurs and current award-winning food scene narrated by friendly and engaging local guides
- This tour visits 4-5 venues where you will enjoy a mix of Maine/Maine-inspired cultural, up-and-coming, and trending fare, plenty for lunch with a sweet treat to cap it off.

experiences.title: Old Port "Seafood Lovers" Walking Lunch Tour in Portland, Maine
experiences.description:
Learn about Maine's most famous crustacean and the men and women who make their living from trap to table. Stroll along Portland's vital working waterfront , view lobster boats often unloading their catch and visit Old Port and waterfront district destinations for a progressive, iconic Maine lunch. 

- This walking tour is appx. 1 - 1.5 miles visiting local favorites with plenty of food, and food for thought - lots of time for Q/A. 
- There's always a whole lobster roll, a New England clam or seafood chowder, local craft beer (or soda) plus a whoopie pie or other Maine sweet, and a surprise seafood taste or two along the way. This is our most “classic heritage” Maine experience with a bit of modern flare.

experiences.title: Boothbay Harbor Bites Guided Food Tour
experiences.description: The Boothbay Harbor Bites guided food tour is a carefully curated, unique culinary experience featuring five beloved, locally-owned restaurants and specialty shops designed to give you a taste of what it means to live and eat in this historic New England fishing village. Join our friendly, local tour guide on this movable treat feast along the harbor where you’ll hear stories about Boothbay Harbor while enjoying mouth-watering savory samples and sweet bites with opportunities to shop and take photographs.

experiences.title: Kennebunkport: A Tasty Lunchtime Walking Tour
experiences.description:
The area has been home to those who make their living on the sea for centuries and a popular destination for visitors who love the history, beautiful beaches and plentiful outdoor activities. In recent years the culinary scene is also attracting visitors with nationally renowned chefs, gourmet catering companies, craft brewers and award winning food artisans.

This tour takes a leisurely half mile walk from Dock Square across the bridge into the lower village as you taste all along the way what it means to be from Maine. You will visit with shop keepers and food artisans, taste chowders, lobsters and more, all regionally sourced and created by local talent. Our friendly and knowledgeable guides will take you to several venues to sip, taste and learn about Maine's culinary history and vibrant food scene.

experiences.title: Small Group Sunset Lighthouse Boat Cruise With Local Drinks
experiences.description:
Board the Elizabeth Grace to cruise around Portland Harbor while sipping local craft beer. This 1.5-hour harbor cruise will take you out into Casco Bay. Keep your eyes open for potential seal sightings, as well as the multiple lighthouses, islands, and forts you will see while cruising around.

We will turn the bow toward Portland so you can take in a Maine sunset from the water and then cruise through Portland Harbor as the city’s nighttime skyline illuminates. You won’t find a more spectacular experience in Maine!

GROUP OF 6 OR MORE? Please reach out to us about private charter options for the best experience possible!

experiences.title: Savor Bar Harbor Culinary Walking Tour
experiences.description:
- An amazing array of tastes will be accompanied by a generous serving of local history, fun facts and lore – making your visit to Bar Harbor a unique and exciting adventure!
- As you sample the fare at the various stops, our tour guides and proprietors will reveal the history behind their industry and what goes into making their specialties. This is a fairly short walk around the Village Green and the beautiful harbor with plenty of food for lunch.

experiences.title: Bar Harbor Food Walking Tour With Lobster Roll
experiences.description:
Join us on the Best of Bar Harbor Food Walking Tour, where we'll indulge in the city's most iconic treats.

We'll meet at a central location, where you'll be welcomed by our expert guide and fellow food enthusiasts.

Our first stop will be at a charming eatery known for its succulent lobster rolls, an homage to the city's coastal culinary heritage. Explore the rich flavors that make Bar Harbor's seafood a true delicacy.

Next, we'll venture to a delightful ice cream and fudge shop, where you can indulge your sweet tooth. 

As we continue our adventure, we'll take a leisurely walk through Agamont Park towards the Bar Harbor Beach. Enjoy the scenic harbor views as we continue to Balance Rock. 

Our final destination will be a hidden gem loved by locals and visitors alike. Here, you'll experience a celebration of ice cream, and enjoy the serene atmosphere of the Village Green.

Join us on the Bar Harbor Food Walking Tour and discover the city's most mouthwatering delights!

experiences.title: Maine Seafood Tasting and Class in Wiscasset
experiences.description:
Eel and seaweed and salmon, oh my! Take your tastebuds on a trip down Maine's coast and explore the aquatic ingredients and flavors that make Maine so special. Participants will be introduced to Maine's wild and farmed seafood industries and hear the stories of local farmers, fishermen and other producers - while sampling delicious products that represent them!

This guided, 30-60 minute experience is a fantastic introduction to Maine's seafood landscape, history and culture. We recommend scheduling this class at the beginning of your time in Maine so you can take advantage of all you've learned during the rest of your trip. Stick around afterwards for personalized recommendations from your MTC host about wineries, breweries, markets, farms and other agritourism experiences to seek out while in Maine - customized to your interests and the regions you plan to visit while in Maine.

experiences.title: Artisanal Maine Cheese Tasting and Class in Wiscasset
experiences.description:
Maine has over 80 licensed cheesemakers, one of the largest amounts per capita of any US state! In this class, participants will be introduced to six different Maine creameries and hear the stories of the cheesemakers behind them - while sampling their delicious products!

This guided, 30-60 minute experience is a fantastic introduction to Maine's cheese landscape, history and culture. We recommend scheduling this class at the beginning of your time in Maine so you can take advantage of all you've learned during the rest of your trip. Stick around afterwards for personalized recommendations from your MTC host about wineries, breweries, markets, farms and other agritourism experiences to seek out while in Maine - customized to your interests and the regions you plan to visit while in Maine.

experiences.title: Flavors of Bar Harbor History and Food Tastings Private Tour
experiences.description:
Enjoy a private, exclusive tour in Bar Harbor with your own local guide. Discover the flavors that define Maine on a relaxed walk through the heart of Bar Harbor. 

This tour includes four tasting stops, offering a variety of small dishes, deserts and beverages. Every tasting highlights a different part of Maine's culinary heritage. Savor fresh seafood, handcrafted ice cream and locally roasted coffee. Learn about the lobster industry, blueberry traditions and the people who shaped Bar Harbor's food culture. Between tastings, your guide shares stories of the waterfront streets and Gilded Age landmarks. Enjoy a memorable experience that blends authentic local cuisine with fascinating history.

Please note: Restaurant menus and tasting selections may vary based on seasonal availability, ensuring each visit is a unique experience.

experiences.title: Maine Fermented Foods Tasting and Class in Wiscasset
experiences.description:
Producers across the state are harnessing the power of fermentation to create an amazing array of value-add products! In this class, participants will be introduced to a variety of Maine fermented products and hear the stories of the innovative producers behind them - while sampling their delicious products!

This guided, 45-minute experience is a fantastic introduction to Maine's fermented flavors and the history and culture behind them. We recommend scheduling this class at the beginning of your time in Maine so you can take advantage of all you've learned during the rest of your trip. Stick around afterwards for personalized recommendations from your MTC host about wineries, breweries, markets, farms and other agritourism experiences to seek out while in Maine - customized to your interests and the regions you plan to visit while in Maine.

experiences.title: Maine Wine and Mead Tasting in Wiscasset
experiences.description:
Explore the wines and meads of Maine! Take your tastebuds on a trip around the state and explore the wide variety of wines made right here in our state - including those made with imported grapes, those made with cold-hardy grapes grown in Maine, and those made from ingredients that aren't grapes at all! Participants will be introduced to six Maine-made wines and meads from six different producers - and hear the stories behind the wineries that brought them to your glass.

This guided, 30-minute experience is a fantastic introduction to Maine's wine landscape and history. We recommend scheduling this class at the beginning of your time in Maine so you can take advantage of all you've learned during the rest of your trip. Stick around afterwards for personalized recommendations from your MTC host about wineries, breweries, markets, farms and other agritourism experiences to seek out while in Maine - customized to your interests and the regions you plan to visit while in Maine.

experiences.title: Private Wine & Mead Tasting with the Vintner in Lee, Maine
experiences.description:
Upon arrival, you will be greeted by your friendly staff and escorted to your cozy tasting room. The experience begins with an introduction to the tasting flight, carefully curated to showcase the best of your local offerings. As you sip on each variety, your vintner will share the captivating history of winemaking in the region, offering a deep dive into the processes and stories behind each bottle.

You'll have the opportunity to ask questions, making this an interactive and educational experience. The tasting room's ambiance, combined with the stunning views of the farm and orchards, creates a perfect setting for a memorable outing.

Included
~A guided tasting of a flight of wines and ciders
~A detailed presentation on the history and process of winemaking in the Maine Highlands
~Personalized attention from your expert vintner

experiences.title: Grand Haven Afternoon Guided Bike & Beer Tour - 3 Hours
experiences.description: Mi Bike Tours is the best way to experience Grand Haven like a local. Our bike route takes you through some of the most scenic parts of Grand Haven and stops at the most popular cafes and restaurants. This tour is fun, relaxed, and is guaranteed to be one of your favorite summer days!

experiences.title: Private Walking Food Tour In Detroit With Secret Food Tours
experiences.description:
On your Secret Food Tour: Detroit, you’ll explore the beating heart of
Motor City.

Your experienced guides will lead you on a rich journey through the
heart of Detroit, home to incredible history, diverse cultures, and a
thriving food scene boasting many of the cities favorite local eats.
Along the way, you'll indulge in classic comfort foods, local staples,
and the iconic dishes Detroit is known for. As you enjoy each dish,
you'll discover how the city became one of the largest and richest
cities in America fueled by the hearty classic dishes that make up the Motor City's food scene today. From the titans of industry who
occupied Detroits famed skyscrapers, to the beloved working-class
heroes that built the cars that got America moving, and the rich
immigrant communities that sought their fortunes in Detroit-communities made their mark on the cities iconic foods that you'll experience on your dive into the true flavors of Motown.

As a private Tour everything works around you!

experiences.title: Indian Cooking Class in Grand Rapids
experiences.description:
Step into a warm and inviting home kitchen for a hands-on Indian cooking experience that immerses you in the heart of India’s culinary traditions. Learn to prepare classic dishes from scratch, including traditional chicken curry, fresh handmade rotis, and authentic Indian chai, all using wholesome ingredients and freshly ground spices. With over 30 years of cooking experience and a passion for sharing Indian culture, the host creates a relaxed atmosphere reminiscent of cooking with family. This class not only teaches traditional techniques but also shares stories about Indian food and culture, culminating in a delightful meal enjoyed together at the end.
- Small-group setting for personalized attention

experiences.title: Detroit Sweet Treats Food Tour: Donuts, Coffee, Pastries & More
experiences.description:
Our journey begins at Astoria Bakery, a local favorite offering a taste of Greektown’s charm with its array of irresistible baked goods. Here we'll try some of Detroit's best donuts, made fresh daily.

Heading near the Shinola Hotel, enjoy expertly crafted coffee and creative desserts in a neighborhood blending Detroit’s industrial roots with modern flair. In Parker’s Alley, tucked behind the hotel, discover a boutique chocolatier crafting unique confections in this revitalized urban gem.

Our next stop is Cannelle, a patisserie inspired by French baking, where exquisite pastries showcase Detroit’s elevated culinary scene. We’ll end at Campus Martius, the vibrant heart of downtown, where the city’s rich history meets its modern energy—a perfect conclusion to this flavorful exploration. Join us for a delicious dive into Detroit’s sweetest spots!

experiences.title: 5-Hour Traverse City Wine Tour: 4 Wineries on Old Mission Peninsula
experiences.description:
Sit back and enjoy the gentle slopes, winding country roads and Caribbean-like views on a Traverse City Wine Tour. The Magic Shuttle Bus is a chauffeur service with an entire fleet ready to take your group around Old Mission Peninsula.

The 45th parallel, is home to the worlds most famous wine-making regions AND Traverse City. Grapevines planted in the region enjoy the perfect amount of sunlight for optimal growth. When coupled with micro-climates created by Grand Traverse Bay, and fertile soil, this sets the perfect stage for delicious award-winning wines that rival centuries-old grapes produced in Europe & California.

"We are proud to say that our Old Mission Wine Tour has been nominated as Top 20 Wine Tours in the Country by USA Today, and stands as our signature tour in Northern Michigan!"

**Wineries are subject to change based on availability**

***Gratuity of 20% for the driver is strongly recommended (Cash Only)***

Discover the best of Leelanau County's wineries with the convenience of inclusive transportation leaving from downtown Traverse City. This wine tour takes you to three carefully selected wineries, allowing you to savor the finest wines and revel in the stunning views without the worry of transportation. Our wine tours have won TripAdvisor's prestigious "Best of the Best" award three years in a row, and named among America's top 10 wine tours—a testament to our commitment to excellence. 

You'll gain exclusive access to wineries that are typically not open to the public for join-in tours. At each winery, there will be plenty of time for you to enjoy and learn. You'll gain exclusive access to each winery's tasting room, where you can sample a variety of wines crafted using local techniques. Find something you like? You can always purchase bottles, and your tour drivers will safely hold your purchases until the tour is over.

experiences.title: Iconic Foods of Detroit Tour
experiences.description:
Get ready to walk, taste, and discover your way through the heart of the Motor City on this food tour. Over the course of three flavorful hours, you’ll sample Detroit’s most iconic eats while soaking up the stories and spirit of the city that created them.

From historic eateries to buzz-worthy newcomers, this fully-narrated tour brings Detroit’s food scene to life with every bite. Savor a slice of Detroit-style pizza, bite into a classic Coney dog, sip on local fizzy favorites, and indulge in sweet traditions of the Motor City – first at a local chocolatier and then at an iconic downtown restaurant.

On this must-do walking tour, your guide will share fascinating stories of the people and places behind the flavors, all while leading you past some of Detroit’s most recognizable landmarks and photo-worthy backdrops.

experiences.title: Designated Driver TC - We Drive Your Car - Private TC Wine Tour
experiences.description:
We drive your car for wine, brew, distillery and cidery tours. We help you create your perfect itinerary which, can be changed on the fly. 

No pressure, stay as long as you want.... this is your day! Let's do exactly what you want to do.

NOTE: Additional hours past the 5 included will be charged separately through Designated Driver TC via cash or credit card.

experiences.title: Sunset Sail from Traverse City with Food, Wine & Cocktails
experiences.description:
Wind down and relax as our captain and crewmates teach you about our elegant schooner and share stories about the history of the lands, people, and waters of the Grand Traverse Bay area. Enjoy complimentary locally sourced food, wine, and cocktails while watching the sunset paint the sky. This is a 2.5-hour sail. 

Check-in at our kiosk 30 min before departure. The 2nd Mate will do a brief welcome about 10 min before departure and then will guide all passengers to board Wind Dancer. We have a variety of beverage options including wine, cocktails, local spirits, soda and water. Food is served around 1 hour into the sail. We respectfully request that guests not bring additional alcoholic beverages. Free parking is available at the check-in kiosk, which is located at The Delamar Resort, 615 E. Front Street, Traverse City, MI. Depending on the weather, please bring rain gear/sweaters and non-skid footwear for boating. Tours will be rescheduled if necessary due to inclement weather.

experiences.title: Grand Rapids, MI by the Seat Cycle Tour
experiences.description:
Pedal, Party, and Pour.

Climb aboard the Great Lakes Pub Cruiser’s Grand Rapids’ only 2-6 passenger party bike! This high-energy, pedal-powered pub crawl takes you through Beer City USA’s best breweries, taprooms, and bars, all while jamming to your favorite tunes and soaking up the city vibes.

Whether you're celebrating a birthday, bachelor(ette) bash, work outing, or just the weekend, the party is brought to the pedals. Cruise the streets, raise your glass, and create unforgettable memories with your crew — one stop (and one pint) at a time.

Let’s ride, cheers, and repeat.

experiences.title: Uptown Grand Rapids Walking Food Tour with Local Tastings
experiences.description:
Explore the culinary landscape of Uptown Grand Rapids on this engaging walking food tour, where you’ll savor a delightful variety of bites from four locally acclaimed eateries. Over the course of three hours, enjoy a mix of savory and sweet dishes while uncovering the rich history of this vibrant neighborhood. With a maximum group size of 12 guests, this tour ensures a personable experience filled with storytelling and insider knowledge. Whether you're a local or visiting for the first time, this foodie adventure is perfect for all palates, accommodating dietary restrictions upon request.

- Duration: 3 hours of delightful walking and tasting
- Sample four award-winning eateries with generous food tastings
- Light walking (0.7 miles) with frequent stops, wheelchair accessible
- Limited to 12 guests for an intimate and engaging experience

experiences.title: Detroit Downtown Food Tour with 6+ Iconic Tastings in Motor City
experiences.description: Dive into Detroit’s downtown soul on a flavorful walking food tour guided by genuine city storytellers. Explore the heart of Motor City—from Greektown to historic landmarks—as you enjoy 6+ iconic tastings that tell the story of Detroit’s culinary comeback. Indulge in corned beef egg rolls, sample rival Coney Island hot dogs, cool off with a Detroit original Boston Cooler float, savor a slice of Detroit-style pizza, treat yourself to a Greektown pastry, and uncover our chef’s exclusive Secret Dish with a local twist. Every stop pairs delicious bites with compelling stories—from immigrant roots to renaissance neighborhoods—offering a warm and authentic taste of Detroit you won’t find on your own.

experiences.title: NON-BUS MOVIE STARS 2 couple / 4 person Old Mission Wine Tour
experiences.description:
SEMI-PRIVATE OR PRIVATE VIP WINE TOUR 

NOT THE OVER-BOOKED CHEAP BUS TOUR!! Want cheap? Stop reading and book the bus...

2 COUPLES ONLY- this is the tour that books only 2 couples- never more than 4 people in this vehicle... great for groups of 4 or for couples who do not want a large crowd on a party bus. Couples that book 2 spots will at most have one other couple with them on this tour. Why would you ever book a loud, obnoxious party bus? See our semi-private or private booking options

Don't get trapped on a bus! Private tours go to up to 4 wineries or just do 2 or 3- up to you... Tell your guide what wineries are on your list! Pickup/drop-off in downtown Traverse City. 

Great for any romantic occasion! 

Skip the hassle of the bus and leave the driving to us! Stunning views, NO BUSES, NO Rush, Iconic wineries, stellar wines, and 5-star Movie Star customer service! Sip and savor as you sample the wines of 4 spectacular wineries with REAL wine connoisseurs/wine tour guides.

experiences.title: Fun Sushi Making Class With a Local Chef in Grand Rapids
experiences.description: Ordering sushi is great. Making it yourself and actually knowing what you are doing is a completely different level of satisfaction. That is exactly what this class is for. Chef See will take you from total beginner to confident sushi roller in one fun, relaxed session. You will master the rice, nail the rolling technique and build two crowd-pleasing classics: a California roll with fresh crab, avocado and cucumber, and a spicy tuna roll that brings just enough heat to keep things interesting. Along the way you will pick up the kind of insider tips that make the difference between sushi that holds together beautifully and sushi that, well, does not. Come for the skills. Stay for the eating. Leave as the person in your friend group who makes sushi now.

experiences.title: Evening Local Food and Art Tour in Grand Rapids
experiences.description:
3 Hours | Downtown Grand Rapids | Local Food • Public Art • Creative Dessert

Experience ArtPrize on a guided walking tour through downtown Grand Rapids. Begin by exploring a hidden art gallery inside an award-winning local restaurant before picking up a slice of Detroit-style pepperoni pizza to enjoy as you stroll between ArtPrize venues and outdoor installations.

Your local guide will lead you through a thoughtfully planned route, sharing stories about the ArtPrize event, participating artists, and the city's vibrant arts scene. Along the way, you'll experience a variety of sculptures, installations, paintings, photography, digital media, and interactive works.

End the tour at one of Grand Rapids' favorite sweet shops, where you'll decorate your own slice of cake using colorful frosting before enjoying your edible masterpiece.

Alcoholic beverages are available for purchase. Guests 21+ may enjoy drinks while walking through Grand Rapids' Social District, following local guidelines.

experiences.title: Fun Character Sushi Making Class at a Local Distillery
