Settle into a lively local brewery in Charlotte and learn the tricks behind homemade sushi with Chef Tiore guiding you through every step. First, you’ll prepare sushi rice with kombu and learn how texture and seasoning make or break a roll. Then you’ll layer nori, rice, sushi-grade tuna, Japanese mayo and sriracha before mastering the rolling technique for spicy tuna rolls. You’ll also sharpen your knife skills while slicing cucumber and avocado for colorful vegetable rolls. Everything is hands-on and beginner-friendly, with plenty of room to ask questions, laugh at imperfect rolls and enjoy the process. By the end, you’ll have practical sushi skills and a full meal you made from scratch.

experiences.title: Discover West Jefferson Through Food, History & Stories
experiences.description:
Discover West Jefferson Through Food, History & Stories.
Explore the culinary delights of West Jefferson on this engaging walking food tour. Sample five delicious tastings, including three seated and two on-the-go, while uncovering the rich history and cultural stories of the area. Meet fellow food enthusiasts as you stroll past vibrant murals and local art, experiencing the charm of the High Country. This tour welcomes participants of all ages and is limited to 10 people, ensuring a cozy and personalized experience. Enjoy a memorable afternoon filled with food, fun, and fascinating tales, rain or shine.

- Savor 5 food tastings, including 3 indoor and 2 on-the-go
- Discover local history and cultural insights along the way
- Limited to 10 participants for an intimate experience
- Available Saturdays from 2:00 pm to 4:15 pm

experiences.title: DIY Candle Making Class at a Local Brewery in Raleigh
experiences.description: Swap the usual “what should we do today?” debate for a fun, hands-on candle making class hosted at a trendy local brewery in Raleigh. In this hands-on experience, Instructor Caroline will guide you step by step as you design and pour your own custom candle. You’ll explore different scents, learn how fragrance, wax and wicks work together and create a candle that feels completely personal. And the best news? No experience is needed. Get ready for an experience that is creative, relaxing and way more memorable than sitting through another average happy hour. This class is ideal for couples looking for a unique date night, friends planning a girls’ night out, solo guests who want a calming creative escape and travelers searching for a local activity beyond the typical sightseeing list. Come for the cozy atmosphere, stay for the joy of making something with your own hands and leave with a custom candle that feels totally you.

experiences.title: Fun Dumpling Making Class With a Local Chef in Charlotte
experiences.description:
Discover the techniques behind classic dumplings in this hands-on cooking class in Charlotte.

This experience is hosted at a trendy local venue in Charlotte and is designed for all skill levels. Start by mixing a balanced filling with ground pork, Napa cabbage, scallions, ginger and sesame oil, with a vegetarian option available.

Next, learn how to wrap and fold dumplings so they hold their shape and cook evenly. You’ll then cook your dumplings until golden and enjoy them fresh while gaining techniques you can confidently recreate at home.

experiences.title: Fun Pasta Making Class With a Local Chef in Charlotte
experiences.description: Nothing beats the satisfaction of making pasta with your own hands, especially in the relaxed atmosphere of a local brewery. You'll prepare an Italian course, beginning with fresh pappardelle from simple ingredients like flour, eggs and olive oil. Pick up practical skills including dough mixing, kneading, rolling and cutting while learning what gives fresh pasta its perfect texture. Next, create a hearty Bolognese by combining pork, beef, celery, carrots, onions, tomato paste, crushed tomatoes and Parmesan into a deeply flavorful sauce. The aroma alone is worth showing up for. Bring everything together into a comforting Italian meal, then sit down and enjoy what you've created. It's relaxed, beginner-friendly and a delicious way to spend an afternoon or evening in the city.

experiences.title: Pasta Making Class at a Local Brewery in Charlotte
experiences.description: Come hungry and leave knowing exactly how to make cavatelli from scratch at a laid-back Charlotte brewery. You’ll mix semolina flour, water, olive oil and salt, work the dough by hand and learn how to roll and shape those distinctive little pasta shells. Then comes the best part: fresh pesto made with basil, pine nuts, garlic and olive oil, finished with salt, pepper and Parmesan for a bright, savory sauce. You’ll combine the pesto with your handmade cavatelli and enjoy the finished dish in a casual, social setting. The class is beginner-friendly, so you can focus on learning, laughing and getting your pasta shapes just right. Plus, with Chef Autumn’s background working at Disney World, training under a Michelin-star chef and becoming an executive chef at 23, you’ll pick up plenty of kitchen know-how along the way.

experiences.title: Private Walking Food Tour in Asheville Downtown Culinary Heritage
experiences.description: You walk through Asheville where spices drift on the air. The streets hum with voices and clinking glasses. Each stop offers a taste that tells a story. Your guide shares insights into recipes and traditions. The tour lasts three hours and unfolds fully on foot. Plates arrive with textures that surprise your senses. You feel warmth in fresh bread and brightness in local produce. Each tasting is included so you can savor without pause. What hidden hands shaped these flavors across time? As evening light falls, scents linger and invite you to remember Asheville by taste.

experiences.title: Private Wine Tour with Dine in Black Mountain from Asheville
experiences.description: Journey through beautiful and stunning North Carolina on this half-day tour from the Asheville metropolitan area. Your private chauffeur will pick up your group from your hotel or private residence anywhere in the Asheville metropolitan area, as well as drop you off at the end of the tour. Your group will visit a couple of amazing vineyards and explore North Carolina with an expert guide who handles all the driving as your private chauffeur, leaving your group free to enjoy wineries, shop and dine in downtown Black Mountain, so sit back and relax, and enjoy the incredible scenery. This tour requires a minimum of 2 and most seating is limited to 6 participants, so you can enjoy a more intimate experience of Georgia’s natural mountain landscapes. 7+ participants will be in multiple vehicles and/or a shuttle van.

experiences.title: Sushi Making Cooking Class at a Local Craft Beer Bar in Raleigh
experiences.description: Join Chef Jenny for an interactive sushi-making experience at a local craft beer bar in Raleigh! In this engaging class, you’ll learn how to create two delicious sushi rolls from scratch, starting with perfectly seasoned sushi rice. Under Chef Jenny’s guidance, roll up a classic California roll filled with avocado, cucumber, and surimi before assembling a fresh veggie roll with mango, avocado, and cucumber. Using a traditional sushi mat, you’ll master the technique of rolling and slicing your sushi like a pro. As you cook, enjoy the relaxed atmosphere of the craft beer bar and sip on locally brewed beers available for purchase. Whether you're looking for a fun date night, a unique outing with friends, or a hands-on way to explore Japanese cuisine, this class offers the perfect blend of learning, great flavors, and craft beer. Book your spot today for an unforgettable sushi-making experience in Raleigh!

experiences.title: Tryon Winery Tour Explore 3 Wineries with Tastings
experiences.description:
This 6-hour guided journey takes you to three premier wineries in Polk County - Mountain Brook, Overmountain, and Parker-Binns - with unexpected delights and insider insights along the way. 21+ only.

You have a choice to either pay for what you'd like at the wineries or add in the all-inclusive for all of the tastings will be included. The first option is perfect for someone who does not want to drink too much wine but want to enjoy and experience the sights while the all inclusive is perfect for someone who wants an amazing tasting experience. Note that there are around 4-5 wines or so to taste at each winery if you choose to take advantage of the all inclusive deal.

IMPORTANT: The default price does not include every tasting - you will get a sample on the bus. If you'd like the all inclusive package, please contact us.

experiences.title: Missouri River BBQ Dinner Cruise with Laughing Sun Brewing Co
experiences.description:
More than just a scenic cruise, this experience is backed by a strong commitment to guest safety and professional service. We are proud to operate a U.S. Coast Guard–inspected, tested, and certified commercial passenger vessel, meeting rigorous standards for safety and reliability.

Guests can relax and enjoy their time on the water knowing that our crew is trained in CPR and First Aid and regularly undergoes man-overboard emergency response proficiency testing. This dedication to safety, combined with our diverse selection of dining, beverage, and historical cruises, ensures a comfortable, enjoyable, and worry-free experience for every guest.

Whether you're joining us for the scenery, local flavors, or engaging storytelling, you can cruise with confidence knowing your safety is our top priority.

experiences.title: Burger Cruise featuring Blarney Stone Irish Pub
experiences.description:
Combine a scenic cruise on the Missouri River with a delicious burger experience featuring favorites from Blarney Stone Irish Pub. Guests can savor a flavorful meal while taking in beautiful waterfront views, creating the perfect blend of dining and sightseeing.

Beyond the food, this cruise stands out for its commitment to guest safety and comfort. We are proud to operate aboard a U.S. Coast Guard–inspected, tested, and certified commercial passenger vessel, giving passengers peace of mind throughout their journey. Our professional crew is trained in CPR and First Aid and regularly undergoes man-overboard emergency response proficiency testing to ensure a safe and enjoyable experience for all.

With great food, relaxing river views, and industry-leading safety standards, this cruise offers a unique and memorable way to experience the Missouri River.

experiences.title: Oyster Tasting and Kayak Tour
experiences.description:
This two-hour tour is the perfect opportunity for those looking to taste fresh oysters, paddle with a trained kayak guide, and observe coastal wildlife.

We will explore Little Bay, a tidal estuary located outside of Portsmouth, NH, near the mouth of the Piscataqua River where there is an abundance of aquatic wildlife from shellfish to shorebirds. Then, we will paddle to Hidden Coast Shellfish's floating farmhouse to learn all about their growing and harvesting process. The oysters you sample will be fresh picked from the ocean!

experiences.title: Historical Tastings at the Iconic Rockingham
experiences.description:
Introducing a Memorable Portsmouth Tasting Experience at one of the city’s most iconic historic venues, where heritage dining meets history and architectural treasures.

For 90 minutes, immerse yourself in the story of the iconic Rockingham, one bite and one sip at a time. Guided by Cassandra and Cameron, uncover layers of history woven into the walls of this Portsmouth gem.

Savor curated wines paired with gourmet bites from our five-star kitchen. Discover the Rockingham’s beautifully preserved architecture, meet historical figures who graced these rooms, uncover its jazz-filled past, and perhaps sense a whisper from its more spectral residents.

This isn’t just a tasting. It’s a journey through time—one sip, one story, and one delicious moment at a time.

Perfect for foodies, wine lovers (21+), and those who appreciate historic venues, heritage dining, and unique Portsmouth experiences.

A great rainy-day activity on the Seacoast. Private tours are available year-round.

experiences.title: Meet the Winemakers - Seven Birches Winery Tour
experiences.description:
Interested in how our wines are hand-crafted, right here in New Hampshire? Then, consider taking a “Meet the Winemakers” tour some Wednesday or Saturday afternoon. This intimate tour of the winery and chat with the winemaker is a fantastic way to experience Seven Birches Wines. Chat with the winemaker and taste some delicious NH wines, curated by the winemaker.

Seven Birches Winery, located within the grand new Riverwalk Resort at Loon Mountain, in the White Mountains of NH, is hand-crafting classic European grape varietals and locally sourced fruits into wines of distinction.

The fruit may be from around the world, but our wine embraces the spirit of New Hampshire. LIVE FREE.

experiences.title: Sip of the Jersey Shore Brew Tour
experiences.description:
The Sip of the Jersey Shore Tour offers a unique, all-inclusive craft beer experience along the stunning Jersey Shore. Visit three local breweries, enjoy guided tastings, and learn about the brewing process, all while relaxing with round-trip transportation. Perfect for beer lovers looking to explore the vibrant craft beer scene in a fun and stress-free way!

This tour includes walking short distances and some areas may not be wheelchair accessible.

experiences.title: Taste the NJ Suburbs - South Orange Food Tour
experiences.description:
This 2.5-hour walking tour will showcase the diverse and delicious restaurant scene in the charming village of South Orange. Chefs and culinary connoisseurs at 4 amazing restaurants will provide an inside look at what makes them special. 

This is the only food tour in Essex County, NJ at this time! We are proud to offer the premier food tour of the New Jersey suburbs -- the only tour that currently offers an insider's view of a highly popular retail incubator marketplace as well as food from a modern restaurant located inside a former police and fire station!

experiences.title: Spirits Tasting at Little Water Distillery
experiences.description:
Sample the best of our distillery with a tasting flight (two options available) of our award-winning spirits and cocktails.

Award-winning spirits: Whiskey, Rum, Vodka, and Gin
Bottled cocktails: Espresso Martini, Chocolate Martini, or Old Fashioned
A complimentary souvenir shot glass

Special Offer: Stick around for hand-crafted cocktails and receive 10% off all bottle purchases made today!

experiences.title: Private Bread Baking Class near Philadelphia
experiences.description: Join an interactive bread baking class in Mount Laurel, NJ, not far from Philadelphia! Master sourdough and pretzel making, enjoy fresh bread with toppings, and take home a starter kit. This private baking class offers a hands-on journey into the art of sourdough and pretzel-making, blending fun with practical skills. From mastering dough techniques to enjoying your fresh creations paired with gourmet toppings and wine, you’ll leave with more than just recipes – you’ll gain confidence, a sourdough starter, and a passion for baking. This is an interactive and memorable way to celebrate or learn together! Perfect for adults and families with children, travelers with limited time, adventure seekers and culture lovers.

experiences.title: Dinner Cruise with Dolphin Watching from Cape May
experiences.description: Enjoy dinner, sight dolphins, drink an ice cold beverage, enjoy the company of loved ones and see one our beautiful sunsets over Delaware Bay. No other Dinner Cruise in the world can offer top quality food (from a Restaurant, not a microwave), unparalleled views and dolphin sightings in a single evening. We have the most to offer in Southern New Jersey. We offer the finest food available a float (see Menu and Ship), the largest and cleanest vessel, and a family oriented atmosphere.

experiences.title: City Cruises New Jersey Signature Bottomless Mimosa Brunch Cruise
experiences.description: No matter the occasion, a New Jersey Signature Bottomless Mimosa Brunch Cruise is sure to create an unforgettable afternoon. Experience a brunch cruise on the East and Hudson Rivers. Dine the day away with friends and family and soak in New Jersey and New York's skyline views along the Hudson and East Rivers. Enjoy spectacular views of the city skyline and local landmarks, including the Empire State Building, the Brooklyn Bridge, and the Statue of Liberty.

experiences.title: City Cruises New Jersey: Signature Lunch Cruise
experiences.description:
When looking for a fun and festive way to get out on the water, a Signature cruise is your answer. Come aboard and experience breathtaking NYC skyline views, a chef-prepared buffet-style lunch, attentive service, DJ entertainment, rooftop lounge and onboard games!

Departing from Lincoln Harbor Marina in Weehawken NJ, a lunch cruise with City Cruises is the perfect way to spend a relaxing afternoon on the water taking in the iconic sites along the Skyline. Enjoy views of Empire State Building, One World Trade Center, Brooklyn Bridge, Statue of Liberty and more!

experiences.title: City Cruises NYC: Skyline Dinner Cruise from New Jersey
experiences.description:
Dine along the skyline with City Cruises
Enjoy chef prepared menus, seasonal cocktails, live music, iconic sights, and the bright city lights as you dine along the New York skyline!

Depart from Lincoln Harbor Marina in Weehawken NJ and sail for two-and-a-half hours along the Hudson and East rivers past many notable attractions such as Statue of Liberty, Empire State Building, Vessel at Hudson Yards, Chrysler Building, One World Trade Center, Intrepid Sea, Air & Space Museum, South Street Seaport, Brooklyn Bridge and more.

Take in the views as you enjoy the chef prepared dinner buffet with freshly prepared entrees, salads and desserts along with live musical entertainment provided by the onboard DJ. Creative cocktails, wine and beer available from the well-stocked bar. 

Board the Spirit of New Jersey for a festive and casual dinner cruise with incredible skyline views from interior and exterior open-air observation decks.

experiences.title: Emilia-Romagna Cooking Class in Philadelphia (3-Course Meal)
experiences.description:
Italy's Food Valley on a plate – this hands-on cooking class in Philadelphia, hosted through Cozymeal, which connects you with top-rated local chefs, explores Emilia-Romagna through aged Parmigiano Reggiano, handmade pasta and a rustic almond cake.

Your hands-on cooking experience features:
- Parmigiano Reggiano con Mostarda di Frutta with aged Parmesan and Italian candied fruit mustard
- Handmade Pasta – gnocchi in sage butter or lasagna with beef ragù and Béchamel (group choice)
- Sbrisolona (Crunchy Almond Cake) with cornmeal, flour, butter, almonds, eggs and sugar

You will leave with the skills to make handmade pasta, a proper Béchamel and a rustic Italian almond cake at home. Guests are welcome to bring wine or beer to enjoy throughout the experience.

experiences.title: Himalayan Tea Flight and Tasting Experience
experiences.description: Explore the exquisite world of Himalayan tea with a curated tasting session featuring four rare teas from Nepal’s high elevations. This interactive experience allows participants to savor distinct flavors while learning the art of tea tasting, including aroma, body, and finish. Hosted by the Nepal Tea Collective, guests will uncover the stories behind each tea and how altitude and climate influence their unique profiles. Perfect for both tea enthusiasts and curious beginners, this session brings the essence of the Himalayas to your cup.

experiences.title: New Jersey Local Vineyard and Winery Tour
experiences.description: Explore the heart of local wine country with a guided tour to two picturesque vineyards and wineries. Travel comfortably in a climate-controlled Jeep Wrangler, ensuring an enjoyable ride as you discover the unique flavors of the region. Each stop features wine tastings where you can savor 5-6 ounces of exquisite local wines. This intimate experience is perfect for small groups of up to four passengers, offering an insider's look at the art of winemaking and the opportunity to learn from knowledgeable guides. Pickup is conveniently provided from your designated location, making this tour an easy choice for wine enthusiasts.

experiences.title: The Official Santa Fe Margarita Trail Tour
experiences.description:
NEW!!! From the #1 traveller ranked tour/activity operator in Santa Fe. 
Explore Santa Fe’s renowned Margarita Trail on this guided walking tour, where history and flavor come together in the country’s Margarita capital. Join the ONLY tour in SF that earns you 3 passport stamps in 2 hours while checking out some The Trail’s most beloved participants. Sample some of the city’s best expertly crafted margaritas featuring local spirits and fresh ingredients paired with yummy bites. Along the way, your guide will share stories of Santa Fe’s rich culture, tequila traditions, and the lore around the origins of New Mexico’s iconic state cocktail.

PLEASE NOTE: We are unable to make dietary substitutions on this tour.

experiences.title: Santa Fe Chocolate Tasting and History Exploration Tour
experiences.description:
Discover the rich history of chocolate on this immersive 3-hour tour in Santa Fe, the oldest capital city in the United States. Explore the evolution of chocolate from ancient elixirs to modern delights. Sample unique offerings at four local chocolate shops, each showcasing a distinct aspect of Santa Fe's culinary scene. Delve into the stories of chocolate’s cultural significance while enjoying a flavorful journey through time.

- Explore four local chocolate shops with unique specialties: Kakawa Chocolate house, Chocolate En La Plaza, Chocolate and Cashmere and Senior Murphy's.
- Learn about chocolate’s history from ancient Central America to modern treats
- Tour duration of 3 hours with a minimum of 4 and a maximum of 12 participants
- Comfortable shoes and a bottle of water are recommended for this walking tour

experiences.title: Las Cruces El Paso Weekend Wine Shuttle
experiences.description:
Leave your cares and your car behind while exploring the charm of New Mexico’s wineries. Savor the rich aroma of oak barrels as you taste rich red wines. Laugh with newfound friends over a glass of rosé under the heat of the desert sun. Let the gentle hum of live music set the rhythm for the day as you sip your new favorite white wine. Each stop offers new flavors, a new story—designed to leave you with lasting memories of a day well spent.

Set Your Own Pace
We spend about one hour at each location to give you time to savor your wine, enjoy live music, take pictures, and socialize. Drinks are not included.

Expert Tour Guide
You’ll learn about local history, get wine tasting tips, and listen to great music between stops.

For Visitors and Locals
Whether you’re visiting for the first time, hosting guests from out of town, or looking for a new way to experience your favorite places, our Weekend Wine Tours are unforgettable.

experiences.title: Santa Fe Day trip to Northern New Mexico Wine Country
experiences.description: Take the scenic High Road to Chimayó and experience a full-day wine tour through northern New Mexico’s stunning high-elevation wine country. Visit three of the region’s highest altitude vineyards, where dramatic landscapes meet exceptional wines. Enjoy curated tastings at each stop, paired with local flavors and seasonal bites. Travel in comfort aboard a luxury Mercedes-Benz Sprinter with a local guide who shares the stories behind the wines, the land, and the culture. This small-group experience offers unforgettable views, rich flavors, and a deep taste of northern New Mexico’s unique wine scene.

experiences.title: Enchanted Eats of Santa Fe Half-Day Private Tour
experiences.description:
Skip the crowds—this private tour is just for your group! Enjoy a delightful half-day walking tour through the enchanting streets of Santa Fe, blending historical exploration with mouthwatering food tastings. Begin at the historic Santa Fe Plaza, where centuries of culture and tradition come alive. Amid the Plaza’s iconic architecture and vibrant scene, sample a variety of local culinary delights. Next, visit San Miguel Chapel—the oldest church in the U.S.—before heading to Galisteo Street, known for its charming buildings, artsy vibe, and local eateries. This immersive experience offers more than just a stroll; it’s a flavorful journey into Santa Fe’s rich heritage and diverse cuisine.

Note: Program and attractions may vary based on booking time and crowd conditions, ensuring each visit offers something unique.

experiences.title: Learn the Art of Leather Tooling
experiences.description:
Learn the art of leather saddle tooling from a second-generation leatherworker. Focusing on creative expression - I teach the process, then set you free to make your own patterns and designs. Students will create functional pieces of leather art: wrist cuffs, keychains, bookmarks, and coasters that make the perfect keepsake or gift.

A unique high desert experience ideal for couples and families, large groups, or weddings.

Solo travelers also welcome!

experiences.title: Red or Green: Chef-Guided New Mexican Lunch Immersion
experiences.description:
Skip to the front of the famously long lines to savor authentic New Mexican flavors with a seated luncheon at one of Santa Fe’s most beloved generational eateries. Enjoy award-winning chile, top-shelf Margaritas, artisan confections and our rich local history on this flavorful journey.
Led by a formally trained culinary expert, this immersive lunch tour explores the origins and evolution of NM’s distinct cuisine through a guided comparative tasting that highlights the key differences between Mexican and New Mexican flavors. To elevate the experience, we’ll celebrate Santa Fe’s status as the Margarita Capital of America with a top-shelf margarita pairing for each course, showcasing different styles and expressions of this iconic cocktail.
After indulging in a feast of local flavors, we’ll finish on a sweet note with a locally inspired dessert at Santa Fe’s premier craft ice creamery.

experiences.title: White Water Rafting and Wine Tour
experiences.description:
If you're looking for a memorable addition to your vacation.
Bringing everyone the perfect day of adventure.
Groups, couples & single travelers come join the fun.
Join us for a FUN & relaxing day of rafting the Rio Grande with good wine & food after your rafting trip.
Go to our website for more information about your tour and BOOK!

experiences.title: Tumbleroot Brewery and Distillery Tour and Tasting
experiences.description: Brewery and distillery tour led by experienced brewers/distillers. It is an interactive, hands-on and multisensory tour. The tour is followed by sampling spirits and/or beer in our intimate tasting room.

experiences.title: Taste of Santa Fe Wine and Dine Lunch
experiences.description: The Taste of Santa Fe Tour is unique because it features 3 of our top spots in Santa Fe, highlights our favorite historical points of interest, and wraps up with our favorite hidden gem for dessert. This tour has a bit more of a upscale theme, is eclectic, and happens to be our top tour. We will provide information about the history of Santa Fe, our food, culture, and historical points of interests. This tour includes a full lunch, n/a drinks, alcohol pairings (Such as wine, margaritas, or local beers), as well as dessert. This tour meets at 10:45am near the plaza (Exact meeting instructions will be found on your ticket), starts at 10:55am and lasts 2.5-3 hours. **NOTE** This tour may feature New Mexican inspired foods and can be spicy for some guests. We don't recommend this tour for anyone with serious food restrictions and minimal walking ability.

experiences.title: Taos Artisan Walking Tour + Chocolate
experiences.description:
Immerse into Taos’ eclectic artistic community! Starting on Kit Carson Road, weave in and out of winding alleyways exploring the historical context while pausing to mix with the local art scene. Taos has been on the map as an art colony since the late 1800s and it has a reputation for its eclectic talented creative populace. Come to this high desert mountain town to not only experience the ethereal light and vivid landscape, but to also encounter this dynamic community and their remarkable art to life. Enjoy a mix of old and new while exploring downtown’s rich art history. Discover the vibrant center of this uniquely quirky and highly talented community.
We conclude this tour with a Chocolate Elixir at Chokola to weave in the art of chocolate making by owners Deb and Javier who are passionate about every step in the process of their decadent sipping chocolate, truffles, mousses and tarts! A perfect way to celebrate the finale of your immersion to Taos Artisans!

experiences.title: New Mexican Flavors Food Tour of the Santa Fe Plaza
experiences.description: Join this fun food tour, with locally raised guides who have generations of knowledge! This tour is unique because you will enjoy a hand-picked New Mexican food experience. Experience New Mexican food and discover some of the best foodie spots near the Santa Fe Plaza. On the tour, you will also learn about the history of Santa Fe, the food, culture, and historical points of interest such as the Palace of the Governors, The San Miguel Mission (The oldest church structure in the USA), and The Loretto Chapel (Home to the Miraculous Staircase). This casual tour includes a full lunch, non-alcoholic drinks, alcohol pairings (Such as wine, margaritas, or local beers), as well as dessert. **NOTE** This tour features New Mexican-inspired foods and can be spicy for some guests. We don't recommend this tour for anyone with serious food restrictions and minimal walking ability.

experiences.title: Savor Santa Fe: Wine Pairing Dinner
experiences.description: The Savor Santa Fe Tour is perfect for unique romantic experience with a loved one or private experience with family, friends, or co-workers. Savor Santa Fe is a more upscale tour that provides an eclectic progressive dinner, wine, and dessert! Along the way we will provide information about the history of Santa Fe, our food, culture, and historical points of interests. The tour includes a full dinner, n/a drinks, wine pairings, and dessert. The tour meets at 3:50pm at our designated meeting location(Exact meeting instructions will be found on your ticket), starts at 4:00pm and lasts 2.5-3 hours. Tours will sell out. Note: We are the only food tour company in Santa Fe that are truly locally owned and operated.

experiences.title: Santa Fe Sweet & Spicy Food Tour: Churros, Biscochitos & More
experiences.description:
Indulge in Santa Fe’s finest sweets on this delicious tour through historic downtown. Start at a cozy café near the Santa Fe Plaza, savoring filled beignets and coffee while uncovering the city’s rich art scene. Stroll to the iconic Plaza, where you’ll soak in the vibrant atmosphere and learn about local legends and Pueblo-style architecture. Sample traditional New Mexican treats, including biscochitos, and visit a hidden bakery renowned for its creative sweets. This sweet experience culminates with fresh churros and homemade dipping sauces, making it a perfect outing for food lovers and culture enthusiasts alike.

- Taste beignets, churros, and traditional New Mexican sweets
- Guided tour through Santa Fe's historic sites and art scene
- Visit local cafes and bakeries with unique flavors
- Ideal for food lovers and cultural explorers; walking distance of 1 to 1.5 miles

experiences.title: Viator Exclusive: Gourmet Brunch in Santa Fe with Chef Carolina
experiences.description:
Dine in Santa Fe with a memorable meal at a specialized chef's brunch. Let Chef Carolina, trained at Le Cordon Bleu School, prepare dishes that showcase the unique flavors of Santa Fe, a mix of Spanish, Mexican, and Native American cuisines. 

You'll be enjoying a three-course menu with hand-picked dishes, fresh flowers, and tableware, creating an air of sophistication. 

In winter months there is a communal table for up to 10 people. In summer months small tables await guests outside. 

Chef Carolina is joined by Manuel, an experienced sommelier and aesthete.

experiences.title: Santa Fe Haunted Spirits Tour
experiences.description:
The Best Cocktail and Ghost Stories Tour Ever. Sample great drinks served with incredible stories of Santa Fe's dark side as you walk through downtown Santa Fe. Lots of history and photo moments fills in the voids of ghost stories, which are chilling and rooted in reality, real people or actual events. 

Tour guide is great for offering other great suggestions from dinner, day trips, in and outs of things to do in Santa Fe or the surrounding area, with a smile.

experiences.title: Dinner Detective True Crime Murder Mystery Show - Albuquerque, NM
experiences.description: America's largest interactive murder mystery comedy dinner show!  Solve a hilarious crime while you feast on a fantastic four-course plated dinner.  Just beware!  The killer is hiding somewhere in the room, and you may find yourself as a prime suspect!

experiences.title: New Mexico Wine Tasting Small Group Tour
experiences.description:
Enjoy a relaxing day making new friends. Door-to-door service, a delicious and hearty lunch, and tasty snacks served at one of the wineries. Wine tasting offers a delightful way to experience wines you've never tried before, each winery being unique. Perfect for couples, solo travelers, and small groups, this is a wine tour you won't forget—so when you've shopped till you dropped, come aboard, explore our beautiful state, and sip some wine with us. You can also add-on activities like a glass blowing class or river rafting (which takes place before wine tasting), making for an even more memorable adventure. 
Tour Includes lunch.
Tasting fees ARE NOT included in your tour, 3 to 4 winerys.
Cost would be $41.00 for 3 of the Wineries. For the 5 wineries $20.00 more.

experiences.title: A Food and Art Walking Tour through Old Town ABQ
experiences.description: This one-of-a-kind walking tour blends food, art and a bit of history all while supporting women-owned businesses in Old Town Albuquerque. Guests enjoy exclusive tastings, explore local art and haunted history, and visit Ascension Crystals for a mystical touch. Unlike other tours, this intimate experience offers a curated mix of flavors, stories, and culture in a way that’s both immersive and unforgettable.

experiences.title: Las Vegas Mexican Salsa Cooking Experience with Celebrity Chef
experiences.description: Experience an unforgettable cooking class led by a renowned Mexico City chef, featured on Top Chef VIP Telemundo and trusted by Disney, HBO, Coca-Cola, and Meta. Master four classic Mexican salsas with raw, roasted, boiled, and fried methods, indulge in unlimited chips, cheesy handmade quesadillas, authentic Mexican flan, and refreshing agua fresca. Perfect for travelers, foodies, and groups, this hands-on culinary celebration blends delicious recipes, vibrant culture, and the expertise of one of Mexico’s most acclaimed chefs.

experiences.title: Las Vegas Food Tour: Chinatown Favorites & Hidden Gems
experiences.description:
This is more than a food tour. It is a guided exploration of one of Las Vegas's most exciting neighborhoods, combining incredible food with the stories, culture, and people that make Chinatown so special.

Located just minutes from the Las Vegas Strip, Chinatown has become one of the city's most vibrant dining destinations. Along the way, you'll visit a carefully selected mix of local favorites and hidden gems while learning how the neighborhood evolved into a culinary hotspot. Each stop has been chosen not just for the food, but for the story behind it.

With small groups and an experienced guide leading the way, you'll get a more personal experience, plenty of opportunities to ask questions, and a deeper understanding of the neighborhood than you could get by exploring on your own.

Come hungry, leave with a full stomach, and discover a side of Las Vegas that many visitors never experience.

experiences.title: BLACKOUT Dining in the Dark Experience, Dining Attraction
experiences.description:
Embark on a culinary adventure unlike any other at BLACKOUT, a fascinating dining experience just off the Las Vegas Strip. Sitting in total darkness, your sense of taste and smell are completely heightened as you feast on a plant-based, multi-course, mystery meal of wonderful specialties.

Upon arrival at BLACKOUT, you're greeted by the friendly and entertaining staff. Next, you're led into the pitch-black dining room where your meal can begin. Taste and touch your way through a delicious lunch or dinner, one dish at a time.

At the end of your meal, the staff escorts you back to the lobby. Head back out into Vegas happy that you've had a truly unique sensory experience that you won't soon forget.

experiences.title: Luxury French Cooking Class in Las Vegas (Includes 4-Course Meal)
experiences.description:
Immerse yourself in the artistry of French cuisine in this refined Las Vegas cooking class, hosted through Cozymeal. Limited to 8 guests, the four-course menu highlights bistro classics with a luxurious touch.

The menu you will prepare includes:
- Salade Niçoise with seared tuna, potatoes, olives and lemon-tarragon vinaigrette
- Coq au vin braised in red wine with mushrooms, pearl onions and bacon lardons
- Demi-glace pommes fondant with buttery reduction
- Dark chocolate pots de crème and black cherry clafoutis

With guidance from your French chef, you’ll master advanced techniques while savoring elegant flavors.

experiences.title: Mixology Masterclass at the Cabinet of Curiosities in Las Vegas
experiences.description: Discover a hands-on cocktail experience with seasonal mixology classes in Las Vegas, where guests learn to craft signature drinks using premium spirits and fresh ingredients. Each session includes expert-led tastings and interactive stations, and depending on the time of year, could have rotating themes like Spooky Spirits, Fall Flavors, Christmas Cheer, Tiki Drinks and Prohibition Pleasers. Perfect for cocktail lovers of all levels, this immersive class combines creativity, flavor and fun in a one-of-a-kind Vegas activity.

experiences.title: SouthWest Vegan Food Tour in Las Vegas
experiences.description:
On this Las Vegas Food Tour, you'll sample delicious foods from around the world but in the convenience of the Southwest area. 

We'll start at a cozy vegan Italian spot, and you'll soon see why that is! We'll have a seat, share some mouth watering food!

Then we'll head over to a local Juice Bar and you'll learn about the benefits of juicing and smoothies. 

Lastly, we'll end at a plant based Mexican eatery where the food is yummy and (almost) guilt free .

We're going to focus our time at 3 major food spots in Southwest Las Vegas. You'll sample everything from comfort food to upscale menu items! All the dishes and foods will be plant based and vary from indulgent to healthy.

You'll walk no more than a half of mile in 2.5 hours because FREE transportation will be provided (for 2-4 people) in between restaurants, and parked nearby.

Note: First location is 18 mins SouthWest of MGM

experiences.title: Chinatown Vegan Food Tour in Las Vegas
experiences.description:
On this Las Vegas Food Tour, you'll sample everything from mouth watering sushi and orange chick'n to boba.

We'll start at an Asian Vegan Restaurant, and you'll taste why it's so awesome! We'll have a seat and share some yummy food platters.

Then we'll head over to a plant based tea and boba shop with yummy flavors like Thai Tea, Biscotti, Cold Brew, and Ube Milk Tea.

We'll end the food tour at one of the largest Asian Supermarkets in Chinatown and learn about various exotic fruits, grains, and vegan meats. 

We're going to focus our time at 3 major food spots in Chinatown. You'll sample everything from street food to upscale foodie delights! 

You'll walk no more than a half of mile in 2.5 hours because FREE transportation will be provided (for 2-4 people) in between restaurants, and parked nearby.

Note: First location is 16 mins West of Caesar's Palace

experiences.title: Fremont Flavors Vegas Food Tour
experiences.description:
Welcome to Fremont Flavors, where every bite tells a story of a culinary delight! Join us on a mouthwatering journey through the heart of Fremont in Downtown Las Vegas, where you’ll indulge in a symphony of flavors, from delectable desserts to savory local delights cherished by the locals! 

Get ready! Your taste buds will be tantalized, and you’ll uncover the hidden gems of Vegas’ yummy food scene. This fabulous tour includes five amazing eateries, accompanied by insightful commentary from your guide, which delves into the rich history of downtown Las Vegas, complete with all the glitz and glamour you’d expect. 

These are five sensational restaurants that will exhilarate your taste buds on the Fremont Flavors Tour: 7th & Carson, Sayulitas(day tour), Mona Rosa(evening tour), Le Thai, Pizza Rock, Lappart's Ice Cream Shop(day tour), Evening Tour Barry’s/S’mores!

experiences.title: Best Bites on The Las Vegas Strip: A Traveler's Guide to Sin City
experiences.description:
Join us for a one-of-a-kind culinary adventure through some of the most iconic resorts on the Las Vegas Strip—including New York-New York, Park MGM, The Cosmopolitan, ARIA, and Bellagio. Our carefully crafted walking route takes you through scenic and lesser-known indoor paths, so you can enjoy the sights without breaking a sweat—even in the summer heat.

Along the way, your expert guide will introduce you to four handpicked tastings from some of the city’s best-kept culinary secrets—casual gourmet spots often missed by tourists. Each tasting stop is thoughtfully chosen not just for its delicious offerings, but also for its connection to the rich and colorful history of Las Vegas.

More than just a food tour, this experience combines fantastic flavors with engaging storytelling and insider tips about the city’s past, present, and what’s happening now in Sin City.

experiences.title: Scenic Wine Tasting Tour from Las Vegas with Food
experiences.description:
Escape the bright lights of Las Vegas and enjoy a relaxing wine country experience just an hour away. The tour begins with pickup at the Harley-Davidson parking lot on the south side of the Las Vegas Strip.

Sit back and enjoy a beautiful scenic drive through the stunning Spring Mountains and through the desert on your way to two wineries in Pahrump. Along the route, you’ll experience breathtaking landscapes, wide-open desert views, and a peaceful change of pace from the city.

The destination is the renowned Charleston Peak Winery, where you’ll spend approximately 2 to 2.5 hours enjoying a guided tasting of 8 carefully selected wines. Whether youre a wine enthusiast or simply looking for a unique day trip, you’ll have the opportunity to discover a variety of locally crafted wines in a welcoming atmosphere.

To complement your tasting experience we provide delicious charcuterie boards and freshly made cheese pizzas, creating the perfect pairing for an afternoon of wine and relaxation.

experiences.title: Downtown Las Vegas Food Tour of 6 Iconic Dishes & Hidden Gems
experiences.description: Step off the Strip and discover the real flavors of Downtown Las Vegas on our Secret Food Tour. In this vibrant neighborhood, you’ll taste 6+ iconic dishes that capture the city’s bold and playful spirit. Savor buttery Lobster Montadito, a local favorite pizza slice that gives back to charity, and the famous Elote Dog bursting with flavor. Indulge in a refreshing classic Shrimp Cocktail, a decadent chocolate bite, and a Hawaiian-inspired Musubi with teriyaki glaze. Along the way, your guide will share insider stories about Vegas’ quirky history and evolving food culture. And of course, no tour is complete without our delicious Secret Dish, revealed only on the day. Join us for a one-of-a-kind foodie adventure that shows you a side of Vegas most visitors never taste.

experiences.title: Private Vegas Strip Celebrity Chef Food Tour with 7 Tastings
experiences.description:
In Las Vegas Strip, boasts a rich culinary landscape, including celebrity-run restaurants helmed by chefs like Gordon Ramsay and Giada De Laurentiis. Join our 3-hour walking tour along The Strip, where you'll sample delectable cuisines from these renowned establishments. Let us introduce you to the winners of 'Hell's Kitchen' and Food Network stars while providing insider recommendations for the city's top food spots.

Embark on our Secret Food Tour of Downtown Las Vegas, where you'll unearth the city's hidden gems beyond the Strip's glitter and glamour. Explore the roots of this downtown area, and discover the fascinating history of its transformation from a quiet railroad town into a global tourist hub. Walk in the footsteps of business moguls and showbiz legends like "Bugsy" Siegel, Frank Sinatra, and Steve Wynn. While basking in the glow of the world's largest 4K video screen, indulge in delicious bites paying tribute to local legends such as Tony Hsieh, Elvis Presley, and more.

experiences.title: Arts District Food Tour: Trendy Eats, Boutiques, Murals & More!
experiences.description: Discover the vibrant Las Vegas Arts District on the city’s trendiest food and culture tour, guided by a local insider. Stroll through this buzzing neighborhood as you sample delicious small bites from top local restaurants and visit hip hangouts and unique cultural attractions along the way. Experience Las Vegas like a true local on this intimate, small-group walking tour, designed for those eager to see beyond the Strip. Dive into the city’s creative community and savor the flavors, sights, and stories that make the Arts District the heart of local Las Vegas. Book your spot for the ultimate Las Vegas foodie and cultural adventure today!

experiences.title: Wine & Mead Tasting, Distillery and Brewery Tour with Lunch
experiences.description:
Taste the best spirits Kingman Arizona has to offer, from Forbes best rum in the world, to award winning win, Mohave counties only Meadery, and multiple breweries. Come with us as we show you a few of Arizona’s hidden gems where you’ll find your new favorite drink of choice. 
Lunch is included.

experiences.title: Downtown Las Vegas Food Tour by Segway
experiences.description: This is a MUST for anyone who considers themselves a true FOODIE! Guests will be treated to multiple unique Las Vegas eateries, mostly off the beaten path, to expose guests to many hidden culinary gems the city has to offer. We will indulge in delicious beverages and sample different dishes in a fun sharing way so everyone gets to taste a bit of everything. Whether indoors with cool air conditioning or sitting outside enjoying the weather, this tour is a great way to enjoy a perfect Las Vegas afternoon. Our fun and knowledgeable guides provide entertaining facts and stories about the individual restaurants and Las Vegas history in general. With restaurant partners rotating every few months this tour is a fresh offering every time you come to Las Vegas.

experiences.title: Las Vegas: The Strip's Celebrity Chefs Tour or Downtown Food Tour
experiences.description:
In Las Vegas Strip, boasts a rich culinary landscape, including celebrity-run restaurants helmed by chefs like Gordon Ramsay and Giada De Laurentiis. Join our 3-hour walking tour along The Strip, where you'll sample delectable cuisines from these renowned establishments. Let us introduce you to the winners of 'Hell's Kitchen' and Food Network stars while providing insider recommendations for the city's top food spots.

Embark on our Secret Food Tour of Downtown Las Vegas, where you'll unearth the city's hidden gems beyond the Strip's glitter and glamour. Explore the roots of this downtown area, and discover the fascinating history of its transformation from a quiet railroad town into a global tourist hub. Walk in the footsteps of business moguls and showbiz legends like "Bugsy" Siegel, Frank Sinatra, and Steve Wynn. While basking in the glow of the world's largest 4K video screen, indulge in delicious bites paying tribute to local legends such as Tony Hsieh, Elvis Presley, and more.

experiences.title: Downtown Las Vegas Food Tour
experiences.description:
Embark on a flavorful food tour through Downtown Las Vegas, where the city's best hidden culinary gems await. This 3-hour guided experience includes five unique food stops, featuring a variety of cuisines loved by locals. Along the way, you'll dive into the rich history, vibrant culture, and evolving food scene of Downtown Vegas. With all the tastings and planning done for you, all you need to do is show up hungry and ready to explore. It’s the perfect foodie adventure for those looking to taste the authentic side of Las Vegas.

Stops are subject to change.

experiences.title: Las Vegas Strip and Downtown Scooter with Food Tour
experiences.description:
See all of Las Vegas' famous sites such as the Welcome to Las Vegas sign, the world's largest chocolate fountain, filming locations of hit reality television shows and more on this 4-hour scooter tour. Hotel pickup and drop-off and delicious food from local favorites is included.

May - Oct Tours Start at 9:00 AM for Weather (Heat)
Nov-April Tours Start at 10:00 AM for Weather (Cold)

experiences.title: Taste the Vegas Strip: A Local’s Food Tour Experience
experiences.description: Embark on a locally guided food tour of the Las Vegas Strip and taste your way through hidden gems and local favorites. Discover and experience the diverse flavors of Las Vegas, from Mexican street food to award-winning pizza and BBQ, with all tastings adding up to a full meal. Along the way, your expert guide will share history, sightseeing highlights, and insider tips on the best things to do in the city.

experiences.title: Downtown Las Vegas Bar Crawl 5 Bars 5 Drinks and Poker Game
experiences.description:
Explore the vibrant nightlife of Downtown Las Vegas with a self-guided bar crawl that takes you to five popular bars along the iconic Fremont Street Experience. Enjoy a complimentary drink at each stop while collecting virtual poker cards for a chance to win exciting prizes. With the freedom to set your own pace, this crawl is perfect for groups celebrating special occasions or just looking for a fun night out. Experience the lively atmosphere, street performers, and the dazzling canopy of lights as you navigate through the heart of downtown.

- Visit five bars in Downtown Las Vegas, each with a free drink
- Open daily 11am to 11pm - Start your crawl whenever you like
- Sign up for the Circa Players Card and get a $25 match play
- Collect poker cards at every stop for a chance to win prizes
- Self-guided, allowing you to explore at your own pace
- Ideal for bachelorette parties, birthdays, and group reunions

experiences.title: Las Vegas Club Crawl with Party Bus and Free Drinks
experiences.description:
Vegas Club Crawl – The Ultimate Party Tour in Las Vegas

Experience the number one party tour in Las Vegas, taking you to some of the best nightlife venues in the city with a great group, fun hosts, and VIP nightclub entry.

How It Works

Check-In + 1 Hour Open Bar
Meet your hosts at the starting venue and kick off the night with a 1-hour vodka open bar while you meet the group and get the party started.

Second Party Venue
The group then moves to another buzzing venue with drink specials and social vibes before heading to the clubs.

Party Bus + Shots
Jump on the party bus with music pumping. Shots are included on the bus as the group travels between venues.

Major Las Vegas Nightclubs
Finish the night inside one or two top Las Vegas nightclubs with hosted entry.

Past venues include Omnia, XS, Marquee, Hakkasan, Jewel, and Tao.

Optional Late Night After-Club
For those who want to keep going, there is an optional late-night after-club where the party continues.

experiences.title: Flavors of Fremont: Downtown Vegas Food Tour & Local Secrets
experiences.description: Discover the hidden gems and local secrets of Downtown Las Vegas on a unique walking food tour that takes you off the beaten path. Sample 1-3 tastings at 5 hole-in-the-wall spots, blending iconic attractions with mouthwatering bites. Led by a Las Vegas insider, this small-group tour offers an unforgettable experience filled with delicious food, fascinating history, and vibrant culture.

experiences.title: Antelope Canyon & Horseshoe Bend Day Tour with Lunch, Free WiFi
experiences.description:
Antelope Canyon's sandstone walls glow red, gold, and orange as light shifts through the narrow openings above. Pick from Upper Antelope, Lower Antelope, or Canyon X, each led by a local Navajo guide, with a stop at Horseshoe Bend to see the Colorado River bend around the cliffs.

If you want something different, try the Secret Antelope Canyon & Horseshoe Bend combo. It's one of the longest slot canyons on the Navajo Nation, and getting there is part of the experience: an off-road drive across the desert, with a good chance of spotting wildlife along the way. There are no ladders or steep stairs here, so you can take your time and get the shot you want. At Horseshoe Bend, skip the walk altogether. An off-road vehicle takes you as close to the rim as possible for a private overlook.

experiences.title: 1 Hour Distillery Tour and Tasting Flight
experiences.description:
Most distillery tours are simply dressed-up tasting flights with a quick trip past the equipment, guided by someone with very little understanding of their spirits and how they are made. 

At Ferino Distillery, whether your tour is guided by owner and master distillery Joe Cannella or by one of our deeply trained staff members, you are sure to enjoy a more intimate experience, learning the personal connection behind Cannella's family history and its intersection with the ancient origins of flavored spirits in Southern Italy. 

In short, this is not your typical vodka / gin / whiskey distillery - come with a sense of adventure and you'll leave with some great memories - and perhaps some liquid mementos!

experiences.title: Downtown Las Vegas Food Tour: Trendy Local Spots & Hidden Gems
experiences.description:
Explore the flavors and stories of Downtown Las Vegas on a guided food tour through the city’s most iconic and up-and-coming neighborhoods. Stroll through the legendary Fremont Street Experience or the trendy Fremont East District while enjoying generous tastings at local favorites, hidden gems, and cult-classic eateries.

Daytime tours feature casual street bites, sweet treats, and rich Vegas history in a fun, easy-walking format. Evening tours offer a more indulgent, dinner-style experience with elevated sit-down restaurant stops and larger portions. Optional alcohol upgrades to compliment all experiences.

With small groups, insider guides, and multiple tour times available, this is the perfect way to taste your way through Downtown Vegas — whether you’re visiting for the first time or looking for a fresh local perspective.

Perfect for foodies, history buffs, and fun-seekers alike, this tour offers a feast for the senses and a true taste of Vegas culture. Come hungry, leave happy!

experiences.title: Popovich Comedy Pet Theater at Planet Hollywood Resort and Casino
experiences.description: Experience the unforgettable Comedy Pet Theater in Las Vegas, a one-of-a-kind family-friendly show featuring European-style comedy, world-class juggling, and a talented cast of over 30 performing animals, including cats, dogs, parrots, and even a miniature horse. All of the furry stars were rescued from animal shelters and now shine alongside their co-star, Gregory Popovich, in this high-energy Las Vegas entertainment spectacular. Perfect for families and animal lovers, Comedy Pet Theater delivers laughter, amazement, and heartwarming fun for audiences of all ages on the Las Vegas Strip.

experiences.title: Motown Brunch in Las Vegas at The Modern Showrooms
experiences.description:
Motown Brunch offers a unique and intimate setting perfect for a memorable Sunday outing. Whether you’re a local or a visitor, this event is a must-attend for music lovers and food enthusiasts alike. Join us for an extraordinary blend of live Motown music and gourmet buffet dining and make your Sunday morning something truly special.

All NEW MENU!

experiences.title: Las Vegas Bar Crawl by Party Bus with Free Drinks
experiences.description:
Enjoy VIP hosted entry into 2-3 of Las Vegas' hottest bars and nightclubs. Why wait waste your vacation waiting in those ridiculously long lines to get into Vegas nightlife venues? With us, you won't!

Check in with your host at the Mandalay Bay Hotel and receive your wristband that gains you access to the tour.

We will also cruise the strip in our nightclub on wheels- our Party Bus!. Listen to bumping music (song requests welcome), meet new people & dance on the infamous stripper pole!

This is the most fun you can have in one night!

experiences.title: The LINQ Promenade Bar Crawl 5 Bars 5 Drinks and Poker Game
experiences.description: An experience created in Las Vegas and unique to this city, this experience offers a daily bar crawl at The LINQ Promenade. Start any time after 11am and your app will guide you to 5 fun bars. You just need to finish all the stops before 10pm. At each bar check-in, receive a virtual playing card and an adult beverage. After 5 bars you'll have a 5-card poker hand where you can compete against all other crawlers for the best hand. The best hands win prizes! Must be 21+

experiences.title: 2 Hour Italian Pasta Cooking Class in Las Vegas
experiences.description:
This immersive pasta class with Chef Luna is designed for anyone curious about mastering traditional Italian techniques, no experience needed. You’ll learn to prepare pasta dough by hand, shape it into a variety of classic forms, and create fresh potato gnocchi from scratch, with a focus on texture, timing, and technique.

As your pasta cooks, you’ll prepare a vibrant marinara sauce using just a few high-quality ingredients: fresh tomatoes, garlic, basil, and olive oil. Chef Luna emphasizes simple steps with purpose, helping you understand not just what to do, but why it works. Perfect for travelers seeking a meaningful culinary moment or locals looking to deepen their skills

What to Expect:
- Step-by-step guidance from a talented chef who makes it make sense.
- A fun, beginner-friendly class where no one judges your knife skills.
- Tasting, laughing and leveling up your kitchen game.
- Ideal for: a solo outing, date night, girls’ night or group fun.

experiences.title: 2-Hour Sushi Making Class With Local Chef in Las Vegas
experiences.description:
Few things are as satisfying as eating sushi you rolled yourself. This interactive class with Chef Luna makes sushi-making approachable and fun. You'll learn how to prepare and season sushi rice before creating a California roll with crab, avocado and cucumber. The combination of seasoned rice, crisp vegetables and hands-on creativity makes for a relaxing and rewarding experience. You'll leave with new skills, fresh sushi and a better understanding of what goes into every great roll.

What to Expect:
- Step-by-step guidance from a talented chef who makes it make sense.
- A fun, beginner-friendly class where no one judges your knife skills.
- Tasting, laughing and leveling up your kitchen game.
- Ideal for: a solo outing, date night, girls’ night or group fun.

experiences.title: Chocolate Truffle Making Cooking Class in Las Vegas
experiences.description:
Chef Emmanuelle combines classic French pastry skills with a warm, welcoming vibe, making this experience both indulgent and approachable. From shaping truffles to flipping crêpes, you’ll get a full-on chocolate lover’s dream in one class. Whether you're a local planning a unique date night or a traveler with a sweet tooth, this experience blends hands-on learning with gourmet flair — and you get to leave with delicious creations to share (or not!)

What to Expect:
- Step-by-step guidance from a talented chef who makes it make sense.
- A fun, beginner-friendly class where no one judges your knife skills.
- Tasting, laughing and leveling up your kitchen game.
- Ideal for: a solo outing, date night, girls’ night or group fun.

experiences.title: Downtown Reno Distillery Tasting Flight and Signature Cocktail
experiences.description:
Explore Ferino Distillery, located in the heart of Reno's Brewery District with a unique tasting flight Featuring five award-winning house-made spirits, you'll discover the Cannella family's rich Italian heritage and their commitment to crafting high-quality liqueurs, including the Double Gold award-winning Caffe Notte Coffee Liqueur. This engaging experience includes a craft cocktail of your choice, allowing you to savor the flavors in a vibrant atmosphere. Ideal for spirit enthusiasts and those seeking a unique local experience.

- Unique tasting of five house-made spirits from Ferino Distillery
- Learn about the Cannella family's history and Italian spirit traditions
- Enjoy a craft cocktail included in the experience
- Suitable for groups of 1 to 25, perfect for friends and celebrations

experiences.title: Fun Chocolate Making Class With Local Chef in Las Vegas
experiences.description: This beginner-friendly chocolate class turns a viral sensation into a skill you can actually master. Led by Chef Emmanuelle, the experience focuses on technique, confidence and hands-on fun. You’ll learn how to work with chocolate properly, from melting to shaping, before filling your bar with the iconic combination of kataifi, pistachio paste and tahini. Chef Emmanuelle explains each step clearly, making even first-time chocolatiers feel comfortable experimenting. Set in a lively Las Vegas venue, the class offers a creative escape where you’ll learn something new, enjoy the process and leave with a decadent chocolate bar you made yourself — plus the know-how to impress long after class ends.

experiences.title: Fun Kawaii Sushi With a Local Chef in Las Vegas
experiences.description: Chef Luna will guide you through every step, from preparing perfectly seasoned sushi rice to working with nori and assembling colorful Kawaii sushi with fresh salmon, imitation crab, cucumber, avocado, carrot, microgreens and black sesame seeds. Along the way, you'll learn rolling, shaping, layering and presentation techniques that make homemade sushi look impressive without feeling complicated. Every bite is fresh, vibrant and completely your own. You'll head home with new kitchen skills, a camera roll full of cute creations and a new excuse to skip takeout next time sushi cravings hit.

experiences.title: Fun Pasta Making Class at a Trendy Local Tavern in Las Vegas
experiences.description: Fresh pasta, sizzling brown butter and tavern vibes in Las Vegas? That’s significantly better than another night scrolling restaurant reviews. In this interactive cooking class with Chef Luna, you’ll learn the timeless art of handmade pasta while enjoying a relaxed social atmosphere at a stylish local tavern in Las Vegas. The class begins with crafting fresh pasta dough from flour, eggs and water before learning how to knead, roll and cut pasta completely by hand. Chef Luna keeps every step approachable and beginner-friendly while sharing classic Italian techniques that instantly level up your home cooking game. Once your pasta is cooked perfectly al dente, you’ll finish the dish with a luxurious sage and brown butter sauce that’s simple, elegant and dangerously good. This hands-on experience includes all ingredients, professional cooking tools and a full homemade pasta meal you’ll proudly devour by the end of class. It’s cozy, comforting and way more fun than takeout.

experiences.title: Fun Pasta Making Class With Local Chef at a Trendy Local Tavern
experiences.description: Join a fun, hands-on pasta-making class at a local Las Vegas tavern. You'll learn from a French-trained chef how to make fresh pasta from scratch and pair it with a gourmet creamy mushroom béchamel sauce. This experience is perfect for a unique date night or a foodie getaway, blending fun and flavor in a casual, social setting.

experiences.title: Fun Sushi Making Class With Local Chef at a Trendy Local Tavern
experiences.description: Master the art of sushi making in a fun, hands-on class led by Chef Luna. In this beginner-friendly experience, you’ll learn to roll classic California rolls from scratch and enjoy your delicious creations with a drink in a cool, local tavern. Perfect for locals and visitors alike, this class is a relaxed way to learn a new skill and enjoy a unique night out.

experiences.title: Las Vegas Street Food Tour With A Local Guide
experiences.description: Join us on our 3-hour Food Walking Tour of Las Vegas. Led by a knowledgeable local guide, you'll explore the bustling streets of the city while satisfying yourself with delectable treats. Embark on a culinary adventure in Las Vegas, led by a passionate local guide eager to reveal the city's diverse food culture. Delve deep into the tapestry of culinary history, indulging in iconic delicacies like the legendary shrimp cocktail. With flexible timing, this journey accommodates food enthusiasts eager to savor every flavor-filled moment. Immerse yourself in the vibrant gastronomic scene of Las Vegas, where each dish narrates a tale of opulence and pleasure. From gourmet restaurants to hidden gems, explore a world of culinary delights that define the essence of this dynamic city. Whether it's indulging in decadent desserts or savoring savory delights, prepare for a gastronomic odyssey that promises unforgettable experiences at every turn.

experiences.title: Private Las Vegas Cooking Class Near the Strip with a Local Chef
experiences.description: Just minutes from the Las Vegas Strip, this cooking class with Chef Luna, a globally recognized chef offers a fun, hands-on culinary experience in a real local home. Trained in international culinary arts, Chef Luna has been cooking for over 2 decades and brings her passion for food, travel, and connection into every class. Guests learn authentic Mexican or Italian recipes while enjoying a relaxed, interactive atmosphere, with vegan, vegetarian, gluten-free, and lactose-free options available upon request. This experience stands out for its personal touch, engaging instruction, and convenient location near major casinos like the Bellagio.

experiences.title: Japanese Ramen in NYC
experiences.description:
In this fun, hands-on class, you will be guided step-by-step in recreating this popular noodle soup dish, renowned for its rich broth, abundance of noodles and endless toppings! You will firstly be trained in some foundational knife skills used to chop all of your fresh ingredients. You will then learn how to balance flavors to create your Ramen broth and the addition of various vegetables. You will have the choice to make a Tori-Kadzu Black Ramen with chicken broth, fried chicken, and vegetables or Veggie Ramen using a veggie broth and stir fried vegetables.

Guests will get to make their own Ramen noodles from scratch! Practice your pasta making skills with a Japanese twist. Cook your noodles and add all the extras that make this deliciously authentic dish! Once you have created your Ramen sensations, you can have fun customizing your bowl with a variety of traditional garnishes and toppings before enjoying your creation with your new found foodie friends!

experiences.title: NoLita's Past and Present Food & History Tour with FNYT
experiences.description:
HISTORY MEETS ICONIC EATS AND STYLISH BOUTIQUES

Tucked off the beaten path between SoHo and Little Italy, NoLita (“North of Little Italy”) is where old-school NY charm meets modern downtown cool. As we stroll through the neighborhood’s tree-lined streets, your expert guide will serve up insider stories, hidden landmarks, the rich immigrant history, and the delicious hidden gems that we love, making this one of the most diverse food experiences in the city.

Find out where the name NoLita came from and when it became known for its charming cafes, restaurants, eateries, and boutiques. Whether you’re a first-time visitor or a seasoned New Yorker, this tour is a delicious way to discover a side of downtown NYC most tourists miss.

FEATURES OF THIS TOUR:
4 indoor restaurant tastings (one with wine), and 2 on-the-go desserts.
And plenty of time indoors to use a restroom!

experiences.title: NYC Chinatown & Little Italy Food Tour Full Portions, Great Value
experiences.description:
Discover the flavors, stories and cultural heritage of two of New York City's most iconic neighborhoods on a guided Chinatown and Little Italy food tour.

Walk through vibrant streets, historic landmarks and hidden corners while tasting authentic local favorites and learning how generations of immigrants helped shape the character of Lower Manhattan.

In Chinatown, explore the neighborhood's rich culinary traditions and discover the stories behind its food, businesses and community. Continue into Little Italy to experience its distinctive atmosphere, Italian heritage and beloved local flavors.

Along the way, your local guide brings the neighborhoods to life with fascinating history, entertaining stories and personal recommendations that go beyond the typical tourist experience. From savory bites to classic sweets, each tasting adds another layer to the story of these remarkable NYC neighborhoods.

experiences.title: Mom and Pop Food Tour in Chinatown and Little Italy
experiences.description:
Savor a delightful culinary journey through Chinatown and Little Italy, highlighting the best flavors from five beloved local shops. Begin with a fluffy Hong Kong sponge cake and aromatic Thai tea, then indulge in delicious Chinese dumplings. Relish remarkable pizza crafted with a sauce that takes 4.5 hours to perfect, and visit a century-old shop for exquisite cheeses and Tuscan salami. Conclude your tour with the best cannoli in Little Italy, a testament to the rich food culture that has been cherished in my family for generations.

- Explore five iconic culinary spots in Chinatown and Little Italy
- Taste traditional dishes, including dumplings and pizza
- Experience family-owned shops with rich histories
- Finish with a sweet treat: the best cannoli in Little Italy
- Get to know the neighborhood, its characters, and have fun!

experiences.title: East Village Food Tour | Tasty Tours NYC
experiences.description:
Join us on the East Village Food Tour and explore one of NYC’s most vibrant neighborhoods while trying a mix of NYC classics, authentic immigrant foods, and unique local favorites.

What’s included?
- 7 food tastings included in the price featuring bagels, pizza, pierogi, empanadas, mac & cheese, donuts, and more

- Explore iconic East Village locations, hidden side streets, music venues, bars, and street art

- Learn about the neighborhood’s immigrant history, punk rock roots, and food culture

About The Neighborhood
The East Village is one of NYC’s most diverse neighborhoods, shaped by generations of immigrants, artists, and musicians. On this tour, you’ll eat your way through the neighborhood while learning about the local stories and history.

About Us
This is a brand new tour from Tasty Tours NYC, New York’s top-rated food tour company. Our mission is to make sure you have an awesome experience and get a real taste of everything the Big Apple has to offer.

experiences.title: Turkish Coffee Fortune Reading
experiences.description:
This is a visually interactive & group-driven fortune telling experience unlike any other! Your coffee grinds are projected onto a giant monitor allowing for all of the symbols and figures to be witnessed right before your eyes as the one-of-a-kind host interprets them one-by-one. 

Honoring the ancient Turkish coffee fortune ceremonies of the past, this communal experience brings strangers together for an experience that is cosmic, insightful & entertaining!

experiences.title: NYC Greenwich Village Food/Nightlife Walking Tour
experiences.description:
Taste your way through Greenwich Village on a fun, tips-based food tour packed with iconic bites, local stories, and neighborhood charm. Explore famous landmarks, hidden gems, and must-try food spots while discovering one of NYC’s most vibrant and historic areas.

Choose your own tastings along the way, from classic New York pizza and legendary falafel to a sweet bakery treat. With great photo stops, insider tips, and a relaxed local vibe, this is the perfect way to eat, walk, and experience the Village beyond the usual tourist route.

Reserve your spot and tip what you feel at the end.

experiences.title: Village to Village Food Tour in West Greenwich and East Village
experiences.description:
On this epic sustainable food tour, we eat our way through the entire neighborhood known as the Village from West to East, meeting the community and sampling food along the way with a local food expert by your side. 

We start in the posh West Village where you'll wander through a maze of tree-lined streets right alongside historic brownstone homes. 

Next, we delve into Greenwich Village which has been home to everyone from Italian immigrants, NYU students, bohemian artists, political activists, and musicians from little known Bob Dylan to up-and-comer Taylor Swift. We touch upon many of these groups to find out how they eat, drink, and live. Visit sandwich shops beloved by local students, an old school Italian market, and the iconic Washington Square Park.

Finally, make your way into the East Village, which was once part of the Lower East Side, where you'll still find remnants of immigrant communities, including Little Germany, the Yiddish Rialto, and Ukrainian Village.

experiences.title: NYC: Bagel Baking Class with Award-Winning Baker (UWS)
experiences.description: Roll, boil, and bake your own authentic New York bagels. Led by an award-winning baker, you’ll learn time-honored techniques, explore the bagel’s rich history, and enjoy your freshly baked creations.

experiences.title: Authentic Chinese Cooking Class in Astoria, Queens
experiences.description: Step into Alison's home in Astoria, Queens, for an intimate introduction to regional Chinese home cooking rarely found in restaurants. Inspired by her upbringing in southwest China, Alison shares family recipes, cultural traditions, and practical cooking techniques while guiding you through a private, hands-on cooking experience. Depending on the season, you may even harvest fresh herbs from her garden before enjoying your meal indoors or beneath a mulberry tree in the backyard. This authentic cooking class experience offers a unique opportunity to connect with local culture and discover a side of New York City beyond the typical tourist trail.

experiences.title: Hand-Rolled Sushi in NYC
experiences.description:
Come and learn how to spread, layer, tuck and roll your way to sushi heaven. In this fun, hands-on social cooking class, you’ll learn all the skills needed to make sushi rolls at home, including how to prepare sushi rice, select sushi-grade fish, and add additional tasty neta (ingredients) to enhance your dining experience. You’ll learn to make three types of sushi rolls: Spicy Tuna roll, Traditional Veggie Maki roll, and a Salmon Avocado Sushi roll. Guests will also make their own ponzu sauce.

Please arrive 15 minutes early to check in. You will be seated with your booking party and socially distanced from other guests. Guests in the same booking party will work together throughout the class by sharing ingredients and equipment. Drinks are NOT included in the ticket price, but will be available for sale at the venue. Outside drinks are not allowed. 21+

experiences.title: Homemade Pizza Party in NYC
experiences.description:
Your focus will be on crafting the Neapolitan-style pizza, Italy's culinary icon. However, you can allow your inner culinary artist to shine as you personalize your masterpiece with an array of popular toppings. Join us for a fun and interactive experience, where you will not only learn the secrets behind authentic pizza making but also get to savor the delicious results of your newfound skills!

No experience is required! We provide all the equipment and ingredients, which are easy to find at local markets if you don’t already have them in your home kitchen. Your events are casual and meant to be fun and instructive, not hardcore. This class is designed to be just as fun for the cooking enthusiast who wants to be a part of every step as it is for the first-timer who’s happier observing and assisting (or taste testing).

experiences.title: Local & Seasonal Cooking in Greenwich Village
experiences.description:
In this hands-on cooking class, you'll learn the techniques and ingredients that make cooking and shopping locally so healthy and delicious. This is a true farm-to-table class - Mary shops from the Union Square farmer's market which are the best NYC restaurant chef's shop. But since hacking a butternut squash or what to do with ingredients like pak choi can seem daunting, Mary will guide you through each step of the cooking process with expert tips and tricks. With a focus on plant-based ingredients, and recipes that change with the seasons, this class is perfect for anyone looking to explore new and healthy ways of cooking. Whether you're an experienced cook or a beginner, you'll leave this class feeling inspired and empowered to create your own farmer's market-inspired dishes at home, plus you'll take home some granola that you learn to make! Book your spot in Mary's cooking class today for a one-of-a-kind culinary experience!

Aperitif Served. Guests can BYOB!

experiences.title: Vegetarian Indian Cooking Class in New York, Upper West Side
experiences.description:
Kavitha has been in the food business for many years, she ran an Indian street food business in the outdoor markets of Brooklyn and Manhattan. She comes from a family of yogis and people who believe that the key to good health lies in good nutrition. Kavitha has first-hand seen the positive effects that simple tweaks in nutrition can have on a person's physical, mental and spiritual health, without compromising on taste. She promotes a simple, plant-forward lifestyle. Kavitha is passionate about teaching guests Ayurvedic inspired cooking, especially to those who are looking to move towards meals that are planet-friendly, healthy and adventurous.

• Private vegetarian Indian cooking class in a locals home in Upper West Side
• Learn to cook three dishes from scratch in 2 hours 
• Learn tips and techniques involved in Indian cooking, and the medicinal benefits of spices
• Introduction to Indian cuisine, culture and culinary traditions
• Vegetarian, vegan and gluten free options available

experiences.title: Fresh Pasta and Sauce Making Class in New York
experiences.description:
