Step into a delightful culinary journey in a stylish New York City penthouse, where food, design, and charm blend perfectly. This cozy, beautifully furnished studio—personally curated by an architect with a passion for food—is the ideal setting for an intimate cooking experience.

In this hands-on class, you'll learn the art of making fresh pasta from scratch, crafting two classic shapes: tagliatelle and gnocchi. Under expert guidance, you’ll prepare two delicious sauces—a saffron-infused Bolognese and a mouthwatering Sorrentina. As you cook, enjoy an Aperitivo Italiano with bruschetta, olives, and Prosecco, elevating the experience into a true Italian feast.

With the aroma of homemade pasta filling the air, the evening concludes with a Neapolitan ricotta cheesecake and freshly brewed Moka espresso. This class is more than just a meal; it's a unique New York experience combining architecture, authentic Italian cuisine, and great company.

experiences.title: Handmade Dumplings in NYC
experiences.description: Whether you're a seasoned cook or a beginner, this class offers a unique and delicious experience that will leave you with a newfound appreciation for the art of cooking. Please arrive 15 minutes early to check in. Guests in the same booking party will work together throughout the class by sharing ingredients and equipment. Drinks are NOT included in the ticket price, but will be available for sale at the venue. Outside drinks are not allowed, 21+ only, please.

experiences.title: #1 Rated NYC Chinatown Food and History Walking Tour with FNYT
experiences.description:
3 sit-down INDOOR tastings included with Foods of NY Tours!

Chinatown can definitely be intimidating, even for a native New Yorker! It’s a diverse neighborhood with historic landmarks, hidden side streets, delicious foods from all over Asia, and it’s home to one of the largest population of Chinese people in the western hemisphere. Join us as we share interesting stories, sights and delicious foods.

Where to eat in Chinatown can be overwhelming, so this is where we come in! Enjoy 3 mouthwatering sit-down tastings: 5 types of dim sum, authentic Peking Duck prepared as if you were in Beijing, and Malaysian street food. The tour also includes a modern and traditional dessert, representing two sides of a changing neighborhood. Join us for a memorable journey that will leave you with a deep understanding of the flavors, history, and confidence to navigate Manhattan’s Chinatown!

We visit 5 establishments, 3 of which we sit indoors with more tastings!

experiences.title: Ultimate Chinatown & Little Italy Food Tour in New York City
experiences.description:
A lot of the focus of Chinatown tends to be in the historically Cantonese area. In this tour you will experience the entirety of Chinatown. We'll head east to the less-touristy, more Fujianese area, which was once considered part of the Lower East Side. We'll make our way through the backstreets before arriving at the more well-known Cantonese area. Finally, we'll brush past Little Italy to the western edge of Chinatown and eat a delicious desert.

We can accommodate vegetarians, but please reach out directly with other food allergies. We'll do our best to accommodate all dietary preferences.

experiences.title: Greenwich Village Food Tour | Tasty Tours NYC
experiences.description:
Join us on the ultimate food tour in Greenwich Village. This 2.5-hour tour explores one of New York City’s most vibrant neighborhoods rich with history, sightseeing, and incredible food. On this tour, you'll eat, learn, and discover one of NYC's most iconic neighborhoods.

Food Tastings
This tour includes 6 authentic food tastings:
- Everything bagels with whipped cream cheese
- New York Style Margherita Pizza
- Mexican Street Tacos
- Middle Eastern Falafel
- Mini Red Velvet Cupcakes
- Italian Arancini Rice Balls*

Tour Highlights
During the tour, we will visit some iconic landmarks including:
- The FRIENDS Apartment Building
- Carrie Bradshaw’s Apartment from Sex & The City
- Taylor Swift’s Apartment on Cornelia Street
- Washington Square Park
- The Comedy Cellar

*Please note: Arancini is not available on evening tours, Sunday afternoon tours, or Monday tours. A different food tasting will be provided instead.

experiences.title: Lower East Side Food Tour in NYC: 6 Tastings + Famous Landmarks
experiences.description: Explore the Lower East Side on a small group, three hour walking tour through one of New York City’s most dynamic neighborhoods. Take in the sights, sounds, and savory food of an area experiencing more change than anywhere else in Manhattan while visiting 6+ tasting destinations along the way. The route includes Orchard Street, named one of the coolest streets in the world, the First Romanian American Synagogue on Rivington Street, the Tenement Museum, Kehila Kedosha Janina, the first Greek synagogue in the United States, views of the Williamsburg Bridge, and the Seward Park High School complex. Led by a local guide, this relaxed paced tour blends food, history, and culture into an authentic Lower East Side experience.

experiences.title: Greenwich Village Food Tour: 6 Tastings + Iconic Sites
experiences.description:
Six tastings, twelve guests, three hours, and one guide who actually lives here. You'll eat your way down Bleecker and MacDougal through the falafel counter, the pizza window, and the fry shop that locals line up for, and finish it off with delicious cupcakes. 

You will explore the most iconic streets and hidden corners of Greenwich Village on this guided walking tour through one of New York City’s most historic neighborhoods. The route includes stops at Father Demo’s Square, Manetta Lane, Manetta Tavern, Cafe Wha, McDougle Street, and NYU, before opening up into Washington Square Park and the famous Arch. You’ll also see the Hangman’s Elm, Washington Square Hotel, the Friends building, Grove Court, the narrowest house in New York, the oldest wooden house in the Village, Cherry Lane Theatre, and Cornelia Street, once home to Taylor Swift, all while uncovering the stories that give the Village its unmistakable character.

Beer and Wine available at select stops.

experiences.title: NYC: Flushing Chinatown Food Tour – Eat Like a Local
experiences.description:
Discover the vibrant heart of New York City's Chinatown in Flushing, Queens, the largest Chinatown in the world. This tour offers an authentic and diverse culinary adventure, surpassing the well-known Manhattan Chinatown. 

Explore the rich cultural tapestry and savor a variety of Asian cuisines, including Chinese and Taiwanese dishes. Immerse yourself in the bustling streets and lively markets, uncovering hidden gems and local favorites. Conclude your gastronomic journey at the conveniently located Roosevelt Avenue Metro station, ready for your next New York adventure. 

Book your Flushing Foodie Tour today and experience a culinary journey like no other.

Please notice that this tour has two booking options:
1, Noon Foodie Tour(12:00pm)
2, Night Foodie Tour(5:00pm)

Please notice that if you need make the booking for a big group, the current booking is maximum 15pax for one booking, so you can make several bookings one by one.

experiences.title: NYC: Greenwich Village Food Tour with 6 Locals Favorites Dishes
experiences.description:
Experience the ultimate New York City food tour in historic Greenwich Village. Led by a local expert, you’ll explore Manhattan’s most iconic neighborhood, famous for its bohemian roots and vibrant culinary scene. This top-rated NYC walking tour takes you behind the scenes to discover where locals eat, combining neighborhood history with the city’s most legendary flavors.

Enjoy six authentic tastings, including a classic New York bagel, crispy street-style falafel, and a hot slice of authentic New York-style pizza. Satisfy your sweet tooth with artisanal cupcakes and gourmet doughnuts before uncovering our signature Secret Dish. It’s a mystery specialty revealed only on the day of your tour!

Perfect for foodies, this Greenwich Village food tour captures the area’s counterculture past and its modern reputation as a culinary hotspot. Taste the best of the Big Apple and discover the hidden gems that make this Manhattan food experience unforgettable.

experiences.title: Shared Wine, Chocolate and Cheese Tasting in Conesus Lake
experiences.description: Located on Conesus Lake, visit us and sample our four best-selling wines paired with cheese and chocolate. The sampling includes four gold medal awarded wines, Conesus White, Runway Red, Pebble Beach Blush and Max Black. Conesus White and Runway Red will each be paired with cheese while Pebble Beach Blush and Max Black will each be paired with chocolate. This will be a seated tasting and will also include a description of the wines.

experiences.title: Original NYC Food Tour of Chinatown & Little Italy- 8 tastings
experiences.description:
The original food tour of Little Italy and Chinatown since 2009 explores the tastes and history of two diverse NYC neighborhoods. 

The delicious food tastings range from delicious dumplings to a sit-down authentic Italian meal. This tour offers quite a bit of food tastings leaving the guests fully satisfied.

This woman owned and operated business ensures that animated and friendly guides allow their guests to learn these neighborhoods through fascinating historical stories and culinary delights. 

There are 2-3 seated tastings and 5-6 on-the-go tastings to ensure that you explore both neighborhoods in 3 hours. 

We can accommodate guests who are vegetarian and gluten free and most food allergies. Water and tea are included.

One leaves this tour fully satisfied, along with a new found confidence in navigating the neighborhoods with a provided recommendation list in hand. This tour is a must if you're a local or visitor looking to get off-the-beaten path and taste amazing foods.

experiences.title: Chinatown and Little Italy Food Tour | Tasty Tours NYC
experiences.description:
Join us on an epic food tour as we explore Chinatown and Little Italy and try 7 unique foods, learn about the local history, and check out some iconic landmarks.

What’s included?
- Seven food tastings including dumplings, pizza, pork buns, Hong Kong sponge cakes, thai tea, handmade ravioli, and the choice of a cannoli or cheesecake 
- Visit iconic spots like Mulberry Street, Doyer Street, Mosco Street, and film locations of The Sopranos and Goodfellas
- Learn about the local history of Chinatown and Little Italy

About The Tour 
Chinatown & Little Italy offer a diverse history and an even more diverse food scene. On this tour, you'll eat, learn, and discover two of NYC's most iconic neighborhoods. 

About Us 
We're Tasty Tours NYC, and our mission is to make sure you have an awesome experience and get a real taste of everything the Big Apple has to offer.

experiences.title: The Original Greenwich Village Food & Cultural Tour Since 1999
experiences.description:
Join us on a multi-restaurant and specialty food tasting with cultural journey through the charming West Village. Embark on a delicious adventure as we stroll through the charming West Village, a section of Greenwich Village and eat at many neighborhood gems and favorites of locals, all included with your ticket. 

Get ready to be captivated by this charming and quant area, known for its European feel and local favorites. Savor the mouthwatering tastings from cozy restaurants and renowned specialty food shops, all included!

Discover hidden gems like secluded gardens, historic homes, the friends building and even the narrowest house in all of NYC. Get lost in the vibrant cultural and historic scene and find out why this neighborhood has captured the hearts and palates of so many. 

This is your chance to experience the true essence of a quintessential NYC neighborhood, and a FULL MEAL, all in one unforgettable tour!

experiences.title: NYC: Chinatown & Little Italy Food Tour with 6 Flavorful Dishes
experiences.description:
On our Secret Food Tour: Chinatown and Little Italy, you'll experience New York City’s most iconic neighborhoods.

Get ready to experience the rich history, traditions, and flavors of New York City's most internationally recognized ethnic neighborhoods. Our 5-star cultural and gastronomic adventure promises to be an experience that will leave you with a newfound appreciation for the city and its diverse communities.

You will be eating all the way from the historic Five Points through Chinatown, and into the heart of Little Italy! As you journey through the streets with us, our knowledgeable guides will captivate you with fascinating stories about these vibrant places. 

New York City is full of hidden gems, with this highly curated tour in Lower Manhattan, you'll have the chance to uncover some of the city's best-kept secrets, long known only to the locals!

experiences.title: Bagels Dumplings Pizza & Tacos
experiences.description:
4 ICONIC FOODS. 4 LEGENDARY LOCAL SPOTS. 4 HISTORIC NEIGHBORHOODS.

Gorge on a visual and literal feast as we explore hidden corners of the city that most visitors miss. 

WHY THIS TOUR?
• THE FOOD: We’ll eat bagels, dumplings, pizza, and tacos - four pillars of New York’s edible soul.

• THE STORY: Learn about the immigrants who brought these foods to New York and how each grew beyond its cultural cradle to become a global culinary superstar.

• EXTREME PERSONALIZATION: We are independent, professional guides, not a big corporation constantly hiring new guides. We’re locals who continue to explore. We aren’t stuck to a fixed route and we love making the occasional fun detour to fulfill a guest's wish.

• SIDEWALK ALCHEMY: We believe in the power of the city to expand minds.

Note: Our route varies slightly based on guest input and the pulse of the neighborhood. This tour walks a little further and dives a little deeper than the average trek—come hungry and wear comfortable shoes!

experiences.title: Chef-Led Brooklyn Street-Food Tour in Williamsburg & Greenpoint
experiences.description:
This is the real Brooklyn food tour for food lovers, led by a local chef who actually lives and eats here. Discover curated neighborhood spots shaped by the diverse cultures that define Brooklyn’s food scene, including hidden gems you’d likely never find on your own.

I’m Nicholas, a private chef with over 20 years in NYC kitchens, from Michelin-starred restaurants to private dining. I’ve spent years living and working in this neighborhood and building relationships with family-run spots we visit.

Many stops have deep personal meaning for my wife and me. They’re places I took her when we first started dating to impress her, and they’ve become our family staples. Now we host the tour together on my days off, sharing our love for food and our neighborhood.

As we walk through Williamsburg and Greenpoint you’ll see street art, architecture, and cultures that shaped these neighborhoods, but the experience is intentionally food-focused rather than a traditional history tour.

Come hungry!

experiences.title: Foods of NY Tours Chelsea Market Food Tour & High Line Park
experiences.description:
THE ULTIMATE FOOD PARADISE:
Become a Chelsea Market Insider serving up 8 separate tastings!

Embark on an enticing food tour with Food Of NY Tours, the pioneers of NYC food tours since 1999, as we uncover the secrets and stories of one of the greatest indoor food markets. Discover the birthplace of the Oreo cookie and savor artisanal delights on our tasting tour. Join us as we explore Chelsea Market, visiting a variety of top vendors and sharing their fascinating beginnings.

Afterward, enjoy a leisurely walk on the High Line*, NYC’s elevated park, and hear tales of its history serving West Side factories. Wander through the Meatpacking District, understanding its transformation from “not” to “hot.” Immerse yourself in a flavorful journey through history and innovation!

experiences.title: Viator Exclusive: Pasta Cooking Class & Dinner -Greenwich Village
experiences.description:
Mary, a NYC local who grew up Italian and has been cooking Italian food her entire life, can teach cooking classes. She is an expert at jarring tomatoes, making fresh pasta, and sauces like pesto, marina, Cacio e Pepe, and clam sauce. Participants can learn these new recipes at Mary's Greenwich Village home with lovely skyline views and may be able to dine on the roof. The class is hands-on, but customizable for those who would prefer to take more notes and enjoy the sit-down meal.

Why we love this experience
 ⁃ Rooftop dinner with amazing views (if possible)
 ⁃ Guests can BYOB 
 ⁃ Learn how to make authentic fresh pasta sauce from host Mary

experiences.title: Italian Dinner with Tiramisu Finale in NYC
experiences.description:
Everyone loves to eat Italian food, but learning how to cook it from scratch is just as much fun! Who better to teach you and your friends the ins and outs of pasta than Chef John, who has over 15 years of restaurant experience in the New York,
Your event includes a reception with light snacks, a hands-on cooking class, and a sit-down dinner.

Please let us know if you have any dietary restrictions.

experiences.title: NYC Chinatown and Little Italy Food Tour
experiences.description:
Explore the culinary delights and rich history of Little Italy and Chinatown in this flavorful 2-hour food tour. Savor authentic dim sum and cannoli from historic bakeries while learning about the unique cultures that shaped these vibrant neighborhoods. Your local historian guide will share fascinating lore of Mulberry Street as you enjoy a slice of classic New York pizza and visit hidden gems known only to locals. This engaging tour not only fills your stomach but also enriches your understanding of NYC's diverse heritage. Perfect for food lovers and those seeking an authentic taste of the city.

There are four different food tastings in locations that blend together rich history, rich culture, and even richer flavors! Taste:

- A traditional Chinese sponge cake, accompanied with Vietnamese coffee
- Authentic Chinese Dim Sum dumplings
- A slice of New York pizza from the best spot on Mulberry Street (soft drink included).
- Everyone’s favorite Sicilian pastry, the cannoli.

experiences.title: Williamsburg Food Tasting & Walking Tour
experiences.description: New York City is known for being pricey, but if you know where to look, it doesn’t have to be. Many of the foods that make NYC famous – like pizza, bagels, fried chicken, dumplings & more– just some of the spots we visit on our Williamsburg tour. Come get a slice from Joe's Pizza, and find out what all the buzz is about. We also make a stop at the famous Pie & Thighs, where you can enjoy the classic Chicken & Biscuit entree made fresh daily. Our tours are fun, safe, and memorable. These are only a couple of the stops we take, buy your ticket today and find out where we'll be chowing down next!!! (6) different tastings are included on this journey.

experiences.title: NYC Greenwich Village Italian Food Walking Tour
experiences.description:
TUESDAY TO SATURDAY TOURS meet at St. Anthony of Padua Church, 153 Sullivan St. , SoHo, Manhattan

SUNDAY TOURS meet at FAICCOS
260 Bleecker St., Greenwich Village Manhattan

This is a fun-filled interactive walking tour of Greenwich Village's Italian neighborhood. Sour samples include: a Brazilian Brigadeiro sweet, Rafetto's ravioli and Italian Rice pudding, Il Corallo lemon pound cake, Ben's Grandma pizza, Faicco's rice balls (arancini) and meatball slider, finishing with a fruit-a-misu at Rocco's Pastry. This 2+hour tour is led by local, licensed NYC tour guide, Greg Marro, with Italian family roots in the neighborhood since 1884. He gives you an insider's perspective into local history with music, serenades and family tales. Samples and sights subject to change. The tasty samples are bites, not a meal. Public tours are limited to eight tourists, providing a more intimate experience.

experiences.title: True Crime NYC: Mafia Walk w/Ret. NYPD Detective and Local Food
experiences.description:
Two options: 10 AM or 11 AM. Why join our experience? We LIVED this firsthand. We are Born and raised in Little Italy or worked in the area as NYPD Officers. We go to places the tour companies don't know exist and see things often missed while meeting locals along the way. 

 Start with Behind the scenes at John's of 12th Street restaurant with spaghetti tasing (only 11 AM option), finish with Italian pastry at local shop Est 1931. This is a NYC Mafia experience from a true “insider’s perspective” of the East Village NYC mafia & Crime history as well as local Gang history. 

Starting with private VIP tasting at a famous Mafia "Red Sauce Joint" seen in Soprano's "Life After Goodfellas" & "Get Gotti" (11 AM) this experience starts in the East Village, ends in Little Italy, we visit notorious Mafia & Crime locations, share true crime stories and crime locations in the neighborhood including gang history & locations.

experiences.title: Brooklyn Bridge & DUMBO Food Tour: Local Eats & Iconic Views
experiences.description: Taste your way through Brooklyn on a guided food walking tour of DUMBO and Brooklyn Heights. Enjoy iconic NYC pizza and local favorites, meet the stories behind the food, and take in views of the Brooklyn Bridge and neighborhood landmarks.

experiences.title: Brooklyn Food Tour by Bus: 4 Neighborhoods, 6 Tastings
experiences.description:
Hop aboard our climate controlled luxury minibus and take a journey to the new culinary center of the Big Apple, where food and dining trends are dispersed to the rest of the country, in Brooklyn. And with this half-day tour, you can take a big bite out of it. From old ethnic enclaves to the latest hipster 'hoods, Brooklyn's dining scene is both diverse and cutting edge. Munch on pierogies in Polish-dominated Greenpoint and tasty Mediterranean fare in Williamsburg. Chocolate bon-bons in DUMBO.

You’ll also get to enjoy freshly made empanadas in Park Slope, coal brick oven pizza in the Gowanus area and finish off with a cannoli in Carroll Gardens.

This guided bus and eating tour of New York's coolest and tastiest borough is ideal for foodies and the people who love them. 

You can even end your Brooklyn adventure by walking back to Manhattan across the most famous Brooklyn landmark, the Brooklyn Bridge, or ride back on the coach to the starting point of the tour in Greenwich Village.

experiences.title: Chelsea Market and High Line Guided Food Tour
experiences.description:
Embark on a culinary journey through New York City's Chelsea Market and beyond. This expertly guided tour blends mouth-watering flavors with a commitment to supporting local artisans and sustainable practices. Explore iconic locations and indulge in diverse dishes that showcase NYC’s vibrant gastronomic scene.

Why You’ll Love This Tour:
Diverse Stops: Enjoy selections from Takumi Taco, Joey Bats, Doughnuttery Doughnuts, Nom Wah, and Bird & Branch.

Scenic Views and Historic Sites: Experience breathtaking views and stories of urban renewal.

Instagram-Worthy: Capture memorable photos against NYC's picturesque backdrops.

Support Sustainability: Contribute to the local community through partnerships with small businesses and social impact partners.

Special Offers: get great souvenirs at iconic Pearl River Mart. Tour guests receive 15% off.

Happy Hour Specials: tour guests receive $5 sangria and $5 wine pour options.

experiences.title: New York Union Square Food Tour: Delicious Donuts & Sweet Treats
experiences.description:
There’re so many amazing foods in New York City: pizza, bagels, pasta and of course, donuts. Our Union Square & Greenwich Village Tour will bring you to some of the best donut emporiums in Manhattan where you’ll try donuts that will absolutely delight and astound your taste buds.

We’ll start with a relative newcomer that serves heavenly bombolone in unique and astounding flavors. Next, a Greenwich Village icon that’s been around since 1964—featuring a wall of donuts in all shapes, styles and delectable flavors to choose from. And finally, we’ll finish the tour at one of our favorite shops where you’ll experience a donut masterpiece in brioche that’s become a favorite with our guests.

As you walk off the donuts between shops, our guides will point out landmarks—both big and small and fill you in on local history and color.

Trust us—this is a tour you “donut” want to miss.

experiences.title: New York City Mafia and Local Food Tour led by NYPD Guides
experiences.description:
Begins either 4:30PM or 5:15PM. Why us? We LIVED this firsthand. Born & raised in Little Italy - or cops who worked the streets here - active and retired/ NYPD Officers. Our “walk with stories” breaks the typical tour company mold of boring facts, repetitive "stops" & irrelevant dates replaced with personal life experiences. Walk the very streets the mafia ruled with a real resident and meet other locals along the way. Plus food included is equivalent to a full 2 course dinner! 
Growing up witnessing some of New York’s infamous families and having consulted for TV and major films makes this a unique experience no other company can offer. 
Beginning at a famous Mafia "Red Sauce Joint" as seen in Soprano's and "Get Gotti" this experience winds through the East Village & Little Italy visiting notorious Mafia and Crime locations sharing personal true crime stories and eating amazing food from the neighborhood. Rated #1 "Things to do in New York" Recently featured in the Washington Post

experiences.title: New York City: Hell's Kitchen Midtown Food On Foot Guided Tour
experiences.description: Experience New York like never before on this award-winning food tour near Times Square! Winner of 11 TripAdvisor awards and praised by over 3,300 five-star reviews, this is the city’s most authentic and fun culinary adventure. Led by a passionate local, you’ll explore real New York neighborhoods where locals live and eat—far from the tourist spots. With your food credit, you choose what to enjoy at 4–5 tasty stops featuring diverse cuisines and one sweet treat. This isn’t a sampling tour—it’s a full meal, packed with flavor and personality. Along the way, meet travelers from around the world, soak in insider restaurant tips, and discover where New Yorkers really dine. Perfect for foodies and explorers alike, this owner-operated experience feels more like hanging out with a friend than taking a tour. Book early, come hungry, and taste the real New York—one bite at a time.

experiences.title: Brooklyn Food Walking Tour: Local Eats & Family‑Run Shops
experiences.description: Discover Brooklyn through its food. This guided neighborhood tour celebrates family-run shops, iconic bites, and the local stories behind them—showing how tight‑knit communities, generations of owners, and great food shape the borough.

experiences.title: NYC Bustronome Sightseeing Lunch and drinks Panoramic Bus
experiences.description:
Savor a gourmet multi-course menu aboard a glass-roofed double-decker bus while taking in breathtaking views of New York’s most iconic landmarks. A unique blend of fine dining and sightseeing you won’t find anywhere else.
✨ A moving gourmet restaurant
✨ A comfortable ride in any season
✨ The perfect blend of fine dining and urban discovery

experiences.title: Lower East Side Food Tour: Iconic Eats & NYC History Walking Tour
experiences.description: Join this 3-hour New York City walking tour to sample the best ethnic foods in the Lower East Side. But this experience includes much more than sampling delicious foods, as you’ll learn about the history of the dishes, establishments, sites, and people along the way from your guide.

experiences.title: Homemade Dumplings 101 in NYC
experiences.description:
Everyone loves dumplings, but learning how to cook it from scratch is just as much fun! Who better to teach you and your friends the ins and outs of dumplings than Chef Danny, who has over 15 years of restaurant experience in New York,
Your event includes a reception with light snacks, a hands-on cooking class, and a sit-down lunch.

Please let us know if you have any dietary restrictions.

experiences.title: The Works Tasting Session (Wine, Whiskey or Cider)
experiences.description:
Make the most out of your visit to Lake George by booking a wine tasting session with the region's first Winery and top rated attraction in the area! During your visit to the Adirondack Winery Tasting Room, a knowledgeable wine tasting associate will lead you through a tasting of the local winery's hand-crafted award-winning quality wines in a laid-back atmosphere.... no pinkies in the air here!
Not into wine? Try our Extreme Heights Hard Ciders or American Oak Whiskey and Bourbons instead!

experiences.title: Seneca Lake South Wine Tastings Tour
experiences.description:
Seneca is the largest of all the Finger Lakes by volume and depth. This makes it an ideal moderating influence for vineyards on the shores that sit largely in Conesus Loam Soils. 
Enjoy a day of wine tasting in the world-famous Finger Lakes region as you tour the vineyards surrounding scenic Seneca Lake. Take time to enjoy tastings and purchase new bottles for your collection. Kick back with friends or family, and let your guide do the designated driving. You will visit & taste at four wineries. Choose the Vineyards, Views and Vinifera plus Lunch wine tour to add a mid afternoon lunch at Tabora Farms & Café.

* Enjoy a day out in New York wine country with your group.
* Taste a variety of premium Finger Lakes regional wines at four wineries.
* Visit & taste at four wineries. Choose to Vineyards, Views and Vinifera plus Lunch tour to add a lunch at Tabora Farms & Café.
* Winery venues are subject to change due to availability

experiences.title: Pier 57 and Chelsea Market Gourmet Food Tour
experiences.description:
**Discover the Ultimate Food Tour of Chelsea Market!**

Join us for an unforgettable culinary adventure through Chelsea Market, featuring a scenic walk along the High Line, exploration of Little Island, and stunning views from Pier 57—all in the historic Meatpacking District.

Our tour caters to every diet—vegan, vegetarian, gluten-free, or omnivore—with delicious offerings from small family-owned eateries. Family-friendly and wheelchair accessible, this all-weather experience allows you to enjoy both indoor and outdoor attractions comfortably.

With a maximum group size of just 12 participants, you'll receive personalized attention from our expert guides. Each attendee is equipped with earphones for enhanced listening as we share captivating stories about the area’s transformation into a high-end fashion hub.

LGBT-friendly and welcoming to all, book your spot today for a memorable journey filled with tasty bites and rich history!

experiences.title: Over The Rhine Cocktail Tour with Riverside Food Tours
experiences.description:
Jump-start your Saturday night on a Happy Hour Tour in Over the Rhine! 
Unlike large bus tours or asking your Uber driver where to get a good cocktail, we offer a relaxing, guided tour and cocktail tasting experience that connects with the local bars and the neighborhood. As a result, you will learn about the history and uniqueness of Over the Rhine, experience a variety of cocktails, learn about each establishments distinctive style and enjoy a nice walk with some amazing people.
We’ll visit 4 different places, enjoying lively libations and learn a few of the bartenders tips and tricks. You’ll enjoy the full attention of one of our fun local guides, who will quickly seem more like a friend escorting you to their favorite spots in town. And since we don’t want to just booze you up, we’ll include one or two snacks along the way.
As we stroll through this German historic neighborhood, we’ll share the stories and history of these magnificent buildings.

experiences.title: Short North Walking Food Tour
experiences.description:
Take a leisurely stroll with us through Columbus’ hip Short North and savor its culinary delights.

More than just an arts district and home to the monthly Gallery Hop—a famous downtown Columbus event—the Short North also boasts a wealth of dining and shopping opportunities. The Short North is packed full of Columbus’ best restaurants, boutiques, bistros, and nightlife. This local food and walking tour is designed to show off some of the best that the Short North and Columbus have to offer.

We’ll start at the North Market, Columbus’ historic public market, where we’ll meet some of the local food vendors and learn the history of the building. We will then stop at neighborhood eating establishments, sampling some of their signature dishes, and hearing their stories. Stops will include some neighborhood favorites, and some highly regarded new additions including Brassica, Jeni’s Ice Creams and The Guild House.

experiences.title: Cincinnati Private Streetcar Food Tour
experiences.description:
On a private Cincinnati Streetcar Food Tour, you'll explore three distinct historic neighborhoods connected by the free Cincinnati streetcar. 
Your friendly local guides will take you on an unforgettable culinary journey. Cincinnati is home to a thriving restaurant scene, but it can be hard for visitors to choose where to dine and what to see first! 

On this foodie adventure, you will relax and enjoy sit-down dining in the heart of the city. Next, we ride to Findlay Market and enjoy even more local favorites. This progressive meal includes 6 stops!

Your hearty dishes may feature Scottish fare, a full-size burger, authentic Mexican tacos, cheese coneys, Fancy focaccia bread with local cheese, chicken enchiladas, and much more!

At historic Findlay Market, you may enjoy award-winning chocolates or handmade truffles
We may visit a cheese and fudge business from 1921.
We save the best for last. This dessert is a surprise, and we guarantee it won't disappoint.

experiences.title: Dublin Ohio Walking Food Tour
experiences.description:
Discover the culinary delights of Dublin, Ohio, on this engaging walking tour that showcases the city's vibrant food scene. Over 3.5 hours, explore six unique stops including North High Brewing and Fado, tasting a variety of delicious offerings that can replace a full meal. This tour is perfect for food lovers eager to experience both traditional and contemporary flavors in a city rich in history and innovation. Vegetarian options are available with advance notice, ensuring everyone can enjoy this flavorful adventure.

- 3.5-hour walking tour through Dublin's best food spots
- Taste dishes from six local eateries, including craft breweries and bakeries
- Full meal replacement with diverse flavors from Irish to Vietnamese
- Vegetarian options accommodated with prior notice

experiences.title: Authentic Mexican Cuisine (Oaxaca)
experiences.description: "Cook like an Oaxacan in our hands-on class. You will learn how to prepare a traditional dish, step by step, while having fun and learning about the culinary culture of Oaxaca. Our host will guide you through every stage of the process, from selecting ingredients to the final presentation. We customize the class according to your preferences and needs! We have vegetarian options and we adapt to any dietary restrictions."

experiences.title: Taste of Little Italy Guided Walking Food Tour in Cleveland
experiences.description:
Explore the flavors and stories of Cleveland’s Little Italy on this guided walking tour. Visit beloved eateries while indulging in authentic Italian cuisine, from freshly baked goods to classic dishes and delightful frozen desserts. Your knowledgeable guide shares captivating tales of the neighborhood's immigrant heritage and local legends, making this a cultural journey as well as a culinary one. Perfect for both locals and first-time visitors, this tour is a delicious way to experience the charm of Little Italy.

- Guided tour through Cleveland’s historic Little Italy
- Sample authentic Italian flavors from local chefs
- Learn about the neighborhood’s immigrant heritage and landmarks
- Ideal for food lovers and culture enthusiasts alike

experiences.title: Alt Eats Tour Discover International Flavors in Columbus
experiences.description:
Columbus's culinary scene comes alive on the Alt Eats Tour, a guided journey through one of the city’s vibrant immigrant neighborhoods. Sample a range of international cuisines, including Filipino, Vietnamese, Yemeni, and Brazilian delicacies, while learning about their cultural significance. Perfect for food lovers, this van-based tour provides enough tastings to replace a meal, making it both a delicious and informative experience. Join a small group and enjoy the comfort of an air-conditioned van as you explore the diverse flavors that Columbus has to offer.

- 3.5-hour guided culinary tour every Friday at 6 PM
- Sample dishes from 5 different international food stops
- Vegetarian options available with advance notice
- Comfortable 14-passenger van transportation included

experiences.title: Delicious Downtown Cleveland Food Tour
experiences.description:
Discover the vibrant essence of Downtown Cleveland on this guided walking tour, where rich history meets delightful flavors. Stroll through the bustling East 4th Street and visit historic spots as you stroll. Explore iconic landmarks such as Public Square and Playhouse Square, while your expert guide shares fascinating stories about the city's architecture and its inhabitants. Along the way, savor a diverse array of local culinary delights that reflect Cleveland's cultural tapestry, making this tour a perfect blend of history and gastronomy.

- Guided walking tour through Downtown Cleveland's historic sites
- Visit popular locations including Public Square and Playhouse Square
- Taste a variety of local foods on the journey - a substantial midday meal
- Learn about the city's rich history and vibrant neighborhoods from an expert guide

experiences.title: Uncorked in The Land - Wine, Cocktails & City Views
experiences.description:
Cleveland has wine bars. What it needed was a better way to connect them.

Uncorked in The Land is a 3.5-hour night out connecting 3 amazing wine bars with premium open-air golf cart rides between every stop.

You’ll spend 45 to 55 minutes at each stop, giving you enough time to sip, snack, and enjoy each place. Between stops, the music stays on while the cart cruises your group through Gordon Square, Ohio City, and Tremont.

The experience includes a complimentary snack at Wyne Tasting & Cocktail Bar, one complimentary wine tasting at both Market Avenue & La Cave Du Vin. 

Additional wine, cocktails, food, and beverages are available for purchase directly from each venue.

This is built for girls nights, birthdays, friends nights out, double dates, visitors, and groups who want something more memorable than dinner followed by a group-chat debate about where to go next.

No Napa needed. This is Cleveland wine done right.

experiences.title: Sunday Brunch at Findlay Market Tour with Riverside Food Tours
experiences.description:
If this is your first time in Cincinnati, a visit to the historic Findlay Market is a must-see. 
Located in historic Over-the-Rhine, the Market welcomes over a million visitors a year! For first-time visitors, the market can be overwhelming. But we make it fun with an in-person guide at your side. We can skip the lines and maneuver to our favorite spots. Your guide will entertain you with stories from the past and old photos that bring history to life.

Our stops vary from week to week, but some of the samples may include a German goetta sandwich, Belgian waffles, fudge, cheese, gelato, samosas, and empanadas.
Rated by Newsweek magazine as one of the Top 10 markets in the World, Findlay Market is perfect for local foodies and first-time visitors. 
(Please note: Unfortunately, we cannot accommodate nut allergies, food allergies, low-carb, diabetes, gluten-free, vegan, or lactose-free restrictions).

experiences.title: Ethnic Food Tour in Over the Rhine with Riverside Food Tours
experiences.description:
Travel the world without leaving Cincinnati! If you’re looking for fun things to do in Cincinnati, this guided culinary tour will introduce you to some of the best ethnic food in town.  
We may begin with Hawaiian-inspired steamed bun filled with a delicious BBQ, a glass of bubble tea, a Mexican street taco. Other unique tastings may include an Argentinean empanada, or a slice of NY style pizza. We may feature French macarons or a piece of Lebanese baklava. Or visit to a modern day beer garden for a sample of German delights!
The Ethnic Eats Tour begins in beautiful Washington Park, where the heart of Over the Rhine congregates. We'll enjoy dishes at 5 unique locally owned restaurants.  
(Please note: Unfortunately, we cannot accommodate nut, food allergies, low carb, diabetes, gluten free, vegan or lactose free restrictions).

By the end of the tour, you’ll have some amazing photos in front of iconic buildings and landmarks, and insider’s local knowledge of the food and drinks scene.

experiences.title: Mainstrasse Village Food Tour in Covington KY
experiences.description:
Eat, drink, and be merry on our premiere 3-hour walking, cultural food tour of beautiful Mainstrasse Village located 5 minutes south of downtown Cincinnati on the banks of the Ohio River in Covington, Kentucky. Linger in the German village, soaking up the charm of European architecture, a glockenspiel, cobblestone streets and fountains. Indulge in local treats, such as Bavarian pretzels, beer cheese, chicken and waffles, pizza, a tasting of local craft beer and much more!
We promise you won't leave hungry! It’s the perfect combination of dining in a charming and memorable setting with your own professional guide.Food servings are ample and equivalent to more than a meal.  This is an easy walking tour.
(Please note: Unfortunately, we cannot accommodate nut or food allergies, low carb, diabetes, gluten free, vegan or lactose free dietary restrictions).

experiences.title: Top 10 Sites + Bites of Cincinnati Tour with Riverside Food Tours
experiences.description:
Discover Cincinnati on a 3-hour adventure through the heart of the Queen City! This fast-paced tour features 6 mouthwatering food stops, Cincinnati’s Top 10 must-see sights, and a fun ride on the modern streetcar — all led by a friendly, local guide who knows the city inside and out.
Along the way, savor Cincinnati icons like a Belgian waffle, a chili cheese dog, Graeter’s raspberry chocolate chip ice cream, German goetta, a French macaron or Market cookie, and more sweet & savory bites. (Findlay Market is closed Mondays — but don’t worry, we’ve got delicious alternatives!)
Come hungry and wear comfy shoes — we’ll cover about 45 minutes of walking as we explore stunning architecture, colorful murals, and sweeping riverfront views. Whether it’s your first time here or you’re a local looking for something new, this tour is a hit with all ages — yes, even kids love it!
Your guide will share the hidden stories, history, and insider tips. You might just fall in love and want to stay!

experiences.title: West Side Market & Ohio City Neighborhood Food Tour of Cleveland
experiences.description: Experience the tastes and culture of one of Cleveland’s most popular neighborhoods with a guided walking tour through Ohio City. Savor local favorites and seasonal treats when you visit culinary hot spots and unique restaurants. Learn about the historic West Side Market, the Ohio City Farm and hear the stories from some of Cleveland’s best local eateries.

experiences.title: Cincy Brunch History and Streetcar Tour with Riverside Food Tours
experiences.description:
We have a hunch you'll love our brunch tour. Learn the history of this restored German neighborhood in Cincinnati while enjoying great food along the way! Maximize your time on this 3 hour guided walking and streetcar tour. Visit Over the Rhine and historic Findlay Market. We enjoy wonderful food from 6 local eateries: We promise you won't leave hungry on this tour. 
(We cannot accommodate nut, food allergies, low carb, diabetes, gluten free, vegan or lactose free restrictions -vegetarians only).
Highlights: 
*Experience colorful multi story murals throughout the city and the free art exhibits that you can return to.
*Stroll through Findlay Market and hear the story of the oldest urban market in Ohio. Stay and shop awhile. You're only a few blocks north of our starting point. 
*Enjoy dining at locally owned restaurants and eateries..
*Receive a food guide with map & list of restaurants.
*Children age 5 and under are free, but do not receive any food. Children 6+ require a ticket.

experiences.title: Streetcar Food Tour and Findlay Market with Riverside Food Tours
experiences.description:
Join us for an exciting afternoon on the Cincinnati Streetcar Food Tour, where delicious bites, rich history, and vibrant neighborhoods come together in one unforgettable experience! This 3-hour culinary journey includes a mix of walking, riding the streetcar, and relaxing at 3 sit-down restaurants—plus more tasty stops at the iconic Findlay Market.

What’s on the menu? From a fresh signature salad to Cincinnati cheese coneys to gourmet burgers, Mexican street tacos, or bangers and mash at a beloved Scottish pub, every bite is a flavor-packed surprise. Our restaurants vary from day to day, but the quantity and quality remain the same!

As you explore historic Over-the-Rhine, your local guide brings Cincinnati’s fascinating past to life—with stories about German immigrants, quirky city facts, and hidden gems along the way.

With just .5 mile of walking over 3 hours, this tour is fun, filling, and totally manageable. Come hungry, bring your curiosity, and get ready to eat like a local!

experiences.title: Private Cincinnati Food Tour with 6 Local Delicacies
experiences.description:
Experience Cincinnati’s rich flavors on our Secret Food Tour through the city’s vibrant historic district. With 6+ tastings, you’ll discover why locals are so proud of their food traditions. Bite into a warm Goetta, egg, and cheese sandwich—an iconic Queen City breakfast favorite. Savor the legendary Taconey, then indulge your sweet side with handmade cake truffles, a golden Liège waffle, and the city’s most famous scoop: creamy Graeter’s ice cream. As you eat your way through hidden gems and beloved classics, your guide will share the stories, culture, and history that shaped Cincinnati’s unique food scene. And, as always, you’ll finish with our delicious Secret Dish, revealed only during the tour. Join us for a flavorful journey that blends tradition, comfort, and a touch of indulgence in every bite.

As a private tour, everything works around you! Our start times are much more easy going, dates can open up. It's a much more intimate and cozy experience.

experiences.title: Cincinnati Historic Centre Food Tour with 6 Authentic Dishes
experiences.description: Experience Cincinnati’s rich flavors on our Secret Food Tour through the city’s vibrant historic district. With 6+ tastings, you’ll discover why locals are so proud of their food traditions. Bite into a warm Goetta, egg, and cheese sandwich—an iconic Queen City breakfast favorite. Savor the legendary Taconey, then indulge your sweet side with handmade cake truffles, a golden Liège waffle, and the city’s most famous scoop: creamy Graeter’s ice cream. As you eat your way through hidden gems and beloved classics, your guide will share the stories, culture, and history that shaped Cincinnati’s unique food scene. And, as always, you’ll finish with our delicious Secret Dish, revealed only during the tour. Join us for a flavorful journey that blends tradition, comfort, and a touch of indulgence in every bite.

experiences.title: Brewers & Barons Trail Tour
experiences.description:
Discover the people and places that made brewing a cornerstone of the Queen City’s history with a guided tour of our unique historical trail, featuring art installations and historical signage along the way! Beginning at the Hop On Trail Sign at Findlay Market, we follow the Brewing Heritage Trail along the eastern portion of the Brewery District, sharing stories of the workers, brewmasters, and beer barons from the 19th and early 20th century. Experience the places they worked, learn the dangers they faced, and the empires they built by producing America’s best brews. 

Tours include a visit into the subterranean lagering cellars of the historic (non-operating) Schmidt Brothers/Crown Brewery, as well as outdoor visits to historic Hudepohl and Kauffman Brewery structures, and concludes with a pint of beer at Findlay Market. Those joining us in the underground cellar will need to be able to traverse a series of stairs leading in and out, but all guests have the option to remain topside.

experiences.title: Tremont Neighborhood Food Tour
experiences.description: Our Tremont Food Tour explores progression of the neighborhood's cuisine, from its ethnic working class roots to the high end gastronomic experiences available today. The tour is 3.5 hours.

experiences.title: Cincy Bourbon, Beer and Wine Streetcar Tour
experiences.description:
This is your shortcut to Cincinnati’s best bourbon, beer, and wine stops—no map, no stress, no risk — and this tour raises a glass to where it all began.

From streetcar to sip, we show you the best bourbon, beer, and wine—and keep it safe, fun, and affordable. 

A truly great tour is about more than just food or drink—it’s about the experience. The Cincy Bourbon, Beer & Wine Tour is a streetcar tour unlike any other downtown tour.

Unlike other companies that require booking a private tour, our public tours make it easy to enjoy all three spirits in one seamless experience. Choose a date and join the fun.

Just as bourbon has grown far beyond Kentucky, Cincinnati is proudly sharing the story of its high-quality distilled spirits. At Riverside Food Tours, we believe a spirits tour should be more than hopping from place to place.

Our experience blends education, storytelling, and fun! This is not a food tour. We suggest planning a light dinner afterward.

experiences.title: Cincinnati's Original Findlay Market Tour With Tastings
experiences.description: Food, culture, and history! It's all at Findlay Market! Findlay Market has been at the heart of the Over-the-Rhine neighborhood since 1852. See why this municipal market is now Cincinnati's most popular gathering place and the favorite destination for food lovers. Taste your way around the market during a 90-minute guided tour while you meet several market merchants and enjoy five samples. Tour also available for private groups.

experiences.title: Built on Beer Tour
experiences.description:
Starting at the Brewing Heritage Trail Sign at Findlay Market, this brewing history and architecture tour walks the western portion of the Brewery District, marveling at the many remaining 19th and early 20th century structures and sharing stories of those who built or doomed these brewing empires during beer’s industrial revolution.

Tours include a visit into the subterranean lager cellars of the historic (non-operating) Jackson Brewery, as well as outdoor visitation to the Sohn/Mohawk Brewery, several Christian Moerlein sites, and the location of the Bellevue Incline. The Jackson Brewery cellars were excavated from the hillside under the brewery, so we enter from street level and there are no stairs to climb going in or out, making these cellars very accessible and the total walking distance of this tour is less than a mile.

At the tour conclusion, we stop in at a neighborhood taproom for a pint of local beer, included with each ticket!

experiences.title: German Village Walking Food Tour in Columbus
experiences.description:
Discover the rich history and vibrant flavors of German Village on this walking food tour. Explore cobblestone streets lined with beautifully restored cottages while sampling delicious dishes from local favorites. Highlights include tastings at Katzinger’s, a Food Network-featured deli, and Schmidt’s, known for its iconic cuisine. The tour concludes at Barcelona, where you can enjoy paella and sangria, providing enough food to replace a meal. This engaging 3.5-hour journey runs from March to November, accommodating vegetarians with prior notice and covering over 2 miles of walking. Perfect for food lovers and those seeking a taste of Columbus culture.

- 3.5-hour walking tour of German Village, Saturdays & Sundays at 2 PM
- Sample dishes from 5 popular eateries including Katzinger’s and Schmidt’s
- Vegetarian options available with advance notice
- Enjoy a delicious conclusion with paella and sangria at Barcelona

experiences.title: Little Italy Neighborhood Food Tour of Cleveland
experiences.description: Our Little Italy Food Tour will explore the Cleveland Italian culture that has existed for generations; its people, its philosophies, and most importantly its food. We will enjoy specialized dishes from a variety of restaurants; some long standing, some new to the area, while we take time to appreciate the contributions of Cleveland's rich Italian culture. The tour lasts 3.5 hours long.

experiences.title: Cleveland Whiskey Behind The Scenes of Distillery Tour
experiences.description:
Discover the secrets of our unique bourbon and rye whiskey production during this exclusive behind-the-scenes tour. Gain insight into the innovative techniques that distinguish our spirits from the rest, while enjoying a guided tasting session that highlights the rich flavors and craftsmanship in every sip. This tour not only offers a chance to see the distillation process up close but also allows you to taste the difference firsthand, making it perfect for whiskey enthusiasts and curious beginners alike.

- Go behind the scenes to learn about bourbon and rye production
- Enjoy a guided tasting experience featuring our finest spirits
- Discover the innovations that set our distillery apart
- Perfect for both whiskey enthusiasts and newcomers to the world of spirits

experiences.title: West Side Market Food Tour
experiences.description: Our food tour brings you through the historic West Side Market to meet the long standing vendors, take in the history, and enjoy a variety of sumptuous cuisine as we visit 15 vendors throughout the facility.

experiences.title: Custom Bourbon Blending Experience @ Willow Run Downtown Cincy
experiences.description:
You're not just a guest, you're the blender.

Your host walks you through the rich history of Cincinnati's bourbon roots, dating back to our founding in 1865, before guiding you through a tasting of six distinct wood-finished bourbons — cherry wood, maple, smoked oak, and more. Along the way, you'll learn exactly how each finishing wood transforms flavor, aroma, and character.

Then comes the best part. With your host by your side, you'll blend your own signature recipe — dialing in the perfect balance that matches your palate.

experiences.title: DIY Candle Making Class at a Local Brewery in Columbus
experiences.description: Swap the usual “what should we do today?” debate for a fun, hands-on candle making class hosted at a trendy local brewery in Columbus. In this hands-on experience, Instructor Mariah will guide you step by step as you design and pour your own custom candle. You’ll explore different scents, learn how fragrance, wax and wicks work together and create a candle that feels completely personal. And the best news? No experience is needed. Get ready for an experience that is creative, relaxing and way more memorable than sitting through another average happy hour. This class is ideal for couples looking for a unique date night, friends planning a girls’ night out, solo guests who want a calming creative escape and travelers searching for a local activity beyond the typical sightseeing list. Come for the cozy atmosphere, stay for the joy of making something with your own hands and leave with a custom candle that feels totally you.

experiences.title: Fun Chocolate Making Class With a Local Instructor in Columbus
experiences.description:
If melting chocolate sounds like therapy with snacks, you're in the right place. Settle into a relaxed, social atmosphere where every swirl, drizzle and sprinkle turns into something worth showing off and even better to eat. No experience? Perfect. You'll be guided through every step without feeling like you're back in school.

You'll learn practical chocolate-making skills, including tempering, molding, hand dipping and decorating, while creating an assortment of gourmet treats. Make rich chocolate bark topped with cookies, nuts, dried fruit and colorful candies, dip fresh strawberries, pretzels and marshmallows into smooth chocolate, then design molded chocolates filled with caramel, ganache, peanut butter or fruit pieces. Add polished finishing touches with cocoa powder, edible glitter, chocolate drizzles and playful decorations before taking home about a pound of handcrafted chocolate that's almost too pretty to unwrap.

experiences.title: Hands On Cooking Class at Findlay Market with Tablespoon
experiences.description:
Great food, good company, and real cooking. We offer a fully hands-on experience where you cook a complete menu from scratch and have a great time doing it.

Stations are set up for pairs, fully stocked with everything you need, and you'll work through each dish with hands-on guidance from your instructor and staff.

We're located steps from Findlay Market, Cincinnati's iconic, century-old public market, so the energy and character of the city are built right into the experience. Classes are small, social, and built around seasonal menus that change throughout the year, so there's always something new to explore.

experiences.title: Pints on the Patio: Cleveland Brewery Patio Golf Cart Tour
experiences.description:
Pints on the Patio is Cleveland’s sunny-season brewery experience, built for birthdays, friend groups, bachelor and bachelorette weekends, visitors, locals, and anyone who believes beer tastes better outside.

The experience begins and ends at BrewDog Cleveland Outpost, where free parking makes it easy to leave the car behind and let us handle the rest.

Over 3.5 hours, ride between 3 of the best patios in premium golf carts with comfortable seating, Bluetooth soundbars, LED lighting, and music between stops.

No parking shuffle. No long walks. No rideshare roulette.

You’ll visit BrewDog for riverfront views, $5 beers, and 50% off appetizers; Saucy Brew Works for $4 beers and 50% off select appetizers and pizzas; and Collision Bend for waterfront patio views, discounted beers, and select offers.

Food and drinks are purchased directly from each brewery. We provide the ride and discounts

It’s patios, pints, music, and premium golf cart rides wrapped into one very Cleveland summer day.

experiences.title: Bikes & Brews Tour
experiences.description: Oklahoma City is home to some of the best craft breweries in the country. This unforgettable experience will stop at five breweries for beer tastings. Our comfortable and easy to ride 3-speed bicycles allow for many interesting view points of the city. Ride OKC was founded by passionate native Oklahoman's, a registered architect, cyclist, and off the beaten path travel enthusiasts. All bikes come with water bottle cages; baskets are available upon request.

experiences.title: Asian District Food Tour in Oklahoma City
experiences.description:
Discover the vibrant flavors of Oklahoma City's Asian District on this guided walking food tour. Sample authentic Vietnamese, Chinese, and other Asian cuisines at three different food stops while enjoying two refreshing drink breaks. Your local guide will share intriguing stories and historical insights about the area, ensuring you gain an insider’s perspective on OKC's diverse food scene. This approximately 1-mile stroll is perfect for food lovers looking to explore the culinary richness of the district. Come hungry and ready to experience a unique blend of traditional dishes and innovative fusions. 

- Guided walking food tour through Oklahoma City's Asian District
- Visit 3 food stops and enjoy 2 drink stops along the way
- Learn about the history and culture of the Asian District
- Approximately 1 mile of relaxed walking with a local expert

experiences.title: Plaza District Food Tour Taste Oklahoma City Culinary Gems
experiences.description:
Explore the vibrant Plaza District of Oklahoma City on a guided walking food tour that highlights local eateries and the area's artistic charm. This culinary journey features five delicious food stops, paired with engaging stories and insider knowledge about the local food scene and history. Enjoy a leisurely stroll of approximately one mile, discovering the rich personality of the Plaza District while tasting diverse dishes. Perfect for food lovers and those seeking a unique experience in OKC.

- Guided walking food tour showcasing 5 local food stops
- Learn about the history and culture of the Plaza District
- Insider insights into Oklahoma City's dynamic food scene
- Approximately 1 mile of leisurely walking with a local guide

experiences.title: Ride Eat Explore OKC Streetcar Food Tour
experiences.description:
Do you want to try different food across OKC? Hop on your streetcar tour! You'll experience 4 unique districts while your tour guides share fun facts as we travel on the OKC Streetcar. Delicious local food will be waiting for you at each stop. So let's EMBARK and connect your taste buds to the community!

What to Expect: 
- A guided food tour with a local guide
- 4 food stops and tastings
- Stories, facts, and history about each area
- Travel on the Streetcar (fare included)
- Insider's guide to OKC's food scene

experiences.title: The Dinner Detective True Crime Murder Mystery Show - Tulsa, OK
experiences.description: Our show is very different from traditional true crime mystery dinner shows. We will hide non-costumed actors in the audience that are pretending to be part of the crowd. This results in a much more social and interactive evening than with other shows. Our shows are set during the present day and take place in real time. Over the course of the night, our costumed Detectives will uncover clues, interrogate audience members that may or may not be part of the show, and help everyone get closer to solving the mystery.

experiences.title: Dinner Detective True Crime Murder Mystery - Oklahoma City, OK
experiences.description:
At The Dinner Detective, you’ll tackle a hilarious and challenging crime while you feast on a fantastic dinner. Just beware! The culprit is hiding in plain sight somewhere in the room, and you may find yourself as a Prime Suspect before you know it! Our engaging and unique murder mystery dinner theatre performances have been playing across the country since 2004.

Our show is very different from traditional murder mystery dinner shows. We will hide non-costumed actors in the audience that are pretending to be part of the crowd. This results in a much more social and interactive evening than with other shows. Our shows are set during the present day and take place in real time. Over the course of the night, our costumed Detectives will uncover clues, interrogate audience members that may or may not be part of the show, and help everyone get closer to solving the mystery.

experiences.title: Dumpling Making Class at a Trendy Local Taproom in Tulsa
experiences.description:
Forget takeout for a night and learn how to make handmade vegetable dumplings from scratch. Inside a laid-back Tulsa taproom, you’ll spend the evening cooking alongside Chef Gregory, whose approachable teaching style keeps everything easy, fun and beginner-friendly.

You’ll start by preparing a flavorful filling with shredded carrots, cabbage, scallions, ginger, garlic and soy sauce. Then, learn how to fold, crimp and seal each dumpling before cooking them to perfection. Chef Gregory shares practical techniques for shaping, cooking and handling dumplings that you can recreate at home.

As your dumplings cook, you’ll make a dipping sauce featuring black vinegar and mirin for a sweet-and-tangy finish. Enjoy a hands-on experience filled with good conversation and the satisfying sound of dumplings crisping in the pan.

The result is a plate of golden, handmade vegetable dumplings packed with flavor and a fun night spent learning a versatile new cooking skill.

experiences.title: Fun Dumpling Making Class at a Trendy Brewery in Tulsa
experiences.description: Learn the art of handmade dumplings while enjoying the lively setting of a local Tulsa brewery in this fun cooking class. In this class, Chef Gregory breaks dumpling-making down into simple, approachable steps, starting with building a flavorful vegetable filling with carrots, cabbage, scallions, ginger, garlic and soy. Next, practice folding and sealing your dumplings, learning techniques used in traditional kitchens to create consistent, well-shaped results. Then, make a bright dipping sauce with black vinegar and mirin to complement every bite. With step-by-step guidance throughout, you’ll leave with practical dumpling-making skills, a full handmade meal and a recipe worth repeating at home.

experiences.title: Fun Pasta Making Class at a Trendy Brewery in Tulsa
experiences.description: Learn the art of fresh tagliatelle while enjoying the lively setting of a local brewery in Tulsa in this fun cooking class. In this class booked through Classpop!, Chef Gregory breaks down traditional pasta-making into easy, approachable steps, starting with mixing flour, eggs and olive oil into a fresh dough. You’ll knead, roll and cut your own tagliatelle by hand, learning techniques that help create the ideal texture and shape. Next, build a classic burro nocciola sauce by browning butter to bring out its deep, nutty flavor, then add sage and garlic for a savory finish. Toss everything together, top with Parmigiano Reggiano and enjoy your handmade pasta fresh from the pan.

experiences.title: Pasta Making Class at a Trendy Local Brewery in Tulsa
experiences.description: Your pasta era starts in a Tulsa brewery, flour-dusted hands included. This two-hour cooking class with Chef Gregory is built for total beginners, date nights, friend hangouts and anyone who has ever looked at fresh pasta and thought, “Cute, but absolutely not.” You’ll prove yourself wrong fast. First, you’ll turn flour, eggs and olive oil into fresh egg dough while learning how to mix, knead and handle it without panic. Next, you’ll roll the dough thin and cut it into classic tagliatelle ribbons. Then comes the sauce: golden brown butter, crispy sage leaves, a little garlic and a generous finish of Parmigiano Reggiano. You’ll cook, toss and taste Tagliatelle al Burro e Salvia in a casual brewery atmosphere that feels more like a night out than a formal lesson. Low pressure, high reward, very sauce-worthy.

experiences.title: Savory Blackened Fish Tacos Virtual Masterclass with a MasterChef
experiences.description:
Learn how to prepare the Blackened Tilapia Fish Tacos that earned the apron for MasterChef Season 8 Top 8 contestant Chef Gabriel.

In this interactive virtual class to help you prepare professional, high quality meals from the comfort of your own home. Join Gabriel and hear the story behind the dish that changed his life!

experiences.title: Willamette Wine Tour from McMinnville (Tasting Fees Included)
experiences.description:
Do you want to taste the best wines in Willamette Valley?

Our custom private tours are designed to take couples and groups of friends deep into the heart of Willamette Valley to explore the cult wines, highest-rated wines, and legendary vineyards of Willamette Valley!

We love building unique tours according to your preferences and ensuring you leave Oregon wine country with lasting memories.

Our tours will take you to 3 or 4 wineries (depending on your desire for a slower pace or more experiences) and will include elevated tours if you choose. 

Our wine tour company, Wine History Tours, is centered in the heart of the valley, and our primary drivers are all industry insiders with years of experience and connections. 

This private tour isn't simply about providing a driver, but ushering you into the best experience of Willamette Valley wines and wineries possible. 

McMinnville, Salem, Newberg, Dundee, and other pickup locations are all serviceable.

experiences.title: Willamette Wine Tour from Newberg (Tasting Fees Included)
experiences.description:
Do you want to taste the best wines in Willamette Valley?

Our custom private tours are designed to take couples and groups of friends deep into the heart of Willamette Valley to explore the cult wines, highest-rated wines, and legendary vineyards of Willamette Valley!

We love building unique tours according to your preferences and ensuring you leave Oregon wine country with lasting memories.

Our tours will take you to 3 or 4 wineries (depending on your desire for a slower pace or more experiences) and will include elevated tours if you choose. 

This private tour isn't simply about providing a driver, but ushering you into the best experience of Willamette Valley wines and wineries possible. 

McMinnville, Salem, Newberg, Dundee, and other pickup locations are all serviceable.

experiences.title: Portland Sushi Omakase Tour – 3 Stops, Small Group
experiences.description:
This is Portland’s elevated sushi night out: a small-group, omakase-style progressive dinner across three top sushi spots downtown. Instead of tiny samples, you’ll sit down at each stop for chef-selected dishes—crafted to highlight different styles, cuts, and techniques—so you leave genuinely full and seriously impressed.

Over 2–3 hours, you’ll enjoy a curated progression that can include nigiri, sashimi, specialty rolls, and seasonal plates (selection varies by night). Your guide keeps it fun and approachable while explaining what you’re eating, how to spot quality, and how to order with confidence the next time you’re at a sushi bar.

All food is included, and group size is capped so the experience stays personal and high-touch. —and if you have dietary needs (gluten-free or vegan), message us after booking so we can plan your best possible menu.

Why this is worth it: you’re getting a guided, chef-curated sushi progression at three restaurants in one night—without the guesswork.

experiences.title: Oregon Coast Tour and Wine Tasting From Portland- Full Day Tour
experiences.description: The Oregon coast is one of the most majestic geologic formations that was formed by lava flows millions of years ago. We depart to the coast and have lunch in the charming town of Cannon Beach and do hiking and exploring on the coast. Explore the majestic Oregon coast, view the amazing Haystack Rock formation, and during low tide gaze at starfish and clams. We will also explore Oswald State Park for lite trail walking and see the stunning cliffs of Manzanita point. This is a joinable small group tour for 2 persons or more, door to door service. Please dress for the season, expect a full day beginning 10am and back to Portland by 6pm.

experiences.title: Portland: Wine Tasting + Vinotherapy Tub Soak at The Wine Spa
experiences.description: Experience a unique spa treatment that combines Oregon wine, self-care, and relaxation at the only vinotherapy spa in the United States.

experiences.title: Afternoon Tour in Columbia Gorge Waterfall with Free Wine Tasting
experiences.description: The Columbia Gorge NSA features waterfalls, mountains, monoliths, terraces, resort towns, vineyards, orchards, and The River, harboring a plethora of fish and birds, and unique plants and invertebrates. In the early 1900s, Portlanders would drive their Model T cars along the Columbia River Highway to gaze at waterfalls. There is said to be over 4000 waterfalls; many are hidden away, but many are just a short hike off the Historic Highway. On this afternoon half-day tour you'll make new friends while exploring "waterfall alley", including views of the Vista House and a stop at Multnomah Falls, the tallest waterfall in Oregon and most visited site in the Pacific Northwest. Your expert guide will teach you about the natural history, cultural history, and wine background of the area, as you drive the Historic Columbia River Highway Scenic Byway. You'll continue on to stop at a vineyard in the Columbia Gorge American Viticultural Area (AVA). Tasting fees included.

experiences.title: Bean to Bar Chocolate Making and Tasting Tour
experiences.description: No other experience in Bend lets you travel the globe through chocolate. The chocolate experts guide you through the entire bean to bar journey, from how we source directly from small farms to the small-batch roasting techniques that preserve each origin's distinct character. Be welcomed with a mug of house-made hot cocoa, then explore the global cocoa story told by the people who live it every day. Learn how soil, climate, and region shape every bar, from fruity Peruvian beans to earthy Indonesian cacao. Then take the craft into your own hands and pour your own bar from warm, liquid single-origin chocolate to take home. Close with a guided tasting flight of the award-winning lineup — comparing the terroir of multiple cacao-growing regions side by side, just as a sommelier would explore fine wines. Taste the world's finest single-origin cacao in one sitting, then shop the full collection at guest-exclusive pricing.

experiences.title: All-Inclusive Downtown Portland Food Tour
experiences.description:
Explore the essential food and drinks at the heart of downtown Portland, Oregon on this all-inclusive walking tour led by an experienced, professional, Portland-native guide and standup comedian. Meet local vendors and hear their stories while getting inside knowledge about the city, its history, its food, and its identity. This is your insider access to some of the best-known and best-hidden bites that define downtown.

This tour is operated by a small local business, and due to our lean business model and relationship to other local small businesses, we are capable of offering unrivaled value and flexibility.

experiences.title: Portland Food Carts, Pods and Patios Tour
experiences.description:
Discover what the food cart hype is all about in the city invented food cart pods! With over 1000 food carts throughout the city, let us take you around to some of the best and taste the delicious foods that make Portland a true foodie destination. On this walking tour, you’ll discover global foods, quench your thirst with tasty drinks, and learn fun history in this colorful neighborhood. We like to think this is the perfect way to discover quirky Portland, eat where the locals eat, and have fun! 

Tour highlights: 
- Try hearty servings of food and beverages from 5-7 different food carts. You'll get more than a full meal!
- Learn all about Portland food cart culture. (We don't call them trucks for a reason.)
- Try a selection of diverse food like Slavic, Mexican, Bavarian, and Burmese delights.
- Discover Portland’s historic, off-the-beaten-path Eastside neighborhood to check out the local street art.

experiences.title: Downtown Portland Coffee and Donut Tour
experiences.description:
Jumpstart your morning with a huge variety of coffee and donuts across 4-5 mouthwatering stops where each bite and sip was crafted right here in Portland. Along the way, immerse yourself in quirky history while exploring Downtown Portland. We like to think this the perfect way to discover Downtown Portland, see where locals get their coffee and donut fix, and have fun!

Tour highlights: 
- Taste two single-origin coffees brewed by pour-over, side by side.
- Portland has over 75 locally owned donut shops, and we’ll sample a selection of the best from our favorite. 
- Stand in Pioneer Courthouse Square and learn all about “Portland’s Living Room”.
- At the coziest Portland hole-in-the-wall café, indulge in a traditional macchiato paired with a homemade French pastry.
- Plus much more! 

Note: We do not visit Voodoo or Blue Star during this tour as they are on the common tourist track – instead we keep it local.

experiences.title: Portland Urban Wine Tasting Tour
experiences.description:
Taste your way through Oregon’s renowned wine scene right in the heart of Portland! Try a variety of wine varietals and savor delicious bites, all while exploring the vibrant Pearl and Slabtown neighborhoods. 

What makes this wine tour special? We’ve met with the wine experts themselves and did all the research for you, so the tastings and snacks are curated and included. You’ll try 10+ wines at two winery tasting rooms plus one wine bar, including a variety of white, rosé, and red, and snack small bite pairings. 

Highlights: 
- Taste 4 Oregon wines paired with artisan popcorn at an approachable winery while learning why Oregon wine is special.
- Explore 2 trendy Portland neighborhoods, blending old and modern architecture with rich history.
- Dine on bruschetta paired with wine at a family-run winery.
- End your evening sipping Bordeaux in a secret wine bar where you might just uncover a hidden surprise.
- Learn from your tour guide and wine experts.

*This tour is 21+ ONLY.

experiences.title: Portland Oregon Foodie Field Trip By Bike and E-bike
experiences.description: Arrive hungry and experience a variety of flavors from local hotspots in Portland, Oregon. Learn about the bustling culinary scene as well as the “localvore” philosophy that drives it. Indulge your taste buds and ride with us on this classic Portland experience.

experiences.title: Portland's Original Delicious Donut Adventure & Walking Food Tour
experiences.description:
We've always had a passion for donuts, but only recently did we realize just how many others do too. And when looking around, we didn't see anything that truly celebrated donuts in all their glory, hence the Underground Donut Tour was born. This tour is for anyone who truly enjoys donuts. At each location, you'll be able to try a curated sample of one of that location's best donuts. Many locations offer vegan, gluten, or nut-free options, however, please make sure to let us know ahead of the tour, so we can make sure to highlight those specifically for you. Our tours include such favorites as Coco Donuts, Blue Star Donuts, Nola Doughnuts, Voodoo Doughnuts, and more. 

We also offer much more information about the route, the city, the stops, and more.

We hope you can join us!

experiences.title: Coffee Roasters of Portland Eastside Walking Tour
experiences.description:
Our small group Eastside Coffee Roaster walking tour takes you to the makers who have called the neighborhood their home for decades, each with a different approach to coffee roasting and brewing. Across from downtown Portland, the industrial neighborhood has transformed from manufacturing and warehouses to the heart of passionate creators: artists, chocolate makers, food innovators, and every kind of free spirit.

Portland has the most coffee roasters of any city in the world, and we would argue some of the most earnest and unique origins and barista artistry is happening right where Around Portland Tours makes its home.

The tour in total is 1.5-3 miles (2-5 km) of walking, tasting and learning. You'll also discover a lot about Portland and how these artisans are nourished. We keep groups small, so you'll have an intimate experience with your passionate guides. Ask about larger private groups.
