On select nights, join us and discover the darker side of Charleston, while enjoying some liquid courage along the way. You'll visit some of the best local bars and pubs, and make stops at historical and haunted locations in between. From the origins of the Blind Tiger Pub's name, to the ghosts of St. Philip's Graveyard and experiences at the Angel Oak, we have you covered for a hauntingly good time!

experiences.title: Charleston's Savor the Flavors of Upper King Street Walking Food Tour
experiences.description:
See what the Upper King Street fuss is all about with this relatively new tour featuring bites from the trendy neighborhood’s most delicious spots. Experience the unique Savor the Flavors food tour in the famous Upper King Street district. Sample mouth-watering dishes of Lowcountry cuisine from the popular culinary innovators in this ever-evolving restaurant district. Come join Charleston’s original food tour company as we enjoy what Charleston’s best Upper King Street restaurants are bringing to the table. 

Please note this tour is seafood heavy and not recommended for travelers with allergies.

experiences.title: Polynesian Fire Luau and Dinner Show Ticket in Myrtle Beach
experiences.description:
Polynesian Fire Luau is one of the hottest shows in Myrtle Beach. The entertainment event features performers from different Polynesian Isles, just for the Luau. Your evening begins with a lei greeting by dancers. 

Then enjoy a buffet dinner accompanied with live music by our Polynesian band! After dinner, the show which highlights songs and dances from the different Polynesian cultures of Hawaii, Tahiti, Tonga, New Zealand and Samoa, begins. The night ends with an amazing performance by our World Champion Samoan Fire Knife Team.

Check in time is half hour prior to start time and the address is:
St John's Inn
6803 N Ocean Blvd, Myrtle Beach

experiences.title: Savor the Flavors of Charleston Walking Food Tour
experiences.description:
Walk, talk and taste your way through historic Charleston South Carolina. This 2.5 hour Charleston food tour immerses you in the history and culture of the Lowcountry and reveals how our unique cuisine has evolved over the past 300+ years. Menu and routes change daily, expect a serving of lowcountry favorites.

***PLEASE NOTE: If there are any food allergies in your party, we must know at least 48 hours in advance or some restaurants may not be able to accommodate. We also can't guarantee there will be a substitution at every location due to some allergies.

experiences.title: Charleston Upper King Street Food Tour
experiences.description:
This Upper King Street Culinary Tour is provided by CHARLESTON CULINARY TOURS, the longest-running food tour company in Charleston. This 2.5-hour tour offers insight into Charleston's Upper King Street neighborhood (named as one of the top 10 food neighborhoods in America), showcasing four of Charleston's culinary innovators who exemplify cooking in the New South.

The Upper King Street district has emerged as an area with tremendous energy; showcasing culinary innovation, experimental design, and exuberant nightlife. The restaurants featured on the food tour are trailblazers in Charleston's culinary scene, edgy and innovative, with tremendous passion for their craft. This Upper King Street tour is designed to show off the modern and eclectic side of the Lowcountry while providing insight into Charleston's ever-changing culinary scene.

experiences.title: Speakeasy Sagas - Charleston Prohibition Pub Crawl
experiences.description:
Step back into the shadows of the 1920s, when Charleston was a city of contradictions—charming on the surface, rebellious underneath. On the Speakeasy Sagas Pub Crawl, you’ll walk the very streets where bootleggers dodged federal agents, secret bars buzzed behind locked doors.

During Prohibition, alcohol was outlawed—but in Charleston, the party never really stopped. This wasn’t just a city of Southern charm and steeples. It was a city of hidden rooms, rumrunners, and lawmen who conveniently looked the other way. From elegant society scandals to rowdy waterfront crime, this tour reveals the untold story of Charleston’s wild side. Along the way, stop at hand-picked pubs where you can enjoy your favorite modern cocktails (not included in tour price) in the Holy City with a refusal to stay dry.

experiences.title: Bay Street Bastards Pub Crawl Shared Tour in Charleston
experiences.description:
History never tasted so wicked! A bone-chilling dive into the criminal heart of Charleston—a city steeped in elegance, drenched in secrets, and soaked in blood. From the cobblestones of colonial corruption to the courtrooms of a sensational modern-day murder, this tour serves up centuries of true crime with a twist of lime and a shot of audacity.

Led by our fearless guides, you’ll prowl the streets where con men, killers, and crooked aristocrats once ruled, stopping at some of Charleston’s finest bars to sip your way through its most scandalous chapters. You’ll uncover tales that Charleston would rather leave buried— tabloid-worthy tragedies that still echo through the alleyways.

Thirsty? Good. You’ll need a strong drink for what you’re about to hear. Cocktails are available for purchase at every stop—because dark stories go down better with a stiff pour.

If you have 7 or more guests in one group, please get in touch with our the private & group sales coordinator.

experiences.title: Charleston Sunset Blues & BBQ Dinner Cruise
experiences.description: Join us aboard the Charleston Princess for a fantastic evening cruise. We have partnered with a variety of local and regional musicians for a fantastic cruise featuring amazing live music, breathtaking views of the "Holy City" and a delicious BBQ buffet! Please keep in mind that while this started with Blues music more than 17 years ago, we are now offering different genres throughout the season! The delicious buffet includes pulled pork, smoked chicken, mac & cheese, cole slaw, buns and sauces on side, tea and water. Fully stocked cash bar on board! This cruise is perfect for date night, groups of friends, group outings, or any occasion. We are now in our 17th season and look forward to another great year!

experiences.title: Charleston Historic Downtown Food Tour
experiences.description:
Savor the very best of the Lowcountry on a unique Charleston food tour designed for true foodies. Our family-run business has crafted a curated culinary experience giving you guaranteed line-skipping access to top restaurants in Historic Downtown. 

Indulge in iconic Southern classics, including:

- Rich and creamy She-Crab Soup
- A slow-cooked, savory BBQ Slider
- Tender, seasoned Collard Greens
- Warm, golden Cornbread
- A decadent Daily Special Cake

As you walk off your tastings along beautiful cobblestone streets, an expert local guide uncovers the deep history behind landmarks like the Old Exchange Building and the Pineapple Fountain at Waterfront Park. Discover where locals actually eat, learn the complex history of Southern spices, and enjoy a full meal's worth of world-class cuisine.

(Note: Child tickets ages 0-6 does not include food).

experiences.title: DIY Candle Making Class at a Local Brewery in Charleston
experiences.description: Swap the usual “what should we do today?” debate for a fun, hands-on candle making class hosted at a trendy local brewery in Charleston. In this hands-on experience, Instructor Hannah Rose will guide you step by step as you design and pour your own custom candle. You’ll explore different scents, learn how fragrance, wax and wicks work together and create a candle that feels completely personal. And the best news? No experience is needed. Get ready for an experience that is creative, relaxing and way more memorable than sitting through another average happy hour. This class is ideal for couples looking for a unique date night, friends planning a girls’ night out, solo guests who want a calming creative escape and travelers searching for a local activity beyond the typical sightseeing list. Come for the cozy atmosphere, stay for the joy of making something with your own hands and leave with a custom candle that feels totally you.

experiences.title: Single Barrel Tasting Experience
experiences.description: This is a unique bourbon tasting experience typically reserved for private barrel clubs and full barrel picks. Sample four cask strength bourbons straight from the barrel with the option to choose your favorite bottles to purchase and bring home.

experiences.title: Full-Day Private Bike Tour of Mickelson Trail and Brewery
experiences.description: Get off the beaten path and onto your bike to see the real beauty of the Black Hills! This day tour takes you to some of the quieter and most beautiful areas of the Mickelson trail (where the locals ride) and a taste of South Dakotan produce. A true balance of effort and reward and a great day out! We give the option to stop at one of few breweries up in the Hill City area, with the outdoor Lost Cabin Beer Garden at the Mickelson Trail Burlington Trailhead being a favorite.

experiences.title: Private - Badlands Rugged Jeep Backcountry Tour with Lunch
experiences.description: Duration: 6–8 hours (Full Day)Start/End: Rapid City or Interior, SDActivity Level: Easy to ModerateGroup Size: Maximum 6 guests per JeepInclusions: Guided 4x4 transport, park park entry fees, bottled water, and a complete picnic lunch

experiences.title: Downtown Sioux Falls Food Tour
experiences.description: Saturday food tours are a collection of tastes from different restaurants and breweries in Downtown Sioux Falls. Join us for the history of the city and some amazing bites that might surprise you.

experiences.title: Nashville Barrel Co: Blend Your Own Whiskey — Bottle Included
experiences.description: Craft a one-of-a-kind whiskey during a 60-minute blending session at the Nashville Barrel Company. Guided by award-winning experts, taste various whiskey profiles, experiment with different mashbills, and create a unique blend tailored to your palate. Adjust the proof to your liking and leave with a custom-labeled bottle that embodies your personal touch. Perfect for bachelorette parties, anniversaries, or team-building events, this interactive experience ensures each participant walks away with a distinct whiskey that represents their creativity.

experiences.title: Cocktails and Conversations: Chattanooga Cocktail Making Class
experiences.description:
Shake, stir, and sip your way through one of Chattanooga’s most interactive culinary experiences. 

Our Craft Cocktail Making Class goes beyond simply following recipes—guests learn the techniques, history, and flavor science behind creating exceptional cocktails while enjoying a hands-on experience led by knowledgeable mixologists.

Unlike a standard bar tasting, this immersive class allows participants to step behind the bar, work with premium ingredients, and master professional bartending skills they can recreate at home. 

Perfect for couples, friends, corporate groups, and travelers looking for a unique local experience, this engaging class blends education, entertainment, and plenty of delicious cocktails into an unforgettable experience. 

A recipe card of the class' 2-cocktail creation is included for all attendees.

experiences.title: Suzy Wongs Drag n Brunch Food and Show Included
experiences.description:
Ladies and gentlemen, it's show time! Experience a new way to brunch at Suzy Wong's Drag'n Brunch in Nashville every Friday--Sunday. We are the ONLY Food-Inclusive Drag Brunch in Nashville! We also have the ability to celebrate any Special Occasion for you or members of your party. 
Whether you're celebrating a Birthday, Bachelorette/Bachelor weekend, Going-Away party, Graduation, Divorce, or you just need an excuse to day drink with friends, Suzy Wong's is an unforgettable Nashville drag brunch experience. We are not a traditional restaurant!

experiences.title: Belle Meade Bourbon Mixology Experience
experiences.description:
Craft your own signature cocktail using the rich flavors of Belle Meade Bourbon in this immersive mixology experience. Led by a certified Bourbon Steward, participants explore a selection of seasonal juices, handcrafted syrups, and aromatic bitters while learning the art of mixing and shaking.

This hands-on adventure culminates in your very own custom drink, presented in unique Belle Meade drinkware, along with a take-home recipe card. Ideal for bourbon enthusiasts and novices alike, this experience blends creativity with expert guidance in a historic setting.

experiences.title: Big Machine Distillery Guided Distillery Tour With Tastings
experiences.description: Experience the Spirit of Tennessee, where tradition meets innovation in idyllic Lynnville, TN. Explore our diverse range of spirits, from our craft Tennessee Whiskey to our New American Style gin, and small-batch bourbons. Whether you're a connoisseur seeking sophistication or an adventurer craving new flavors, there's something for everyone.

experiences.title: Nashville Street Food Tour With A Local Guide
experiences.description: Embark on a flavorful adventure through East Nashville and 12South with our guided culinary tour, where you'll experience the best of Southern cuisine and trendy eateries. Taste delights like catfish tacos, Tennessee whiskey glazed donuts, and pulled pork while discovering the rich culinary traditions of Nashville. Your knowledgeable guide will lead you to iconic landmarks, including Dolly Parton's studio, and share fascinating stories about the city’s musical heritage. Perfect for food enthusiasts and culture seekers alike, this tour offers an immersive dive into Nashville's vibrant food scene and history.

experiences.title: Nashville Barrel Co Premium Tasting Experience with Guide
experiences.description: You will get to taste offerings that are limited and rare with a guided whiskey expert. You will get to try whiskey straight from the barrel that will include Rye and Bourbon.

experiences.title: Nelson's Green Brier Distillery Guided Tour with Tastings
experiences.description:
​​Digging into the past didn’t turn up skeletons and scandals for brothers Andy and Charlie Nelson; more like sour mash and stills. After discovering their triple great grandfather was one of the most successful whiskey distillers in pre-prohibition America, the brothers vowed to revive the since-forgotten family business. If you’re into sunken ships and lost gold, a woman running a distillery before women could vote and the rebirth of a Nashville business after 100 years, you’ll be sucked into this story.
Sample gold medal award-winning Nelson’s Green Brier Tennessee Whiskey, the spirit based on the wheated mash bill recipe for Tennessee’s oldest whiskey and mellowed in a sugar maple charcoal bed. Taste the perfected blends of two, modern-day, straight bourbon whiskeys crafted by the Nelson Brothers, and finish your tasting with strong and sweet Louisa’s coffee caramel pecan liqueur.

experiences.title: Nashville Barrel Co "Straight from Barrel" Tasting with Bottle
experiences.description: Nashville Barrel Co leads the way on Bourbon experiences. We offer this Single Barrel Experience that is the first of it's kind. In the past, you had to be a store or bar to go pick your own barrel of whiskey. We made the same experience open to everyone and without the commitment to have to buy the entire barrel. You get a bottle from the favorite!

experiences.title: Downtown Nashville Food Tour: Bites Beyond Broadway
experiences.description:
Embark on a 3-hour culinary adventure with 5 unforgettable tasting stops. Savor a diverse range of local flavors, from elevated Southern classics to comforting favorites, all crafted with seasonal ingredients.

As you stroll through the vibrant streets of Nashville, your guide will reveal fascinating history and hidden gems even locals don’t know. Between bites, you’ll discover iconic landmarks like the historic Ryman Auditorium and the architectural grandeur of the Schermerhorn Symphony Center, all while uncovering stories that blend Nashville’s storied past with its dynamic present.

Whether you’re a first-time visitor craving an authentic taste of Nashville or a local eager to reconnect with the city’s evolution, this tour promises a one-of-a-kind journey. Book now and explore the heart of Music City like never before!

experiences.title: Learn Cocktail Design from Nashville's Bartender Guild President
experiences.description:
Most cocktail classes stop at recipes. Tennessee Whiskey Workshop digs deeper. This is storytelling stitched into hospitality, where Tennessee Whiskey isn’t just poured—it’s unpacked, demystified, and celebrated. You’ll use professional bar tools to create three original Old Fashioned variations, but what sets this apart is the atmosphere: no scripts, no ego, just a host who’s lived and breathed Nashville’s bar culture for 25+ years.

Set in the private Tank Room at Love & Exile, the workshop is intimate, welcoming, and rooted in Southern hospitality. Guests walk away not just with new skills, but with the kind of confidence, perspective, and insider connection that makes Nashville feel like more than a stop on the map. This is cocktail education with character—part storytelling, part hands-on craft, part Eastside magic.

experiences.title: Create Your Own Custom Perfume or Cologne Workshop in Nashville
experiences.description: Tijon is a unique make-your-own fragrance experience not found elsewhere. Original location is on the French side of the island of St. Martin.

experiences.title: Nashville Barrel Co "Flight from the Barrel" Whiskey Tasting
experiences.description: Get the chance to try whiskey straight from the barrel at cask strength! You will get to pick from Bourbon, Rye, Tennessee Whiskey, Rum and agave!

experiences.title: The Ultimate Wine, Shine & Bourbon Experience
experiences.description:
Check out our reviews! This is an experience not offered like any other and cannot be experienced the same way on your own. Visit multiple distilleries...not just one! We created this tour to share our passion of local (SMALL BUSINESS) moonshine and wine locations! 

People love this tour because you will be visiting as friends! From private VIP backstage to sampling, its all included!

I will be showing you real life working stills and getting behind the scenes where people can't go. You will be treated as VIP guests at all the locations we visit. 

During our walk we will have a couple of stopping points where we will go over the fun (NOT DRY) history and tidbits of moonshine and of course talk about "how the old-timers did it".

This tour will be action packed for the full 3 hours you are with me with the goal of trying different wines and over 15 different flavors of all proofs and even a moonshine cocktail!

- Mobility scooter accessible

experiences.title: Nashville's Sweetest Food Tour: Taste Nashville's Best Donuts
experiences.description:
Our tour begins in the Sobro (South of Broadway) neighborhood at Parlor Doughnuts, one of the newest editions to the area. Here we’ll try some of their amazing donuts, featured above. After that, we’ll take a leisurely walk through downtown, stopping along the way to talk about the major entertainment district along Broadway. We’ll then continue our way to two amazing donut shops in the Arts District. We’ll end our tour at Donut Distillery in the Assembly Food Hall, which has plenty of options for delicious donuts, as well as other amazing food and drinks. 

This is one of our most fun tours for friends, family, locals, and visitors. Also - if you’re planning a bachelor or bachelorette party, please let us know. We also have special packages available to make your day even more amazing. Hope to see you soon!

experiences.title: Sip History in Music City Cocktail Making Class
experiences.description:
Combines hands-on bartending with a journey through the city's storied bootlegging and cocktail history. In your intimate retro bar setting, you'll shake and stir three different cocktails with guidance from a local expert, learn the stories behind Tennessee whiskey and other spirits, and enjoy curated bar snacks.

Every guest has the chance to step behind a real bar and make a cocktail! (3 cocktails included). Be ready for jokes, stories, history, pro tips on drinks, and interactive drink making.

experiences.title: Walking Food & Drink Tour of Downtown Nashville
experiences.description:
Experience downtown Nashville through the eyes of a local on this award-winning 3 to 3.5-hour walking food tour. Recognized by Tripadvisor as one of the Top 1% of Experiences Worldwide, A Little Local Flavor has welcomed 23,000+ guests, earned 2,700+ five-star reviews, and helped direct nearly $1.5 million to locally owned Nashville businesses.

Come hungry! Visit 6 locally owned restaurants and tasting rooms as you savor Tennessee barbecue, shrimp and grits, a locally brewed beer, two handcrafted cocktails, and a tasting at a local distillery. Dine at a James Beard Award semifinalist, explore one of downtown Nashville's most historic venues, hear the stories behind iconic landmarks, and soak in the city's legendary live music.

Generous tastings add up to a hearty meal. Every stop is locally owned, every dish is made from scratch, and our passionate local guides share insider stories and recommendations to help you experience Nashville like a local.

experiences.title: Downtown Chattanooga Food Tour
experiences.description: Chatt Taste Food Tours, LLC showcases the transformation of dining and local businesses in Downtown Chattanooga through guided food tours. Visit 3-4 restaurants locations effortlessly for the same amount of time and money as a conventional dining experience. With the surge of available eateries, Chatt Taste has dubbed this era as "Chattanooga's Culinary Renaissance". Since our start, Chatt Taste has been identified as a TOP 10 Food Tour in the country based on a USA Today poll.

experiences.title: Nashville 12South District Authentic Food Tour with 7 Tastings
experiences.description:
Traverse Nashville’s most iconic corridor where residential charm meets high-end Southern chic. Our 12 South Food Tour is a curated stroll through a district that has transformed from a quiet suburb into a world-class destination for fashion and country music royalty.

Walk in the footsteps of legends. As we wander down vibrant 12th Avenue, you’ll feel the creative pulse of a neighborhood shaped by stars like Sheryl Crow, Reese Witherspoon, and Dolly Parton. We’ll pause for essential photos at the legendary Nash Angel wings and the original "I Believe in Nashville" Mural, symbols of a community that prides itself on local grit and global style.

A Deep Dive into Local History. Explore historic landmarks like the 1920s-era Waverly Belmont Elementary and the lush greenery of Sevier Park, home to the historic Sunnyside Mansion.

An Elevated Narrative of Flavor. Our gastronomy is a sophisticated reflection of Nashville's communal culture.

experiences.title: Nashville's Goo Goo Chocolate Tasting & Candy Making Class
experiences.description: With a local instructor as your host, you’ll learn all about America’s first combination candy bar and it’s significance to Nashville history. As part of the class, you’ll get to taste several types of chocolate and try a sample of this beloved Tennessee treat. All guests take part in a hands-on candy making session where you design your own Premium Goo Goo, choosing from a plethora of ingredients.

experiences.title: Nashville: Authentic Food Tour with 5 Tastings of Local Dishes
experiences.description:
East Nashville has always done things its own way. Five Points and Historic East Edgefield grew back from the 1916 Great Fire with Victorian streets, an arts corridor, and a food scene rooted in Tennessee tradition. Your tour starts at Hunter's Station, a former automotive garage on Main Street, and moves through blocks shaped by the same spirit of reinvention. The food follows: Double Cheese Burger, a 2-Bone Rib (Southern style), Bee Bite (Yemeni Honey Pastries), Nashville hot chicken, a crispy catfish taco, and a Secret Dish kept under wraps until you're there.

12SOUTH - Uncover the city's trendiest avenue with our guides. Explore vibrant streets boasting cool coffee shops, stylish eateries, and restored buildings. Discover unique shops and maybe even a celebrity-frequented dress store. Indulge in the finest local bites and drinks during this exciting adventure!

experiences.title: Taste of Downtown Memphis Food Tour
experiences.description: There’s no better way to get acquainted with Memphis than by tasting some of its most acclaimed foods.  You’ll sample the very best of Memphis cuisine from BBQ nachos to southern tamales to delectable desserts. Memphis offers a plethora of choices from delicious and historic family-owned, local restaurants to trendy award winning Chefs. We provide a local, sustainable experience tasting a variety of foods, allowing you to feel like a native Memphian.  Your guide will provide a sampling of culture and history sprinkled throughout this walking tour. 2 person minimum per booking

experiences.title: Brewery Hop-On Hop-Off Trolley Tour of Nashville
experiences.description:
Travel in a vintage trolley on a convenient 1-hour loop for a Nashville beer tour unlike any other. Hop on/off at your brewery picks!

Music City’s only hop-on hop-off trolley brewery tour includes unlimited rides the day of your ticket to explore the Nashville beer scene. With 7 different brewery stops on our 1-hour loop you are sure to find something for everyone. We visit Honeytree Meadery, Stoke Haus Brewing & BBQ, Tailgate East, Xul Beer Co., East Nashville Beer Works, Bearded Iris Brewing and Monday Night Preservation Society.

We make it easy to visit your choice of local unique neighborhood craft breweries providing safe, responsible, and fun transportation on your schedule. Hop-on and start your day at any of the 7 stops on our loop.

PLEASE NOTE: We only depart once from downtown each day (Omni Hotel Nashville/5th Ave side) and return several times in the evening. Our downtown departure is at 11:50am (daily). 
You can also meet us at ANY brewery on our tour and start there!

experiences.title: Taste of Nashville Food & Sightseeing Tour
experiences.description:
On this fun and delicious tour, sample the best of Nashville's classic cuisine and visit some amazing places along the way. We'll enjoy a frosty local cocktail, taste hand-made spirits, visit a bakery with a history, enjoy Centennial Park, where you'll learn about the Parthenon, Vanderbilt, and more. Experience whole-hog barbecue at it's very best and learn the secrets that make it so amazing. Feel the heat with authentic Nashville Hot Chicken. Lots of food, fun, and local insights! 

Along the way, you'll see sights such as the Capitol, Bicentennial Mall, Sounds stadium, Germantown, the Cumberland River, Marathon Village, East Nashville's Five Points, Nissan Stadium, and much more!

We may substitute or alter the specific stops and foods, based on daily closures or events.

Travel in our comfortable high-roof touring van with a knowledgeable and fun local guide. The very best way to experience Nashville's neighborhoods, history, and amazing local foods!

experiences.title: Private Small Group Nashville Food & Sightseeing Tour
experiences.description: Enjoy Nashville's favorite foods and a private sightseeing tour exclusively for your group. Visit Nashville neighborhoods and landmarks with your private guide, and sample our quintessential foods along the way. Discover the food, fun, and facts that make Nashville a unique and fascinating city! Along the way, sample our signature Nashville Hot Chicken, Whole-hog BBQ, our own frosty alcohol milkshake, and the quirky and local neighborhoods that showcase Nashville's creativity. BYOB on the van! It's fun, social, and delicious!

experiences.title: Nashville's Big Machine Distillery Guided Tour with Tastings
experiences.description:
Centered in the heart of downtown Nashville, at The Big Machine Brewery & Distillery you can get a taste of Nashville like no other. Here we are home to hand-crafted spirits: Big Machine Platinum Filtered Vodka, Double Spiked Coolers, Clayton James Tennessee Whiskey, Abernathy Gin, All Mighty Moonshine, and more!

Experience how our custom Platinum filter reinvents vodka as you know it! As the only distillery in the United States to use such technology, we bring the vodka tasting experience to new levels creating The Smoothest Tasting Vodka, Period!

Join us at Big Machine and experience the platinum standard!

experiences.title: Sip History in a Secret Speakeasy with Drinks Included
experiences.description:
Join a 2-hour interactive cocktail class in Nashville. Learn to make 3 cocktails, enjoy a performative history lesson, and discover local drink history in a speakeasy setting.

Full description
Step into the legendary Golden Sound in the Gulch, a retro recording studio turned Speakeasy, and be transported to an era of moonshine, flappers and speakeasy secrets.

Begin with a charismatic cocktail expert who combines storytelling, booze news, and local drink history with pro tips on making better drinks.

Learn about Nashville’s rich alcohol and cocktail history, including tales of Al Capone’s bootlegging escapades through Printers Alley during Prohibition.

Enjoy three cocktails and basic bar snacks as you immerse yourself in this interactive experience. Whether you’re a bachelorette party looking to let loose or a couple wanting to elevate your cocktail game, this is the perfect experience for you.

experiences.title: Downtown Nashville Food Tour With Sidewalk Food Tours
experiences.description:
Join us on a 3-hour food walking tour of Downtown Nashville (The Gulch) On your eating extravaganza, you will savor amazingly delicious foods from 5 unique restaurants, eateries, and bakeries. 

In addition to all the mouthwatering foods you'll be enjoying, your guide will discuss the history, culture, and food scene of the neighborhood. We tell the story of Downtown Nashville through its food and the people who prepare it. Lace-up your sneakers and come eat with us on an eating adventure through Downtown Nashville (The Gulch)

experiences.title: Tennessee Whiskey Experience: Bus Tour with 11+ Whiskey Tastings
experiences.description:
The Tennessee Whiskey Experience is your chance to go beyond the big names and explore the heart of the state’s craft distilling scene. This small-group tour visits three award-winning, locally loved distilleries, each offering a different take on Tennessee spirits — including whiskey, bourbon, and other spirits.

You’ll enjoy guided tastings at each stop, transportation in a comfortable tour vehicle, and insights from a local guide who knows their whiskey and the region’s history. Along the way, you’ll get a behind-the-scenes look at how Tennessee whiskey is made — from grain to glass — in places most tourists don’t discover on their own.

This is a great choice for guests looking for something authentic, relaxed, and off the beaten path. Whether you’re a whiskey connoisseur or just curious to try something new, this tour gives you a full taste of what Tennessee spirits are all about — without having to worry about a single detail.

experiences.title: Jack Daniel's Distillery Tour from Nashville + Whiskey Tastings
experiences.description:
This whiskey tour is rolling straight into Lynchburg from Nashville. You can hop on the bus, kick back, and enjoy the ride to the historic and picturesque Jack Daniel's Distillery. You'll have time to peruse downtown Lynchburg, just a 5-minute walk from the distillery, and grab a quick bite to eat. We've got some suggestions! Don't forget to stop in the White Rabbit Bottle Shop and grab some limited bottles of whiskey.

DISCLAIMER: The 12:00 PM tours WILL NOT have time to explore or eat lunch in Lynchburg. We highly recommend eating lunch prior to pick up.

experiences.title: Nashville's Speakeasy Secrets: Murder True Crime Cocktail Crawl
experiences.description:
Avoid Broadway. Step into the hidden world of Nashville's underground past.

Speakeasy Secrets takes you behind unmarked doors and into three of the city's most exclusive speakeasies and underground bars.

This isn't a bar crawl. It's a VIP evening of hidden rooms, signature cocktails, and the true crime stories soaked into Nashville's Prohibition past.

Luxury without the attitude. History with a chaser.

Ready to sip in secret?

experiences.title: Premier Distillery & Craft Brewery Bus Tour with 9+ Tastings
experiences.description:
Nashville's most talked about local distillery and craft brewery tasting experience. 

Music City craft brewery and distillery scene is booming! Let us show you around our favorite spots and flavors. Our Craft Brewery & Distillery Tasting experience stops at 3-4 locations, such as Nashville Barrel Company and Big Machine Distillery, that create Middle Tennessee’s best beers, bourbons, whiskey and vodka.

No drinking and driving! We provide transportation with our tour guides throughout the Tour & Tasting experience. 

Tour involves 9-12 samples and transportation is provided from 1st location to the last location. 

Distillery and brewery locations are subject to change. When booking this tour, there may be variations in the locations visited. We will always visit at least 3 places and we will always have a great time!

experiences.title: Music City Food, Drink, Sightseeing Walking Tour along Broadway
experiences.description: Your Nashville Food & Sightseeing Walking Tour provides a 3-hour overview of history, landmarks, and delicious food and drink! Explore the downtown Honky Tonk District of Broadway on foot and fuel your 3-hour, 1.5 mile journey with some tasty treats along the way! We’ll sample delicious local foods, a little beer and/or a cocktail, specialty confections, and more as we share history, architecture, and local lore with you.

experiences.title: Guided Pub Crawl Walking Tour of Downtown Nashville
experiences.description: Music City Pub Crawl is Nashville's oldest and most coveted bar crawl, with attendees from all across the globe! Guests are taken to a slew of unique watering holes off the beaten path of touristy Broadway, each with exclusive drink specials only available to our pub crawlers! All the while, our world-class tour guides combine hysterical & intriguing local history with a heaping pile of friendly competition and a plethora of interactive, Nashville-themed games & activities to keep guests entertained and on their toes! Our general groups run every day and are legendary for spurring camaraderie. By the end of the tour, it's very difficult to tell who arrived with whom. Music City Pub Crawl is perfect for guests of all ages, and one that's ideal for individuals, couples, birthday parties, family gatherings, bachelor & bachelorette parties, and corporate events! Given our low price point and tour duration (2.5+ hours), our pub crawl tours are the best deal in Nashville!

experiences.title: Famous Moonshine & Wine Tour From Pigeon Forge
experiences.description:
Ready for a real taste of the Smoky Mountains? Join our Moonshine & Wine Tour and discover why we get voted the #1 tour company year after year! We're not just tour guides; we're true locals with generations of history in the area, & we've been sharing our passion for local spirits since 2015.

This isn't just a tour; it's a 4-hour tasting adventure. With your friendly & professional guide, you'll travel through the scenic downtowns of Pigeon Forge & Sevierville, visiting up to 8 different places. We visit more locations than anyone else, ensuring you get the full flavor of Tennessee.

Get ready to embrace the legendary kick of authentic, old-fashioned Tennessee moonshine. You'll sample a wide showcase of unique flavors straight from the stills of our finest local distilleries.

Savor the smooth, sophisticated nature of quality wines. From crisp whites to bold reds, you'll get to experience the best of our local wineries

Book your spot soon because we always sell out!

experiences.title: Belle Meade Guided Mansion Tour with Complimentary Wine Tasting
experiences.description: History and hospitality...two words that have been at the foundation of Belle Meade for over 200 years. In the 1800s, Belle Meade was one of the largest and wealthiest private estates in Nashville, raising the nation's finest thoroughbred race horses. Having hosted celebrities, presidents, generals, and a wealth of revered turfmen, Belle Meade became Nashville's first attraction. Located just seven miles west of downtown Nashville, today this sanctuary of Southern hospitality offers Guided Tours, Food and Wine Pairings, Bourbon Tastings, outstanding Gift Shops, Nashville's first Winery, an on-site Restaurant, an Outdoor Game Court, and some of the most beautiful Grounds in Nashville.

experiences.title: Haunted Spirits: Nashville's True Crime Ghostly Pub Crawl
experiences.description:
Tour Nashville’s Most Haunted Bars and uncover the tales of murder and mayhem that have rocked Music City for decades.

Led by local storytellers and paranormal pros, you’ll sip your way through haunted honky-tonks and historic pubs where infamous murders took place and restless spirits are said to linger.

This isn’t your average pub crawl. You’ll hear true crime tales and local legends you won’t find anywhere else—mobsters on Music Row, speakeasy secrets in Printer’s Alley, and cold cases that still haunt the city.

Whether you're a ghost hunter, a true crime junkie, or just looking for a dangerously fun night out, this haunted pub crawl delivers.

Come thirsty. Leave haunted.

experiences.title: Germantown Neighborhood Food & Sightseeing Walking Tour
experiences.description: Sample local meats, locally produced spirits, handmade chocolates and unique specialty foods while you exploring the historic neighborhood of Germantown on our walking food and cultural tour.  Germantown is Nashville's oldest neighborhood and one of its newest and trendiest redeveloped areas. Its brick-lined streets, Victorian homes, and quaint shops have been updated to include food and drink experiences that you won't want to miss! Along the way, you'll visit the Farmer's Market, walk through the fountains, flagpoles, and bell towers at Bicentennial Mall, pass the Walk of Counties, Sulphur Dell Park, and walk over the top of historic French Lick Creek, as we share the stories of Nashville's early years and its current culture, all with a knowledgeable and fun local guide and a small group of fellow food adventurers!

experiences.title: Uncle Nearest Distillery Tour from Nashville + Whiskey Tastings
experiences.description:
This is the easiest way to visit the award-winning Nearest Green Distillery — home of the Uncle Nearest whiskey brand and one of the most meaningful destinations in American spirits. We provide round-trip transportation from downtown Nashville to the distillery in Shelbyville, so there’s no need to drive, coordinate rentals, or plan logistics.

At the distillery, you’ll enjoy a guided tasting experience and time to explore the beautiful grounds. You’ll learn the story of Nathan "Nearest" Green, the first known African American master distiller and the man who taught Jack Daniel how to make whiskey — a story that’s as powerful as the whiskey is smooth.

This tour is perfect for whiskey lovers, history buffs, and anyone looking to explore beyond the city while soaking up Tennessee’s rich whiskey culture. Everything’s handled — just hop on the bus and enjoy the ride.

experiences.title: Nashville Barrel Co: Whiskey / Wine Chocolate Pairing
experiences.description:
Indulge in a delightful pairing of chocolates with either whiskey or wine. This guided tasting invites you to savor a selection of unique flavors, enhancing your appreciation of the spirits and chocolates. Whether you’re a whiskey enthusiast or a wine lover, this experience offers an engaging way to explore the art of pairing. Enjoy expert insights as you sip and learn in a relaxed setting. Suitable for solo adventurers or small groups, this 30-minute experience is a great way to treat yourself or a friend. 

- Pair chocolates with a choice of whiskey or wine in a guided tasting
- 30-45 minute experience perfect for casual enjoyment
- Engage with a knowledgeable guide and ask questions
- Ideal for individuals or small groups looking for a unique experience

experiences.title: Nashville Bar Crawl with VIP Club Entrance and Bonus Shots
experiences.description:
Make new friends, have fun, and discover Nashville’s buzzing nightlife scene with this 3-Hour Guided Night-Time Nashville Bar & Club Crawl. Your Party Host will bring you to 4 of the best Nashville bars and Lower Broadway nightclubs where you'll have 40 minutes to experience each location. Guests may also choose to stay at the ending location after the tour ends to keep the fun going! 

Bonus shots are included with your tour (at multiple stops!), and enjoy the benefit of not having to wait in line with VIP Entry into each of the bar and club locations. 

The Nashville VIP Bar and Club Crawl has a rotating list of bars and clubs that travelers may visit during their tour. Your Party Host will bring your group to four (4) of the following rotating list of locations on your day of travel:
• Coyote Ugly Saloon
• PBR Rock Bar
• AJ’s Good Time Saloon
• Lucky Bastards Saloon
• Alley Taps
• Dirty Little Secret
• Jason Aldean’s
• Blueprint Cocktail Co.
• Pete's Dueling Pianos

experiences.title: Nashville Hop On Hop Off Distillery Tour
experiences.description:
Your ticket is good for 1 full day and will allow you to access all of Nashville’s hottest breweries and distilleries. The starting location for this tour is at our BUCKWILD Bar at 747 Fesslers Lane, Nashville TN 37210. You are required to board check in at this location prior to boarding the vehicle. Take part in a behind the scenes tour, enjoy a flight of their in-house crafted brew or liquor tasting! Book now and let Cruzzin Nashville create an extraordinary experience for you. 

We make a stop at the following locations: 
* Big Machine Brewery & Distillery
* Nashville Barrel Company
*Standard Proof Whiskey Co.
*Corsair Distillery
*Tennessee Legend Distillery

experiences.title: Goos & Booze | Candy Making + Spirit & Chocolate Tasting
experiences.description:
The Spirit & Bonbon plus Candy-Making experience features multiple (4) spirits paired with our beautiful handmade bonbons. You'll learn a little about each spirit, taste some amazing chocolates, and even get to create your own custom Goo Goo!

 - Tasting plus Insider look at the history of Nashville's official candy bar
 - Hands-on candy making 
 - Classic clusters plus take home apron
 - Chocolate and Spirit pairing activity

Please note: This is a 21 plus experience. All participants must have a valid form of Identification. All parties in the classroom must purchase a ticket.

experiences.title: Hands On Pasta Making Class in Chattanooga
experiences.description: Step into the world of authentic Italian cuisine at Chattanooga’s leading pasta-making school. Here, under the guidance of seasoned chef Debi, who has over 40 years of experience, you'll learn traditional techniques to create silky pasta and delicious sauces from scratch. The intimate class setting ensures personalized attention, allowing you to hone your skills while enjoying engaging stories and laughter. At the end of the session, savor your homemade creations with newfound culinary confidence.

experiences.title: Make Your Own Candle at a Local Brewery in Nashville
experiences.description: Swap the usual “what should we do today?” debate for a fun, hands-on candle making class hosted at a trendy local brewery in Nashville. In this hands-on experience, Instructor Tamee will guide you step by step as you design and pour your own custom candle. You’ll explore different scents, learn how fragrance, wax and wicks work together and create a candle that feels completely personal. And the best news? No experience is needed. Get ready for an experience that is creative, relaxing and way more memorable than sitting through another average happy hour. This class is ideal for couples looking for a unique date night, friends planning a girls’ night out, solo guests who want a calming creative escape and travelers searching for a local activity beyond the typical sightseeing list. Come for the cozy atmosphere, stay for the joy of making something with your own hands and leave with a custom candle that feels totally you.

experiences.title: Pasta Making Cooking Class at a Local Brewery in Nashville
experiences.description: Homemade fettuccine and marinara sauce from scratch, made at a local Nashville brewery. It is the kind of evening that sounds too good to be true until you are actually there doing it. Chef Dylan walks you through every step in a relaxed, no-pressure setting, from kneading and rolling your dough to cutting proper fettuccine strands and building a rich marinara from crushed tomatoes, Parmesan, garlic, red pepper and fresh basil. By the time everything comes together on the plate, the hardest part will be deciding whether to pair it with the pasta or just drink it. Simple ingredients, timeless technique and one of the more unexpected evenings Nashville has to offer.

experiences.title: Sushi Making Cooking Class at a Local Brewery in Nashville
experiences.description: Sushi at a brewery in Nashville. Yes, really. And it is every bit as fun as it sounds. In this beginner-friendly class hosted at a local Nashville brewery, Chef Dylan will take you from never having touched a bamboo mat to confidently rolling a classic California roll and a bright, fresh mango veggie roll that looks every bit as good as it tastes. He breaks down each step without making it feel like a lecture, from getting your rice to the right texture to cutting your sushi into clean, even pieces that hold together beautifully. The setting is casual, the atmosphere is buzzing and by the end of class you will already be planning whose dinner party you are going to show this off at first.

experiences.title: Austin BBQ Tour: 6 Tastings, Michelin Stops & Skip the Line
experiences.description:
Six barbecue stops in East Austin — including a MICHELIN One Star joint and two Bib Gourmand smokehouses — with skip-the-line access at every one and an air-conditioned ride between them. No walking in Texas heat, no three-hour queue, and enough food that most guests tap out before the last plate.

la Barbecue holds a MICHELIN One Star and a line that wraps the building. Micklethwait Craft Meats is a Bib Gourmand honoree and one of Food Network's 25 Best Food Trucks. KG BBQ is chef Kareem El-Ghayesh, a James Beard semifinalist, smoking lamb with Middle Eastern spice. Mum Foods makes the pastrami Texas Monthly's barbecue editor calls the best in the state. Parish Barbecue brings Louisiana heat from a pitmaster who cooked at Franklin.

Then a sixth stop we don't announce. It's sweet. You'll think you're finished eating. You aren't.

Between plates, your guide tells you how East Austin was built and why these blocks became America's most argued-about barbecue.

Come hungry.

experiences.title: At-Home Private Wine or NA Wine Tasting Experience in Austin
experiences.description: We are excited to host your at-home, private tasting featuring local wines and/or non-alcoholic wines in Austin! Get ready to see, swirl, & sip with a expert Sommelier!

experiences.title: 2-Hour Express Austin Food Tour: Local Street Food Flavors
experiences.description:
Meet up in front of Cosmic Saltillo. A lush garden oasis serving up coffee, brews and cocktails in a unique setting that is the definition of what makes East Austin a top destination for locals to hang out at. 

We begin our 2 hour walking food tour with a leisure journey through a small part of the east side and stopping for the first food bite at a local favorite food truck that has grown with the neighborhood. There we will try a delicious falafel bite. 

Our journey will continue with a walk through the neighborhood taking in the Historic sites and street art to our 2nd destination, a place that was once a local convenient store turned brewery. There we try a Tex-Mex bite while learning about how this place became a local favorite brewery that has won multiple awards for their craft and a place that is literally off the beaten path.

We then end our food journey with a sweet, unique bite you can’t find anywhere else, from a local place with an Austin cult following.

experiences.title: Austin Street Art and Street Food Tour with Local Guide
experiences.description:
A tour of Austin’s best street art and most delicious food trucks.
sips, samples and snaps along the way

Includes a drink of choice and two (2) food truck snacks

Want to get to know Austin? First thing you need to know is there’s amazing art and delicious food on just about every street corner. We’re going to drive you around in our luxury Mercedes Sprinter van to learn more about the street art in Austin, and in doing so, learn more about Austin itself.

experiences.title: Grapevine Main Street Food Tour + Winery by Food Tours of America
experiences.description:
Taste your way through Historic Downtown Grapevine, where Texas food, local favorites and wine come together along historic Main Street. Enjoy 8 generous tastings with plenty of food for a meal at handpicked local stops, from Tex-Mex and house-smoked brisket at veteran-owned AJ’s on Main to a sweet treat at an artisan food hall and a custom olive oil trio tasting.

Between bites, discover the people and stories behind Grapevine, from its agricultural and railroad roots to its rise as one of North Texas’ best-known wine destinations. Explore historic Main Street, local landmarks and stories most visitors walk right past.

Finish at Messina Hof Grapevine Winery, inside a re-creation of the historic 1891 Wallis Hotel, with an included splash of Texas wine. Stay afterward and enjoy more time at the winery.

Texas food, local stories and a taste of Grapevine wine country—all in one delicious walk down historic Main Street.

experiences.title: French Cooking Class in Houston (Includes 3-Course Meal)
experiences.description:
Discover the flavors and elegance of French bistro cooking in this immersive culinary class. This 3-course experience celebrates refined techniques and bold flavors.

Your hands-on cooking experience features:

 - First course: Salmon rillettes spread over toasted baguette.
 - Second course: Pork tenderloin with mustard sauce, plus potatoes au gratin and bacon-wrapped green beans.
 - Dessert: A decadent chocolate mousse with silky texture and deep cocoa notes.

This class combines professional instruction with approachable recipes, leaving you confident to recreate French bistro dishes at home. Bring wine or beer to enjoy with your freshly prepared meal.

experiences.title: Upscale Italian Cooking Class in Houston (Includes 4-Course Meal)
experiences.description:
Step into a welcoming Houston kitchen and explore the flavors of refined Italian cooking in this interactive class hosted through Cozymeal. With a maximum of 8 guests, this intimate session highlights timeless techniques across a four-course menu.

The menu you will prepare includes:

- Starter: Zuppa Toscana with sausage, kale and potatoes
- Main course: Chicken marsala with a rich wine sauce and risotto
- Side dishes: Garlic-sautéed broccolini and carrots
- Dessert: Lemon cream cake with layers of citrus cream

With guidance from your local chef, you’ll gain confidence in crafting Italian sauces, risotto and vegetables with finesse. Guests are welcome to bring wine or beer to enjoy with the meal, making this both an educational and celebratory culinary evening.

experiences.title: Cook Authentic Chinese Feast in Houston (Includes 4-Course Meal)
experiences.description:
Step into a welcoming Houston kitchen and experience the flavors of authentic Chinese cooking in this interactive class hosted through Cozymeal. Limited to 8 guests, the workshop introduces essential skills and bold recipes that go beyond takeout.

The menu you will prepare includes:

- Starter: Hot and sour soup with shiitake mushrooms and tofu
- Appetizer: Crispy shrimp toast with a savory shrimp filling
- Main course: Sesame chicken or beef coated with sesame seeds
- Side dish: Vegetable fried rice with colorful vegetables

With step-by-step guidance from your local chef, you’ll gain confidence in seasoning, frying and layering flavors to recreate these dishes at home. Guests are welcome to bring wine or beer to enjoy alongside their meal in a relaxed, small-group setting.

experiences.title: Downtown San Antonio Riverwalk Tamale Cooking Class
experiences.description: Our cooking class offers a unique experience including a cultural presentation on the history of tamales to give each bite more of an impact while you sip on our iconic El Jefe Margarita and enjoy some of our famous guacamole. The tamales that you make alongside your guided instructor will have you leaving inspired to carry the tradition on yourselves at home and with your friends and family.

experiences.title: Fun Pasta Making Class at a Local Brewery in Dallas
experiences.description: Craving bold Southern flavor with a handmade twist? Step into a welcoming local venue where you’ll roll up your sleeves and turn simple ingredients into fresh Cajun butter fettuccine that tastes far better than anything from a box. Store-bought pasta is officially on notice. Chef Dee brings more than 12 years of culinary and hospitality experience, making every step approachable and fun. You’ll mix flour, eggs, oil and salt into silky pasta dough before rolling and cutting your own fettuccine. Then you’ll build a rich Cajun butter sauce with garlic, butter, herbs and bold Louisiana-inspired seasoning before tossing everything together into one irresistible bowl. Along the way, you’ll practice dough preparation, rolling, cutting and sauce-making techniques you can recreate at home. Whether you’re visiting the city or simply looking for a memorable night out, you’ll leave with new kitchen confidence and a dinner worth bragging about.

experiences.title: Houston Distillery Tour with 4 Spirit Tastings
experiences.description:
Discover the art of distilling at William Price Distilling in Houston with a guided tour that provides a behind-the-scenes look at the spirit-making process. Enjoy a tasting flight featuring four of their unique in-house spirits, including whiskey and vodka. This engaging experience is perfect for whiskey enthusiasts, couples, groups, and anyone looking for a memorable outing in Houston. Guests will have access to the production area, barrel room, and tasting room while learning about the distillation process from knowledgeable guides.

- Guided distillery tour with production insights
- Tasting flight of four in-house spirits included
- Available multiple days a week at 6 PM, and 3pm on weekends
- Private tours for groups of 6+ can be arranged upon request

experiences.title: Premiere Wine and Chocolate Experience in Fredericskburg
experiences.description: Indulge in the exquisite art of wine and chocolate pairing at Hill Country Chocolate in Fredericksburg, Texas in the heart of the Texas Hill Country. Over the course of 90 minutes, guests will savor a selection of wines from the exclusive DKM Cellars portfolio, meticulously paired with handcrafted chocolates that highlight unique flavor combinations. The experience begins with an enticing welcome featuring brittles and artisanal chocolates, including a signature cocoa nib goat cheese drizzled with Texas honey and a wall of agave bourbon glazed candied bacon. Led by a knowledgeable chocolatier team, this guided tasting offers insight into chocolate making while you enjoy stunning views of the factory through floor-to-ceiling windows. This is a perfect retreat for chocolate and wine enthusiasts alike. This is considered the ultimate wine and chocolate tasting in the United States.

experiences.title: Private Pink Hummer 2 Limo Wine Tour in Fredericksburg
experiences.description:
Explore Texas Hill Country in style on this private Pink Hummer Limo wine tour. Enjoy visits to three top wineries, with tastings available for purchase at each stop. The experience includes a fun pink party bag, your choice of music, and the option to bring champagne to sip during your ride. With pick-up and drop-off from your Fredericksburg accommodation, this 5-hour tour is perfect for groups looking to enjoy a day of wine tasting and relaxation. Waters are provided, but please note that food is not allowed on board.

- Visit 3 pre-selected top wineries in Texas Hill Country
- Enjoy a private ride in a stylish Pink Hummer Limo
- Bring your favorite champagne and enjoy it during the ride
- Pick-up and drop-off in Fredericksburg city limits included

experiences.title: Sushi Making Cooking Class at a Local Tap Room in Austin
experiences.description: Discover the art of sushi-making in this hands-on cooking class with Chef Melanie, hosted at a local taproom in Austin! Learn step by step how to create three delicious sushi rolls, starting with a perfectly seasoned sushi rice base. Then, layer fresh ingredients to build a creamy veggie roll, a classic California roll, and a bold tuna roll with fresh ahi tuna. Under Chef Melanie’s expert guidance, you’ll practice rolling techniques and experiment with toppings like spicy mayo, black sesame, and Japanese 7-pepper spice. While you perfect your sushi skills, enjoy the lively atmosphere of the taproom, where craft beer is available for purchase to pair with your handmade rolls. Whether you're looking for a unique date night, a social event with friends, or a fun new skill, this sushi-making class is the perfect way to roll, sip, and savor. Book your spot today!

experiences.title: Howdy H-Town EADO Food Tour
experiences.description:
PUBLIC TOURS AVAILABLE OCTOBER - APRIL 

Taste some of the many flavors Houston has to offer as your guide walks you to five delicious venues. Through food, art and history you will see how EADO has evolved from Houston’s original Chinatown into one of the fastest growing neighborhoods in the country.

Sample delicious food from a bakery, a taco stand, a BBQ restaurant, a unique supermarket and a Vietnamese restaurant as you learn about the graffiti art, architecture, public art and green spaces that have helped shape EADO. 

2 miles of total walking with stops along the way.

experiences.title: VIP Breakfast with NASA Astronaut & Space Center Houston Ticket
experiences.description:
Enjoy an exclusive, once-in-a-lifetime experience found only in Houston, where the story of space exploration comes alive through the eyes of a veteran astronaut.

Begin with an elegant brunch catered by Wolfgang Puck Catering, followed by a captivating presentation and private Q&A session with your guest astronaut. Hear firsthand stories, gain rare insight into life in space, and connect with one of the pioneers of human exploration.As a special memento, each guest receives a personalized photograph from the astronaut—a keepsake of an extraordinary encounter.

This unique experience also includes General Admission for the NASA Space Center allowing your group to explore the remarkable legacy of NASA and human spaceflight once breakfast is over! Finish your day with an amazing tour of the NASA Rocket Park —the very place where Apollo 11's famous Saturn V rocket lies for observation. 

Exclusive. Inspiring. Unforgettable. A truly unique Houston experience you won’t find anywhere else.

experiences.title: Downtown Plano Walking Tour with Food and Drink
experiences.description:
We are Texas born and Texas proud. Our tours feature delicious food at 3 different restaurants. We also include 2 alcoholic beverages and a dessert. We offer retail therapy in addition to eating!
Our guides know the area and want to share what makes the neighborhood unique. We provide excellent customer service. Engaging activity for locals and visitors, young and young at heart.

experiences.title: Austin Downtown Private Walking Food Tour With Secret Food Tours
experiences.description: On our Secret Food Tour: Austin, let our guides and your stomach lead you through the busy streets of Downtown Austin for an urban gastronomy experience in the central and historic area of the live music capital of the world. You'll try numerous foods, from our famous BBQ brisket to banana-leaf-wrapped tamales that have remained virtually unchanged since 5000 B.C., plus lots more. Don’t forget our Secret Dish as well!

experiences.title: 1-Hour Distillery Tour and Tasting in Dallas
experiences.description: Start off with a Welcome Water & a tasting of our ROXOR Artisan Vodka, Gin & Bourbon. See and smell the real plants used to make these artisan products in our tasting lounge, that features a Steinway Grand Piano and Contemporary Art of JM Rizzi. Next, let's relax and enjoy a Singature Cocktail. Then head back to the stills and see how these products are made. Not finished yet, as it's back to the lounge for another signature cocktail. Be sure to check out the merchandise room and get a signed bottle to take home.

experiences.title: Stockyards History Tour Fort Worth Pub Crawl
experiences.description:
Cowboys, cattle drives... and beer! On the Cowboy Pub Crawl, you’ll visit four iconic saloons and local watering holes throughout Fort Worth’s famous Stockyards with an expert local guide. Discover the unknown and hilarious tales of Texas’s Wild West and how Fort Worth earned the nickname “Where the West Begins,” - from Texas becoming the Lone Star State to cattle drivers blazing the Chisholm Trail and the exploits of notorious train robbers. Enjoy hidden history and good times with fellow travelers from around the globe.

The tour lasts 2 hours and 15 minutes and begins at the Bill Pickett statue outside Cowtown Coliseum. Tickets must be purchased in advance. Drinks are not included in the ticket price and are available for purchase separately at each bar, so you can choose exactly what you would like to enjoy. Walking is limited to just a few blocks.

So hitch up your wagon and head to the Stockyards for history, drinks, and a Wild West adventure. Cheers!

experiences.title: Private Drunk History Tour: Lunch, Libations & History
experiences.description:
Imagine meeting an old friend who is a historian and a great story teller for drink or two and having him show you around. That's exactly what your Barwalk tour will be like. 

My name is Emzy. I've been guiding guests around San Antonio for over twenty years and I invite you to join me for lunch, a cocktail and an afternoon of all things history. 

We will meet in the lobby of the historic Menger Hotel before a brief walk through and discussion of all things Alamo before heading to the world famous riverwalk for a lunch at a locally owned bistro. We conclude our afternoon back at the Menger Bar for a digestif and private tour of the historic hotel and bar. The Menger Hotel bar that Teddy Roosevelt bellied up to in May of 1898 and recruited many his Rough Riders after a round or two. Drink in hand we will then explore the oldest hotel west of the Mississippi and discover it's many secrets including the history behind why it is reportedly the most haunted hotel in Texas.

experiences.title: From Austin: Hill Country BBQ & Wine Shuttle
experiences.description: Searching for an affordable and fun way to get out to the famous Salt Lick BBQ and two (2) beautiful Texas Hill Country wineries? Look no further! This Hill Country BBQ and Wine Shuttle is great for solo travelers, couples, and small groups. The shuttle departs from the Austin Visitor Center at 10:30AM and heads out to the Driftwood area of the Texas Hill Country approx. 35-45 minutes southwest of Austin. Enjoy comfortable transportation in a Mercedes Sprinter van with a friendly local guide. Spend 45-50 minutes at each stop. Food/drinks not included in the shuttle price; guests pay directly at the restaurant and wineries. NOTE: This is an early lunch so come hungry!

experiences.title: Half-Day Hill Country Wine Shuttle From Austin
experiences.description:
Love wine but don’t want to pay high prices for a private wine tour? This is the one for you! Our Austin/Hill Country Wine Shuttle takes you on a journey to see the beautiful variety Austin has to offer, both geographically and of course, in our amazing wine.

Ride comfortably in our luxury Mercedes Sprinter van with a knowledgeable and friendly local guide. Cruise through the scenic Texas Hill Country and stop at two (2) different award-winning wineries for tastings, then finish up back in Austin proper at your final winery in the St. Elmo Arts District. We’ll take care of the reservations at the wineries, you take care of the tastings. We can lead you to our wineries, but we can't make you drink. Tastings at any of our wineries is completely optional but highly recommended. Please note that each tasting costs $20-25 plus tax/gratuity (paid directly at the wineries).

* Mondays, am I right? … Route may vary to accommodate our local wineries and their hours.

experiences.title: 6-course Walking Food Tour in Dallas History + Cocktail opt.
experiences.description:
Off the beaten path Explore two of the city’s most historic neighborhoods, now including the Bishop Arts District, a lively enclave known for its rich history, thriving small businesses, and award-winning restaurants. Meet local artisans whose creations breathe life into Dallas’ heritage and savor 5 authentic international cuisines, with gluten-free and vegetarian options available at every stop.

As the day unfolds, let the rhythms of music fill the air, reminding you that in Dallas, every note is a testament to unity in diversity. Whether you're joining a group or booking a private tour for a more personalized experience, this immersive journey through the soul of Dallas promises unforgettable flavors, stories, and connections.

Add Some Flavor:
Want a cocktail (or two) along the way? Our drink package is offered with no hefty markup, just enough to keep it flowing and cover our costs.

* Portions are large, so come hungry! 
Private Tours available
Book Today!

experiences.title: FW Stockyards All-Inclusive, Self-Guided Food & History Tour
experiences.description:
Enjoy an all-inclusive Stockyards experience without spending half the day figuring out where to go, what to eat, or which stories are worth your time.

Delectable Dilemmas is a self-guided food and history tour with hand-picked food stops, real Stockyards stories, just-for-fun puzzles, and an easy-to-follow web app that lets you explore at your own pace.

No trail boss herding you. No strangers in your posse. No clock calling the shots. Just enough guidance to explore with confidence, and plenty of freedom to make the day yours.

It’s a guided path, not a guided tour.

Pause for photos. Browse the shops. Watch the cattle drive. Linger over lunch.

Experience a fun, memorable Stockyards day without the guesswork.

experiences.title: Austin South Congress Food Tour with 5 Tastings, Tacos & Sweets
experiences.description:
On our Secret Food Tour: Austin - South Congress, you'll escape the hustle and bustle of Downtown to discover a living, breathing Texan landmark.

Our experienced guides will take you on an eclectic journey through Austin's vibrant and unique dining, nightlife, and shopping district the locals call "SoCo." On your adventure, you're likely to stumble upon delicious diner favorites, smoked BBQ specialties, and refreshing sweet treats. Throughout the experience, you'll see firsthand why this town is so fabulously "weird" and learn why we want to keep it that way! South Congress isn't just any old street in Austin, it's the artery that leads straight to the heart of Texas.

experiences.title: All-Inclusive Social Wine Tour
experiences.description:
Enjoy an immersive all-inclusive carefree day as you travel on our vintage open-air Cable Car, Limo Bus, or Luxury Limo Van! Our guides are trained on the wine and the history of the area. They will be with you all day long to help explain the wines, the experience, and show you the insider’s way through each winery. 

The tour lasts five hours with lunch and all wine tastings provided. 

*Even though we limit our numbers to 6 per booking, this is a public tour that includes up to 25 people on the vehicle. Vehicle type is determined the day of the tour based on the number of guests and weather permitting*

*Most tours start with a Cable Car pickup and finish with the comfort of an enclosed vehicle.*

*Itinerary is decided a day in advance based on availability. Subject to change from the listed locations.

experiences.title: Dallas Food Tour with 5 Local Food Tastings in Deep Ellum Area
experiences.description:
Y’all ready to taste the real soul of Dallas? Step into the artsy, mural-filled streets of Deep Ellum for a small-group food tour led by local insiders. You’ll savor 5 iconic tastings that showcase why Dallas is a BBQ and Tex-Mex powerhouse. Indulge in cowboy-style BBQ brisket, delicious traditional Adobada Taco, a spicy cup of chili con carne, cheesy chicken quesadillas, and a boozy pecan pie with a Southern kick. Finally, of course, as for any of our Secret Food Tour, enjoy our delicious Secret dish. 

Whether you’re a BBQ fanatic or new to Southern eats, this tour delivers delicious bites, cultural flair, and true Texas hospitality, no cowboy boots required!

Our guides will lead you through the art-filled streets of Deep Ellum. As always, there's our Secret Dish, which will only be revealed on the tour!

experiences.title: San Antonio Ranger Creek Brewstillery Tour
experiences.description:
Our popular brewstillery tour is two tours in one! You’ll learn how we make beer and how we make bourbon. This intimate, immersive experience includes a detailed guided tour and three samples of our products. Designated drivers can attend for $5 and kids under 6 can attend for free. Tour lasts approximately 1 hour and are limited to ten guests to provide proper social distancing.

Add an optional $20 at the door to join a VIP Whiskey Sampling Experience after the regular tour where we sample two future releases straight from the barrel.

experiences.title: Texas Hill Country Olive Oil and Balsamic Vinegar Tasting
experiences.description: We have curated a selection of products that will pair nicely with our signature Extra Virgin Olive Oil and Balsamic Vinegar to give you a unique and tantalizing treat for your taste buds.

experiences.title: Fredericksburg Wine Tour with Three Winery Stops Plus Lunch
experiences.description: Come enjoy what the Fredericksburg wine region has to offer with this guided wine tour package. The hill country boasts over 60 wineries with more being built each year. This tour is perfect for couples, groups, bachelorette parties and wine enthusiasts.

experiences.title: Austin Food Tour with Authentic Flavors, Tacos & 5 Food Tastings
experiences.description:
Join us on our Secret Food Tour of Downtown Austin and let our expert guides and your taste buds take you on a culinary adventure through the bustling streets in the heart of the live music capital of the world. Discover the flavors of Texas as you indulge in a variety of dishes, including the famous BBQ brisket and Instagram-worthy breakfast tacos, among many other mouthwatering options.

Or escape the hustle and bustle of Downtown to discover a living, breathing Texan landmark on our Secret Food Tour of South Congress. Discover Austin's vibrant and unique dining, nightlife, and shopping district that the locals call "SoCo" and stumble upon delicious diner favorites, smoked BBQ specialties, and refreshing sweet treats. See firsthand why this town is so fabulously "weird" and learn why we want to keep it that way!

experiences.title: Austin Small Group Taco Food Tour
experiences.description:
Welcome to the Austin Taco Food Walking Tour, a perfect way to experience the best of Austin in a single afternoon. This tour combines the must-see city attractions with the deliciousness of Austin's taco scene.

As you stroll through the city, you'll discover the hidden gems of Austin, including the iconic Willie Nelson statue, the historic Driskill Hotel, and the Austin Public Library, which is an architectural masterpiece. You'll also get to see the Congress Street Bridge, a truly "eye batting" experience that only Austin can offer.

Next is the taco prowl. Austin is renowned for its amazing taco scene, and this tour is the perfect way to sample some of the best. You'll visit a nice variety of different taco stops, each offering a variety of mouth-watering options, including grilled steak, shrimp macha, pork, grilled chicken, vegetarian, and many more. And for dessert, you'll get to indulge in a delicious doughnut from a local bakery.

experiences.title: San Antonio Centre Food Tour of 6 Tastings with Tacos & Ice Cream
experiences.description:
On our Secret Food Tour: San Antonio, you'll discover a picturesque foodie oasis that winds its way through the heart of Texas' second largest city.

Our experienced guides will take you on a foodie adventure through bustling Downtown San Antonio, an area steeped in more than 300 years of history and heritage! On your journey, you'll sample an array of handmade hispanic specialties at family-owned businesses and see where the locals eat while avoiding chain restaurants and tourist traps. Throughout the experience, you'll learn firsthand what "Tex-Mex" actually is while enjoying it in the city in which it originated while also being enchanted by local landmarks such as San Fernando Cathedral, the River Walk, and the Alamo along the way. In fact, we're pretty sure that you'll remember more than that storied building by the time your journey is complete!

experiences.title: Dallas Uptown Foodie Tour + Trolley by Food Tours of America
experiences.description:
Taste your way through Uptown Dallas with 9 generous tastings at 5 restaurants, a ride aboard a real historic streetcar and a behind-the-scenes trolley barn experience. Come hungry for Moroccan-Lebanese, Thai, Southern comfort, Tex-Mex and Guatemalan flavors—with plenty of food for a meal.

Then climb aboard an authentic McKinney Avenue streetcar—not a reproduction—and hear the remarkable stories behind the vintage cars that still roll through Dallas, including Rosie, the fleet’s oldest car, which came all the way from Portugal.

When available, go behind the scenes at the McKinney Avenue Trolley Car Barn, a working facility not generally open to the public. See where the historic cars are restored and maintained and meet some of the people who keep them rolling.

Uptown Eats! launched in 2011 as Dallas’ original walking food tour, bringing together great food, neighborhood stories and a piece of Dallas history you can actually ride.

experiences.title: Houston Downtown Food Tour with 5 Tastings of Tradition & Fusion
experiences.description:
Skip the tourist traps and taste why Downtown Houston wears the crown as the most internationally influenced food scene in Texas, one bite at a time.

The walk starts at the Historic Clock Tower before diving into an Italian Cajun fusion masterpiece: smokey crumbled spicy boudin, thick cut crispy bacon, and melted cheese on a toasted crust. From there, stroll through Market Square Park, a living testament to the city's transformation and growth, then head into Houston's subterranean Underground for Brisket Eggrolls, a bold Asian Southern mashup. A walk down Main Street brings street art and urban energy before a stop at a local Houstonian favorite for a Quesabirria Taco. The tour wraps at the Historic POST Market with a sweet treat and rooftop views to cool down, plus a mystery Secret Dish revealed only on the day

By the end, you'll have tasted five of Houston's most talked about bites and picked up a real feel for the culture and traditions behind them.

experiences.title: Fort Worth Stockyards Foodie Tour by Food Tours of America
experiences.description:
Come hungry and discover the Stockyards through its food, legends and places most visitors walk right past. Enjoy 6 tastings with plenty of food for a meal, including a BBQ brisket taco, Choctaw fry bread, chicken-fried steak slider, Texas-sized onion ring, smoked brisket elote and cajeta-filled churros.

Between bites, follow Cowtown’s story from cattle drives and cowboys to rodeos, outlaws and old saloons. See Texas Longhorns on Exchange Avenue, hear about Bonnie and Clyde’s Stockyards connection and discover the world’s first indoor rodeo at Cowtown Coliseum.

When available, enjoy a VIP visit with the innkeeper at historic Miss Molly’s, a former bordello known for its colorful past, reported hauntings and ghostly legends.

Texas food, legendary stories and a side of the Stockyards most visitors never discover.

experiences.title: Taste of the Strand all-inclusive family friendly food tours
experiences.description:
Looking for a casual, fun, and unique way to get to know the Strand District? Book a Galveston food tour for a taste of local flavors! This is a fun, casual way to get familiarized with the local eateries in and around the downtown Galveston Island Strand District.
Galveston’s Orginal food tour with the most tasting stops! While on the tour, you get to explore Galveston Island like the locals do and experience the local food with your ticket purchase and drinks available. Our menus change seasonally. You’re sure to leave with a smile on your face and a full stomach.

This intimate experience gives you a taste of true southern charm in Galveston, TX. Book today.

experiences.title: Fredericksburg Wine Trolley - Air Conditioned and Heated!
experiences.description:
Experience Fredericksburg's Best Wine Trolley aboard our Air Conditioned and Heated Wine Trolleys. 

All Inclusive 3 Wineries and Lunch - Winery stops include all tasting fees at 3 popular wineries and a delicious lunch. Our hosts take care of you and your reservations at each popular winery. Return to the Visitor's Center with all the wonderful memories, new friends, wine and souvenirs collected along the way.

Our pickup location is at the Visitors Center - centrally located in the midst of the Historic/Shopping District with free parking.

Wineries visited will be three of the following: Texas Wine Collective, Hye Meadow, Longhorn Cellars, Meierstone Winery, Pontotoc Picnic, Adega Vinho!

Please note: for small groups of under 8 people reserved, we may use a luxury coach for your comfort. Please advise if anyone is mobility impaired or has dietary restrictions.

experiences.title: Waco Foodie Tour: Taste the City Like a Local
experiences.description: Enjoy Waco's top food tour and experience its award winning culinary scene. You will taste some of the best food the city has to offer on this tour. Relax, let us show you around the food fare of our wonderful city in a comfortable air conditioned and heated van!

experiences.title: Dallas Deep Ellum Food & Street Art Tour by Food Tours of America
experiences.description:
Eat your way through Deep Ellum, where legendary music, bold food and street art come together in one distinctly Dallas experience.
